Name: "Adamai seimons"
Identity: Fighting his way to the top
Known History:
Adopted and raised in a circus in the mastrazs settlements,adamai grew attached to the circus crew who he saw as his own family,who raised took care of him in return as he grew so did his stranght,he started participating in dangerous stunts and plays alongside his family and learning with them,eventually he became stronger than most man in the circus,and that caught the owner attention,one night he took adamai to ring wich he won and it paid well. 

If he got himself hurt,just a practice injury,yet in one fight adamai lost, when he woke up,the owner had fled with his money and all the circus money, leaving everyone desperate. 
But adamai endured,recovered from his wounds and went after any big fight opportunity he could find,he would recover everything 
Fight all the away to the top if necessary.
Physical Description: "An young man,6'3ft has a Slim and athletic physique,black eyes and brown eyes,at first glance you will always notice he talks to other people while lowering his posture."

Name: "Kage"
Known History:
- Born in the forests surrounding Sakai, after a failed Kitsune expedition from the south.
- Her parent, instead of leaving her to the elements choose to excommunicate themselves from Sakai
- Years later the child would return to Sakai, now changed and alone
- Taking up the name "Kage", she'd become a Disciple under the leader of Sakai, seeking to learn balance and perhaps one day reverse whatever have caused their body to change
- Despite never fully fitting in, she'd find companionship with several new pupils who see her for the warrior she is, and not the monster that others see
- Having reached a plateau in her cultivation, her master suggested her to leave for the deserts. To either overcome her trials, or to do what many before her has and slaughter Yokai.
- Seeking a better alternative for the people of Sakai, she'd try and overcome her trials, only to be left in a pool of her own blood. Not long after she was caught in an all too familiar storm, lifting her to the worldhelm.
Physical Description:
After a ritual that pushed her to her limits, Kage now resembles more of a person and less of a walking nightmare. Standing at roughly five feet four, the young Half-Kitsune seems far healthier than when she first appeared on the Worldhelm. She now possesses an athletic physique befitting her station, no longer marred by the side-effects of her training. While her almost glowing cyan eyes remain alongside the foxfire burning within her body, her expressions are no longer muted, wearing her emotions far more freely.

Her wardrobe consists of her old bodysuit, now far more distinguishable from her pitch black skin, however she no longer hides herself behind an oversized poncho, opting instead to wear a sleeveless open vest. Her attire is dotted with white and grey geometrical shapes and symbols, in the past she marked herself as such as to not truly disappear in pitch black darkness, nowadays however it’s simply to remember the past.

Name: "Trillion"
Identity: Demon with a Heart of Gold
Known History: The demon known as "Trillion" has been around for a time immeasurable by human standards. Once the leader of a great Circle, he has long since lost his people to the many horrors of the Third Layer of Idyll. No longer a Witch of the Circles, "Trillion" finds himself seeking a new way of surviving, as well as a new flock to shepherd. A sudden revelation has sparked an ideology of pacifism; if the great Kuzunoha has been corrupted by madness, then he will bring peace to her furious hunger through self-example. He now serves to guide others onto this same journey. And, if you ask nicely, he may just let you know his name.
Physical Description: "Trillion" stands at a modest height of 5'9", with a slim, athletic frame akin to that of a young adult. His youthful appearance is marked by his vibrant blue hair and glowing golden eyes; however, he is also easily distinguished by his demonic features that have manifested with his time as a revered Witch of Aaruna. Equally vibrant blue scales fleck across his face, neck, and limbs; and his slender fingers are complemented by long and sharp, black nails. Despite this, there is an overall welcoming warmth to his composure.

Name: 'Dr" Maxwel Luuv
Known History:
-Parabellum field researcher
-Pirate Radio host
-Squatting in a super condemned mcmansion
Physical Description: Flashily dressed scientist with pink/purple died hair constantly carrying gadgets

Name: (the last) Stroke (on the canvas
Known History:
Two things are quickly noticeable about Stroke: They have a hunger for all experiences, even the bad ones, enjoying them quite thoroughly, for one. Two, they are an oddball. Stroke, or "The last stroke on the canvas" in full, seems to look at reality a bit differently. Using very odd metaphors, they see possibilities rather than facts.

Their history is traceable to the settlement of Snowmaw in Kor'Tarion, where Stroke was found near Spirit's Grove, nearly frozen to death but laughing in the cold snow. Stroke quickly picked up language and told about "being here in this wonderful realm since my old job kicked me out". 

Soon enough, Stroke turned out to be a Fae that was sort of trapped in the Mortal Realm. A peculiar talent they brought along was to be able to use their surroundings to 'paint' magic into existence.

For now, Stroke is using their abilites to travel the world and help. And experience all they can. Except webs. Webs suck.
Physical Description:
Stroke is a middle-sized individual with their 1.7 m, having blue hair "like the droplets of dew on a sunny day" like they will tell you. They have a scrawny build, but can swing their staff-sized staff quite easily. In their face, they are spotting freckles beneath their violet eyes, the freckles sometimes looking like splashes of color.  

They also have a very peculiar way of speaking, using metaphors and personifications that seem odd but seem to hold meaning for them.

Name: 45TON
Known History:
Raised in a Cabre orphanage with his twin sister, both showed rare psychic potential that caught corporate eyes. Recruited young by Tubal & Cain, the twins became TEMPS, contracted for weapon tests and Soul Network operations. Over time her talents soon outshone his, yet the two would compliment each others shortcomings, becoming a twin duo of some renown.

During a classified experiment, something went wrong. She never woke up. Some say her mind lingers in the Network. Others say she’s gone. After that Tubal & Cain kept her body, and him, under watch, sending him on missions that left him increasingly more augmented. 

Details after that are unclear. Records show his apartment was struck by an electrical outage. When next he opened his eyes, he was aboard the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Aston stands just short of six feet tall, with a lean, athletic build. His hair is a dull silver, usually tied back and hidden beneath the demon fox-like mask he rarely removes. Most of his body is covered in dark tactical gear and red armor plating that’s seen its share of wear and tear. A katana rests across his back, and faint mechanical seams run along his arms.

Name: A'shibah
Known History:
- Born the seventh son of a Hiear merchant family.
- Family was killed; but used his body to shield his twin brother, Levan.
- Levan failed a ritual to revive the family, A'shibah took the consequence by making a deal with Akhir.
- A'shibah promised his soul to oblivion, but Musta'khan managed to save him by binding the brothers together.
- Now lives inside of Levan, sharing the same soul vessel.
Physical Description: A'shibah is tall, even for Hiear standards, and stands at an impressive 6'3" (7'2" with his ears perked). His hair and fur are a shock of white, as is iconic for the Hiear of his family, and his eyes are a piercing gold. Though fraternal twins, A'shibah is actually quite different than his brother, Levan, putting the obvious hereditary genes aside. He seems to bear an oppressive aura of intimidation and despair as he rarely speaks anymore; however, despite this, there still appears to be a hint of good and kindness about him, especially with regards to his brother.

Name: AVA
Known History:
-Ava is an Elden automaton, created for the purpose of entertaining an Elden Child. She and the Elden child regularly played pretend. Where she began to absorb the ideals of a heroic soldier.

-The Rapture came, and she was entombed in the chaos and destruction. Refusing to disobey her rules to wind herself up, she fell into a deep slumber.

-She was awoken by the New Empire, now truly believing her instilled values to be fact, she worked as a soldier under the new empire. Attempting to become a hero unknowingly chasing the goal she had before she lost her memories.

-During her service, she began to surpass the rules her creators had given her, becoming more independent. Even learning to wind her own mechanism.

-She was dishonorably discharged for disobeying her superiors orders to save more lives.

-Unable to comprehend her being discharged for doing the right thing, she joins the adventurer's guild, assuming proving herself would allow her to return to the New Empire in glory.
Physical Description: 5'2 | Unknown Material Sheen on skin | Red Eyes | New Empire styled outfit with honor badges (buttons)

Name: Abaddon Throné
Identity: 𝒯𝒽𝑒 𝐿𝑜𝓈𝓉 𝒫𝓇𝒾𝓃𝒸𝑒 𝑜𝒻 𝒯𝒽𝑒 𝐵𝓁𝒶𝒸𝓀
Known History:
A man cared for by SIA. He is seen roaming the streets with a woman who is presumed to be his caretaker, though he claims she's his 'Retainer'. He's infamous as a strange man, claiming to be the "Prince of the Obsidian Throne" or the "Maleficent Heir of Terror and Shadow".

Little is known about him, and he is not often allowed to speak to others. 

> ᴛʜᴏꜱᴇ ɪɴ ꜱɪᴀ ᴡᴏᴜʟᴅ ᴋɴᴏᴡ ᴀʙᴀᴅᴅᴏɴ ᴀꜱ ᴀ ᴄʜɪʟᴅ ꜰᴏᴜɴᴅ ɪɴ ᴛʜᴇ ꜱᴛʀᴇᴇᴛ ʀᴏᴜɢʜʟʏ 17 ʏᴇᴀʀꜱ ᴀɢᴏ. ʜᴇ'ꜱ ʙᴇᴇɴ ɪɴ ꜱɪᴀ ᴄᴜꜱᴛᴏᴅʏ ꜱɪɴᴄᴇ ʜᴇ ᴡᴀꜱ 13, 11 ʏᴇᴀʀꜱ ᴀɢᴏ. ʙᴇꜰᴏʀᴇ ᴛʜᴀᴛ, ʜᴇ ʙᴏᴜɴᴄᴇᴅ ᴀʀᴏᴜɴᴅ ʙᴇᴛᴡᴇᴇɴ ᴏʀᴘʜᴀɴᴀɢᴇꜱ ɪɴ ʜᴏꜱᴘɪᴛᴀʟ, ᴄʟᴀɪᴍɪɴɢ ʜᴇ ʜᴀᴅ ᴅʀᴇᴀᴍꜱ ᴏꜰ ᴅᴀʀᴋɴᴇꜱꜱ, ᴀɴᴅ ʜᴇ ᴡᴀꜱ ʙᴏʀɴ ᴛᴏ ʙᴇ ᴀ ʀᴜʟᴇʀ. ʀᴇᴘᴏʀᴛꜱ ꜱᴀʏ ʜᴇ'ꜱ ɪɴᴊᴜʀᴇᴅ ᴍᴀɴʏ ɪɴ ʜɪꜱ ᴏᴜᴛʙᴜʀꜱᴛꜱ ᴡʜᴇɴ ʜɪꜱ ᴅᴇʟᴜꜱɪᴏɴꜱ ᴀʀᴇ ᴘʀᴇꜱꜱᴇᴅ, ᴀɴᴅ ᴡʜᴇɴ ʜᴇ ᴡᴀꜱ 10, ᴇᴠᴇɴ ᴋɪʟʟᴇᴅ ꜱᴏᴍᴇᴏɴᴇ.
Physical Description:
Abaddon is a delusional man dressed in royal looking costume garb. He's dressed culturally out of place for his home of Myist. He's dramatic and verbose, even if he's not always accurate in his descriptions. His belief in his delusion almost makes it feel real.

He has brown hair with bangs that drape over the horned circlet/eyecover he wears. He's just over six feet, of mostly lean muscle.

Name: Abhila (Asva)
Known History: Born in a small village on the edges of the Tiger Lands. Asva growing up grew fascinated with music and how it can influence animals. He decided go around his village showing his talents off being able to use music and movements to have snakes mimic himself. After entertaing quite a few common folks. Though one day Asva had gotten an oppertiuny of a lifetime, show his talents with snakes to the Great House Ijya, which sadly ended up being his biggest mistake. When the moment comes he ends up to perform to the head of the house herself, though sadly she was not amuse when she saw Asva's performance not really understanding the snakes instead making them mimic his movenments. For this insult, Bhaviini ended up cursing Asva giving him a "Snakes Tounge" and banishing him from the House which also includes his home village. Without much left Asva was about to take the chance at the Tiger Lands before getting swept up to the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: A new form as Asva is now a snake, taking a form of a spirit from the Viper Gardens.

Name: Abigail Byrne
Known History: She grew up in Snowmaw with her grandmother, she has worked as a guide with the help of her raven Aoife, and when she was younger she would help out at Hela’s shop gathering herbs.
Physical Description: A pale woman with red hair and dark eyes usually dressed in warm clothes a cloak

Name: Absalom Kasand
Known History:
- Born in Stratford to migrant Leirsin parents
- Gloomy as a kid, was sensitive to the bad vibes his foresight gave, along with not having many friends because he tended to be around where misfortune struck
- Nowadays acts optimistic, a little overcompensating but wanting to be positive in the face of adversity
- Studied with the Disciples of Wisdom, likes to have a breadth of knowledge, including both Spiritualism as well as channeling the stone directly
- Became eager to please the Beacon, and when the Beacon got desperate to send his disciples out for More Wisdom he signed up immediately
- One of those efforts threw him into researching the Runewall, hence his arrival on the Worldhelm
Physical Description: Slender 5'3" Leirsin with long brown hair, wearing a simple dress shirt, a vest, and slacks, usually has a briefcase and a few books on him.

Name: Adelaide Cartwright
Identity: Blossom in the Shade of Desire
Known History:
- Eldest daughter of a single mother who wants her children to have a better life than she had
- Is found to have a talent for Virelia, opening up possibilities for their family to escape their ill-fortune
- In order to pay for Ada's entry into Galius Military Academy, her mother mortgages their estate. The family's hopes are pinned on Ada either earning prestige or marrying into nobility
- Ada finds an unexpected opportunity for work from the Rehinsfel family, keeping tabs on their wayward daughter while she attends the boarding school
- When that same daughter goes missing, Adelaide chases her and ends up swept into the Runewall
Physical Description: Blonde with hair tied into a braid behind her, Adelaide wears armor borrowed from Galius academy. She has all the hallmarks of an honor roll student - except for the whispers that her family aren't real nobility.

Name: Adelphel Durand
Identity: A Noble Soul Believing in the Brilliance of Tomorrow
Known History: A armored man like that of a knight in appearance, they travel around Kor'Tarion to and fro just aiding people along the way. From things like protecting travelers from bandit muggings to aiding with work on a farm as a form of payment. They say they don't have a destination for their travel or don't remember exactly what journey they set off for, but they know it involved meeting or helping the people.
Physical Description: A man standing at about 5'11, medium length dark brown hair and a darker olive skin tone with hazel hued eyes, they have an odd faint glow about them in both eyes and body. Holding a genuinely young and kind expression that easily shifts to earnest one in times of hardship and danger. Their hands are somewhat bruised and rough from work and battle. They are very well acquainted to physical labor of many kinds for long hours just to get by during travels and it shows.

Name: Aelina Van Deivoet
Identity: Pressured Blade with a Storm Inside
Known History:
Awlina is a third generation lost of the house of Van Deivote. A noble house in one of the underwater cities of Ripplith that has a connection to storms. They act alongside the wardens to protect the settlement from the dangers of deep. Aelina herself is the current heir to the house and would take over when her mother retires or dies. For now though, she has been sent to Gnosis Academy to be a part of the house of Treasures where she became the Regalia known as ᵀʰᵉ CloudBurst.

Those form the academy would know her for the scandal of her being rejected at the ceremony of binding. This leads to her declining grades and sudden crash of her self confidence that led her to remodel courses on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Aelina is a medium height woman with straight purple hair that always seems well conditioned and cared for. She has two black horns on the top of her head and her violet eyes seem glimmer and shine with something like electricity. She is usually dressed in her school uniform but when she isn’t she wears a formal, almost regal, military like regalia. On her hands there are 9 rings, one on every finger except the ring finger of her left hand.

Name: Aer Drasil
Known History:
Aer Drasil was a fearless huntress and protector in her mortal life, renowned for her unwavering resolve and mastery of the spear. She perished heroically in a grand battle, defending her people from a relentless foe. Upon awakening in Idyll, she found solace in Asga, a realm of contests and camaraderie. However, the sanctuary was corrupted when madness consumed Idyll, turning friendly duels into a cycle of endless bloodshed.  

Determined to preserve what remained of hope and justice, Aer took up her spear once more. Now she protects wayward souls and fighting to uphold light against the growing darkness. Driven by the memories of her mortal sacrifices and an unbreakable will, she stands as a beacon of defiance in a realm descending into chaos.
Physical Description: Aer stands tall at 6'0", her posture ever straight, radiating poise and grace. Her long, curly brown hair cascades down past her waist, framing her commanding presence. She dons armor adorned in rich tones of brown, brass, and deep blue, exuding both strength and elegance. Black feathers accentuate her ensemble, lending her an air of formidable beauty and otherworldly majesty.

Name: Aerah
Known History: She would often get picked on growing up though because she would never speak to other kids. This was because she was told she was not allowed to by her parents, and she never understood why until she got older. In her preteens the bullying pushed her to a breaking point causing her to yell out and hospitalize several of her bullies, one of which succumbed to the injuries. The results of this pushed her family into debt, her mother eventually turning to try and gamble to get that "one big score" to pay everything off. That score never came however and the debt just grew. Someone in 777LC saw Aerah's potential between her skating abilities and though digging up dirt on her vocal "gift". The roped her into skating in their derby games that people bet on to work off the family debt.
Physical Description: Aerah is a 19 year old girl who is 5' 7". She has long black hair with a bit of green tones in it. She is typically walking around in a body suit and fancy skates to allow her quicker movement.

Name: Agata Nergath
Known History: Agata is from the kingdom of Merrane, from a town on the outskirts of its influence known Hidela. She grew up near a military dump where they abandoned  old and broken machines  from the academy's test sites. . However, she did not approve of the way Merrane was using its magitech. Living on the border, she had seen what suffering the common people in Karlsgaurd and her own tone where facing. The last straw came when her cousins where killed in a raid on Ionian. It was then that she broke in to the forbidden decomishened mech side of the yard and took one of the older model suits for her own. The government went after to recover the mech and she took off, shaking them in a Realmstorm where she ended up in the strangest place.
Physical Description: Agata is a young woman standing at about 5'10 in height. She has long blonde hair tied back in a pony tail most times. Her clothes usually are stained with oil and grease as the scent of machinery follows her around.

Name: Agrippa Molide
Known History: Saturday morning cartoons and after-school specials would make a strong impression on the young girl, inspiring her to eat her veggies, workout out, listen to her mom, and NEVER do drugs. With a health-concious mother, this would lead to Agrippa growing up to be 6'7, strong, but easy-going, having no doubt missed the episode where P.I. Joe explained that junk food and energy drinks were no good. Now, with the belief that the cool wrestlers on TV were the paragons of good, she's joined the TWF as the amazing **PUNCHRIOT**, here to tell kids to stay in school and avoid peer pressure. Despite her straight-edge lifestyle, however, the doctors at the TWF might have done something to her without her knowing, to give her more 'oomph', which would explain her wilder ring behavior at times...
Physical Description:
Agrippa stands at an impressive 6'7,  accentuated by a good deal of muscle to her tanned body, something she credits to healthy living (as she understands it). When out of costume, her dark brown hair is left in a messy mane, and her choice of clothing can be described as lazy, with pyjamas, hoodies, and sweatpants being the preferred sort of getup. This tends to somewhat hide her musculature, while her slouch conceals some of her height.

As Punchriot, she's much more impressive in the ring. Standing up straight and proud while flexing, to impress the crowds, she sports a red wrestler's getup, with boots, armbands, white kneepads, and a colorful mask over her eyes, while her hair is kept in a ponytail. Any belt she may have recently won would be worn at her waist.

Name: Ai Xianyu
Known History:
She was born a bishi'e to an isolated village and temple on the edge of Wujing Guo's Skysea. Many great things were expected of her because of the nature of her birth, but her eyes are clouded with an unusual fog, which she believes to be drawn from heaven's ire.

She is encouraged to train and meditate, reading the ancient texts left behind by cultivators long past that survived the war and listening to the whispers of techniques passed down by these cultivators through the Skysea's echoes, becoming in touch with the earth, seeing through her proverbial darkness, and gaining an affinity for Abyss Cultivation.

Through the echoes of the Skysea, she learns of a mysterious ancient vessel that fought alongside gods in the war against Heaven. Overwhelmed by the increasing pressure of her responsibility, she finds her chance to prove herself, leaving the village in search of this ship. 

Losing consciousness after a vicious storm, she comes to, finding herself by a gentle fountain...
Physical Description:
A bishi'e standing at 4'9" with purple scales and long flowing violet hair. She covers her misty red eyes with a blindfold and her jagged antlers with a cloth covered in gold trims. She typically wears a dark blue uniform specifically tailored to her martial arts style, with several gold trims and a long pendant with two bright gems dangling between her neck.
Her tail has a red ribbon wrapped around the edge.

Name: Aiden Kane
Known History: A product of both the Moon and merged essences. He seeks to find the light in all darknesses.
Physical Description: Tall, nearly seven feet tall. His face is always hidden behind a wide brimmed straw hat. His fingers are long and slender and wrap around the handle of his Katana nearly twice.

Name: Aijing Minli
Known History:
He was a healer back in Xuanwu city, curing people of fostbite and other ailments they gained when returning from the mines.
Now, he is exploring the boat, hoping to find out why he was chosen
Physical Description: Often described as frail, standing at 4´9, and not a single developed muscle found on his body. Often hunched over and looking around nervously, potentially scared even.

Name: Aile Forrester
Known History:
* A dancer and songstress from Kor'Tarian, known as the performer Viola De La Mariposa of the Butterfly House Theatre.

* An apothecaries granddaughter, a dear friend soothed her grieving heart when her grandmother passed. 

* She'd spent her first few months upon the Worldhelm searching for her missing friend , hoping to reunite him with his sister.

* Anytime her spirit waned on her journey,  she found herself reinvigorated by the people of the ship.

* Eventually, in an encounter facing off against the demon Anatherium she had found her friend, brainwashed and puppetted. 

* Through the aid of her companions , she was finally able to fulfil the promise she'd made, and now works to provide the same support to others that was bestowed to her.

* She now alternates between performances, her duties as a Goldhearted and spending time with her found family.

"Any storm you weather, I'll dance by your side."
Physical Description:
An average sized woman of 5'5 , Aile's flowing brunette hair is let loose.

Wearing a hair-pin that was a gift from her time in the Butterfly House Theatre, the young dancer wears a practice yet flashy garb accented by blues and blacks.

The garnet necklace she wears had been the final gift she received from her grandmother before passing, and Aile rarely takes it off.

A friendly and empathetic young woman,  she has moments of self-doubt and has a habit of feeling inclined to take on the burdens of others.

On the odd occasion a more playful, flirty side rears its head.

Name: Akahime Fuyumi
Known History:
- Serpentine yokai who guides lost souls through frozen Aldistir.

- Found the glowing Night Lantern at the Grasping Tree.

- Became a beacon for the lost- and threats.

- Trained to protect the souls she ferries.

- Hunts godblood corrupted beings to free them from torment.

- Thanks to the Worldhelm, she now travels between realms, continuing her sacred task.
Physical Description:
Akahime, the Winter Serpent, is an ethereal being with a long, serpentine lower body that is is cloaked in obsidian-black scales, coiling with silent grace across the frozen wastes she calls home. Towering and poised, her upper half bears the countenance of a pale, silver-haired Ald—yet her piercing gaze and the faint, otherworldly glow in her pale eyes betray something far older and deeper.

She dons ornate, silver-on-black armor. Flowing silks trail from beneath the plate, catching ghostlight as she moves. In her hands, she wields the Night Lantern, a staff bound with chains and a crimson lantern that bleeds spectral mist. Its flickering light draws spirits near, some seeking peace—others, prey.

Name: Akai Katsumi
Known History:
The town of Ogawa had little to offer to young Katsumi, who was seemingly born into this world with a hunger for strength. From a young age, she had childish dreams of reaching the heights of cultivation.
Her family never cared much for her, and the inverse was also true. She left the household early into her teenage years, and sought out her hometown's monastery to learn what she could about the practices of cultivation. As she would find out, however- and much to her disappointment- the monastery's teachings were mostly of the non-combative variety. nevertheless, it was her one insight into the world of cultivation- however meager and fragmented.
She learned many things during her stay, and even came to regard the other people within the monastery dearly, but ultimately they could not sate her desire. She left eight years after she had joined, to pursue strength by her lonesome in the absence of a teacher, hoping to one day come back an accomplished warrior.
Physical Description:
A young girl with hair almost as bright and fierce as her temper, whose short stature (5'5'') is more than made up for by her physical prowess. She wears mostly practical, light clothing that leaves her body free to move unimpeded. 
Her hands, on the contrary, are clad by two massive steel gauntlets, engraved with various Kanji and other mystical symbols. One would think that they must surely rob her fingers of their precision and range of motion. And they would be right to do so.

Name: Akali Amari
Identity: Noble wishing to be someone else
Known History:
- Daughter of Councilman Rabi Amari

- Was taught all her life skills in order to inherit his position. Including use of the family heirloom.

- She always yearned to do something more, but relented due to the roles importance.

- Outside of her fathers ear and sight, she typically hanged out with the locals.

- Eventually was caught and then sent to become a student of the Order of the Sealing Sands. A place where many councilman came before and to keep a stricter eye on her.

- Eventually news of the expedition of the Rune Wall reaches the city.

- In order to not seem small and weak before the other cities in Grestazs, they send some students of the college to the wall to join in their own expedition. Akail was involved in it and ventured with others into the storm.

- Made it to the Worldhelm where she has a chance to enjoy things without her father watching her.
Physical Description: Akali Amari appears as a 5'7" woman. She wears an assortment of jewelry on her character. A bone necklace with a golden medalion hanging off of it. A pair of earring with the tusk of a creature on it. And an amber ring upon her right hand. Clothing wise she wears a long black and white dress. Upon each of her arms she wears a black and yellow bracelet.

Name: Akar Ceba
Known History:
Not much is known about this eccentric, wide eyed wanderer. There is a certain innocence and wonder about his eyes, that makes his home somewhat easy to guess: the peaceful hills of Paradise, free of war and trouble. Through some way or another, he has left that place of harmony and now, thrust into a world filled with unknown dangers and painful experiences. 

The only thing that reminds him of his home is his woolly companion, the sheep Nyima. With her he now travels the world, trying to find his way back home and doing his best to protect and care for all that he might find along the way.
Physical Description:
Akar wears a comfortable, white robe and a heavy, black robe over his left shoulder. The seams of both his tunic and his robe are adorned with soft sheep wool. Both his lower arms and ankles are covered in red threads. Akar wears many decorative charms and colourful decorations, including earrings and a talisman in the shape of a bell, which is tied to his collar. He almost never seen without his shepherd crook, which is also adorned with the same charms and bells he wears on his body.

His long, red hair is tied into a casual braid. The young shepherd has small goat horns, growing from just above his ears. Usually his face has a soft expression with a bright smile on his lips and shining, green eyes.

Name: Akiko
Known History:
Akiko was born in the village of Ishiyama under the iron fist of the Oni. Like the rest of the human population, she was put to work as soon as she could hold tools and climb into the mines. With a natural Fire Qi affinity, however, her value was discovered and she was taken by the greedy Oni clan ruling over Ishiyama. Conscripted by a powerful red Oni, she ended up in the remains of the Temple of the Rising Sun as a living forge, melting metal and attempting to make powerful weapons.

In quiet moments, Akiko cleaned and cleared rubble away in the temple. This led to a discovery: a small room with dust, bones, and the remains of destroyed relics- one of which a black and gold sun shield cleaved in half.

As she knelt and grabbed the broken handle remaining on each, it was like her soul was set aflame, something stirring, awakening. The hopeless fog in her mind cleared. Akiko raised her head and lifted the relics, then raced out of the temple towards a newfound destiny.
Origin: Teisei, Tian Yin, Shrine of the Rising Sun
Physical Description: Akiko is a muscular young woman standing at 5'8" with long black hair and pale skin. Her eyes are a dull amber color, but a spark of light gleams within when she wields her black and gold shields that seem like two broken halves of one sun.

Name: Akino
Known History:
- Born in Hanae, Akino always lived as an outcast due to their oni heritage.
- Was treated more harshly then most within Hanae, but regardless they kept their kindness
- Was raised by one person who lived within the outskirts. - A non-yokai folk who was simply just kind. Over time they taught them Sun cultivation as she fostered heavenly qi.
- Read tales of the  past involving the gods. Specifically about Amaterasu. Which she grew curious about.
- She dreamed of wanting to bring back the light to the skies in anyway possible. Despite how impossible such a goal may be.
- She wished to accomplish her dream. Sadly she could only stay at home.
- Regardless she wished to accomplish it by giving mercy to all. No matter what. Even if it was irredeemable. She had to try atleast once. As she believed the sun should be comforting and merciful to all.
- And if she wanted to do her dream, she needed to imitate its merciful warmth
- While thinking about her dream, a realmstorm took her away.
Physical Description: Standing at 6'2", Akino is a Half-Yokai. She has a pair of horns atop her head, with some fabric tied or wrapped around them. She has a set of brown hair, some of which is eratic while some is tied up. She wears a white kimono with green outlines in the center and black shirt beneath. She wears brown shorts, a white hanao, and a geta.

Name: Al-Amir
Identity: A Dreadful Smile In The Corner of Your Eye
Known History:
A kind and gentle story teller, that’s all he was ever meant to be. In a past life before ascending to the fourth layer of Idyll, he was just that. A young man that often got lost in both reading and writing stories for both young and old, creating realms for others to escape to when they felt the real world was too much to endure, or perhaps they just wished to see it through a new perspective. When he eventually met an untimely end at a young age, his essence found rest in the realms of dreams and hopes. A place where he could dream and a place where he could continue his favorite pastime, tell stories. Sadly, that dream was all but wrenched from his hands when the nameless lord fell. Madness took hold and everything he created, everything he cherished turned on him.

What happened after felt like a fleeting dream, all that remains is the memory of a caravan, a group of people who still dare to hope and a promise that he will never dare break. Nor could he, even if he wanted.
Physical Description: Al-Amir's form, much like a dream that you’ve just woken up from, is rather immalleable. Shifting and changing, however, if you dare look at them long enough his form would settle on an 8 foot tall nightmare straight out of a children's book. One that you read to make sure your children stay out of the dark forest at night. His skin glows with an eerie shade of purple, in place of a head he brandishes a crescent moon, while his “face” lacks eyes, his mouth remains. A dreadful smile that never fades, and in the middle of his chest rests a single unblinking eye that could stare into one’s soul. His attire consists of multitudes of golden rings, bracelets and other accessories gracing his arms, fingers and neck. While his attire is but a simple loose and baggy pant and a pair of worn dark boots.

Name: Alan Reverie
Known History:
Practically speaking, Alan has been blind for his entire life. Blindfold notwithstanding, one would be forgiven for not being able to tell, given that he has more than enough awareness to get by on a daily basis. Though again still, Alan's "daily basis" since The Night of the Red Sky has consisted disproportionately of sleeping. Even now, part of him wonders if The Worldhelm itself is just a particularly vivid dream — the type he'd have while wandering the Kor'Tarion wilderness.

If it is, he feels it's the sort of idyllic dream that deserves protecting.
Physical Description:
Alan stands at 5'7". His demeanor most often seems to be that of tranquil serenity, even with the fact that his eyes are constantly concealed by a covering of some sort — typically a golden blindfold with a blue gem.

In present day, Alan's manner of dress, blindfold aside, typically consists of a metal suit of carefully-engraved armor that is entirely draped in a white-and-gold robe. Finally, he carries two sizeable shields, the backs of which have been customized with extra padding such that they can both serve as emergency pillows.

Name: Alaska Vertigo
Known History:
A human born in the heart of Lorel.AI's slice of Terra, Alaska was taught to code at one of the company's official Employment Skills Cultivation Offices at a young age. She kept her head down and prioritised her work, and that got her a "comfortable" job within the company.

She remembers hearing about the employee backup initiative; something about preserving valuable knowledge in the event of unforeseen departures? She doesn't remember being signed up, but then again there's a lot she doesn't remember.

The next thing she remembers is waking up on the floor of an abandoned gas station in central in a metal body. wired up to expensive computing equipment and with a sea of corrupted memory files.

Discovering a bounty on her head, she went to ground, resorting to doing soul net work for disreputable individuals to pay for repairs.

When she was swept up in the affairs of the Goldhearted, she jumped at a chance for a place aboard the Worldhelm, away from Terra's authorities.
Physical Description: Wrapped beneath a worn cloak, Aly occupies what was, at one point, clearly a streamlined, and admittedly compact, modern LUA chassis. Between wear and tear and mismatched repairs, her body is far from the sleek corporate factory standard it was at time of manufacturing, covered in scratches, rust, and all manner of more concerning marks. From behind a cracked screen, she looks back at the world with eyes that manage to appear tired, despite their lack of detail.

Name: Aldrich S. Escher
Known History:
Born in Tradefair to a family of merchants, Aldrich has always had an innate talent for Magic, which his family saw fit to encourage and finance.
That said, simply helping his family turn a profit didn't satisfy his curiosity for how the world functioned one bit. For that reason, he sought to set off and learn more, against the wishes of the merchants he called family.
It wasn't long after he began this solo journey that a Realmstorm spontaneously dragged him into the Worldhelm.
Naturally, he would now have many more opportunities to learn more.
Physical Description: Slender and fragile-looking, but with a confident aura of power. Always carries his Tome, which doubles as his Journal, where he records his findings and experiment results.

Name: Alec Lyon
Known History:
Alec Lyon comes from a working class family in Babyl City, Dawnstar Valley. Growing up, he had a natural gift for spiritual and light magic, which got the local NTTech branch in Dawnstar to watch over him. Making sure he doesn't misuse his magic. He lived a relatively normal life otherwise, eventually going into schooling where he met and befriended Mae Lavery.

Then after graduating, he enrolled into a college ran by NTTech. A specialized college that focuses on developing mages. After graduating, he eventually got hired to work for one of NTTech's subsidiary that focuses on investigation of magic in Dawnstar. Becoming a licensed mage.

From there, due to budgeting reasons, he and Mae moved into an apartment to save on living expenses. Eventually forming a romantic relationship. However, about a year ago, tragedy befell Mae during an accident at her workplace. In order to live once again, she became an Insolvent. They are trying their best with the new circumstances.
Physical Description: Alec is a tall, athletic man who stands at 5'11" (180cm). Usually wears a smile on his face when interacting with most people. Typically wears a set of battle armor when he's on the job, but otherwise the casual jacket and pants when not on the job. His grayish-white hair done in a stylish mess, with gentle amber eyes.

Name: Aleksy Nowak XV
Identity: Respectable Bandit from an Ancient Bloodline
Known History: Descendant of the great Nowak the Golden, Aleksy XV is the heir to many things. His ancestor's name, his ancestor's treasure, and, most importantly, the leadership of his ancestor's men: the Dead Foxes. A storied group of bandits within Karlsgard that was rebirthed in the war, locals would have heard tell of the Dead Foxes harassing refugee camps and picking over battlefields. The most recent news, though, was them being wiped off the map by hellfire from Imperial mechs, perhaps the one good thing they've done. It's a mystery, then, how Aleksy ended up here. The Worldhelm chose him, though, so there must be something respectable to this bandit.
Physical Description: Standing a little over 6 foot with an athletic build, Aleksy carries himself with a special kind of pride not found in most. He's always adorned with some golden trinkets, bangles, earrings, whatever strikes his fancy, which pairs strangely with his rather meager choice of dress. Like a commoner playing royalty.

Name: Alethra, Daughter of Zephon
Known History:
* The daughter of Zephon and a noblewoman.
* Born with mental sense and cursed sight that gives her unnatural insight into those around her.
* Found some amount of comfort in her father's temple, training to become a priestess and judge, and to manage her sight.
* Also learned how to draw on her father's arcane might, finding an outlet in destructive magic.
* Prepares to fight the coming Cataclysm.
Physical Description: Alethra is a 5'8" tall, lithely athletic woman with sun-touched skin and long, golden hair. Often she is dressed regally in fine clothing, jewelry, and makeup. Additionally, she is always seen wearing a cloth blindfold over her eyes.

Name: Alexander Romani
Known History: Not much is known publicly about Alexander's early life but for Terrans if they frequent the Fortune Valley Casino he has been an opera singer and composer in there for years now. Terrans who also lives in Mount Providence may have also seen him scavanging abandon churches to find old and forgotten musicals antiques.
Physical Description: Light grey almost white hair, constant stern look on his face with piercing red eyes. Wears a formal but out of fashion suit with a red tie.

Name: Alexandra Stuart
Known History:
* Born to the Prestigious Lancastrian Noble Family. Her father, Charles, is a Mid level Noble in charge of administration of one of the larger Imperial Provinces

Was always a brilliant girl, and to many considered a Prodigy.

Joined the military on her 18th birthday.

At 25, she was placed as part of the Sky Service, working on the Vigilant Watch to hunt down people who Violate the Delver's Code.

Six months ago, upon the retirement of her Captain, Johannes Kranston, she was promoted to Captain.

Two months ago, a confrontation with Charlotte Morgan caused a stir as Charlotte was briefly put under custody. This led to decommission of the ship and her being placed under leave.

With her ship donated to the Adventurer's Guild, she followed the ship and agreed to join on the condition that she is allowed to keep control of her ship.
Physical Description:
Alexandra Lancastrian fills an imposing figure. She stands at 5'9, though she is often wearing heels or platforms that push her to 6'. Her long hair is nevertheless kept well groomed and straight, maintaining a professional appearance even in the air. And of course, her Service Uniform is kept immaculately pressed, cleaned, and ready for presentation.

Alexandra is an intense woman, with little patience for impropriety, and less for hooliganry or lawless behavior. The people who cross the line often quickly find themselves afoul of her custom service weapon, the 'Principles of Prosperity.'

Name: Alexei Volkov
Known History: Not much would be known of Alexei by any of the Goldhearted, though those that do a little digging, or any of his fellow Gnosis Academy students, would know that he is the son of two rather prominent mages back in Dreadlan. Aside from this, he is a student of Gnosis Academy, in which he has shown remarkable results in all fields theoretical. In practical though, any who have had the pleasure of working with him have had mixed opinions of the man.
Physical Description: Alexei is of average to thin stature and around 5'7'' tall. He's pale, his eyes eerily empty of any colour besides white and grey, and his black hair mirrors this scheme with long streaks of white already showing on the otherwise seemingly young man's black hair. Most notably, Alexei has a large scar that runs down his left cheek, neck and further down. Its not certain how large the scar is, as it eventually disappears under his Gnosis Academy uniform.

Name: Alice Aschenwald
Identity: Broken Witch Saved by the Stone
Known History:
Alice grew up in a poor family of farmers on the outskirts of Reven. A hedge sorcerer’s test earned her a place at Bennigsen Military Academy, but her chaotic briar magic kept her near the bottom of the grades.

That was until Erasmus Bonafide took her and Brenno, her only friend, under his wing. Erasmus secretly experimented on them, implanting magic crystals, breaking their spirit, and using the Memory Stone's power to twist Brenno’s mind. 

Under his influence, Brenno murdered Alice’s parents. She arrived to find the house burning, confronted him, and tapped into the Memory Stone for the first time, briefly freeing his mind. Brenno fled. 

Alice fled from Desatz, trying her best to avoid going back into Erasmus' hands, wandering all the way down south.

There, she crossed the Runewall, since she had nothing left on Eurys to go back to.
Physical Description: A blonde girl that dresses in common Eurysian garbs, nothing fancy, no jewelry, clearly trying not to stand out from a crowd. She walks with the posture of a trained military, even though her young face might tell you otherwise. When the coat is off, her arms are bandaged all the way up to the elbow, much like one of her eyes.

Name: Alira Spector
Identity: Professor of Optics With a Masters in Illumination
Known History: Koralan professor with a skeptical streak. Learned to keep her head down until her student-turned-protege was made to disappear. Reawakened to the truth, she steals the prototype devices which they'd been working on rather than letting them be turned towards military applications. Narrowly escapes capture thanks to the call of the Worldhelm; now seeks to unveil all of Korala and Merrane's lies and secrets, with the foremost being the fate of her student Polli Magnic.
Physical Description:
An overly-critical gaze and pursed mouth that looks like it's *just* about to call out something wrong with whatever she's looking at makes up Alira's "neutral" expression. This is framed by long red hair which is largely unkempt.

The only thing that sticks out with her wardrobe is the eyepatch. It's a new addition to her clothing, a necessity given the serious damage inflicted to that entire side of the face due to the Photon Displacement Harness malfunctioning. Otherwise, she dresses plainly if professionally.

Name: Alois Wagner
Identity: Haughty Heir Clawing to his Desire
Known History:
- Born an ambitious boy in Markensburg with a magical talent and a burning desire to improve his skills. Family was supportive of it.

- Pulled by the desire stone into the cave and guided to it. Touching it and revealing his truest desire, his mind repressing the memories to prevent him from going mad. He remembers the feeling of contentment.

- Is carried out of the cave unconscious by the Desire Beacon, who introduces him to the new gem embedded in his eye, marking him as an Heir.

- He returns to his family and they still accepted him, he felt a shred of contentment, but they tried to ensure that his new power and path never consumed him.

- When he was in his late adolescents, he came back to his house to find his family killed and his house burnt to the ground. Going to the Desire Beacon.

- He swore his desire was to find those responsible and get his vengeance, became an agent of the Desire Beacon.

- Went to the expedition as an agent of Desire seeking to test his mettle.
Physical Description: Alois is a lean man with a pale complexion and a beauty mark under his lip. His outfit varies from place to place to ensure discretion but his normal attire is standard Wulfroh with purple replacing red. Covering one of his eyes is a sash, concealing his crystal he has as an heir. His demeanor is rather methodical and quiet, measuring everything around him with a hint of suspicion and distance. His weapon is a large scythe that thrums with thaumatergic power.

Name: Alwyn
Known History: A wanted Sky Pirate whom currently flies alone. Though he is wanted for Theft and Assault, there is no evidence that he has done so to any non-noble/rich people/group.
Physical Description: A relatively tall, well kept man with black hair wearing loose but well fitting clothes.

Name: Alysone The Shadow
Known History:
Alysone was born and raised in Markensberg by her parents.
Due to the war and militaristic, she was molded to be tough and cold with little opportunities to be soft.

Her parents died one after the other in the endless war and Alysone picked up the mantle in their absence, becoming a soldier herself for many years then defecting along with a handful of others to seek an escape through crime.

This path lead her to coming across a witch who, in her dying breath, cursed Alysone to a restless life filled with grief and anger, leaving her face scarred.
Seeking yet another escape, Alysone left her band to try and settle down to start a family.

She was beaten and left on death's door with her husband murdered and her son kidnapped from his crib, with nary a lead to his whereabouts.
Alysone tried to find her son for a few years before giving up, seeing it best she find an escape through the Runewall.

Of course, she did not know it was a gateway to more suffering and perhaps...redemption.
Physical Description:
Alysone is a 5'8" human woman with black, free-flowing hair.
Her face is scarred from a battle with the witch who cursed her, changing her remaining eye to have a yellow iris and black sclera while keeping her damaged eye shut at most times.

Her attire is a mix of her old military uniform plate and bandit band fabrics, creating an almost monochrome leather and steel outfit that has seen many battles on her journey.

Name: Alyster Miff
Known History: Alyster always wanted to be a cook when he grew up. Living in Hedgeburg offered him a chance to learn how to cook (and he did well!)... that was, until a Mech from Merrane crashed nearby the village. He took it home and discovered that it was a MK.2 Legion, an older class of Mech from Merrane, but still very powerful. He had done some inventing alongside his old tutor, Maya, an excellent Tinkerer who taught him much. Slowly, he managed to get it back up and running. It was then christened Cook's Spice, and he went out to the forest to test it out on gathering some ingredients. Turns out, he accidently found himself a Goldhearted and chosen by the Worldhelm. His lust for adventure (and more ingredients!) now drives him forward to building a truly incredible restraunt with Mech-Made Meals.
Physical Description: At 6' and 185lbs, Alyster Miff is a pale skinned human with long, combed back brown hair and brown eyes. He wears a whitish-blue coat, a blue scarf, brown gloves, and brown leather boots and pants.

Name: Alyx Fauxmont
Identity: Has Your Back, and Your Coin!
Known History:
- Alyx was the well-loved only child of the Fairmont merchant family in Markensburg, Wulforh. 
- Spoiled and secure, she was taught to ignore the struggles of others, but rumors of heroes risking life and limb across Eurys gnawed at her conscience. Every head turned for coin fed a growing resentment: life had to mean more than just cashing in Zenit, didn't it?
- Reaching her breaking point, she claimed she was traveling to Pragstenburg to study, but instead began moving across Eurys delivering much needed wares to those struck hardest by the calamity. 
- Meeting heroes inspired her. Giving them respite brought her great pride.
- Things changed when she came upon a strange creature in Grestazs. It longed for a home, somewhere beyond the Runewall. If she didn’t help, who would? After all, a merchant truly is a weary traveler’s best friend.
Physical Description:
Alyx is a broad-built woman adorned in a variety of unpolished metals, refined leathers, and multicolored gemstones. Her forearms are clad in thick, soot-stained mining gloves. Heavily reinforced breeches support the many items she tosses on the various belt loops and packs she has strapped across her body. Wild blonde hair curls down her back in a ponytail, with occasional streaks of crimson painting its ends. Piercings of varying sizes decorate her ears and brow, and thick smudges of ash line her eyes, intensifying her features. Alyx’s mint-green gaze is full of energy and, surprisingly, focus. She makes a point of maintaining eye contact in conversations, and is clearly well-practiced in people-pleasing despite her rugged appearance.
Carrying herself with immense pride, Alyx exudes a punkish demeanor that bleeds into her everyday attitude. A grin frequently lights up her beauty-marked face, and her jovial voice often trails into fits of hearty laughter when surrounded by others.

Name: Amaranth
Known History: Amaranth was nothing until a few short years ago. A corpse, lying dead in the Prosperity Plains. Due to the stone's magic, as well as being guarded by a strange magical animal, however, Amaranth came into being as a unique fusion between a human, and the magic of the Prosperity stone that was infused into them by the nearby plants of the area. After wandering Eurys for some time, they joined the call to charge through the Runewall, with their siblings-in-arms.
Physical Description: Amaranth is a slender figure of small stature at 5'1", with large, wide eyes that seem to hungrily absorb the world around them, no matter where they go. While human at first glance, closer inspection reveals their hair to grow more fibrous in texture as one travels down each strand, with the end of each hair being indistinguishable from the head of a common grain. When near them, the distinct smell of earth after a rainfall is noticeably present, regardless of the circumstances they find themselves in.

Name: Amber O'Riley
Known History: Amber was born in Hedgeberg, and moved to Korala to study medicine.  While there she met her wife Cassandra and after a few years of working together in the medical field they married, and had a daughter.  Tensions grew as the war began, Cassandra wanting to stay in Korala where it was safe while Amber wanted to go into danger to help the people who'd need them the most.  They separated, with their daughter Jessica joining Amber in Pikeway until the forming of Ionian Village made Amber believe she could do more good for the refugees there, and opened up a clinic in that location.  After working in Ionian for a few years, Jessica, now a teenager ran away from home.  Amber, while searching for her daughter one day is caught in a realmstorm and brought to the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Amber is a middle aged Felkin with thick black hair.  Her eyes shift between green and yellow depending on the light.  She wears round glasses, and a doctor's coat over basic clothes.  She's usually frowning and/or smoking

Name: Ambrose
Known History:
This Napoleonic scholar is one of the few people at Hudal Academy who completely lacks the ability to use Spells like a traditional mage. His talent instead lies in the production of magical equipment that can channel Mana for spellcasting. 

While he can't use Spells normally, his savant-like understanding of Wands has resulted in his ability to use his mana, but only for the purpose of producing blasts of magical energy from his armaments. 

He's set to graduate soon, but he is not well-liked among the teachers. They have posed to him a single challenge, and that is to produce SOMETHING remarkable for the academy that isn't some kind of magical ordinance.
Physical Description:
Ambrose is a small person at only 4'5", whose lithe body is hidden underneath a couple layers of baggy mage clothing and alchemist tools laid atop them. He carries a large backpack covered in meticulously maintained labels. Any educated person in Kor'Tarion would quickly realize that this guy's inventory is stocked with magical payload that could easily raze a small town, if not most of a large city. 

Dangling from a short rope attached to the wrist is a charred wand, with its core compartment and focus crystal empty, and waiting for its next configuration.

Name: Ambrose "Alder" Silverpine
Known History:
- Lived with his nomadic people and family, the Deerfolk, following the guidance of the elementals via a Hearer, nurturing life along the way.
- Before becoming Goldhearted, he was suddenly, mysteriously, shunted out from his mother's domain, and hasn't been able to get back in or find his family.
- He has recently found his mother, Willow, learning that the Wyld Hunt has been responsible for hunting and tearing Fey, particularly those of the Spring Court, from their domains. He has also learned that his mother has had dealings with the Spring Court as well, but doesn't quite know how deep it runs.
- He still doesn't know that his mother managed to get Caladrius' favor to bestow upon Alder some of his power to protect him.
- Has yet to become fully aware of his aptitude as a Hearer for his people
- Yuzuru Eiji of Terra is his boyfriend. c:
Physical Description: Straight, tall, and lithe, covered in silver and white dappled fur, he stands at 5'11'' (not including the antlers) on deer-like hooves, peering at you with what look like distant reflections of stars in his blue(?) eyes. Over a simple linen shirt and pants, he wears a knitted white sweater and a night blue coat lined with white fur. He adorns himself with a pair of simple, hand-made necklaces, and a single earring on his left ear.

Name: Amelia Green
Known History:
Amelia Green born in North Rock and had an uneventful life, coming from two hardworking, low-income parents. Taking a leap as a young adult, she took out some loans to begin her college education, reasoning that she could surely pay it off once she found a proper career after gaining a proper degree. After graduating, her friends treated her out to celebrate. Being as ecstatic as she was, she overindulged and died that night due to alcohol poisoning. 

This also soured many of her friendships once she returned as an Insolvent. 

Amelia now has spent the last 5 years trying to live a normal life, having found an entry-level journalist position for one of Galeforce's smaller newspaper subsidiaries and struggling to move up in the company.
Physical Description: Amelia is a woman of average 5'4 stature with short pale yellow hair and bright red eyes. She often is dressed somewhat professionally and in light colors.

Name: Amelie d'Artois
Identity: Cursed Druid Searching for a Cure
Known History: Amelie came to Rocade as a young girl alongside mother, living in Lithos into her later teens. After her mother fell ill and died, Amelie joined the Disciples of Longevity, becoming a Druid serving under the Beacon after finishing her training. For a number of years she then acted as one of the guardians of Ardevor, protecting it from humans, beasts and mad spirits alike, until she was afflicted with the same corruption that the spirits of Rocade suffer from. She was sure to die, until special chains were fashioned for her to hold back the spread of her corruption. Her live saved, though she could not continue to act as a guardian druid, her desire to protect her homeland remained, and so she decided to join the venture into the Runewall in hopes of finding a solution to her home's plight...
Physical Description: Amelie is a woman in her mid-20s with long blonde hair that falls down just past her hips. Her eyes are auburn, though noticeably glazed over, and her complexion seems oddly pale. Her clothes are usually black, to the point where they could maybe be mistaken for mourning clothes, were it not for the flower pattern embroidered upon her cloak. Most notably though are the golden chains around her neck, ankles and wrists as well as her arms that are unnaturally tinged blood red, up until just above her elbows.

Name: Anabella Westley
Known History: Anabella was born north of Proudrock, on the well known Pine Creek Ranch run by the Westley family. Anabella always had a weak constitution, but still faithfully helped around the ranch with her parents and older brothers and was known for a fierce work ethic even if she herself couldn't quite keep up. A demon encounter destroyed the ranch and her family when she'd barely become a teenager, leaving her to be sent to the Temple of Sol. She picked up the mantle of the Dawnthread, and was beginning to fledge a promising potential when she was swallowed by a Realmstorm.
Physical Description: A young lady with dirty blonde hair that shines softly in sunlight, accompanied by a pale complexion around hazel eyes and a frail frame to boot. She walks gingerly, yet still finds every patch of uneven ground to lose her balance upon, and struggles to withhold the cough that she can never seem to shake off.

Name: Anais Penelle
Known History:
* Raised in Stalmer as a abandoned child by the Witch Ingrid
* Showed herself capable of wielding the anima of the soul and even drawing upon the **anarchy** stone.
* Became Stalmer's one Witch after Ingrid left to pursue a calling across Silverdale. 
* In her absence, she became cursed by a man claiming her to be the reincarnated soul of his late wife.
* Left Stalmer in order to protect the town from her curse and to escape the man who befelled such dark anima
* Became part of the expedition to cross the runewall..
Physical Description:
A pale beauty with streets of silver that end in pink hues, lithe and delicate Anais carries with her the traits of a Witch true. 

Standing at 5'8 she holds no special place above the crowds.

Name: Ananda Hassan
Known History: Having grown up in the Great House of Vasu, Ananda spent his life under the influence of the House matriarch, Ananya. With the matriarch as his inspiration, Ananda began to practice cultivating his own purusa. However, upon being found doing so without permission from Maharaja, Ananda was exiled from the territory he called home.
Origin: The Great House of Vasu, Bahata Kajaana, Tian Yin
Physical Description: Standing at 6'2, Ananda is fairly unique for being human. From his head to his feet, it'd be hard to find something not interesting about the male. Cloudy looking horns sit atop his head and seem incorporated throughout his attire, even appearing along the length and tip of his wavy tail.

Name: Anderth Rhastal
Known History:
Anderth is a simple man. He wakes up. He goes to work. He works. He comes home. He sleeps. Repeat. That's been his routine for a good 60% of his life. Being a human in the Scalefire Empire, he has lived a life of poverty and prejudice. And yet, he simply accepts it, seemingly never wanting more. Perhaps he doesn't even know there's more to life. 

The last thing he remembers is the mineshaft he was in shaking, before it totally collapsed on him and his crew. His supervisor decided to save his own skin first, and left his crew for dead. Upon coming back to consciousness, he found himself on the Worldhelm, with no recollection of what happened in between.
Physical Description: Anderth is a buff, stocky man who stands at 6'3". He wears a thin, patchwork shirt and a durable pair of trousers. His boots are so dirty it's hard to tell where they end and where his legs begin. He carries a beat-up pickaxe with a bunch of counting marks on it. He also wears a utility belt that has all the essentials for a miner. A lantern, oil, rope, a hunting knife, several maps, and various satchels and pockets. Anderth is usually wearing a scowl.

Name: Ania
Known History:
Ania was from a family who referred to themselves as "Mantle-Blades." They are Regal Vessels who dedicate themselves to be paired with honored Regents, for the sake of social status. Ania was however never chosen by a Regent.

When the Pavilion opened she settled in Polis, trying to find a new life for herself, until she heard about the Goldhearted and decided her destiny awaited her aboard the Worldhelm.
Physical Description:
Ania is a 23 year old Gilded from the Pavilion's 7th floor, with long golden blonde hair typical of her people and a friendly, obedient demeanor, a habit born of her specialized upbringing and training.

She generally wears fancy dresses and adornments, less so from a desire to appear socially elevated and more out of habit.

Name: Anise
Known History:
As far as she is aware, or at least, as far as she is willing to tell people, Anise has no past. The Nezzim found her as a child, and promptly branded her as being a 'mage' when her psychic abilities became apparent. They began to push Anise to her limits, attempting to hone her Esper abilities and forge her into a weapon on their behalf. Since then, that is the only life she has known for nearly 3 decades. Bodyguard work was her main forte, though her might and gravitokinesis found usefulness in manual labour, too.

The Realmstorm's arrival was a ticket out; newfound freedom, away from their demands, and their punishments. Now, Anise intends on directing her blade elsewhere - towards the throat of the Nezzim and their draconian empire.
Physical Description: Anise is a tall and imposing woman, standing at around 6'0" and wielding a large but otherwise ordinary greatsword. Her hair is light brown and often kept in the style of a chignon, pinned in place by the binyeo she wears. Up-close, scale-shaped brands can be seen going up her neck and parts of her face, though they are mostly hidden by her shawl and hair. Anise dresses in loose-fitting garb, accustomed to the heat of Nezmira. Other identifying features include her golden-yellow eyes, and small pieces of debris float around her at times, as if Anise had her own small gravitational field.

Name: Anki
Identity: Runaway Child of the Fox Mother
Known History: Anki was born among yokai. As the child of two oni, he was not torn from a human life and into a wild one. He was raised as a devoted servant of the fox mother, and trained as a warrior under the Doom Seers of Tsukamu village. However, in recent times, their teachings have proven fruitless. Their visions are thwarted by outsiders. After a heated argument turned battle with his teacher over their purpose, Anki fled to Sunfire City, where he was caught up in a Realmstorm, and arrived on the ship. Now free of his prior roots, he searches for a reason to exist.
Physical Description: A relatively small Oni with subtle muscles and a relatively inconsistent bone structure. His face tends to twist between charming and innocent to unnatural and monstrous. He barely crests five feet tall, with bone spikes protruding from his chest, forehead, shoulders, elbows, and back.

Name: Annelise Klein
Identity: Lost Soldier With A Lost Cause
Known History:
- Annelise was born into a notable Merrani family, though the Klein family has been known to be one of the more stubborn families against the crown.,
- Annelise herself was given proper education and training in Korala before joining in her family's footsteps.
- She gained a leg up due to her family name and gained a promising path ahead of her.
- When she entered her first proper task, she took well to her role until it came to the fact that she and her squad were sent to interfere with the transportation of supplies. When arriving it was also found to be transporting citizens.
- Annelise failed to commit to Merrane's edict and was caught trying to sabotage the mission to allow the citizens to escape. 
- She was labeled a deserter and a traitor, being sent to Heaven's Gate due to her family name and those above her wanting to have one of the Klein's children with the intention of bargaining.
Physical Description: A 5'7 polite-looking woman, often dressed in a more professional attire, her clothing ironed and pressed. To her side is often a rifle of magitech make, those who are aware can easily tell of its Merrani make.

Name: Annette Desjardins
Identity: Cheerful Painter for Love and Peace
Known History: Annette Desjardins was born and raised in Korala.  She attended the Acadamy of Korala from a young age, possessing the rare gift of magic.  She took mainly to the arts, and as the college became more focused on the war, she faced pressure to train as a battlemage.  She hated the idea of contributing to the war, and chose instead to flee the college as the demands from above became more threatening.  Along with her familiar, a water elemental named Flaque, she was travelling through the countryside when she was caught in a realmstorm and brought into the Heaven's Sea.
Physical Description: Annette is a 5'4" girl with dirty blonde hair, and light brown eyes.  She carries a brown bag full of paints and other art supplies with her at all times.  When she speaks she has a noticable french accent.  She's accompanied by a small water elemental named Flaque, who sometimes rides in a waterproof container in her bag.

Name: Anri
Known History:
The only son to a couple of blacksmiths and Tubalcain devotees in a now-forgotten village in the Kald Forest, Anri learned his parents craft from an early age, always more interested in helping around the forge than connecting with the other kids. His life was upended in his teens by an Ald raid, which saw him captured and separated from his kin.

Considered a "useful" prisoner due to his skill with smithing, Anri was kept alive, exchanging captors often due to leadership changes, trades between clans, and short-lived escape attempts. They were finally given freedom due to the actions of Goldhearted, and brought to Hearthgarde.

They didn't stay long however, soon journeying back to his village in the Kald. However, rather than a home, all he found there was burned-down buildings and shallow graves-- two of which were marked with his parents' names.

With no surviving bonds to Aldistir, Anri was intent on simply walking to the world's edge. However, it seems fate had other plans...
Physical Description: Standing at just under 5 feet tall (not counting the ears), Anri is a white-and-grey-furred rabbit Yokai with distant silver eyes, blue markings on his cheeks, and a deceptively muscular build. Quiet and introspective to a fault, they always seem preoccupied with some question or other, often giving the impression that he does not notice-- or care-- about what's going on around him.

Name: Antigone
Known History:
She was one of the first, if not the first who awoke in Deleria. Quickly she took to exploring the island, coming to cultivate a connection between her and the land.

After the attack on Sangriel and the disappearance of Deleria, it became clear how much her soul was tied to the island. Still, she is here and that will mean something.
Physical Description:
A 5'5 woman with draconic features, both a pair of horns and a tail. She is often dressed in colorful clothing and a messenger bag often filled with different maps. Her demeaner remains positive, as she is often seen with a smile and is eager to converse with most.

Often to her side is a creature of Deleria as well, a small reptilian-like plant that chirps commonly besides her.

Name: Anzai Midori 安斎 緑
Known History:
- Former Samurai in service to Hakage Ito, a lord killed in a duel
- Became a mercenary instead of following an honorable end
- Infected by negative energy, saved by a seal placed on the energy by a priestess from the Mugetsu region.
Physical Description: A dark haired individual standing at 5'10'', they carry an empty scabbard, an old spear, a straw hat and flexible armor beneath warm clothes.

Name: Apollo Marinelli - ᵀʰᵉ Rhapsody
Known History:
Hailing from a high class family from Heartdom. Apollo is the son of a prestigious Paladin and an influential politician. He had always had expectations of him. But, because he was never able to fully reach the high standards of his mother, he was scorned and faced trouble at home. One day, wanting to believe he could be something, he ran away from home to enroll in Gnosis Academy. He tried at first to be a part of the House of Paladins, but with the reality of him not truly being suited for such. Apollo transferred to the House of Treasures. Entrusting his dreams and wishes to his closest friend and confidant at the academy, Perseus, entering a Rite of Binding with him.

With time spent at the remedial class, Apollo has been through many ordeals alongside his friends, overcome hardship, and grown into someone who is able to more properly appreciate and respect himself. And with his reforging into the Rhapsody, he continues on to walk down the road alongside his beloved regent.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'7" and carrying himself with dignity. Apollo is a gold scaled Nezzim with a dainty form. He sports two sets of horns, green eyes, and a pair of glasses, likely to help with reading all the tomes and papers he usually carries around within his bag. Ever since graduating from Gnosis academy, He wears a wide variety of fashion but tends to gravitate towards two styles of clothing. Either some modern casual attire that is irrespective gender norms, or Victorian-esque noble wear, a style he's particularly fond of. He moves with grace and fluidity, and as of recent has started to smile more genuinely.

Name: Arasaka "Saki" Sasaki
Known History:
Arisaka Sasaki is one of a pair of twins born to Sayumi Sasaki, a well respected member of 100G Security. She had average grades in all her schooling and chose not to go to university to better care for her younger sister Minebea. She works as a freerunning courier in the megacity of Haven to help their houshold afloat.

[HPD file Codename: Raven]

Possible affiliation with the Goldnails. Suspect in several armed robberies in relation to Goldnails activity. Uses a high powered rifle to suppressive fire  from a great distance. All attempts of pursuit are thwarted through rooftop and city pursuit. Be on watch for sniper scopes when responding to robberies]
Physical Description: Saki is a medium height at 4'11 very thin girl with long white hair. It often sticks up at odd angles either due to lack of care or to differentiate herself from her twin sister. Her normally blank expression hides eyes that seem to always be watching for trouble. She tends to wear heavier jackets that almost look too big for her and combat boots.

Name: Arashi
Known History:
A Kitsune from the Feywyrd; an eccentric Yokai that loves to play pranks, and make friends. Though raised by a guardian rather than her parents, she never let it keep her down. 

"I shall survive and live on, for all those who could not."
Physical Description:
Height: 150cm

Arashi is a short, silver haired Kitsune with a curious look to her. Usually dressed in a tight and elegant garb; though with colder climates has a full body cloak on for warmth!

Name: Argad
Identity: The Tower, a quiet and friendly warchild
Known History:
Argad is a quiet man: not much is known about him. He sometimes mentions a difficult childhood and how Father Hegar Seive saved him.
She took him to the orphanage and raised him as the child he is now. They were good times when no life-threatening events occurred.
With a boring life for a young man accustomed to war, Argad left the orphanage and the second life that Hegar gave him, promising himself to honor that opportunity by giving others the same opportunity. Shortly after beginning his journey, he was able to enter the Worldhelm.
Origin: Kor'Tarion. The White Feather House of Youth
Physical Description: Argad is a tall person (6'5'') with a bulky muscular body (240lb). His hair, almost as black as obsidian, a meticulously groomed beard, and intense black eyes give him an even more intimidating appearance. If it weren't for the almost constant smile on his face, no one would approach him.

Name: Aria
Known History:
Born as a daughter to one of the Matriarchs of Tangbawan, she was unnaturally gifted physically and spiritually. As such her story ended up as similar to other daughters for reasonings that were not really known to her she was eventually given to the Kabiya and traveled with them at a very young age. She only served to learn and grow even more under individuals of similar circumstances and through training of people who knew more despite her carefree spirit.

These times abruptly came to an end when the group she was traveling with came under brutal assault by a powerful Yokai. The Yokai was slayed but at a great cost. However in that moment she would be introduced to her next mentor for many years to come. Even following them to a place in a sea of clouds.
Physical Description: A not so tall young lady with a head of short red hair, dressed in lightly protective ware that doesn't hinder the movement. Behind the very relaxed and unbothered expression on her pretty face is a hunger to push herself into new heights and grow stronger for it with her swordsmanship. Evident in the physique she sports, while not a bulky build, her arms visibly appear built from constant use wrapping around to her back and through out her body. A combination of a lithe type that tightly bound the muscles and raw strength into a unassuming form.

Name: Arin "Bolt" Sylvester
Known History:
Those close to Arin before he left Lumina City would know him as an Overachieving college student who always did his best to get top marks in his class. After graduation, close friends of him would know he won't be staying in Lumina and Left  for Vacay City. Those close to him know him to be truly unhappy with his rich life and left it.


Those who know Arin in Vacay City know him as a local drummer that once played in the Band known as "The Misfits"  but that band disbanded right after the events of Luna's shards falling onto Terra. From there close to him would know him for his temp work with Sword working as a musician and becoming an expert in all manners of instruments. He is also known for some tracks he made for the hit MMO RWO! Most of it was rock tracks though.
Origin:
Terra, Lumina Prime

Currently Living in Vacay City
Physical Description: Standing at 134 Cm Dark skinned with now yellow hair and black sclera eyes. The septid wears a yellow jacket, black leather pants, some brown boots and earphones around his neck.

Name: Arsene Flamel
Known History:
Arsene was the main help at his fathers small shop down in midhole until he eventually they had to sell the shop soon after Arsene's father passed away from a mysterious illness.

Shortly after that Arsene enrolled at hudal academy and researched alchemy so he could find a way to develop a cure for the illness that killed his father.

Arsene tried many times but one night he accidentally blew up the lab when one of his alchemy experiments went wrong.

Because of this Arsene was expelled from the school.

Now Arsene has become an adventurer in order to make enough money to independently fund his alchemy research so the world can be a brighter place.
Physical Description: He is a short man about 5-7 and has the build of someone who runs frequently he has blonde hair and green eyes.

Name: Artemis Anderson
Identity: A girl given 4 legs up in life
Known History:
* Born to a comfortably wealthy family in South Rock
* Diagnosed with a disease in her youth that would rob her of the use of her legs
* Her parents paid for a surgery to augment her spine to halt the damage, but the process was botched
* Parents tried suing the hospital but were destroyed in court and lost almost everything
* Parents then put themselves deep into debt to get her a far more underground solution from an independent lab
