* Given her new lease on life, Artemis has decided to push her new augments to their limit to try and earn enough to save her parents from the possibility of insolvency when they pass.
* A mixture of running her top speed and her unstable augments misfiring at the same time transported her to the Worldhelm!
Physical Description: A spirited wheelchair-bound girl, 5'1" tall and weighing a concerning 107lbs.

Name: Arthur Birkett
Known History:
- Born in Eurys (Silverdale)

- "Works" as a wilderness guide 'round Eurys, has traveled to every region chasing after the cataclysms and knowledge

- Works side by side a large buck named VIX, who is capable of growing various fruits and vegetables on his own body

- Is capable of speaking with any species other than constructs, and will quite often be found conversing with the various creatures nearby if not spoken to
Physical Description: A small 5'5" tall male Leirsin, he wears a quite well made coat with various trinkets attached to it using different colored rope as well as a fancy hat with sapphires inlayed in them. His skin is a pale white, eyes a light blue  but his hair would be the most notable visible feature as it wears the same pattern as his tail and ears.

Name: Asahi [旭]
Known History: The only known history of this individual was that they are often seen being a servant of a clan, usually negotiating with various merchants or other clans.
Physical Description:
A woman with long, brown hair who stands at 5'8" with a slender figure. Wearing a comfortable set of kimono robes with a checkered scarf, and a pair of rounded glasses that accentuates her brown eyes. Often seen carrying a smoking pipe.

Usually Asahi speaks with a sense of wit, and often playful tone. Often teasing the other person. Carrying themselves in a rather refined manner. When in more private spaces, they're exhibit a much more comfortable demeanor.

Name: Ashtilla
Physical Description:
Height: 96cm
Weight:18kg

With shimmering blue scales Ashtilla Skedaddles into the fray!

Name: Aslatiel
Known History: An elf from the fairy realm of Kor'Tarion. He was a bright and promising student of the Hudal Academy but wasted it away when he acted on a dangerous and unsanctioned ritual. His ritual failed causing a horrible accident that scarred half his body and injured many other students. He was banished and many began calling him the "Half-Dark Elf". He wandered the humans lands in search of his home but couldn't. Then during the blood moon, he fought off the demons he could and aided in the defense of a helpless family. After his sacrifice he wandered into the woods, tireless, refusing rest as to not die but fell all the same. When he awoke, he found his new destiny: Goldhearted.
Physical Description: 5'8" with pale blue skin, white hair, and purple eyes. Half of his body is covered in a shadow leaving only his eye and teeth visible like a gnawing scar. His clothes cover most of it which is a blue combat tunic with a big blue cloak with starts. He carries a sword at his hip and a blue shield with a white star either in his left hand or back. His neck has a two-toned collar and gold chain with a gem carved to look like a decorative star at it's center.

Name: Aster Vayelia
Known History:
- For generations the Vayelia family has trained one child to serve the Order and one for the Coven.
- Aster's older sister Laurel joined the Order and rose quickly. Aster was initially clumsy and nervous but showed connection with nature and the Soul Stone, and slowly built her sense of confidence and self-worth.
- Laurel was selected for an expedition to the Runewall, but grew more erratic as the dangerous mission approached, expressing doubt that the constant fight was worth it. She abandoned the mission and the Order, and rumors circulate that someone fitting her description is with the Rimelz Hounds.
- Blaming herself for not seeing her sister's fears, Aster prayed to the Soul Stone for the ability to make things right - and received a vision to bind the Stone as an Arcanist and go to the Runewall in her sister's place.
- Frightened but determined to fight for a better world, Aster took her sister's place on the expedition, and survived to join the ranks of the Goldhearted.
Physical Description: A tall and skinny young woman with fair skin. Her reddish-brown hair is in two messy braids, with a tendency to frizz and have flyaway strands. Her wide blue eyes make it easy to get a read on her emotions, or at least on her anxiety in the moment, though sometimes they're concealed behind large round reading glasses. She tends towards the simple, pretty, and practical: full skirts and sturdy boots for afternoons out in the garden.

Name: Aston Aldebrand
Identity: Old Soldier, Cook in the Trenches
Known History:
- Born in Little Ottington in the Kingdom of Karlsgard. One older brother living in the Tundra, one niece who moved to the Bastion.
- Joined the military when his tavernkeeper parents died around twenty years ago. Assigned as an army cook after training.
- Survived the destruction of his battalion during one of the first Angel attacks of the Merrani invasion. Spent months in recuperation afterwards.
- Eventually helped with feeding and housing of refugees and wounded, instead of returning to the frontlines.
- Taken by the Realmstorm to the Worldhelm some time after, where he then joined the Goldhearted's embassy to the Dragon's Den, and learnt the true stakes of the Lhodos war.
Physical Description:
Aston is tall (6'1"), grizzled, and rather well-muscled (220 lbs) - he walks with a noticeable limp, but is otherwise in great shape for his age and (last-known) occupation. 

Being retired from active service, he no longer wears his old uniform anymore (doing so would draw too much attention anyway), although he still prefers clothes in similar colors, which he wears underneath his old gear. A small brass pendant is hung around his neck.

Name: Astrid Engstrom
Known History:
Astrid was born and raised within the outer ring of Genesis - her family often struggling with keeping a roof over their heads most of the time, let alone having meals on the table every night. During this time, Astrid's parents described their daughter as someone who was 'too quiet - like someone had pulled all her will right out of her', and with her upbringing, perhaps they weren't wrong.

Upon reaching adulthood, Astrid's social life went completely quiet for a prolonged period of time before popping up in the city of Fortune, working as a body guard for one of the casinos in the Jewel for some time before vanishing once again. However, during her employment, many regulars and staff noted an increasing number of prosthetic replacements and addons.

Some people speculate that, during that time, Astrid has criminal connections with one of the criminal organizations within Terra - however, no concrete evidence has been gathered.
Physical Description:
Standing at roughly 5'10", Astrid has many defining features - most notably of course, being her four prosthetic arms. Beyond that however, Astrid possesses a paler complexion, grey hair, and bright red eyes - the upper-right half of her face being covered by a metallic mask, and her mouth covered by a black cloth.

As for her attire, Astrid is most often seen wearing a long, cream jacket, black pants, and a custom-tailored crimson coat that appears to have been made to accommodate for all four of her arms.

Name: Asuka Senko
Known History:
A girl that sought more out of her life than the oppression that her home had given her; seeking not really wealth, but a richer life than one she would have at Tokusou. 

Though she might seem a tad arrogant, she wants to help and protect people.

Life is meant to be enjoyed, after all.
Physical Description:
A dark haired beauty that hails from Tokusou, with a soft smile and gives the impression she enjoys luxury and the nicer things that places have to offer.

Standing at an impressive height of 5'1'', she is often seen floating, carrying small pouches and instruments, as well as the faint aroma of incense on her person.

Often if not always accompanied by a strange masked bird she affectionately calls Kumo.

Name: Asuka Yumiko
Known History: Asuka grew up far away from civilisation, with her mother. While purely human, she grew up away from the culture of the Alder, and instead was raised with the trappings and culture of the Yokai with her mysterious mother, and absent father. That is, until fate caught up to this family away in the peaks. Having grown up, she left for a hunting trip, and returned to her home destroyed, with clear signs of the Yokai's doing. With nothing else to live for, she started to travel Aldistir, hunting down the most dangerous Yokai she could out of both grief and civic duty, hoping to find the ones who did it, and why they have done so.
Physical Description: A woman standing at 5'8 with luxurious eastern clothing and a large bow. She stands with an aloof but scrutinizing look, judging all in her sharp eyes.

Name: Atticus Blackburn
Identity: The Cunning Deadeye of Goetia Squad
Known History:
After the fall of his home Vale Atticus immediately joined up with the KPLA.

As an adult he joined Phantom Squadron, a reconnaissance group for the KPLA.

Throughout his time in the KPLA Atticus proved himself as a Sniper and scout. His skill is impressive able to nail Merrane walkers and is able to takedown targets from 3871 yards out with a regular sniper rifle

After over a decade of dedicated service to the KPLA Atticus earned the rank of Wyrm and was chosen to be one of the members of Goetia Squad.

He now pilots the mech Balaam taking down enemies with frightening precision.
Physical Description: Atticus stands at six feet tall with an athletic build. He has olive skin and keeps a shaved head. He wears a pilot's uniform consisting of a standard plug suit and a red coat over top.

Name: Auro Benites
Known History: He's from Windhaven. (The Origin is not public information).
Physical Description: 5'9", lithe/muscular build.

Name: Aven Elmhorn
Known History:
- Aven was a knight tasked with hunting down Fae and would travel most of Kor' Tarion to do so.
- Three years ago his squad went missing after being sent to the Howling Woods.
- Aven with no recollection of events after having arrived in the woods woke.
- Found himself questioning if he was himself or if he was something imitating himself.
- A thorny plant seems to be growing though his body and armor and wrapping around it, any thoughts of trying to remove it quickly leaving him.
- Saved Fae-Touched in the Gwaed when before he would have never, as a desire for retribution to those who wronged Fae and Fae-Touched built.
- A few days after his run in with Fae-Touched he was swept up in a strange storm and awoke on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description:
When in his armor its brass in color and fairly standard, however from holes in the armor or from its joints a throned plant grows from it aggressively.

Out of armor he is a middle aged man, with darker colored hair and a scarred face. His eyes a bit sunken and dark.

Name: Axel Reed
Known History:
- Son of a frontier blacksmith from Jamestown and a witch from Copsehaven, Axel grew up between two worlds on the far frontier.
- Everything changed when a nearby gold vein drew Gold Standard and Proudrock west. Rumors spread that his mother hid liquid gold with witchcraft.
- When officials came to take her in, a scuffle broke out and Axel's brother was shot dead. The forge was ransacked and his family driven out.
- That night a devil answered Axel's grief, gifting him a fragment of hellfire to forge a gun and take vengeance.
- After killing the men responsible, Axel became a wanted outlaw.
- Years later, he sought pardon through a bounty on the witch Antikythera and her apprentice Isolde.
- Realizing the bounty was unjust, he turned on the other outlaws there. He and Isolde became gravely wounded in the fight, and Isolde saved them both by entwining her soul with his.
- Now unlikely partners, Axel and Isolde travel together handling personal business until being caught in Realmstorm.
Physical Description:
A massive man standing at a lean but towering 6'8", Axel Reed has the imposing, coiled presence befitting his reputation as a dangerous outlaw. His hair is a wild ruddy red that falls in jagged layers beneath a dark, gold-trimmed hat before being tied into a long decorated braid that hangs to his knees. His devil pact has marked him physically, leaving burnt brown scales creeping across his arms, chest, neck, and face that glow molten orange whenever the hellfire within him stirs. His eyes glow with that same heat, emphasizing a sharp grin that speaks to his confidence and enthusiasm for the chaos and fun to come.

His clothes are rugged frontier leathers and a long coat, with jagged blackened armor fashioned after snake skeletons fused over his limbs. At his side rests a massive custom revolver, built to fire specialized rounds infused with devilish magic so powerful its recoil could knock an ordinary person flat. Its metal still has a faint glow from the fire he used to forge it.

Name: Axel Therogaard
Known History:
- has been working for 100G for quite some time now
- has a small reputation as a trustworthy bodyguard
- literally died protecting a client (hence, Insolvent)
- is known publicly as Zero
Physical Description: "I'm six feet tall. Usually I'm dressed for work, or I'm not dressed at all. If I'm not at work, no reason to get out of bed. I wear stuff that makes me look good. Professional. The clients like that. They don't want to be seen walking around with some cheap North Rock kid. Had to take out a loan to get it, but it's done me well. Better than the first one, at least. I've always got my protective gear on, too - runic armor's nice because it doesn't interfere with what I'm wearing. Got some nice shields that I can wear as wristbands, or carry as a business briefcase. ... what's that? Why am I so pale? I'm an Insolvent. Got pale skin, white hair, red eyes. What, never seen one before? Tch."

Name: Axl Erenbrass
Known History: A sociable troublemaker by nature born in a scholar's paradise. While not the only one, the circumstances around his birth and subsequent natural quirks designated him as a gifted child. A mage among the magicless. However, when he was unable to meet expectations among his peers as a youth, ostracization, and shame followed closely behind. The experience warped him, and now he wanders to prove that he can be the greatest among them.
Physical Description: Axl is an athletic man who stands tall at 6'2, has dark skin, pierced ears, and a dyed blonde undercut. He adorns himself in a showy black duster with a red inner lining that leaves his chest bare, knee-high boots with far too many straps, a red scarf to mask the lower portion of his face, and an overly large brimmed hat that hangs behind his duster. He is often seen wearing several potions that hang by his waist, as well as a pair of glasses that obscure his eyes.

Name: Ayan Jabir
Known History:
Born to slaves, Ayan learned the harsh realities of Nezmira. Eventually, the Sikhaari Order assassinated his masters, and he and his family escaped slavery. He came to idolize the assassins that had freed him, and decided to join the Order, hoping to better Nezmira and help the slaves and downtrodden in a more direct way than the Blue City Revolutionaries, though he didn't dislike their methods. He learned the art of assassination, killing several Nezzim slavers and slave masters, helping many humans and mages escape slavery.

After the Revolution, the Order decided to continue killing Nezzim with no real cause, following their hatred and resentment rather than what would lead to a better Nezmira. He couldn't abide by that, so he left. In his flight, he stole Nightblood and Nalthis, two of the sacred artifacts of the Order, leaving behind the sacred mantle, Sel. Shortly after, a raid from Zalfira nearly killed him, surviving by falling into a realmstorm, appearing on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: At 5'5" and fairly thin, Ayan is a beautiful young man, with dark skin and long black hair he ties back at the nape of his neck. He mostly wears clothing that lets him blend in with a crowd, and tends towards blacks and reds with gold designs. He's very attached to his crescent moon earring.

Name: Azhtang Tenker
Known History:
- Azhtang was an orphan from a small village at the foot of the Tanggula Mountains
- He was a pickpocket and a thief
- He tried to steal from a member of a local martial arts school, and got beaten half to death
- He vowed revenge
- He joined the Empty Monks to gain power
- His gravity qi was incompatible with void qi, so he tried to develop his own cultivation method by journeying to each of the Temples
- At the Temple of Fortitude, he found tablets discussing a god that could grant him strength and a cultivation method to emulate the god's power
- While training with one of his new techniques, the Unbound Steps, he stepped into the void and found a realmstorm, which brought him to the ship
Origin: Temple of Fortitude, Leytik, Tian Yin
Physical Description: Tall at 200cm (about 6'7"), and fairly pretty, Azhtang wears traditional clothing, with geometric symbols along the hems of his deel, and symbols representing Tengri among the talismans and jewelry he wears. He usually keeps his long silver hair in a braid, but his techniques often loosen it.

Name: Azik Eggers
Known History: Up until the inciting incident that caused him to be connected to the black they lived a normal life in the city not knowing of the horrors that crept among the shadows. When he convicted the wrong man he was later kidnapped by them for a dark ritual to banish him to the black. SIA broke in during the climax of the ritual and stopped it before it could be completed however not before it could affect his very being. Now forever tied to the black he tries to coexist among those that know not the horrors, those who know the horrors all too well, and those who belong to the many horrors of this world.
Physical Description:
A dark skinned 5’ 8” man weighing around 183 pounds wearing black and white clothes (what a shocker)

He likes wearing firm and proper clothing to match his serious profession. Outside the myist they still end up being darker toned clothes however bronze detailing and shades of maroon under his black coat.

Name: Azra Yıldıran
Known History: A Grestazs-born prodigy of arcane engineering and successor to the Gaia Stone of Prosperity. Identified during a leyline rupture that took her arm, she was brought to Wulforh and later enrolled at Bruesen Academy. Known for her invention of a glyph-etched prosthetic and mastery of resonance theory, Azra is considered one of the Academy’s most promising heirs. Now on expedition beyond the Runewall, she seeks lost knowledge and tools to strengthen Wulforh’s dominance—though she often follows her own curiosities.
Physical Description: Azra has short, white hair styled in a tousled pixie cut. Her golden eyes hold a calm, steady focus beneath strands that frame her face. She wears a high-collared black outfit decorated with deep blue and violet floral embroidery and silver star patterns. Her right arm is entire made of crystal, adorned with an intricate prosthetic that glows faintly, its surface shifting with gold and green hues and releasing fragments of light. When she walks, she carries herself with a poised, confident silhouette befitting an heir of prosperity.

Name: Baaxee
Known History: Not much is known of the goblin race, found in the forest and ruins of Kor'Tarion. They're not usually worthy of notice, be it by the forces of good, or evil. But Baaxee doesn't just want to be noticed. She wants to be relied on. She wants to be a protector. She wants to be a hero! A rare aspirant to something great, she would move out from the hidden lodgings of the green-skinned species without much of a plan. However, stealing fancy armor and the biggest, nicest shields she can find during a chance find in lost ruins is, while not exactly heroic by itself, certainly a good start! And she knows that, if she were to find her very own band of heroes, that would accept her and see her as the Guardian she knows herself to be, she won't allow harm to come to those who'd give a goblin a chance.
Physical Description: Baxee is a 3'5 goblin, with the standard green skin of her people and with messy hair tinted blue by forest berries. Her head is wide, and her sharp grinning mouth, wider still. The sclera of her eyes is yellow/orange, and the iris a solid black. More often than not, she is clad in armor across her whole body, save her arms, though those are often, instead, protected by dome-like shields that can link together into a closed sphere.

Name: Bai Ziyun
Known History:
• Ziyun was born and trained within a cultivator's sect within the Heavenly Isles.
• She was trained following the Dao of the Heavenly Sword - a technique focused around quick, direct sword strikes and manipulating the energy of the sky.
• While still struggling in the Qi Condensation stage, a band of corrupted cultivator's attacked her sect.
• While her comrades were fighting for their lives, Ziyun managed to barely escape with her own.
• She survived with little food or water in the wilderness for weeks, to avoid detection.
• Realmstorm brought her to the Worldhelm
• After training, learning of her home continent being reunified as one, she seeks to help people in her realm and beyond while seeking to attain the Immortal Heights of Cultivation through following the True Path of Heaven.
Origin: Heavenly Isles, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Physical Description:
Physical Description
Ziyun is a petite, human girl, approximately 5'4'', who keeps her her appearance proper and pristine. Her skin is delicate porcelain, her hair a light, white-blonde, and her sage-green eyes reveal a wisdom and intensity beyond her years.

She wears a white, round collar robe, cinched with a wide band around her waist, and a dark tunic underneath with matching leg wraps.

Name: Barry Strike
Known History:
* Born and raised in Vale, inspired by the arts and stories of grand heroes & stylish gunslingers
* Loses father as a young child during the attack on Vale ten years ago
* Family takes refuge in Bastion, persists through scavenging and survival skills
* Joins the KPLA as a teenager in hopes of fighting for freedom and becoming his own man
* Faces death's door when fighting to save allies during a skirmish
* Miraculously saved by a Realmstorm transporting him to the Worldhelm
* Aims to one day return to Lhodos with new allies and more experience to aid the resistance
Physical Description:
Barry Strike is an enthusiastic young man appearing to be in his late teens, standing at 5'6" with messy, fringe blonde hair and sparkling blue eyes. At first glance, it's his grandiose, larger-than life cowboy character that takes center stage. He's got the skills, looks, and attitude to back it all up-- but his excitable, youthful nature often cracks through his cool persona whenever he's caught unaware.
His attire consists of what you'd expect from a Lhodos gunslinger, his most notable accessories being a worn black hat and a tattered red scarf around his neck. In terms of demeanor, Barry carries himself with the exaggerated charm and bravado of a classic frontier hero, but shines the most is is the warmth of his presence-- bright, carefree, and impossible to ignore.

Name: Basim
Identity: Courageous Hunter for the Black Obelisk
Known History: Eight odd years ago, there was a body washing up the shores near the Black Obelisk, covered with both recent and older burns with a dull blade gripped tightly in his hands, almost like a death grip and might have been one if not for his luck. That person was Basim. The researchers within the Black Obelisk finding him on one of their expeditions into the desert and brought him back to their base to recover. After their recovery he has been working and learning under the researchers' guidance to help repay their perceived debt to the group. Now that he's here, well, might as well keep learning on behalf of the researchers and his own curiousity - hand in hand with the other goldhearted or otherwise.
Physical Description: A tall and bulky human male standing around 6'6 with their brown hair tied into a ponytail. Basim's form covered with several burn marks inflicted on him, the most notable of which being the one over the bandages that cover his eyes.

Name: Bear
Identity: Lone Survivor of a fallen resistance
Known History:
Bear grew up in Windhaven as a young human boy working day after day as a laborer. At about 12 years old, an older kid put it into his head that life doesn't have to be about laboring day in and day out, so he and a few friends went to attended their first resistance meeting. For a few years, he continued his labor by day, and learned how to fight by night. By his 17th birthday, he had grown into a proper shield, learning how to move in heavy armor and protect his allies.
On his 17th birthday, his resistance cell was eradicated. Bear was home at a small celebration with his family. The day of the next meeting, Bear hadn't received his usual message and he hadn't seen his friends at the labor camp for a week. 
Since then, Bear has continued laboring in Windhaven, his Guilt about not being around to protect his friends gnawing at him in the back of his mind. When Windhaven went into lockdown and was subsequently freed, he pulled his shields out of storage and started his journey.
Physical Description: Himbo build: broad shoulders, wide chest, muscular, sturdy, and "thicc." He has a moderately tan complexion, like that of a perfectly baked loaf of bread. His hair is a deep burgundy and he keeps his full beard. Wearing short sleeves and more airy clothes reveals the surprising amount of body hair that earned him the name "Bear," but he only wears so little while working out.

Name: Beatrice Verdenhart
Known History:
Having been raised by a powerful Mother Bear in the wilds, Beatrice was discovered by the town of Willowbough. Having known Beast Magic all her life, she was a natural candidate to become Willowbough's local guardian, a role she took with pride.
What captured her imagination from youth into adulthood, was the legends of the Green Knight's, and the ruined castle close to Willowbough. She absorbed every story she could learn of them, and with dreams of knighthood, vowed one day to rebuild the castle, and to become a true Knight.
After becoming Goldhearted, she took on the last name "Verdenhart" as a declaration to protect all life across every realm, one she holds to this day.
Physical Description: Standing tall at 6'1, she has fair features with a carefree expression, wearing her favourite piece of plaid over her steel armour.

Name: Beatrice Walker
Known History:
- From a young age Bea could always see glimpses of The Black.
- Ostracized as a creepy, unstable, and delusional individual she spent years trying to prove what she saw until social pressure and psychological intervention forced her to bury the truth.
- After re-integrating with society she redirected her obsession into safer outlets-becoming a supernatural fiction writer and earning a job with the Midnight Eye newspaper.
- As a reporter Bea continued to find signs of the occult beneath ordinary life. Her attempts to sneak in mentions of it into the paper eventually earned her a visit from the SIA.
- Rather than backing down, Bea countered with a deal: she'd stay under their watch and use the Midnight Eye as a cover for hidden messaging across the supernatural world so long as they let her continue investigating the Black.
- This cooperation went smoothly, until one night she came across a mysterious briefcase in the place of her SIA contact. A potent shard of the black exists within.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'4", Bea has raven colored wispy hair, deep brown skin, and piercing purple eyes. All her shapes from her face to her body round off into soft curves. Her manicured fingers end with long, stiletto-style black nails, and occult styled tattoos can be found peeking out on the exposed skin of her forearm and legs. She wears a frilled blouse beneath a mauve toned vest, an asymmetrical skirt that falls just above her knees, two different styles of stockings and large, heavy black platform boots to round off her outfit. Various straps, harnesses, and belts made of dark leather with silver embellishments carry items she uses on a daily basis like her black book, notepads, pens, ink, or cigarettes. She smells like coffee, newspaper, tobacco and rain. Bea is rarely ever seen without her tinted violet glasses.

Name: Bec
Known History:
Bec has been in Idyll since before it turned into Hell. Frequented Asga, but primarily dwelled in Nirve, which is where she was when Idyll changed.

Continued living in Nirve, but would go up to Sum on supply runs. Doesn't talk much about it.

Had a brush with a guard in Nirve while recovering from a supply run. It ended with her being accused of assault and getting exiled to The Bastard's Den, where she has been wiling away time, surviving amidst the criminal scum, cutthroats, murderers and monsters that made their way from the other realms, through the city proper. Life in hell is just that. But it isn't always so bad. Bec keeps her head up and keeps going.
Physical Description: Relatively short (5'3). Athletic and Sturdy Build. Dark Medium-Length Hair. Blue Eyes. Eyepatch Covering Right Eye. Scars along right side of face.

Name: Bellamie Ghoroznova
Known History:
Twenty one years a victim, eight years a soldier, nine years a monster...

Born and raised in Little Ottington, Bella joined the KPLA to defend her home. She excelled in combat drills and live fire training. She was even a gem in actual combat.

That changed when her family would be turned to ash and rubble by a Merrani bomb. Following this, Bellamie would join a line of experiments held by Dr. Doskik. She would become a shining success, a woman turned war machine... 

As years passed, she would begin to lose herself to rage and grief, eventually going rogue and going on a campaign of guerilla warfare throughout the woodlands. 

Then, the ship would take her.

Through a year of strife, and the trials of Tian Yin's broken lands, Bella would find not only self perfection, but ironclad peace. It is thanks to these trials, and the aid of her friends on the ship, that now she is truly human again... though bearing the spark of a monster.
Other Names:
Bellamie Ghoroznovich
Agent Lindwurm
Bella-Taisho
Bella
Physical Description:
Standing at 6'6 and some 200 pounds, Bellamie Ghoroznova stands at the peak of physical fitness. Her flesh, though newly regrown, still bears the scars of a life lived in battle - and she would have it no other way.

The old soldier lives her life in army fatigues and a military green jacket, though its not uncommon for her to experiment with other clothes - particularly those from Terra. In combat, though, Bella wears a suit of pure iron, decorated with reliefs of dragons and heroes and a single orange sash.

Name: Benjamin Abram Moore-Fletcher
Identity: Bandit On The Right Foot This Time
Known History:
Benjamin Abram Moore-Flatcher used to not be a good person. 

You could say he used to rob folks, even killin' them sometimes. But lookin' for repentance in a gunfight gone south was enough to get 'im to Idyll, and his brashness with blue lightning got him safely down to Nirve, where he tries to make some space that he would have ruined back in his living life.
Physical Description: 5'10, slightly pudgy cowboy with a light fuzz for a beard. Medium brown skin and god's strongest lineup, immortally preserved in death.

Name: Benício Galhardo
Known History: Born in the Wandering Wings trailblazer caravan, Benício Galhardo is a lively yet rowdy and ready bird. A hunter of outlaws and some what a keeper of peace by proxy. Some might say they are heavy handed when it comes to dishing out punishment or dealing with thieves and highwaymen but he'd say that those who steal and mug others of their things don't deserve too much sympathy. The path of a criminal who holds up families and caravans with violence for their possessions, is a cowards path and that path is one that needs to be cut short. He's sure the cycle of retribution will come to hold the sword over his head but until then. . .
Physical Description: Dressed in a leather duster standing over five feet by a few inches. A rowdy looking kind of expression as a young man ready to tussle, yellow eyes and grey-ish feathers with sharp black talons. In his shadow looms the visage of jaws sometimes.

Name: Bernard Cooke
Known History:
Starting from moderately humble beginnings, Bernard has quietly studied most of his life. Moving into the academy years, very few exist whom he considers friends. Studying and learning about the magitech revered by so many, it was a privileged and exciting time to be a student.
After his studies, Bernard was employed to put his rather impressive knowledge to good use. Being thrown into a group with a common goal, the task was simple, bigger and better. While mostly seen as stress tests, and figuring out the limits of what is actually possible, Bernard had seen beyond the veil on a few opportunities.
Initial reactions to what had been with his new research were not well received, and he dropped the program completely a little while after. But being too important to be left alone, he was tracked down and left with an important choice.
It is during this time, whether to continue working for the Empire, or be disposed of, that the Helm claimed him first, as a means out of this ultimatum.
Physical Description:
about 6'2"
Caucasian Male, slightly husky in stature, almost just muscular.
Ginger hair, face looks older than he is. Generally serious disposition.

Name: Bernhard Klausner
Identity: Scarred Beast of the Scarlet Roar
Known History:
Raised as the son of a woodcutter in Delsatz, then married a merchant from Mastrasz, Bernhard's life took a dark turn at the age of 26. His wife was killed in an attack by a corrupted drake, after which he spent 5 years as a disposable soldier for the military garrison on the southern border of Delsatz.

In an attack by a briar witch, Bernhard was afflicted with a horrific curse, before being recruited to the Scarlet Roar, a mercenary company originating from Wulforh and operating out of Pragstenburg. It was with the Scarlet Roar that he served for five years before his Pride was called for an incursion into the Runewall. 

Of the two Prides of the Scarlet Roar who entered the Runewall, each fifty soldiers strong, two members survived... and now only Bernhard remains aboard the ship as a Goldhearted.
Physical Description:
An imposing man, standing at 6'6" with a powerful physique tempered by constant conflict and manual labor. His face and upper body show scars from fighting a large, clawed beast that took his right eye.

His equipment is well-worn, showing signs of intensive combat using a pair of armored gauntlets. Around his neck is a seemingly hand-crafted pendant that depicts a bear.

Name: Beryl Reynaud
Known History:
- Born and raised in the Barrio
- Wasn't poor, but not very well off
- Some financial instability caused their parents to turn to gambling and drinking to cope
- They despised seeing their parents a mess and got into work as soon as they could
- Coincidentally got into work in DHK and dislikes the corp, but it helps keep their parents stable so they deal with it
- Got caught tagging one of the stores near the Barrio and got hired to make art for some bird guy as a side gig
- Was swept away while out tagging during a particularly bad storm, turned out to be a Realmstorm
Other Names:
Birth Name: Jayne Ybarra
Callsign: Basilisk
Physical Description: Standing at a modest 5'8, Beryl is usually dressed in a hoodie and baggy pants, with a large duffle bag that they use to carry their spray cans as well.

Name: Bion Kosmopolites
Known History: A man conscripted into the Sky Legion of Aeolia to pay off his dead father's debts.
Physical Description: A bulky 6'3" man with natural dreads and a rugged physique. He has a neutral resting face but is quick to grin when addressed. He dresses in a tattered ||grecian|| military outfit.

Name: Bjorn Kalderson
Known History:
Born in Dryholde, Bjorn lead a simple life as the son of a blacksmith. He would provide for his family from a young age, helping at father's smithery. As he grew older, he found himself drawn to the village's cemetery and on occasion would visit the elder whom watched over the graves. The years flew by and the elder passed away, but left the care of the graveyard in Bjorn's hands.

Time marched onwards until one fateful night in which Bjorn stumbled upon a small font of magic in the form of a white shard. He reached out to it and at a mere touch, became blessed with the powers of elemental magic. The ability to control the earth, fire, wind and more were at his finger tips, the power of elemental magics lied within him. He wasn't alone in this revelation though, and work quickly spread through town about how Bjorn had stumbled upon "foul magic" and was ushered out of the town, to never return. Not even his own father watched him leave. Now he finds himself wandering alone.
Physical Description:
At exactly 6'0, Bjorn is a rather broad individual who has seen his fair days at an anvil and other forms of strenuous labor. It's extremely rare to see him not wearing his full set of plate armor covered head to toe in protective gear.

For those who get to see him underneath the suit, Bjorn is a simple-looking human man with dirty blonde hair and brown eyes that faintly glow a faint white--just like the moon.

Name: Blackthorn
Known History: Born to parents in Dryholde, Blackthorn always preferred life outside the city to in it. While young, they'd often accompany their mother on hunts into the nearby forests. One day, while on a hunt with her mother, the two returned to find the city of Dryholde destroyed and their father dead or fled. After being injured while searching for her husband, Blackthorn and her mother escaped to Concordia where Blackthorn's mother took up life as a leatherworker. While Blackthorn ate mostly fresh food from the nearby forests, her mother was fed the tainted food of the city. This caused significant tension between the two and after some time Blackthorn fled to the forest to live permenantly there. When the town was liberatored by the Goldhearted Coalition however, she suddenly felt like she was a coward for fleeing and decided that she'd join up with the coalition to help out where she could while looking for her father, who she hopes is still alive.
Physical Description: Athletically built with long white hair and blue eyes. Wears natural colored clothes to help blend into nature. Rosebud is a black wolf with ice blue eyes.

Name: Blake Morn
Identity: Test Subject #1 for his Life's Work
Known History:
*Initially born in Wulforh, but his parents moved to Pragstonburg not too long after his birth.

*Was eventually accepted into Pragsten academy due to his intellect at a young age. Spent years studying Enara, such as armaments and magispheres.

*He wasn't really that social in classes, but he had a tutor or two that looked out for him, and he even assisted in experiments for extra credit.

*Grew curious about how far he could push Enara and started to wonder if it could be used to contain or reduce the Calamaties...or potential casualties

*Argued how Enarin machines could be integrated into people to further enhance physical capabilities and prolong human life. Some of his tutors thought he was being too reckless.

*With no room given volunteers or funding, he integrated the project into himself. Which ultimately had him expelled.

*He then joined an expedition to field test his life work and prove his point to those too slow-minded to see the most optimal solution.
Physical Description: Blake is a 5'8ft pale man, bleach white hair, grey clothing and a cloak that seems to obscure more of his body. Though careful observation could help people notice that even this coat seems to show how he has integrated Enaran tools into himself. This is further apparent with his left arm, having a full gauntlet integrated into it where it seems to be constantly abuzz with this mint green electricity. More observant people could see that his left hand is a prosthetic, which he regularly maintains.

Name: Brandr Vol
Identity: A Man Striving to be Better
Known History: Hailing from the wilds of Alidistir within a clan of Vanagandr, Brandr was once human. Like many others, he tried to survive with his kin within the tundra. However, one long-lasting blizzard left him stranded alone for days using a cave as refuge. While the snow gave him a source of water,  he was growing weak from starvation. Out of desperation he braved the blizzard for food only to find the body of a dead Yokai. Lacking many options he ate of its flesh and while it kept him full long enough for the storm to pass, it changed him forever. Be it the nature of the beast, or arcane consequences from Kuzunoha, Brandr was warped into a fiery Oni. He now harbors an insatiable hunger for both food and battle like a raging flame he can't quell. After remaining within the wilds of his home aiding those he could, he no longer felt himself fit to live alongside his people within Aldistir. Feeling the same tug many Goldhearted do to the Worldhelm,  hoping to do good with his new life and powers.
Physical Description: Though only 5'10'' in height, Brandr is a unit of a man sporting only pants as most shirts are impossible for him to wear. Having a broad, wide, and stocky build that stores within it a well of power from his large arms and heavyset build. It is a form that opts for strength and brawn, visible in even subtle movements as what could be mistaken for pudge holds muscles underneath. His fiery mane of hair flickers and moves like a living flame. As he himself loses energy, though it takes on a black charcoal look to it. His skin is a dark ashen coloration and resembles scales or cooled plates of magma. Cracks and lines along it run heat akin to lava running through veins. Sporting light tribal markings along with piercings, many can tell he hails from Aldistir as an Oni if they're familiar with that realm. Despite his fanged maw, horned helm, and burning ember like eyes, Brandr comes off as a gentle giant or someone constantly trying to be friendly when not in the throes of combat.

Name: Brigitta ᵀʰᵉ Superstar
Known History:
* Born in the ruins of Heartdom, to a loving family of Lhodosian origins, with a laborer father and a housewife mother
* Would use the echo when climbing atop the metal skeletons of ruined skyscrapers to carry her words and song
* Applied to Gnosis Academy, intent on furthering her stage and find a cause
* Underwent the Rite of Bonding due to wanting to amplify other people's message, too, and be an echo for everyone
* Heads the Gnosis Student Radio, and spreads both upbeat song and a message against all tyranny
* Sent to remedial class due to a general flaunting of rules, especially dress code
Physical Description: Standing at a stunning 6'0, Brigitta sports a mane of sparkling, dark hair, with bangs that hide her eyes, but not her wide smile. It contrasts with her style of dress, favoring stage looks with bright, sunny colors, over-the-top choices like leotards and thigh-high gogo boots that have definitely had her yelled at by Gnosis faculty. Overall, it's hard to ignore, which is the point.

Name: Bronzeheart
Known History: The circumstances of Bronzeheart's birth are unknown. She was found in the northern forests of Kor'Tarion by a group of vagabonds and was raised as one of their own, learning how to protect the people of the land from dangerous beasts and monsters. Following a less than peaceful altercation between their brigand, Bronzeheart left to travel on her own, swearing on her life that she would never let another innocent soul die.
Physical Description: An elvish woman of average height and muscular build, typically clad in heavy armor. Her red hair is decorated with flowers and, in battle, a mask resembling winding branches.

Name: Brooks Howard
Known History:
To hear Brooks tell it, he’s a lazy scoundrel, a womanizer, and a liar. Only the last one is really true.

He's a quick-witted rogue with a knack for smooth-talking and survival. He made a name for himself as a mercenary and a negotiator for the desert’s merchants, using charm and guile to secure himself a living. For whatever reason, he willingly became an Insolvent a long time ago, and continues to wander to this day.
Physical Description: A broad and slightly unkempt Insolvent standing at about 6'. He has dirty blonde hair, a beige coat over a dark green open shirt, dark cargo pants, and brown boots. He carries a well-kept modified greatsword, a belt with magitech tools, and a pistol.

Name: Brym Terablight
Known History: The first clear memory is that of a brand being put upon him, everything before was a blur. Forced into the world of Nezzim rule early in life due to his magical talents. Going around, obeying every order given as if it's the sole purpose of existence, but it's always felt off. Freedom was but steps away, in the right direction. Up.
Physical Description: Blonde hair, orange eyes with a skinny build. He wears  a robe adorned with little decorations, The left side of his head containing a complicated brand running across his neck.

Name: Burkhardt Stahlgren
Known History:
- Raised in Gerlund by his mother and father, Ilva and Anders, along with his older brother, Liam
- Father was a soldier and told stories of their ancestors and their family history
- Brother became a recruit when Burkhardt was 7
- Became a soldier when he turned 12
- At 16, during a training drill near the Permanence Stone, he snuck off to see the stone, and through means he still doesn't fully understand, took some of its power
- Spent his life on the border of the Wasteveil, fighting undead, as did his father and his brother
- After years of fighting, his brother and his brother's squad died when undead swarmed him during one of Waste Warden's bouts of wild magic. Only the scout that returned the shield was left alive. Liam left behind a wife, two daughters, and a son
- Joined the Expedition to find a better way to help Liam's family and to maybe put an end to the undead scourge brought about by the Calamity
Physical Description: Tall at 6'3", and well-muscled at 224lbs, Burkhardt is a defender through and through. Armored in the best he could get during his career in the military, shrouded in the blue and orange of his house, and almost always with his personal tower shield, the Waste Warden, the glowing orange handprint in its center giving off a constant warmth. He also carries a giant blade, though it doesn't seem to really fit the word "sword", as it's too big for any normal person to reasonably wield, and it's not sharpened at all, almost like it's a blank slate for him to manipulate with his Anima magic.

Name: Bàthte
Known History: He grew up in the once-bustling village of Sestiaz, and has spent much of his life trying to be a helper for and defender of the village. As months turned to years and the effects of the Calamity left an ever-decaying husk of what he called home, his family long since taken by its monstrosities and malefic influences, he turned his gaze to the sea, hoping that somewhere out there might be a better life. However, on his way to Sagneron, the boat he'd boarded was attacked by Rimelz Hounds bandits, and between them, the sea monsters, and the looming storm of the Runewall, he soon found himself clinging to driftwood, covered in soot and scratches, hoping against hope that there could still be something more to life. The next thing he knew, he was waking up aboard The Worldhelm.
Physical Description:
A tall, sturdy Leirsin of fair complexion, with the sort of build that speaks of one who shies away from neither hard work nor a good meal. He has green eyes and cherry red hair atop his head, though his eyebrows are a paler shade of strawberry blonde, and his facial hair as well as his body hair are closer to brown. 

Although he was always a capable fighter, his body's stranger abilities (as well as his Omen quirk) manifested only after his catastrophic shipwreck-awakening, and here at the beginning of his journey he's only begun manifesting minor changes, namely a set of lines on his neck that become gills when activated.

Name: CHAOS SHARD
Known History: Elliot Hilde was a young study in the Palace City Michalis in the skies. He quickly learned the arts or icons & rituals his family were granted for their loyalty to the dragons. Elliot used this power to channel chants capable of summoning draconic fire or granting healing & succor unto those who need it. Often using his powers to help others he was found worthy & goldenhearted, and rose up to grant his words of healing light to those who may need them.
Physical Description: 6'3" human man with a lean yet muscular build & fashionable clothes. Wields a magical staff, and bears a tattoo of a dragon across his back.

Name: Cadence Claudia
Known History:
- Born and raised by her single mother in a solitary cabin at the edge of town.
- She was taught to be kind to all living things, fey or otherwise, but that lesson was challenged when her mother's kindness was taken advantage of always.
- Without a father figure, Cadence legally changed her last name to be her mother's first name. A gesture her mother disapproved of, but Cadence would not yield.
- On her 18th birthday, a demon disguised as a fey came to her home and promised her a gift while complimenting her mother's "heart of gold".
- After that day, her mother's health declined as the curse took hold of her; causing a terrible chill to overtake her year by year until she was ice cold on her deathbed three years later.
- When Cadence's mother was cremated, the funeral home came to her with a terrible discovery of the "fey's" gift: Her mother's heart had been frozen solid with magic and a shard of moon rock was inside when it shattered, unlocking Cadence's magical potential painfully.
Physical Description:
Cadence is a 5'4" tall human (5'9" with the hat on).
She has long dark blue hair, that often borders on black in dim lighting, that she styles into two very long pigtails.
Her eyes are an intense shade of red that make her scowls more fierce than she intends to.

Although she came from a naturally cold region in Kor'Tarion, she likes to dress lightly when she has the chance.
Her attire is styled to resemble the witches of the region, but in calming shades blues and clear white adorned with gilded patterns of stars and various runes to reflect the moonless night sky of her home world.

She wields a normal lightweight sword that she meticulously maintains and enchants with her magic to fight against her enemies and to protect her allies.

Name: Caelan Blacklaw
Identity: Agent of Terra fighting for a future
Known History:
* First born of the second generation of Blacklaw children. 
* Graduating from Haven Prep, was thrusted into the work force for tradition into Qilink
* Worked in the CLAW branch of Qilink under D'arcy for 20 odd years
* One of the few on the ground when SKYFALL took place, and one of those afflicted with a strange sickness from the Dusklight shards. 
* Engrossed himself into the reclamation of Termina City and the Capture/Slaying of ARMY-Grade beasts
* Currently one of two Administrators of AGES
Physical Description:
A Terran agumented of the canine variety, sporting grays and darker grays that are only highlighted by the scars of work. 

Standing 5'10" with a frame built from years of work on the front. Sporting a custom made set of clothes made for exploring and fighting within Termina's brutal environment

Name: Caellica Ronara
Known History:
"Grant us clemency. Grant us benediction. Grant us salvation. Grant us **light.**"

These are the words that echoed through Caellica's mind as they hatched from their pupa, shivering. They housed a spirit of ice from the Rootway within their soul as one of the Moth Tribe's youngest seers and empaths.

They grew an immense curiosity about the visions, dreams, and prophecies given to them by their tribe. They began wandering away, sometimes aimlessly, to various parts of Firwood in search of answers, referring to themself as the "Seeker of Fate". 

Their sense of justice and a chance meeting with a young Arzen Algonst led them to join the Fellowship of Firwood, hoping their connections with new friends will help them understand Fate's plan for all of the realm while fighting off the Blight that threatens them all.
Physical Description: A small moth person of 3'3" tall, with gray blue fur and puffy navy blue hair. Their eyes are a bright hazel, with two scars running across the sides of their face. They wear a thick oversized purple coat with two wings poking out from their back, both of them slightly clipped.

Name: Caelum Fulmin
Known History: Caelum was a common civilian in The Veil, located in Karlsgard. He was known for being extremely helpful, going door to door and helping with chores, free of charge. However, on one fateful day,  a powerful soldier from Merrane, Fang, showed up and wreaked havoc. After desperately trying to escape, it proved futile, as he was captured by the soldier, and brought to Merrane. There, he was drugged and experimented on. Scientists rended his flesh, inserting highly advance technology into his skin. With the intention of making the poor boy into a walking weapon. Upon waking up days later, Caelum was informed of his new abilities, and was horrified. Desperate to return to his old life, he pleaded to Merrane. They promised he could become normal again, once they had won the war. Left with no other option, Caelum joined the front lines of Merrane. There, he spotted Fang again, after a brief conflict, He was convinced to make the most of his abilities. Him and Fang fled to Karlsgard.
Physical Description: A male Humanoid standing at 5'7, green eyes with a faint glow. Several black markings scattered across his body, birth marks. He wears a common grey shirt underneath his combat clothing. His combat clothing being a long black coat, dark grey slacks, and black gloves. He walks around barefoot, however due to Merrane experimenting on his body, combat boots are formed whenever his feet come into contact with certain molecules. His clothes differ immensely from what he would normally wear, as they were given to him by Merrane.

Name: Caerwyn
Identity: The Last Healer of the Old Faith
Known History:
Caerwyn is a young woman hailing from the Charred Hills of Kor'Tarian. The details of her birth or childhood are largely unknown, other than that she was left with the Fire Monks due to the unnatural fire in her soul. At some unknown point, she disappeared off the map and eventually showed up once again in the Cult of Brimstone, in which she had joined a circle of healing mages. However, a supposed betrayal led to the circle of those who had been her makeshift family being executed, much to the lost young woman's rage. Before the waraxe met her own neck, she lunged forward, tearing it from the executioner's grasp and turning it against its wielder, and then his allies.

Her retaliation drew the attention of a nearby Balefire brood, and as she realized the dragon was approaching, she resigned herself to her fate. However, fate instead manifested as a Realmstorm falling around her, sweeping Caerwyn away.
Physical Description: Caerwyn stands at 5'5" with blue eyes and long blonde hair that always seems to be fluttering and coiling uncannily like flames, even in a windless land. She is always seen in black, ashen clothing and dark armor ridged with reds and oranges.

Name: Cake
Known History: Once, there was a baker in Kor'Tarion who made the greatest strawberry shortcake ever. Before the last slice could be eaten, the cake decided that it at least wanted to go on an adventure first.
Physical Description: Cake is an animated strawberry shortcake with a diminutive height of only 3'0", or 0.9 meters tall. It's a bit of a coward, and it seems constantly wary of its surroundings.

Name: Calibre Harmony
Known History:
- From Pikeway, a town taken over by Merrane and made into a labor camp for honorary citizens
- Deported, saved by Goldheart though they didn't know that at the time
- Joined the KPLA, and assigned to 21st Magitech Procurement squad meant to track valuable tech
- 21st Magitech followed the trail of a Dupartist lab to find an experimental Walker.
- Merrani find them, ambush the lab, Calibre is forced to soul-link to the Gallant.
- On the run, was picked up by a Realmstorm and joined the ship before they could be caught
- Had their soul treasure stolen within Banshee's Wind Temple of Kor'tarion 
- After seeing the gates of Oblivion, entered a contract with ETA, and encountered Loftur face-to-face
- The Gallant was redesigned as the Cerberus, and it was discovered a demon of their dead mentor figure, Captain Lancaster, dwells within.
- After the return of their soul treasure, and laying Lancaster to rest, they built The Revelation and have now become a Captain in their own right.
Physical Description: 5'10, Brown-skinned, Androgynous, Well built. Wears beaten-up Karlsgard military surplus, customized through years of wear. Their pilot suit is armored, and directly links them into the machine interface of the Gallant Engine. Now, they wear a heavy captain's coat with a KPLA Wyvern's armband. Inactive circuit lines that look like tattoos to the unknowing eye extend from the corners of their eyes and from the tips of their fingers. Now, their right arm and left foot are mechanical prosthetic replacements after having been severed in combat.

Name: Califex Aleactea
Identity: Court Magician Seeking the Ultimate Challenge
Known History:
Some say she was exiled from the fae realm because of her devious card tricks and was supposedly caught cheating during a royally sanctioned duel. Others say she was in love with one of the fae nobles, and tried to seduce her way into the royal family. Few others even say she might have been a faetouched, lured into the land of fae and transformed entirely into a beast. Regardless, she was often found in the Jarwood next to the City of Brightshield, where she soon became notorious as an urban legend of a beast who challenges hapless explorers to games of chance. 

Of course, she merely wishes to have a good time, seeking out the strongest of challengers for her deft card hand. She ventures to Hudal Academy, hoping the alumni there may prove to worthy challengers, but a sudden storm crashes down on her, eventually sending her to the Worldhelm.
Origin: The Autumn Court, Fae Realm, Kor'Tarion
Physical Description: A beastly black creature, almost fox-like in nature. She is always wearing a skull mask with horns protruding from the side of it on her face. She always dresses sharply, with a pink vest and bright red tie, wearing a very large dress coat around her shoulders. A very large bushy tail always trails behind her.

Name: Caliste Poe
Known History:
Caliste lived amongst the streets of Haven her entire life, living off whatever she could fine on her own. She found she could not trust anyone, as like her. They were trying to survive and eat.

In her teens, when she was readying herself to apply for a TEMP License. She found herself an injured raven. Usually such a beast would be easy pickings for a meal. However, for some reason, she helped it back to health. Why she did such an action was a mystery to herself. When it was able to live on its own again, she then left it.

Though to her surprise, the bird stuck with her. It was strange, but for the years to come. The two were inseparable. The raven was her one and only friend. Something for the now roaming hirable soldier to trust. Something that won't hurt, nor betray her. Eventually she named the raven Edgar and took care of him. No matter how little she made with her work. He was going to stay till she laid dead upon some street

For now, it's time for the two live upon Worldhelm
Physical Description: Caliste is a simple woman who wears one simple outfit. Whether she is on the job or not. Black tie, white undershirt, black shirt, black slacks, and a brown coat with a badge indicating her TEMP license. She sports a rifle upon her back and has short black hair. At times when danger isn't present, a raven rests with her. The raven in question is named Edgar.

Name: Calliope Florence Maier
Known History:
- Born within Wulforh as a servant family serving under House Baudouin.
- Held an affinity for Eidola & Enara magic.
- Baudouin family agreed to pay for her schooling within Breusen Mage Academy so long as she continues to work and serve the Baudouin house.
- She agreed, taking the opportunity to gain further prestige in magic.
- Became the charge of Callum Baudouin, and after she graduated Callum was sent off to travel the world in becoming a better leader.
- During her travels, she developed a resounding faith in all the Gaia Crystals and their Beacons, becoming a devout follower of the faith. She always held a love for the crystals but during this pilgrimage zeal manifested.
- Returned to Wulforh a changed woman along with Callum, and when he was casted out by his family she continued to walk alongside him.
- The duo now travel to the Rune Wall, Callum believing himself an exception. Calliope hoping her prayers get him and many others past the wall.
Physical Description: A 5'8 woman dressed in rather stylish clothing though very little jewelry. Silvery white hair that hangs low past her shoulders, part of it braided in a loose braid. Dark sun touched skin, and vermillion eyes full of compassion and hope for better days. By her garments and style of clothing her lineage of Wulforh is rather obvious. By no means a warrior nor carries herself as such, instead bearing many tools and instruments to perform feats with magic.

Name: Callum Baudouin II
Identity: The Apple that Fell Too Far
Known History:
- When he turned 21, he was told to travel the world, and return a better leader. So he left, and ventured through every nation in Eurys.
- Along the way, he arrived at the Eternity Stone, and learned from them. He made a vow to protect Eurys and put an end to the cataclysm, abolishing selfishness from his own spirit.
- When he returned, his new way of life contracted the families growth, at least to his parents. While a public exile would be a scandal, he was informed he must 'go on another journey', specifically, to the Runewall. His parents expect him to die there, though the action is masked in glory to outsiders to the family.
Physical Description: A younger looking man in his mid twenties, with long blond hair tied back behind him that goes down to about his middle back. He wears regal looking black armor cloaked in red fabric. His hand glows with a set of white scales, and his eyes are tired.

Name: Carine Eyt
Known History:
- Born on Terra (Helios)
- Works as a travelling doctor for Sparrow, as well as a mechanic or event organizer for others if required
Physical Description:
Height: 5'7"
Hair Color: Black
Eye Color: Blue
Skin Color: White

Outfit: A standard mostly black dress with a white undercover with a tie, she also wears a small black poncho with white ends. A very modest and official looking attire.

Notable Features: She carries a suitcase with her at all times, it is also attached to her arm by a pair of metal handcuffs so that she can let go of it to manipulate objects.

Name: Carmelita
Known History: Those who know her from Sangang-Daan know her for being a resourceful and quick learner. She speaks with grace and makes sure to present herself as best as possible to everyone, she of course sometimes slips up and swears and talks in the language she learned in Amihan.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'8 wearing a somewhat traditional traveler's outfit with her hair tied up with this red cloth, wearing this white croptop and red scarf and a long cloth with black pants and brown boots. She wields an Enchanted bow with runes related to the old culture of Amihan.

Name: Carmine
Known History: A child of Vale, Carmine lost both of her parents to the war in Lhodos. Spending years scavenging parts from former battlefields, she repaired a defunct Merrani mechsuit and prepared to make her escape. To anywhere she might know peace.
Physical Description: A young woman of reasonably muscular and athletic build. Her hair is wild, fashioned into unkempt spikes with shaved sides. She wears light armor, with a re-breather hung around her neck. Beneath her gauntlets are a pair of pistols, designed to be accessible in an instant should she need to defend herself.

Name: Carnot
Known History:
Carnot was created in Genesis, Terra, with his purpose in design being to research and experiment with combinations of elemental and entropic magic to create a "perfect combat engine."

Carnot willingly helped the other researchers in Genesis, not fully understanding the consequences of what fulfilling his design would do in the wrong hands. Once he finally realized what the consequences of handing over his research would do, he fled from Genesis to Dawnstar Valley. The other researchers seemed strangely unperturbed by his fleeing, to which they simply said that they needed field data anyways.

In Dawnstar Valley, Carnot began his start as a freelance mercenary, hoping to make a name for himself outside the research he had done. He found that protecting workers and envoys traveling through Dawnstar was a rewarding way to use the magic he had learned so far, yet one day, as he was escorting materials from a mining expedition, a realmstorm suddenly formed and swept him away.
Physical Description: Carnot stands at six feet tall. He typically decides to keep himself fully covered in an array of different-colored coats, jackets, suits, and gloves, most of the time choosing to look professional since he has no armor he himself wears. His head is a rectangular, box-television shape with a gray screen. He will either use black pixels in the shape of an animated face to communicate or outright present emojis on his screen if he deems it not a good time to speak. Underneath his clothing is a pale imitation of humanity, with thin, pale skin colored metal plating covering his body.

Name: Carol "Kite" McMillan
Known History:
Carolyn McMillan is a prodige technician from Goldilock City. She isn't exactly the brightest, just the one that always, somehow, made things work. Working under Orrery as mech maintenance crew for augmented work on the launchpads, she soon got her TEMP license and began work as a private contractor. 

Carol has been all over Terra, got arrested a few times already, and is probably wanted for petty crime or vandalism in some territories. 

Be it fixing things, disposing of monsters, and trying her best not to blow herself up while doing so, Carol loves her trash, and loves to get trashed just as much; "it's part of the game!" she'd say. She would rather fix broken things than buy new ones, cause at least now she knows where the breaking point is.

While doing work for AGES, a realmstorm swooped in and caught her.
Physical Description: A though looking blonde girl, with bright blue eyes and tan skin, carrying herself with a carefree attitude and a smile on her face. Just from the outside, you can tell she looks like trouble.

Name: Carol Belle
Known History:
Carol lived with their family, and many others in a frontier village at the very edge of the Marrane border. In semi-secret their family engaged in trade and barter with the travelers, settlers, and militia of Karlsgard. During this time Carol became a shrewd, and discerning businessman, but was later sent back to Korala to receive a proper education.

Carol received formal certification in R&D, and Engineering, as well as compelled military service training.

Upon returning home Carol discovered that their village, and others close to the border had been pillaged and bombarded in a push by revolutionaries to reclaim land. Despite only mild losses, the Marrane retaliation was massive, and deadly.

Carol was so distressed by the violence that they defected from Marrane, and assisted Karlsgard villagers in their efforts of recovery and defense. Despite their desperation, Carols efforts were valiant, and in their darkest moment were chosen to be Goldhearted.
Physical Description: Carol is a relatively diminutive person, only standing to about 5'4" tall. This, combined with their cherubic, androgynous features gives them a very unthreatening appearance that makes it difficult for people to take them seriously. They are of fair skin tone, often somewhat flush. They have mid-length brown hair, impressing somewhere between tastefully curly and mildly unkempt. Their eyes are blue like the sky, and just as open. They wear practical adventuring gear, leather jackets, and are strapped with an array of gadgets. Their tools, trinkets, and otherwise useful items are kept in a large shoulder-strapped bag.

Name: Caspian Riviera
Known History:
Caspian Riviera's bits of his own history is only known to those that attend Gnosis Academy. He is a student in the Regal House of Paladins. Caspian is also an honor roll student who comes from the upper class, with his mother, Cecilia Riviera, being a graduate from the Regal House of Wardens and notable figure in the Galeo Empire in Ripplith.

Those from the Academy would also know about the recent scandal in the previous semester that revolved around him refusing the Rite of Binding to a certain regalia.

However, this is all prior to arriving to the Worldhelm for the first time.
Physical Description:
A young man with long, platinum blond hair as well as red algae that grows much like his hair. With an athletic build, standing tall at 6 feet. With purple eyes and fair skin. Depending on the mood, he's dressed in a dark naval attire to represent his homeland in the deep sea Reflection of Ripplith, dressed in the blue Gnosis Academy uniform or more casual attire. With a hat on top of his head usually.

His vocal pitch is on the deeper side, with a hint of refinement to it. His mannerisms are usually on the reserved side, usually acting with some empathy.

Name: Caspian Wakes
Known History:
Near the old coast of Kor'Tarion, rumor circulates about a sea creature that roamed the area from time to time. Slinking off into a nearby cave to feed or scaring small children on the beaches.

In reality, Caspian looks disappointing from up close. Not much for a sea monster, despite the local tales.
Physical Description: Caspian has an athletic build, and stands at 5ft 11in tall. Otherwise looking like an average man of his age, save for the sickly pale of his skin and the shock white of their hair.

Name: Cassidy Hertz
Identity: Rising Angel Fighting for Her Home
Known History: Cassidy lost her home to the bombing of Morgan when she was a little girl, surviving only with her friend Esmon. She was saved and brought under the wing of Lady Charlotte Luther Von-Hardwick. Her desperation to prove herself and give whatever she could to the desires of Merrane left her an Esper at the behest of researchers, the demon merging unnervingly well with the mage Felkin. The government insisted she join WWA and become an Angel, and more than willing to continue giving, she did. But now she knows what's within Merrane, and she knows what kind of people put something unfathomably terrible into her mind.
Physical Description: Cassidy is a very short 5'1" pale-haired Felkin with matching feline ears often laid flat against her head and a tail tightly woven around one of her legs. She has fair skin and unnervingly yellow eyes, usually wearing fine black and gold Merrani pilot gear that resembles knight's armor.

Name: Cassidy Price
Known History:
Born into a large family on the poorer end of the financial scale Cassidy Olivia Price had one dream growing up with her 6 siblings, to be like her Pa who was a self styled sheriff and officer with 100g.

She trained hard to emulate him, learning to shoot and watching a bunch of old western movies whenever he got a chance to come home from work.

Unfortunately, tragedy struck, her Pa was gunned down after the two of them were ambushed by thugs, Cass ending up paralysed. Her career seemed to have ended before it began… until she received an offer to field test a new mobility unit meant for mounted officers.

Now more determined than ever, she intends to do everything in her power to bring no good folk like those thugs to justice.
Physical Description: Short Platinum Blonde hair, hazel brown eyes and slightly tanned skin. Wearing a Stetson hat, bandanna neck scarf and some old hand me downs under her flexible hydraulic exoskeleton making her appear like some cyborg centaur cowgirl. A railgun mounted to the side and connected via cable.

Name: Cassius Caldonis
Known History:
* A once field researcher of those who used the Observatory as a base in the Tundra. 
* Spend years studying the wildlife on behalf of the team. 
* It was with the destruction of the Observatory in Lhodos that forced him to become the man he is now.
* Almost succumbed to hypothermia in an accident, pretty much died for a few seconds before intervention of the Helm.
* Woke up on the helm after warming back up, miraculously alive.
Physical Description: Bearing pale skin and hair, standing at just 5'10" A single braid of hair over the shoulder amidst a rather messy head of it. They sport gear suited for colder climates.

Name: Cassius Mordred
Known History:
- For those whom are part of the Moth Tribe, they would know Cassius as a prodigal Seer within the tribe with alot of promise to becoming their leader.

- Those of the same tribe would then see Cassius leave for reasons that were not clear to the tribe but one thing was for certain and it was because they did not agree with their methods.

- Many others from distant tribes would see this small moth accompanying a wolf, they are stern and straight to the point. They despise inactivity, wields wolven magics, and fights similarly to the wolf tribes.
Physical Description: White Furred Moth with black Antanae. Wearing the tattered clothing belonging to a member of the wolf tribe.

Name: Cecil Wagner
Identity: Legacy Burdened Operative powered by Potential
Known History:
People from the SIA know Cecil as a understanding, and cunning operative. Respectful but professional is how most who've met him see him as. Way too serious for his own good, but when someone is able to get through to him, they see a much calmer relaxed version of himself, someone not burdened by how appearances should look or how they should act in a workspace. 

Many also knew him for originally having a friend or as friends someone can be when they were originally acting as their handler, at some point they were a handler of a Lycanthrope from the Sundizno tribe but based on reports they would sacrifice themselves, dying in the process but saving Cecil. For a time Cecil was despondent from a week till a month they were not available nor were they at the SIA, until a few weeks before the realmstorm opened up.
Physical Description: Lean, human male with brown hair and tan skin, wearing what most would see as the main uniform for the SIA with some minor modifications.

Name: Cecile
Known History: A short lithe chameleon girl with a penchant for taking things that don't belong to her. She has a reputation for being a no-good thief due to her kleptomania but has never stolen from other gold-hearted* (unsubstantiated). It is pretty common knowledge now that she and Yorick are a thing. She is currently working primarily on dealing with the ordeals in her home realm but occasionally shows up for other tasks if the headache is great enough.
Physical Description: Standing at 163cm Cecile is a short chameleon-tailed girl with large crimson-red eyes and a disarming smile. Her streaks of scales along her body (usually covered by a tight catsuit) and unique prehensile tail show her unique Nezzim ancestry as an Ophidiya. She has a few other distinguishing features that are unique such as her monocular vision (the ability to control each eye independently) and her very very long tongue.

Name: Ceri Raposa
Identity: A broken soldier with a second chance
Known History:
Known records in NTT as recon operative, with a honourable discharge due to injury

Their record proceeded to become very odd after that moving to their familly at downpour city but all job records and such are wiped clean after that. Minor records exist listing them as special forces and similiar notations but no explanation beyond the approval of a NTT temp license of a high security clearance
Physical Description: Very sleek and delicate looking individual bounding with energy. The most obvious part not shown on art, is the fact she always seems to be just above the ground. Looking close she is never actually walking but hovering a couple cm above the ground

Name: Chance Dastardly
Known History:
* Integrated into human society early on, taking jobs in theater to eventually reach his target
* Eventually snagged the internship at a large radio station and worked his way from fetching coffee to DJing
* The eccentric behavior he used to hide his vampiric nature made him a strong personality on the air and finally netted him host status
* His personal show, a write in advice segment called "Chance at a better Tomorrow" took off like gangbusters, but in truth was a way for him to gather intel for the Atent family
* After years of his show however... he began to genuinely enjoy helping his listeners solve their problems and the info smuggling became secondary.
* This change of heart eventually led to his chance encounter with a realmstorm and arrival on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: A lanky, ashen, eccentrically dressed man with slicked back hair and a devilish grin.

Name: Charlies Erp
Known History: For the past Century there have been stories floating around Kor'tarion of lost books being found in nearby forests; open but barely touched. Fairy tales of kids who wonder alone at night that end up getting lost being led back home safely by the light of a lantern being held by a cryptid. Almost every account shares in common the moral of don't lie.
Physical Description: A faceless creature with long deer-like antlers and two eyespots. Vantablack like skin seemingly woven in with the colors of old pages. Looking at them feels like looking hundreds of compressed books bound together yet freely movely. No smile but their "head" compresses and shifts to changes shape to match silloute of someone who is. No words ever leave their person. Only the sounds of fluttering paper appear to escape them to convey thoughts.

Name: Charlotte
Known History:
In her earlier years she did work for all kinds of shady work criminals, peasantry, and even nobility. This mostly consisted in spying on and/or assassinating targets deemed… unnecessary for their clients future. This led her to do military work alongside a now very old bat, despite this she isn’t old don’t do the math.
