After retiring from the front and back lines of death she took up work for the ruler of the Mouse kingdom as the nanny of his eldest son. This title was more so as their bodyguard but years passed and she grew soft and attached to the little baby. She raised them as a child they never really had to have in her line of work while respecting their position, title, and lifestyle.

Time passed and her young master grew to be a mighty warrior in their own right. He formed a fellowship of animals from all tribes to serve as a task force against the blight and she had no choice but to tag along. Despite her kind not being fond of her, she will represent the Spinner’s glory.
Physical Description: A black humanoid spider with four legs and four arms. She stands at a mighty 3’ 1” (2’ 11” without her heals). She wears the uniform customary for her position though she likes to accessories with hats and glasses to stand out among other servants. She keeps most of her eyes closed to not bother others though she opens them all when she notices that she or others around her are in danger.

Name: Charlotte Morgan
Known History:
Charlotte was born to the esteemed Morgan family in the capital. Her family is responsible for vast swaths of factories across the Empire and a great many sponsored inventors with shining promise.

Charlotte gleefully indulged in the plenty, but she possessed an uncontained avarice beyond even her peers... accompanied by a potent pride, fundamental disbelief in others to do what she could, and a passion for craftsmanship.

This led her to the dungeons, diving alongside the delvers for ancient artifacts to repurpose and going beyond in a reckless contempt for safety. However, sheer ~~luck~~ skill kept her alive and well alongside her cocky attitude.

Her parents quickly had enough. Delving was for the lower class, not heiresses. After briefly getting put into custody, in return for getting her out, they sternly demanded her to join the Adventurer's Guild instead if she so insisted on getting her own hands on things. She has begrudgingly complied and left the dungeons. For now.
Physical Description: Charlotte is a short woman standing at 5'2", with fair skin and steel grey eyes. Her appearance is meticulously kept; her brilliant red hair rolls in waves down to the middle of her back, face done up with cherry red lips and perfectly shaped eyebrows, nails flawless, and always dressed in a blended mix of high fashion and adventurer's gear. Her gold hairband reveals matching goggles when she pulls it over her face.

Name: Chieko Miyashiro
Known History:
Part of the private security force of the Kikugumi, a collective or organization for red light districts and bathhouses all over Nishibi. 

Her base is in Ishihara, but her work has taken her several times from home to other settlements to do trade and help transport people.
Physical Description: A Medium tall woman at 5'4 with black hair and good posture, carrying a bow taller than she is and wearing classical archery outfit, but with the signature colours and insignia of the Kikugumi.

Name: Chime Hong
Known History:
- Born into a small village in the Lhasa Outlands of Leytik to the leader of a dojo.
- She was born with an affinity to both Heavenly and Demonic Qi and was trained in the dojo early on to be able to combine it and use Hell Qi.
- Has a twin brother who she was trained to practice dual cultivation with to improve their abilities together.
- Her and her brother had to take their father's place from a challenge from the Empty Monks.
- To see to the challenge they went to put their dual cultivation training to work but something disrupted it, causing her body to fade and soul to be bound to her brother's.
- Managed to win the challenge even with the two's now unique state of existence.
Origin: Chung Lhasa - Lhasa Outlands - Leytik - Tian Yin
Physical Description: A short girl of 5'2" with long red hair, fair skin and blue eyes. She wears large earrings, a large moon talisman and a flower clip in her bangs. She seems to be lightly armored and almost ethereal at times.

Name: Circuit
Known History:
- Commissioned at the [request of a LUA couple](<https://discord.com/channels/1169852846083153941/1170110466299809873/1291077076010668072>) in Silver Rock, Haven.
- Really enjoyed watching boxing and gladiator style matches, "growing up".
- Wanted to become a prize fighter, but they could not make the cut for a SWORD sponsorship.
- Eventually saved up for an ETA license and started doing Temp jobs to make ends meet. Has cultivated the suit and gauntlets image to make themselves seem more professional!
- It was during one of these jobs where they (and some others) fell foul of the leader of the Olympians...and they made their escape through a Realmstorm to safety.
- They're still looking for that big break that will make them famous...and maybe this Worldhelm can help them in that regard!
Physical Description: Circuit's frame is compact (5'8"), but bulky (223 lbs). Their attire for jobs (unless requested) is a tailored suit with the sleeves rolled up to keep the arms (and gauntlets) free. Gotta stay professional!

Name: Ciro Solano
Known History: Born in Proudrock, Ciro was an orphan left on the doorstep of one of the temples of the Sun. It is there that he was adopted by a priest and was taught their ways growing up. Ciro was taught holy magicks in the hopes that he would help defend against demons when he was of age. One day after a raid against demons, Ciro's adopted father came back with a wounded Foal. His father explained that the Foal lost his parents to the demons and had no place to go. Ciro promptly decided to adopt the horse and named him Kaiser. After this Ciro and Kaiser were inseparable and would always be around each other and train so they could fight demons together. Years past and they are finally of age to help defend against demons. They were both assigned to help New Jamestown against demon raids. While they have hard times both getting there and fighting, they had each other and that's what mattered to them. A year later they were both swept up by a realm storm and ended up on the Worldhelm
Physical Description:
Ciro is a 184 cm man with brown skin with medium length black hair that goes down to his neck, he has a braid to the right side of his face.  He wears a long white and gold trench coat and has a holy vibe about him, but he also is incredibly friendly looking. 

Kaiser his horse is a  Quarter blue roan breed horse, he is quite large and has a beautiful coat which is very well maintained by Ciro.

Name: Claire de Blanc
Known History:
As a demihuman orphan in Caldera, Claire was considerably impoverished during part of her childhood. Only until she successfully enrolled into White Wing Academy out of a combination of luck and effort at age 12. She was considered rebellous and rude, but very talented in combat and quick among her peers. Spending 6 years studying and training to be an Angel, formally becoming one by age 18.

Then she spends the next four years in service, taking on very dangerous missions or following orders that one would consider heinous. Even losing friends' lives more than one occassion. Suffering mental tolls throughout her service, to the point leaving the military at around age 23.

The next several months go by like a blur for Claire. Living her life aimlessly as she takes up random side jobs to feel useful every now and them. That is until one day she encountered her first Realmstorm...
Physical Description: A young woman with long black hair, a lithe build and light-brown eyes. She has wolf-like ears on top of her head, and a black wolf tail she maintains often. Standing at 5'3"/160cm tall, weighing 130 pounds/58.9 kg. Claire typically wears comfortable clothes such as a hoodie, shorts, or something she finds cool.

Name: Clara Cardia
Known History:
* Recruited by 100G Security during a recruitment drive.
* Trained in the 101st Powered Security Division as a combat medic.
* Was swept into a realmstorm that killed her other squadmates.
* Continues to work for and support 100G Security.
Physical Description: Clara is a 5'5" slim build female in her late 20s. Her hair is usually dark colored but an augment of hers allows her to shift her hair color at will. Outside of her exosuit she wears military style fatigues and generally more casual clothing. Inside her Exosuit she is in a white power armor with a large shield with a large cross and the 100G Securities Logo. She also has an oversized rifle and various healing tools.

Name: Clarissa Aspenfield
Known History:
Born into a relatively ordinary family in Legenried, Clarissa was orphaned from a young age, leaving her to fend for herself, with only a small inheritance from her parents and lacking their guidance throughout her life.

Growing up, she began to frequent dubious social circles, an experience from which she obtained a fair few vices, a penchant for concealed carry, and a healthy dose of distrust for complete strangers.

Once of age, she moved to Breusen to distance herself from her previous life and study at the magical academy. Though her natural intelligence got her far, her terrible work ethic and self destructive habits caused her to fail her last year, and she lacked the necessary funds to give it a second attempt.

In a desperate and illogical bid for a semblance of purpose in her now empty life, she turned her attention to the Runewall, traveling to Grestazs and joining one of the expeditions to cross into it, hoping to find something... anything.
Physical Description:
A mass of unkempt and tangled black hair crowns a pale face, blood red eyes shining through the inky bangs with a calm and calculating gaze. 

Clarissa stands at a staggering and imposing 5'3'', her top half usually covered by some manner of baggy garment, whose purpose it is to hide a firearm she keeps safely tucked into her pants. Her style of clothing is almost always simple, practical, and maybe a little bland- the antithesys of flashy.

Name: Clement Carmichael
Known History: Clem hails from the town of Legenreid in Wulfroh on Eurys, where he was raised by two bakers as an only child.  He attended a trade school and learned cartography with a desire to map out Eurys' ever-changing landscapes.  However that desire slowly transitioned to one involving combat strategies as the wars of the land devastated the kingdom over a presumed Cataclysm that was prophesized to come.  While he personally didn't believe in the Cataclysm, he did think some sort of disaster was approaching, most likely man-made with how the conflict between kingdoms were going.   However he lacked the ability to actually do anything or help anyone- he was just a mapmaker, after all.  Thus he joined a warband as a new tactician in order to approach, and traverse, the Runewall with the hopes of learning something that could help protect his people from the oncoming disaster.
Physical Description: A human standing only about 5'5" in height with straight brown hair kept in a pony tail.  His green eyes are protected by a pair of glasses.  Wearing a set of traveler's clothes, he's rarely seen without a large satchel containing maps and battle plans, along with an assortment of potions and camping supplies.

Name: Clover of Yarde
Identity: Battle-Sick Cook Contributing Where She Can
Known History:
Clover was born in the small town of Yarde. As a child, she adored the idea of living as a farmer; but fate was not kind to her dreams and the war forced her parents to flee to Bastion and take her with them.
Even then, she didn't give up on her dream. When she grew up, she joined the military and trained and fought hard, even earning promotions, to recapture the area around Yarde and beat back Merrane. That lasted until she and her unit was caught in an ambush and only a few of them made it out alive, Clover losing a hand. 
This broke her fighting spirit and she quietly asked for a reassignment to a refugee camp near Constance. She lived there until one day she was caught in a wildfire while out gathering ingredients, and met Dahlia. 
Ever since she has been recovering little by little by her friendship, even receiving a new hand from Dahlia, until the Worldhelm summoned both of them as a Goldhearted.
Physical Description:
Clover is a short girl usually dressed in a mix of green, white and red. She has vivid green eyes, even if they shine dully when she's in a low mood, and long brown hair tied in a practical braid. She wears comfortable clothes still padded against damage, and holds a five-tailed whip, each one dyed a different colour.
One of her most distinctive features is her left hand - it's missing from half the forearm down. She usually wears a prosthetic made of living wood, gifted to her by Dahlia.

Name: Cole Grant
Known History:
- Cole was raised on the stories of Sheriff's Cavalry, romanticized them all of his life. It was no wonder that when he could become part of the sheriff's department, he started his training.,
- Then he sent to Rivermouth as a greenhorn and truly, he panicked. At least the first three expeditions there. He didn't run, just fired wildly and otherwise gave a poor performance in field testing.
- As opposed to giving up, he continued to believe in those stories, having faith that through this he can be like them, he just needs to try harder.
- Eventually the day would come where he completed his sheriff training and joined the Cavalry proper. Though the day that he was meant to go out in the field, he was swept away by a realmstorm.
Physical Description: A young man standing at 5'6 with messy blonde hair, a pair of pistols holstered at his side.

Name: Colin Subar
Known History:
Colin is a human from the wartorn lands of Lhodos. Born to an unassuming couple in the small village of Hemsway in the Kingdom of Karlsgard, Colin quickly showed that he had a true gift for higher learning. His small village put together their funds and sent him off to the Academy, believing that while it was funded by the feared Empire, it was still free enough to be its own institution, and it would give Colin the education he needed. And they were right. Sort of.

Colin never gained any kind of connection to magic, which frustrated him to no end. Eventually, he was offered a chance at testing a new piece of magitech, which promised to grant magical abilities to those with the proper intellect. But it was all a ruse. He was used as an experiment subject, and though he walked out healthy and whole, he was forever changed.

He fled the Academy, and began his investigation into the true nature of the world, to reveal the evil laying dormant in the magic the Empire used so easily.
Physical Description: Colin is a fairly pale man, tall at 6'8", with short, dark brown hair, pale indigo eyes, and a sharp nose. He has two lines on his face, running from beneath his eyes down to his jawline. He tends to wear simple slacks with a button down, a necktie, and a dark topcoat, and he has a pair of glasses, though he seems like he can see just fine without them. Strangely enough, despite his fairly thin frame, he's heavy, like he's denser than he should be.

Name: Cora
Known History: Living in relative luxary, Cora was an up and coming student at an academy until an incident where her instructor forced her to explore the outside world to learn humility and worldly knowledge
Physical Description: Taller and somewhat fit, with brown eyes dark hair and fancy clothing. Has a blue gem necklace and a flower crown

Name: Coraline Silvermeadow
Identity: Overeager Baker In Over Her Head
Known History: A lovely little baker with a quaint shop near most of the government buildings in the center of Veyrhold, she is known to occasionally stop by to provide food for the hardworking government officials that keep her city safe. Speaking of! She has a brother that works there as a public defender, went missing a few days ago, what a shame.
Physical Description: A slender woman standing at 5'5 in fine clothes, the scent of sweets constantly following her with a small cardboard box in hand suited for donuts and the like.

Name: Cordelia Hartwood
Known History:
* Reporter working undercover for the SIA

* Creates cover stories regarding supernatural incidents

* Was investigating a rogue group of SIA agents to avoid information leakage

* Found a werewolf girl named Petra who was kidnapped by said group

* Took her in since Cordelia was looking for some muscle & having her running around unsupervised could cause public to ask questions.

* Petra now acts as her assistant after saving her from a "kidnapping." Cordelia teaches her how to blend into humanity and the SIA agency.

* Is known for being quite callous in her approach to her work, IE taking in a werewolf purely since having muscle makes her life easier.

* Prioritises public safety , seeking results through whatever means necessary.

"You just implicated yourself, sweetheart. Luckily for you I'm awful good at covering the truth. "
Physical Description:
A 5'6 woman with an cynical and laid-back demeanour.

Typically seen wearing her worksuit,  white shirt, tie, overalls and her signature hat.

Name: Corgaven
Known History: A Liutentant in the People's Guard, nearly tried and executed for treason against the Empire for knowingly aiding the enemy escape.
Physical Description: He is about 5'4", mess of brownish hair and brown eyes. Fairly slender, but not unfit

Name: Cornelius Ribbib
Known History: From those from Firwood in recent history might have met Cornelius on a trade caravan or in some camp. He talks about the wonders of the world with the love and vivaciousness of a fresh-faced youth. He is one of the former students of a frog by the name of Alabaster Croak.
Physical Description: A frog-person on the shorter end, approximately three and a half feet tall. He has smoother blue and teal skin, and bulging green eyes. He is clad in a colour array of cloth woven into a Robe and Wizard hat that is perched neatly on the top of his head. He carries with him a book, treated to be water proof, full of song and tales and all manner of wonder.

Name: Corvin
Known History:
While Corvin does talk much about her prior life, its known that she was born and raised in Veyrhold. Most of her life seems to have been on the wrong side of the law, deeply entrenched in organized crime before something evidently went awry. 

After a stint in prison, she joined the SIA a few years ago as part of a deal. Her skills and interests led her to being selected for the DSC, seeming to be very comfortable studying, hunting, and killing targets. She's taken to Countermeasures quite well despite her limited experience fighting the monsters of Myist.
Physical Description: Corvin is a tall, fair-skinned, well-muscled woman. Clearly built for a variety of manners of violence, as also evidenced by a number of scars on her face, arms, and body. She has fair hair, which is pulled back and braided, shortened on the sides. Typically dressed smartly in a vest or suit and pants. Little else adorns her, aside from a few tattoos.

Name: Corwin Kruzik
Known History:
-Born near Stratford in Eurys.
-Spends most of his early years traveling from village to village in the same region because of his family situation.
-Due to worsening conditions family tries to move to Grestazh, but the trip goes very poorly.
-Alone and lost tries the Runewall out of desperation.
Physical Description: Standing at 1,84 Corwin is a tall man with tanned skin. He sports black hair alongside a singular blue eye, his left orb has been long replaced by an eyepatch. He has  a strong build and a calm and aloof demeanor. While traveling he usually wears simple, practical and discreet clothes, preferring function over form. While ready for combat he usually wears black plate armor and shield, alongside Blightbringer.

Name: Cory Cash
Known History: Cory was a Fixer for a Gang; however, he wished to use his position, connections, and job to uplift his community and family. Now he dedicated himself to uplifting all communities, so one day all of Terra would return to its former glory.
Physical Description: Cory is a tall well groomed man who dresses in sleek business casual clothes and carries an advanced Suitcase where he carries his equipment. His dreads are long, and he typically likes to wear them loose, but sometimes ties them up or dresses them up.

Name: Cressida Octi
Known History: Once a simple woman, she earned her humble income by reading cards to travelers and adventurers. When many came back to her asking for her to lift the curses she apparently put on them, she decided to seek wisdom from a spirit in a lake. Something in the ritual she performed went awry and now the two are entwined. Plagued by the doubt of being an hexer and a danger to the people of Tradefair, not even knowing if she's herself anymore, she started wandering the world in search for answers. Until one day she found a door in a tree, and curiosity got the best of her. Is she ready to be one of those to face adventure?
Physical Description: Her figure is long and thin, with sharp features so that more than one mistake her for a young man. White long and straigh hair encompass her face, and she's rarely seen wearing something different than a long robe and pointy hat. Her book of tarots always by her side hides a set of deadly magic cards.

Name: Crimson
Known History: Daughter of a mob leader from Karlsgard.  A mute, taken an oath of silence.
Physical Description:
Height 6'5"
Weight 175 lbs

Name: Cyph
Known History: Cyph was formerly in a special 100G program of details she is not allowed to talk about. But due to how things in the program had been going it was discontinued freeing her from the obligation she had. However because of this program there were not many skills beyond acting as enforcer that she had, so they sponsored her for a TLEL. As long as she continues to uphold her agreements from the past contract and does good work they have agreed to keep her sponsored.
Physical Description: Cyph is a woman who stands at 5' 5" she has very long white hair and icey blue eyes. She seems to favor wearing an oversized jacket.

Name: Cypher Yuten
Identity: Aspiring Mage delving into the Realm's Secrets
Known History:
* A once solo game developer, having accidentally created a companion consisting of a daemon posessing hardware.
* Created the card game Daemon Spiral
* Worked as a desk worker in an analytical company before taking his inheritance from his grandpa. 
* Currently living as one of the Goldhearted, pursuing the secrets of the Heaven's Sea
Physical Description:
A thin framed snow leopard, sporting eye catching hair. Attire from the upscale side of Silver Rock, showing a modicum of skill to live such a lifestyle.
     A plethora of both physical and mechanical augmentations decorate their body. Giving the likeness of a snow leopard

 Cypher clocks in at 5'9" and weighing in at 184lbs.

Name: Cyrus Sand
Known History:
- Born Cyrus K'zzek in the City of Scales, son of a wealthy merchant family.
- Ran away from home at a young age due to overbearing expectations and a smothering lifestyle. He has come to hold a distaste for the very concepts of decadence and nobility ever since. Took on the surname "Sand" to further sever his family ties.
- Eventually became a shield-for-hire and monster hunter operating out of The Last Hold. He uses what he terms the "testudo style" of hand-to-hand combat, though it's more shield-to-hand.
- Enjoys meat and booze perhaps a little too much.
- Since emigrating to Terra following the Nezmiran Realmstorm’s closure, he has sworn his life to AGES and Basil, his love.
- He is gradually transforming into something between Nezzim and Seaborn, though he still has room left to grow.
Physical Description: A 6' tall teal-scaled Nezzim in black plate armor trimmed with gold, marking him as shieldbearer of AGES. His two shields are practically extensions of his arms, and literally become so when he takes on his Seaborn transformation.

Name: Céline Brighttail
Known History:
Born to an underground community of Ratfolk in the fae realm, Céline grew up in a world of rules and restrictions, longing for a chance to know the world outside. She'd dream of climbing up to the moon, and asking the stars why the world was as it was.

One day, the stars answered.

They guided her away from her familiar home, into the mortal realm, and to a distant, ancient temple. There she struck a bargain: she would be taught the secrets of the stars, and in return, she'd one day return there to restore the temple to its former glory.

With that, she bound Anyktera as her first Arcana, and set out in pursuit of the knowledge and power to make good on her promise. She eventually joined Hudal Academy, where she honed her magic until its ruin during Project Bloodmoon.

Her classes on hold, she took to wandering Kor'tarion, and eventually stumbled into a certain anomalous storm... And the rest, as they say, is history.
Physical Description:
"Many have told me that, when it comes to magic, the sky is the limit. I disagree. The sky is merely my starting point." 

 Céline is a rat-like fae with soft white fur, large rounded ears, and sharp violet eyes. She is most often seen wearing a set of deep blue scholar's robes along with a black mask and a matching hat. Standing just under 4ft tall-- which she insists is quite tall for her kind-- she sports a delicate frame, though her ears give a significant height boost to her silhouette.

Name: Córdoba
Known History:
It's harder to come across Córdoba's history in Aranova than it is to learn about his actions as a Goldhearted. This al-Roya was once a Keeper of the Fourth Grave, like much of his family; then he left to live a few walks of life, from a peddler of fortunes to an exorcist under the Adventurer's Guild.

Nowadays, he frequents Eurysian circles more than anything. He's become a full member of the Knights Wyvernia in Daermon, and the make of his sword places its origin at the Court of Decision. He lives on the ship with his younger sister, Isra.
Physical Description: A slight beastkin, standing five feet tall, or taller with his ears, recognizable by the usually-closed third eye on his forehead. He's always adorned with vast amounts of finery and golden jewelry — plates that line his inner ear, caps over his claws, shining eyeliner, golden teeth, and more. Córdoba's kind and sunny disposition has blossomed since his arrival here, and he's much less shy than he was, even in just the way he holds himself.

Name: DRAGONTRAP
Physical Description: Unix is a male Wilkin that stands at five feet and ten inches and weighs around 175 pounds. He has soft brown eyes, golden blonde hair, and soft brown dog-like ears and a multicolored tail. He also has a strange burn mark across his eyes, causing the skin around his eyes to be slightly darker than his normal skin color. On his days in the field, he wears a set of bronze plates he got from his parents, and on his days off, he is normally seen wearing a set of casual clothing consisting of normal long pants and a short-sleeved shirt. But one thing always stays the same: the two shields he carries on his back at all times and a golden amulet he wears around his neck.

Name: Dagna
Known History: A mercenary hailing from Karsbren looking for work. She earned a bit of a reputation for mostly taking jobs that involved protecting merchants and taverns. Despite being known for taking safe, cushy jobs she was strangely eager to join the expedition into the Runewall.
Physical Description:
✧Tall (around 5'8")and slender, slightly stronger than she looks.
✧Earrings are a keepsake from her late sister, only takes them off when necessary.
✧Clothes are clearly worn yet well taken care-off.

Name: Dai Shuye
Known History:
Shuye was brought on the ship during a Goldhearted mission. She once denied her own status as a goldhearted. She has advertised her counselling services in the past, but shortly after avoided making too many public appearances.

Over time, she became royal seneschal to Gin, before coming Emperor in his stead. Now, she has both a feminine and masculine form, the latter of which goes by Dai Tenbin.
Physical Description:
As a woman, a 5'5 lightly melanated woman who dresses in colorful kimonos that, to those familiar with the culture, suggests an imperial background. As a man, much the same, but a few inches taller.

Her eyes bear the pattern of the Taiji, with topaz being on top in her masculine form, and amethyst in her feminine form.

Name: Daisy Starbloom
Known History:
Unlike other Deerfolk families, Daisy grew up isolated from the world, living instead with a secluded coven of Forest Witches in the far north-eastern region of the Gwaed Forest. Raised as a young initiate under the Coven’s eclectic teachers, she was taught the art of herbalism, gardening, and sustainability. 

However, despite her enthusiasm and reverence for the earth, she struggled keeping pace with the other apprentices - seeming to lack an intuitive green thumb that her other sisters possessed. No matter her determination, she felt she was always one step behind, a flower struggling to bloom in the shade of trees. It wasn't until one of the Coven's renowned Hedge Witches stepped forward and nurtured Daisy as one of her own that her hidden potential began to flourish. 

And now, like a sapling with budding leaves, Daisy recently has taken the leap forward to leave the hearth of her coven, and truly figure out what her own green thumb looks like beyond the woodlands.
Physical Description:
Daisy is a 5'2" half-deer girl with warm, dark-brown skin and white spots that dust across her cheeks and fawn ears. Her hazel green eyes seem to always carry an ever-curious, yet serene expression, looking almost lost in whatever occupies her thoughts at the time. An abundance of curly brown hair tumbles down her shoulders and back, partially entwining the small antlers atop her head, which bloom with small flowers that change alongside the seasons. Her everyday attire reflects her rustic upbringing, making up cottagecore dresses that are sometimes paired with a half-apron, even when she's not actively cooking. 

The sweet scent of honey, citrus blossoms, and fresh cinnamon seem to follow wherever she goes, as if the springtime warmth lingers in her presence.

Name: Dane Alston
Identity: Cowboy with a Heart Full of Scrap
Known History: A fairly well known seller of scrap material, trustworthy enough to hire for jobs but not trustworthy enough to keep around for the long haul. Generally affable and decent at keeping his nose clean, and it is that latter part that keeps him poor and without significant work. He is generally satisfied with enough pay to keep him full and enough scrap to keep his hands busy.
Physical Description: About as wiry as a life of wandering and scavenging can get you, Dane Alston stands at a lanky 6'3. His clothes are well worn to the point of disrepair, and the only piece he seems to wear for aesthetics is the duster The clothes underneath and the hat on his are all sturdy and function and lacking a bit of style. He carries on his back a large pack, and has a partially filled holster on his hip.

Name: Danny Wong
Known History: Danny was once part of a 100G force in Haven.  After a case gone wrong, He left 100G and Haven to Downpour City where he began a private detective agency.  Here he began to come accross strange occurances that would lead him on a path towards uncovering the truth about the realms and the Goldhearted.  However during his quest for information he would find himself caught in a realmstorm and brought directly to the ship itself.
Physical Description: Danny is an augmented human with a draconic appearance.  His body is covered in scales of varying shades of white, black, brown, and yellow.  He has a large finned tail.  He wears a fedora and a long coat, along with a pair of tinted glasses.

Name: Dante Sterling
Known History:
- The youngest son of 100G Board Member Anderson Sterling, Dante grew up surrounded by a corporate, morally compromising environment that he loathed.
- Rejecting the corporate game, Dante's father redirected him to a different role: 100G Strategic Visibility Officer. Sariel's Golden Boy.
- The role was exhilarating. Live missions, public trust, real impact. Dante felt he had something genuine, and 100G could drive up recruitment and showcase cutting-edge technology with a charismatic face behind it.
- Eventually, Dante learned the trade-off. Visibility was its own form of containment. If he pushed too far, the spotlight was used to pull him back in line.
- Dante realized he would never become more than a company symbol. At the recognition, he snatched some tech and left 100G to go rogue alongside his bodyguard Emile.
- Now carving his own path as an independent mercenary and corpo-pirate, Dante lives to prove, loudly, that he’s above 100G and any other system that would try to own him.
Other Names:
Anderson’s Kid
Ex-100G Strategic Visibility Officer
Golden Boy
MITAMI Bearer
Physical Description:
Dante is a broad-shouldered, powerfully built figure with dense muscle and flashy blue-gold cybernetics. His hair is dark and swept back in black-blue layers, and his narrow gold eyes are usually paired with a wide, sharp-toothed smile that reflects his bold, charismatic nature. He sports a cropped blue-gold tech jacket worn open over bare skin, decorated with a collection of pins, buckles, and buttons. Below, he wears slim dark pants with a MITAMI logo emblazoned along one side, as if to openly claim the weapon and its branding as his own.

He carries himself with an easy confidence, standing relaxed and comfortable in being seen, heard, and relied on. A large mechanical sword rests across his back in a reinforced sheath, and his right arm is fitted with a matching magitech gauntlet. When he draws on elemental power, faint blue-gold light pulses through his cybernetics and equipment, and elemental wisps flicker into view around him, lively and eager to fight alongside their idol.

Name: Daphila "Daphy" Tinkertop
Known History: Daphila grew up in an isolated little community of Fae called Dazzleton. The Fae of Dazzleton are all adept illusionists, except Daphila, given magic never made much sense to the young Fae. Unable to help provide for the grand illusion that keeps the little town hidden from the rest of the world Daphila felt like an outsider among her own kind. In this solemn state she took to woodcarving, sewing, and even tinkering with clockwork, eventually being able to make a few toys for herself. They served as nice little distractions, letting her forget her predicament even for just a little while. She then started making them for other kids, seeing the smile on their faces made her realize what she wanted to do. So she packed up and left her hometown to travel across the world and spread the same joy she felt for a period of a few years, before the Worldhelm sought her out.
Physical Description: Delphila stands at a staggering 3'2". She has long sparkling purple hair and is usually carrying around a pack full of trinkets twice her size. Making jingles, and rattles everywhere she goes.

Name: Darius Kallis
Known History:
The heir to Silverdale's noble house, Kallis. The house is known to most as one that deals in business and diplomacy. To an increasing number of others though, they're known as criminals and spies.

The main Kallis line are snow Leirsin chased from Rocade to Silverdale generations back. Their actions vary from hosting masquerade balls, to infiltrating smuggling operations to seize their stock.

Many accusations have caused the house to lose favor, along with general wariness of the Leirsin.

To restore Kallis' name, Darius proposed two things. One, the Kallis name can be earned by worthy employees. Two, he and his willing siblings would join the 1st expedition to the Runewall. Among them, only Darius survived.
Physical Description:
A 6'0'' Leirsin, his hair white with occasional darker patches of grey, likening his Leirsin features more closely to that of a snow leopard.

He's often seen dressed in Silverdale noble garb, typically a fine suit with a coat hanging from his shoulders. One common factor of his clothing is a peculiar black and white emblem, one depicting the black king of chess embedded in a white hawk. Typically leans on a sharpened cane.

Name: Dastan of the Swirling Sands
Known History:
Dastan was born to one of the free-spirited clans living away from imperial influence, deep within the northern sand dunes. Dastan has always been a dreamer, fascinated by the heroes of old, he left his homeland to seek his fortune in distant lands. To survive in the harsh desert and make a name for himself, he turned to banditry, targeting imperial convoys and wealthy travelers. Yet, despite his roguish lifestyle, Dastan held to a code of honor. He never raided those who could not afford it and ensured his victims had enough supplies to reach safety.

After a particularly dangerous raid on an imperial convoy hunted by Kiir, Dastan took a mysterious relic, a blood-red gemstone set in brass known as the Raging Sun. While he could feel there was something wrong with it Dastan couldn’t bring himself to part with it. After all perhaps this gem was the key to become a legend like those of old.
Physical Description: Dastan is a human, 5'11 ft tall with a well built body. He has tanned skin, shoulder length blue hair and golden eyes. Often wearing ornate clothing that as well as jewelry.

Name: Datu Anahi
Known History:
Anahi grew up in Sampaguita Village as an only child amongst her loving parents, friends, and village, but has disabled with an empty left eye. When she turned 12, she discovered her affinity with wood qi and trained for a decade under her mentor, Arjo. She then wandered the Tikba Rainforests with him until they were attacked a beast echo resembling Qionqi, her empty eye glowed gold, and she returned to the village on Seer Patu's demand. She was divined ready to enter  a realmstorm, so she did. 

Since those beginnings, she has discovered she is a reincarnation of a man before the heavenly war named Datu. She is both, Datu Anahi. Once Heaven's Favored Son now Heaven's Scorned Daughter, she embraces himself as both. Her loss, of parents, friends, mentor, whilst on this ship is all part of the Dao of Man. With the blessing of Dimalapitan, she walks as the Datu of Saangang-Daan, carrying the will of her whole homeland on his back. All of Saangang-Daan knows the name.
Physical Description:
(F) 5'11" | 158 lbs. | Heterochromia - Gold + Brown Eyes
(M) 6'5" | 184 lbs. | Heterochromia - Gold + Brown Eyes
Datu Anahi is a muscular yet lithe genderfluid human cultivator. Both forms carry traditional Sangang-Daan tattoos across her chest, arms, and upper back that represent the human desire of the person who looks into them. Her body is adorned with gold as well as the cultural blend of Amihan and Tangbawan clothing styles. She carries the aroma of a tropical jungle meadow and the melody of life wherever she walks.

Name: Dawn of Nezmira
Known History:
Dawn of Nezmira, she who was once named "Zero". Once she believed she had nothing, and now with the gift of the Dragonlord of the Dawn Atem she has a new purpose. Many of the Goldhearted would remember her for her odd behaviors and meek appearance. 

Now, Dawn stands proud of who she is and for what she believes in. Entrusted with the legacy of Dragonlord Atem she returned to the ship changed. Now ready to carry on the hopes, dreams and future for the people of Nezmira.
Physical Description: Standing roughly at 5'8 (172 cm) she stands a few inches above average for her people. Before she was malnourished and barely alive. Now, Dawn stands proudly for her people. Gifted with the power of Dusk and Dawn she glows faintly with an golden light. One of her eyes a crimson red and the other a pale turquoise. Proudly she shows off her draconic features, adorning her horns with jewelry to show devotion to the Dragonlord of Dawn.

Name: Deacon Farum
Known History: Deacon grew up in the city of Midholde, son to a wealthy merchant. He never really liked the merchant life much, so he would often sneak out from home in order to spend time with those who traveled through the settlement. Deacon found love in the arts. Singing, acting, story telling, these things brought joy to him, which made him love talking to the travelers all the more. To hear the songs and stories of peoples across the land, it was his dream. He left for quite some time on a trip to see a potential business offer at the behest of his father. When he finally returned to Midholde, he saw its ruins, his family gone, he was by himself. With nothing to his name, he spent no time with grief and went on a journey, not just to fulfill his dream, but as a duty to make sure those who fall will have their stories and songs remembered forever.
Physical Description: Dirty blonde hair, skin white, and eyes green like emeralds. Deacon stands at a height 5'7ft, his physique skinny and average in almost every way, save for the fact that his face is as beautiful as that of an angel. Upon his head is a reddish orange and gold cap adorned with the exotic feathers of orange and yellow birds. He wears baggy and poofy pants alongside a shirt of similar fashion, sporting colors of scarlet and a dark yellow. Around his shoulders and neck is an emerald green scarf of great length, long enough to almost seem like a cape at times. His shoes are rather goofy, but are made of good quality leather.

Name: Dealan-Dè
Known History:
Dealan-Dè was originally a seamstress from the town of Dryholde, tasked with sewing clothing for the townsfolk.  Though she was a master artisan by no means, she was dedicated to her work, and cared greatly about it.

One night, whilst exploring a remote corner of the Gwaed, she saw an entrancing sight out of the corner of her eye; a fragment of silver stone, with a colony of butterflies perched atop it. She approached the location, and touched the stone, causing a cascade of emotions and thoughts to pour forth. Memories of tragedies from the past, strong feelings of relationships she had, be they of love or hate, and a portent of danger approaching on the horizon. Her desire for justice shaped the stone into a blade, and the butterflies instead perched on her. Unsure of what to make of things, but fearful of the future it foretold, she attempted to cut through the darkness surrounding her, and in its wake, found herself upon the Worldhelm, with no guidance from the newfound creatures.
Physical Description:
Dealan-Dè is a remarkabaly short girl, measuring up to 4'7 in height, and weighing 92 lbs. Her features are svelte and eye catching, with hair and eyes of a subtle lavender shade. 

As if to compliment her elegant and dainty appearance, she is followed at all times by a small gathering of butterflies, or at the very least, apparitions that take the appearance of butterflies. With no physical substance, and an appearance that vanishes once in someone's peripheral vision, the ethereal creatures lend to her unique silhouette, making her easy to spot in a crowd.

She clothes herself in flowy, breathable outfits, prioritizing range of motion over protection, making up for it with small bronze plating in some areas. On her hip, even in casual settings, is a beautiful sheathed sword, that she constantly rests her hand upon, as if to ensure it still remains in its proper place.

Name: Deckard
Known History: They spent their time before going the worldhelm simply swimming and exploring the oceans of Terra while watching but not interacting with any people or buildings they come across.
Physical Description: Mainly seen as a shambling diving suit filled with a thick black liquid. They’re about 6’ 2” however due to how they usually stand they remain at a 5’ 9”. When pushed to the limit the arms of their suit will often rip open revealing several tentacles that lash out at anyone around them.

Name: Delphine Fiore D'Myrdel
Known History: Delphine Fiore D'Myrdel is a Firebrand of the Scarlet Roar, joining the mercenary company about a decade prior to the expedition those that have knowledge of the countless wars that have stricken Eurys are likely to be well aware of this Landschknect. A sorceress able to channel flame with her voice, near every battlefield she steps onto is left scorched. Any who've done battle against the other kingdoms of Eurys may have even met her on the field should they have been so unlucky, though they might note the oddity for a Firebrand not to travel with the full number of their Pride.
Physical Description: Standing at 6'0, Delphine is athletically built and commonly dressed in the multi-colored patterns common to the Landschknects of Eurys. Bearing scars from 2 decades of work as a carrier soldier and mercenary, the most prominent Delphine has is her lost eye, typically hidden under an eyepatch with the golden inlay of the Scarlet Roar's emblem. Her equipment is as well-worn as she is, but the gaudy golden trinkets and adornments she wears as a symbol of her success typically blinds those unaware of her reputation to a storied military record.

Name: Desiree
Known History: Desiree is one of the newest members of EntroPRISM, having joined after many years of wandering the cold streets of Terra, performing odd jobs and trying to find some kind of purpose or place to fit in. After joining EntroPRISM, her disposition improved greatly, and her actions eventually caused her to join the Worldhelm, where she continues her streaming career.
Physical Description: Desiree is a 6 foot tall, heavily modified LUA, sporting a heavy, bulky frame designed for protection or law enforcement. Since her creation, however, various mods have been added to her frame to appear more cutesy and catlike.

Name: Desoka Targandr
Known History: Born in the icy wilds of Aldistir to Star-Crossed Lovers, Desoka's life changed after he was abandoned at a young age outside the village of Camp Von Kibo. He has been honing his martial skill since childhood but has always had the innate power over the elements, After reaching adulthood, he decided to use his talents and become a monster hunter. Now known for his cold heart and sharp blade, his deeds only grew as he honed his skills facing the perilous beasts of the realm. After a deadly encounter with a draugr, Desoka finds himself upon the Worldhelm seeking a new purpose as he picks up his sword once again in the hopes of securing his new life and surviving whatever comes next.
Physical Description: A dark skinned young man, about 5'10 in a white combat tunic with a cloak and a large katana with a bronze grip. He has black hair and icy blue eyes, he typically has a mean look about him and always seems to be cold.

Name: Despina — ᵀʰᵉ Deliverance
Known History:
Despina Stripeless hasn't opened up much about her history at Gnosis Academy, but some things are pretty easy to tell about her. Just from the way she acts and carries herself, it's clear she's from Dreadlan, and her look as a Regalia all but screams it at a glance. People with a little familiarity could guess she grew up with Wild Souls, and probably ones living outside Gray Fox Castle. And from some of the things she's answered in questions or shown in practical magic, she knows a bit of the nastier magic Dreadlan's known for.

A student in her third year, Despina has already failed a few classes. She has talent and dedication, having already completed the Rite of Arms, but struggles with book learning. She also struggles with socializing, being clearly more used to the social dynamics of whatever wolfpack she grew up with. (Though she'd tell anyone who *asked* that they were striped hyenas.)
Physical Description:
*Despina:*
5'2" (158 cm)
Curly red hair, shy of chin length
Brown eyes with rectangular pupils
Light brown skin
Spiraling sheep horns
Wooly red tail, fairly long (like an undocked sheep)
Dressed in a Gnosis Academy student's uniform: a pink-purple shirt with gold accents, sleeves flaring at the elbows, with a darker undershirt going to the wrists; a red sash bearing the insignia of the Regal House of Treasures; off-white pants; and oddly shaped boots on her hooves.

*ᵀʰᵉ Deliverance:*
A one-handed axe with a haft that looks to be made of a long femur, cracked at its bottom. It is wrapped with fabric with white and black stripes to make a handle.
The axe is largely dark black, shifting to dark grey as it starts narrowing to the cutting edge. Symbols are etched onto the blade that dully glow when she is using her token magic while in her core.

Name: Devendra Tharvani
Known History:
- Born in the House Bhavya lands

- As a child became inspired by Dharnim Savvat when he constantly spare those who tried to challenge him

- Devendra ends up joining the Slayer legion once he became of age.

- Showed great promise as a warrior in the legion though he always tried to do more beyond his station. (Be it move in to save a fellow soldier despite a retreat order or challenge demonkin before the main legion arrives)

- Soon he was starting to show signs of Purusa due to his deeds.

- Before he went to the wastes to practice his new strength Devendra was swept up by a realmstorm
Physical Description: Tall man with black hair and beard. Wears what seems like simple cloths however it has miltary armor underneath them. Always seems to have a jovial expression on his face.

Name: Devon d'Augustino
Known History: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1q-b_0MDDqucyATSm6KUEtIhzr6c01JfLH1twuY7wFm8/edit
Physical Description: Devon is a 5-foot, 5-inch king. His whole body has been modified to look like a tiger shark, complete with teeth, webs between his fingers, and a fairly long tail. He's got short black hair, coffee-colored irises and the back of his tan-and-sand body is lined with darker stripes all the way down his tail.

Name: Dhata Chamomile
Known History:
Dhata Mithril had worked tirelessly to further one goal: to imbue everyone in Lhodos with psychic abilities. To her mind, it could end Merrane's tyranny for good, elevate humanity, and usher in a new era of unity, peace, and joy in Lhodos. She went so far as to make herself the test bed for this experimentation, becoming an Esper and gaining incredible power at the cost of instability and pain, all in pursuit of this utopia.

For a time, they lost all ambition, and then, all memory. But now, they are prepared to make good on their dreams. To bring the world into a new era. To bring peace, happiness, and hope. To be a hero.
Physical Description: Dhata stands at a little over 5'9", with a rather reedy build. Their skin is dotted with scuffs and bandages from past training injuries. They carry themself with a calm, focused demeanor, their inner turmoil all but settled.

Name: Dira
Known History: Dira, is a part of a family of 7. Mom, dad, and 4 other siblings + her (being the second youngest). Most of them handle the crafting and shop, with the eldest and Dira being the ones that goes out and get materials for them. Depending on what's needed might either be returning in the same day or a few days after. Dira does know how to craft a little though, just pretty average at it compared to the others in her family.
Physical Description: Dira is a 3'8" slender green lizard with a decent build to her body and grey purple eyes. She also wears lighter clothing with lightish armor around her body that her family had made for her.

Name: Dolce Amoretti
Known History:
- Born in Soda Gulch
- KAIJU PR Representative
Physical Description: A small 3'5" tall creature called a Septid, they absolutely beam with energy. Instead of the normal smell of a Septid she radiates an array of various flavors almost as if being in a KAIJU production facility. She's always surrounded by a group of 12 snakes that wrap around her and/or fly around her. Their seem to be 2 groups within the swarm, The Rainbows & The Tropicals.

Name: Dolly Felton
Known History: Dolly comes from the Fae Realm, starting her journey when a travelling artisan mistakenly came across her domain and provided her with laughs and accidentally leaving the tools necessary for tinkering and puppetry— she now looks for said woman whilst exploring the outside with curiosity and explicit interest.
Physical Description: Dolly is a fae, whose physical body outside of her realm consists of a small, stout plushie doll. From the first look, it is not too apparent that the doll is magical, but it is where her spirit is stored, made from a very soft, durable fiber.

Name: Dominic
Identity: A Man Best Left in the Drafts
Known History: Dominic is a late arrival from Castle Ladon, having put off the incessant call of Yubel for months before reluctantly stepping aboard the ship. Despite living in castle Ladon with many other Delerians, he's not a familiar face to most.
Physical Description: A 5'7" man with one arm covered in red dragon scales and tipped with claws. A furred, white tail that just barely touches the ground at rest trails behind him.

Name: Donovan Goodwin
Identity: Ceremonial Dancer With a Penchant for Fooling Around
Known History:
When he was younger, Donovan was a wandering dancer who traveled across Kor'Tarion and put on beautiful performances only to vanish the next day. He didn't stay for long, only using them to earn enough zenit to make it to the next settlement.  
As he arrived to the small town of Dryholde and started setting up for his show, he was approached by a kindly middle-aged man who seemed to be the town's priest. He asked if Donovan had appropriate accommodations for the night. Donovan brushed him off, but he was persistent. He gave in and was brought to the town's orphanage. Despite being 19, he was treated with overwhelming kindness. Donovan fell in love with the sense of community the quaint town had and felt at home there. That night, he put on the most heartfelt dance in his career. Enchanted by the town, he decided to settle down there, becoming a frequent helper at that very orphanage. Spending time with the kids softened him up, and he's developed a love for pranks and jokes as a result
Physical Description: Donovan is a tall, stocky, slightly intimidating human man dressed in plain religious vestments. On his shoulder he carries a long, golden cloth he uses in tandem with his fans for his performances. Despite his grey hair, he is, in his words, "29 years young".

Name: Doragon
Known History:
Doragon is an Ophidiya, born from a human servant and a Nezzim Master in the City of Scales.   Doragon was immediately hidden away or else risk the disgrace of the Nezzim parent’s bloodline.  However, soon it was discovered that Doragon had the ability to shape shift as either pure human or pure Nezzim.  Therefore, Doragon was brought back to “hide” in the Nezzim environment.  However, someone discovered their true natures and the tattling began.  Doragon, having so much love for their mother, left the City of Scales to avoid adding to a possible scandal.
Doragon forged ahead eventually finding their way to City of Sand Sailors where they have been fully excepted by the local citizens while they are in Nezzim form.  However, Doragon has not fully accepted themself and thus begins their inner journey.  They have trained in the ways of Fury which is fuel by their inner turmoil and hate for the Nezzim.  They also have found they have a way with the Elements garnered from the birth ancestr
Origin: The Realm of Nezmira from The City of Scales
Physical Description: 6'5"  and 200 lbs pale skin being with silver scales lining the sides of their head, neck, arms, torso and legs.  Black wings expand from the back and silver horns protrude from their head.  They have white strait hair.  They wear a long combat tunic that looks like a trench coat and have high black boots.  Shirt and pants underneath their tunic.

Name: Dorian
Known History: Dorian was sent by his family to a monastery in the mountains to learn the Fivefold Philosophy, a way to balance out the spirit against both the physical elements and the mental uncertainties that exist in the world. He devoted himself to studying the spear as a means of defense and also centering his mind. He strives to perfect his technique in both areas. Once he finished his training, he took a position at the Fire Shrine, helping protect the shards so research could continue on how their power could be used to reverse the damage that was done when the moon disintegrated.
Physical Description: Dorian is an athletic human of slightly above average height from Kor'Tarion. He has black hair and brown eyes. Height 5'10" Weight 160 lbs

Name: Dr. Dorian De'Angelo
Identity: Influent Vampire Doctor Living a Half Life
Known History:
He arrived at Brindlewatch about ten years ago when interested in learning the art of life, being tutored by many Chirurgeons. Dorian was a curious kid, and did everything he could to absorb both the academics of being a doctor, as well as the social rules of being a member of society.

It wouldn't take long before he became a true practitioner and a respected and influent aristocrat. During the day, he saved lives in the hospital, away from the sunlight. During his night, he attended meetings, balls and reunions with the nobility, inserting himself deeper into human civilization.

De'Angelo believes that the bloodlust of beasts is a disease that is rotting away precious life; but, he will aid in curing it, be it with his words, or with his scalpel.

As such, he joined the DSE voluntarily, working as a diplomat and informant for supernatural cases, using his charisma and influence to make sure that, at the end of the day, the innocent are safe, and the wicked get what they deserve.
Physical Description:
A tall and lean man, with long dark hair worn in a loose ponytail pulled back, and a few strands falling forward. His face is sharp, and his dark eyes often seem disinterested in the mundane.

Usually, he dresses in a black tailored coat, with a white ruffled cravat, looking the part of an aristocrat or noble.

His posture is of someone who knows something about you that even you are not aware, and he looks mildly disappointed at your self-ignorance.

Name: Dr. Eno Somata
Known History:
A doctor who has worked 10 years in biotech, specializing in genum-based health and cognitive tech.

Joined CLAW (QiLink) to apply his science in direct, real-world situations.
Physical Description: Eno Somata is a green haired person who is entirely clad and masked, making his actual appearance difficult to read. He wears a recognizable face mask that has lizard-like features to it. His body seems very lanky, but there is a strange strength to it nonetheless.

Name: Dr. Henry Calvin
Known History: The most well known about Dr. Henry Calvin is his wagon that has the logo "Calvin's Curiosity!" noting him as an Snake Oiler, someone who peddles with various materials that while some would claim false he would claim they did not believe in themselves hard enough.
Physical Description: Blond hair with a stubble showing a very easy going smile, despite his proffession his clothes are still unkept and a bit mismatch.

Name: Dr. Lawrence Faust
Known History:
Nearly twenty years ago, he took out a simple and manageable loan to open a pharmacy with a friend. However, not long after, just as the business was beginning to take a dip, the Baylore Company collapsed. His loan was now in the hands of ETA, and there was little he could do about it. In a stress-enduced bender one evening, Lawrence attempted to return home, intoxicated. Unaware, and delerious, Lawrence stepped out into traffic, and passed away. Since then, he's managed his pharmacy as a diligent, passionless worker, with glazed red eyes. ETA had returned him as an Insolvent, and he was now to work for the rest of days.

Nowadays, he manages a practice  in Haven called Last Life PX, which specializes is low income healthcare and the insolvent. He has a team of Insolvent who work under him, keeping the place running during his regular long breaks to Nezmira to see his wife, Dawn, and newly born daughter, Innes.
Physical Description: Lawrence is a shorter man (5'5''), with pale ashy skin, and faded crimson eyes. His hair is a light gray and he wears a similarly toned suit. He has minimal skin showing, and simple metal jewelry. He's cold to the touch, and has a generally foul aura about him, to those familiar with magic. The boy is undead.

Name: Dr. Sable von Nausicaa
Identity: Biomagical Engineer/surgeon with a discerning eye
Known History:
The middle daughter of a renowned Merrani scientist and decorated military woman.,
Went to Korala Academy,
Became a Biomagical Engineer and Surgeon, dealing with Colossi and grafting,
Starts working in a few different labs for The Merrani Empire
Physical Description:
Usually found in a lab coat and with a concentrated that quickly breaks into a smile when disturbed.
Just above average in height and slightly under average build, and always just a bit cold to the touch.

Name: Dr. Sienna Black
Known History: A doctor that grew up in Haven who dabbles in genetic modification, known to be recklessly experimental but almost exclusively uses herself as a test subject. She also has a bit of business knowledge, but doesn't like to put it to use unless she absolutely has to.
Physical Description: Dr. Sienna is quite tall at 6'2" and obviously cybernetically modified, but otherwise looks like a fairly average human most of the time. She is fit and often wears clothes that show off her toned body in bits and pieces. She has black hair that hangs at about her shoulders and piercing blue eyes that seem to be constantly studying something

Name: Duan Nüying 「段女英」
Known History:
Born to one of Xiexie’s servants, Nüying showed a promise for death cultivation quite young. Quickly, Xiexie took Nüying under her wing, and she became one proud to learn under her home's guardian.
Nüying took to her training with more vigor than any would expect from someone her age. Any negative side effects of taking in so much death qi were waved off by her. Every part of her being offered to be better her cultivation and how her teacher views her.
Now with Xiexie’s guidance and training, Nüying would be proud of her skill but still strives for more.
Origin: XieXie Village, Gutou Senlin, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Physical Description:
A woman standing at a proud 5'7, Nüying is often dressed in training clothing, and her long black hair pulled back. She holds a bamboo staff that has lost its vibrancy of life but still has yet to have rot stick to it.

The tips of her fingers seem to have been stained black due to her cultivation though she holds such things as a point of pride rather than worry.

Name: Dujom Hong
Identity: Fading Form Seeking to be a Savoir
Known History:
- Born into a small village in the Lhasa Outlands of Leytik to the leader of a dojo.
- He was born with an affinity to both Heavenly and Demonic Qi and was trained in the dojo early on to be able to combine it and use Hell Qi.
- Has a twin sister who he was trained to practice dual cultivation with to improve their abilities together.
- He and his sister had to take their father's place from a challenge from the Empty Monks.
- To see to the challenge they went to put their dual cultivation training to work but something disrupted it, causing his sister's body to fade and her soul to bind to his. This event caused his own body to begin to break down, causing him to need to try and keep himself together..
- Managed to win the challenge even with the two's now unique state of existence.
Origin: Chung Lhasa - Lhasa Outlands - Leytik - Tian Yin
Physical Description: Dujom stands just shy of 6' at 5'10", he has a fairly athletic build and typically carries two spears with him at most times. His clothes are decorated with various talismans that he focuses his Qi though.

Name: Dull Ahan
Known History: Once a regular man who wanted to defend his hometown from the constant undead threat, he decided to go to the source and take down a necromancer. That necromancer Killed the man and turned the man into a reanimated monster. despite this, he still wanted to do good despite the people of Kor'Tarian treating him as a mindless monster
Physical Description: 6:3 pumpkin headed man with an eternal lite in his eyes and mouth (literally) and eternal sinister smile. He is dressed in raggedy clothing with a cape and coat over his armor. The armor has a massive almost magical gash over its chest and a heart stitch where his heart SHOULD be. he has grafts over his body and clear stitching where he was sealed together

Name: Dustin Ryder
Known History:
- Grew up in Netherhill, parents and many of the people he grew up around died during plague
- Moved to and lived a quiet but pleasant enough year at Eckard's Rise until Gold Standard Inc. started wanting to stir trouble with the coven town of Kereti
- After speaking to a certain drifter, elected to take matters into his own hands by sabotaging Gold Standard's efforts in the region
- Was cornered by their thugs when he was taken by a spontaneous Realmstorm
Physical Description: White-haired, amber-eyed 5'8" man with a somewhat lackadasical disposition. Pleasant enough to look at, but otherwise not obviously remarkable. Dresses in typical cowboy attire that's a little odd-fitting.

Name: ELK
Known History:
The Fae Realms are a strange place - the fae crossings, only slightly less so. These places where the lands of men and fae meet are more... traversable than anywhere else in these alien lands - but make no mistake: these are still faerie lands. These woods are still dangerous to be in.

But there are rumors. Rumors of an armored figure, wielding weapons bearing no insignia. Rumors of a warrior that declares themselves ally of the innocent, protector of the meek. Rumors of a knight that ensures that even in a place as weird as the realms of the faerie, honor and chivalry still have hold.

This knight is real, and he does not know his name. He does not know his home. He does not know his origin. He knows only his oath, and the code he is sworn to. For strange years he has protected and served as arbiter of the places where men and fae meet... but now he leaves his appointed place, for a question has suddenly pierced his mind:

Who is he?
Physical Description: A well built, 6' tall figure decked in full armor, distinguishable by the mighty anklers on his helm. His arms, though well-maintained, curiously lack any markings or emblems.

Name: Ebb
Known History:
Very little would be known of Ebb, other than that they were once a Cecrae. Rumors of a creature that is like Ebb would've started up around fifteen or so years ago around the western shores of Kor'Tarion. A ghost like creature that would watch people gathering Sea Glass or as they fished. While it was never malicious in its actions, many said that seeing it was an omen while others claims it was a blessing.

Though now, with his remade state, he intends to make his own story. Still a guide to many others, but now he pens a new chapter. One for himself and the friends around him. With much left to learn, he will navigate the Worldhelm and the Realms as best he can.
Physical Description: After being remade, Ebb now stands roughly at 5'7 feet tall. Usually in baggy clothing with a long white cloak over his shoulders. One eye is a vibrant purple while the other is an emerald green. A pair of antenna stick up through the back of his white hair which is tied off in a ponytail.  With him is usually found some brown moths which would natively be from Kor'Tarion, but they seem to follow him everywhere.

Name: Echo
Known History:
Though granted sapience and power as a young kit, Echo holds no particular loyalties to any of the Aesir, including Kuzunoha. His early life was marked by the same strife as countless other residents of Aldistir, crafting barriers in his heart that have remained strong into adulthood. Having been born and raised on the outskirts of Camp Von Kibo, Echo was known to associate minimally with the Aldish and other yokai, preferring his solitude whenever possible. 

Since boarding the Worldhelm, Echo’s growing understanding of connections between his fellow Goldhearted has melted away that desire for isolation, and he finds himself swearing to become a dependable companion for all.
Origin: Outskirts near Camp Von Kibo, Aldistir
Physical Description: A large red fox standing about 3' at shoulder-height and 5' long from nose to bushy tail. Distinguishable as a yokai from the soft golden glow of his eyes and the way wind seems to play a soft tune around him wherever he goes.

Name: Edmund Archer
Known History:
Edmund Archer grew up in the streets of Lastport. From a young age, Edmund learnt quickly about the evils of the elite. Edmund used his pretty looks and charisma to get pity taken on him, using that to rob the rich blind. 

As he grew into a young adult, Edmund learnt how to behaviour as a servant, a common disguise he'd use to hide his identity. He does his best to help out the poor, acting as a sort of robin hood.
Physical Description: Edmund is a 5"4 man with long light blue hair with hazel eyes. He wears a butler's uniform.

Name: Edward Lowell Jr.
Identity: The Union of Death and Taxes
Known History: Edward Lowell Jr., aka Ed, is the son of Edward Lowell, board member of ETA, and Winnona Mescal, former board member of DHK. His father is known in upper echelons as one of the leading, alive board members of ETA. Ed himself grew up in the 1%, graduated from Haven Prep, and used to run a private investigation company, but it has since foreclosed. Now, he sets his sights on taking claim to his birthright before his brothers do. He still reeks of silver spoon privilege.
Physical Description: Ed is a 6'4" muscular guy with blonde hair and blue eyes. His physique is often hidden in a nice, custom tailored suit that keeps him sharp. His cologne smells of a dark wood and old spice blend. He's got an old watch on his wrist, but is iced out with his rings, containing various magical signatures.

Name: Edwin Fairwright
Known History:
born and raised in the southern colonies under NTT researcher parents

had a love of magic he could never engage with for years even after joining them and his parents became the heads of a project involving a dangerous beast.

Approached by olympia after an argument with his father where they offered him a deal. access to the project in exchange for knowledge and magic

Accepted, bot due to frustrations and being unaware of their true nature

once they had accessed, they sabotaged the project, and released the monster who proceeded to way waste to the area, killing his parents and barely surviving himself

The incident was quickly covered up, his parents disappearing off the face of the web, and leaving him to survive on his own

managed to repair a magitech mech and has been forced to survive until swept up by the realmstorm. he's found himself much more comfortable on the worldhelm then terra ever since. finally able to study magic fully. Though the guilt still weighs heavily on him
Physical Description: Essentially an anthropomorphic black cat that looks a little bit on the scraggley side. After his introduction to the worldhelm and the realm sea. he's adopted a bit of a steampunkish look, with a bit of a butterfly motif to it as a way to symbolise his own growth and change after said introduction. He also has a steampunk monocle that he thinks makes him look cooler.

Name: Ekho
Known History:
With whatever limited vocabulary they have, a few of the induced hallucinations this one managed to provide, it's been only clear enough that Ekho acted as a warding flower next to the Kiir hives, occasionally taking proteins from fallen creatures. Things have changed when they ended up nursing a young woman back to health, just enough to get her back to safety. On a particularly rough night during the sandstorm, while this one was hiding away in an old sack, that decision ended up making this one eligible for the spot on the ship.

...or so this one recalls.
Physical Description:
To the naked eye, Ekho resembles a green-skinned desert plant in the shape of a young woman, with black eyes and a stretched-out mouth, with a hair bun that allows this one to open their own head as one giant bulb.

Standing about five feet high, this one wears an old linen sack they were thrown in with, with a rope acting like a sash to hold some of their possessions, like water skins and seeds of "little ones". One may also spot this one with a wooden stake they use for movement, gardening and, occasionally, fending off hostile creatures.

Name: Elaine Sejr
Known History:
Elaine grew up in Haven, though where specifically isn't widely known. She travels around in her Van she inherited from her good Uncle, and left her home thereafter without any goodbyes. 

Since then she has been doing on and off jobs for people. Eventually getting into a gig with 100G Security. Though spends most of her time playing games and only working when she has to by her superiors or has bills to pay.

On her van is a sticker for blood and plasma donations.
Physical Description:
Height: 160cm

Elaine is a blonde haired female presenting individual from Terra. Rather petite figure and a patch covering her right eye. Usually wears rather loose clothes and looks mostly unbothered by most things.

Name: Elara Fleiss Alksnis
Known History:
Orphaned as a child due to Caden Lockflint's direct actions, she was fooled and taken by him as an adoptive daughter and raised to be a Magitech engineer. But her latent magic made it so the Magitech crystals consistently exploded from her touch, causing her to fail at the Academy of Korala.

Caden then severed ties with Elara, forcing her into a mercenary life. He left her with some equipment and two cyborg animal companions for support, of which only Quill remains. She managed to survive through these two years thanks to a band of mercenaries that saw her sharpshooting skills.

She became a Goldhearted a year and a half ago, and remained close to other Lhodosian, both from Merrane and Karslgard. She initially hid her relation to Caden, but was accepted even after it was revealed.

She accepted the truth about Caden with the help of her friends and learned to control her Chimeric magic. She then abandoned the surname Lockflint for Tika's Alksnis and Milo's Fleiss.
Physical Description: Young white-haired girl with wolf ears and often wagging tail. 157cm (5'1") and 63kg (139lb).

Name: Elasandros Pavaros
Known History: Born into a long line of warriors and hunters.  Elasandros was trained to follow suit. From an early age it was clear he didn't inherit his father's skill with a bow or his mother's strength but he tried. Eventually he began going out on his own, doing minor acts of bravery. Soon it became less about the fights or hunts but more about helping people or saving people. For the first time in his life he was given a reason to look inward and discover the person he's meant to be and what good he can do.
Physical Description:
Lean and somewhat athletically built, slightly short for an elf standing around 5'8'. 
Slightly androgynous with bright piercing green eyes , long well kept, fabulous golden hair tied loosely into a ponytail. Normally seen wearing their armour of which most noticeably is that his sword is often worn on the opposite side to their shield.

Name: Eleanor Radcliffe
Identity: A cunning Inventor protecting the one she loves
Known History:
Eleanor's life began in a peaceful village, under the watchful eye of her loving family and amidst her parents' experimental workshop. As war encroached, her idyllic life was shattered, forcing her to flee with her family and beloved Elysant. Together, they sought refuge in Bastion, a city that offered a chance to rebuild.

In Bastion, Eleanor and Elysant found strength in their bond, marrying and committing to their new community. Both joined the war effort, driven by a deep sense of duty. While Elysant protected others on the front lines, Eleanor used her skills to fix armors, create weapons, craft elixirs, and take out dangers with the experimental guns gifted by her parents.

Despite the danger, Eleanor's unwavering love for Elysant gave her strength, fueling her determination to survive and build a better world together. Each act of courage was a step toward ensuring they could share another day in each other's arms.
Physical Description: Eleanor has striking blue hair and vibrant green eyes. Her hair, cascading in waves, frames a face that alternates between a serene smile and a contemplative, almost pensive expression. She is mostly seen wearing elegant yet practical outfits. Her signature outfit being a a black cropped top with a high collar. Over her right arm, she has a beautifully designed armored sleeve with intricate gold detailing. The armor contrasts with the softer fabric of her white pants, which are loose and comfortable, tied with a blue sash that complements her overall color scheme. Black knee-high boots complete the look.

Name: Elias & Eugene 🦀
Known History:
Elias is artist who adds onomatopoeia to comic panels - creating images (Symbols) that imitate sound, movement, and emotional intensity, which depict wild adventures against fantasy creatures (werewolves and vampires included). Due to his work, he's regularly overworked and sleep deprived, which is why he's chronically a narcoleptic. He under surveillance from the Department of Magical Investigations due to his possession of what he calls "Eugene," a blood magic familiar which the SIA speculates is from Hollow Vast (unbeknownst to Elias). Eugene will occasionally draw a small amount of blood, making him more docile and friendly by reflecting Elias' likeness and creativity. Together, they help Elias' art come alive with Eugene as it's main action star.

Eugene is a familiar made with blood magic; a plant fused with shell of a dying crab and animating to its benefit. Eugene bumped into Elias passed out in the park, as he usually does, feasting on his blood and consequentially his dreams
Physical Description: 5'-6", thin build, white collar

Name: Elijah-2615
Identity: A Fleshling of Metal and Magic
Known History:
For those from his school, it is known that Eli is a quiet third year in the House of Paladins who comes from Steelbin. He often needs medical or physical accommodations, and is often missing from class.

For the attentive, it would also be known that he was briefly considered for the House of Regalia before joining the House of Paladins instead.
Physical Description:
A lanky individual, a little over 6'1'' tall, with a face and body hidden inside an environmental isolation suit with a tabard, robes, and sigils atop, giving it the appearance of a strange armored mage's robes.

He carries a mechanized staff and a tome at his belt, as well as a wide variety of stimulants and medicine at his belt should his body begin to fail.

Name: Elora Moonleaf
Known History:
* Born in the Winter Court a mere 34 years ago.
* Was a quiet, but always kind child. This, of course, did not ingratiate her to the more severe Winter Court.
* So it was that a kindly summer Fae saw her nature and took her in, teaching her how to manipulate the world to help people.
* A particular Winter Fae did not like this. And so about 10 years ago, this Fae slew her teacher and had her banished from the Fae Realms.
