* Elora traversed alone for a while, until she met Familade and Melancholia. Deciding that these people might need her, she began traveling with them and studying magic.
* It was in this moment that she found out about her fae weakness. Familade made an off handed comment about how warm it was, and she began sneezing uncontrollably.
* Despite this, they traveled together until they were suddenly picked up in a realmstorm.
Physical Description: A Short young woman with Grey skin and white hair. She rarely smiles, but nevertheless always has a gentle aura of cheer. She carries a staff and wand, and her magic soothes the weakened.

Name: Eluna
Known History: Despite her fangs there is no vampirism that some may think, neither herself or her village partakes in such practices or have a need to. Having spent a lot of time in an isolated fae village she hasn't interacted much with humans, beyond a few chance encounters in her moments of wanderlust. Very few of her interactions with humans have been outright hostile but many have been afraid of her. However, there have been a few instances that have given her hope music and song might manage to ease some of the discord between the fae and humans. Music and singing mean everything to the village she is from and as such she will not refuse to give an encore if asked and will never willingly leave a song unfinished.
Physical Description: Eluna stands at 5'2" with silver hair, pointed ears and fangs. Most notably though is the faint fire the seems to dance in her the irises of her eyes that grows brighter as she sings.

Name: Ember Wake
Known History:
- Came from a poor family
- Went into debt with ETA to get qualification through higher education
- Worked for Orrery for a long time, and finally got a chance to work in sub-orbital satellite maintenance through a work-visa for the Trans-Orbital Relocation Colum
- Skyfall destroyed many orbital structures, one of which he was working on
- He died, and was brought back as an Insolvent, and then got picked up by a realmstorm only days after
Physical Description: Ember is a 6'5, bulky figure in maintenance gear suited for 0-G and Vacuum usage. His skin is a faded, darker grey with the classical glowing red eyes indicative of Insolvency for Terrans. His beard is trimmed but somewhat shaggy, as is his hair.

Name: Emi
Known History: Emi is the first daughter of a well-to-do corporate family. Tired of the pressure and responsibility, she ran away from home when her uncle died, changed her name, and started a new life as a musician. She's been playing shows and trying to make a name for herself in Haven ever since.
Physical Description: Emi is a short, pretty woman with medium length blonde hair, bright blue eyes, and a slight build. Her hair seems to by styled differently every other day, and always has some streak of bright pastel. Her wardrobe seems to be constantly shifting as well, though short skirts with fun patterns, thigh highs, jackets and crop tops are more common than anything else.

Name: Emil Stoneheart
Identity: Newest Knightly Recruit of the Goldhearted Coalition
Known History:
Those from Snowmaw would know Emil as being a simple guard after being released from being a Brightshield Knight. He became one after he was inspired to become a knight due to the actions of the Goldhearted's Heroism.

Those from the Knights of Brightshield would know Emil as an Aspiring Knight when they had recently joined but they were expelled due to the red moon's events and being half-fae.

Those from the Goldhearted Coalition know Emil from being the latest recruit brought in by one of the knights that serve with the coalition. He's new to the Coalition but has been an active member ever since they joined.
Physical Description: This character has short, fluffy pink hair and striking amber-gold eyes with slit pupils, giving a feline impression that matches their prominent pink fox ears. They stand at a height of 5'9. A small red mark rests on their forehead, adding a mystical touch. They wear white and gold-trimmed armor over a dark turtleneck.

Name: Emile Ripley [C0M.3T_M31-0117]
Known History:
- One of nine survivors of 100G's PERSEUS Program, M31 was taken as a child and subjected to invasive augmentation to turn her into a "MEDUSA", a super soldier capable of synchronizing with GORGON-unit mech suits.
- Raised as an asset, M31 was trained to view themselves and their peers as human weapons. The life of a human was considered distant. Irrelevant.
- At 18, M31 was deployed onto their longest and most unusual assignment: an ongoing protection detail for 100G's public-facing asset, Dante Sterling.
- The corporate son was the first person to treat M31 as a person, naming her Emile and treating her as an equal rather than property.
- Through trust, honesty and friendship, Em's loyalty gradually shifted from corporate obedience to personal devotion. When Dante went rogue, she followed suit, marking her first true decision in life
- Now, Em continues to work with Dante of her own will, learning bit-by-bit about her own wants in life and what it means to be human as best as she can
Origin:
PERSEUS Labs; Secura, Terra. 
South Rock, Haven, Terra.
Physical Description:
Armored
- He/Him, "Comet" or "Emile"
- Standing at 7'4", C0M.3T is covered in a black, iridescent, defensive exosuit called the STARFALL AEGIS. It operates with the predominantly analog GOR//GON system which reports vitals, suit integrity, and other statuses to its operator when directed
- An ionized comet-trail streams from his head and limbs when he moves. A sealed, unidentifiable energy core burns at the center of his chest and supplements power Emile can't provide
- Emile's voice is echoey and deep in this state

Unarmored
- She/Her, "Emile" or "Em"
I- n contrast to her armored appearance, Em stands at 7' and has a muscular, full-figured body. Wispy purple hair trails down her back with a white patch centered above her forehead
- Scars can be seen along most of her visible pale skin, and her right arm is replaced with a metal, scarlet prosthesis. Her eyes are a similar color
- Em hides her spine, which is heavily cybernetically modified and grotesque
- She likes turtles a lot

Name: Emmaline "M" Daley
Identity: Neurotic Game Dev on Forced Holiday
Known History:
Emmaline grew up near the southern point of North Rock, gaming her whole life and obsessed with creating her own. She developed her ability to Soul Run when she was young, and between this and her coding, she had an impressive resume for SWORD the moment she stepped out of high school.

She rose through the ranks quickly, spreading out and growing a multitude of developer skills. Time off was not a concept to M; in five years she never took a single day. Not for anything.

Recently, SWORD pushed a major update M had a big hand in, and her manager forced her to take accumulated time- that comment about not eating or sleeping for three days probably wasn't a great idea. Her brain didn't like it either, as she passed out on the street on the way to the store and woke up in... what crazy concept world is THIS???
Physical Description: M is a short woman at 5'4", with yellow eyes and messy teal hair kept under a white graphic cap which is further kept under a headset. Her clothing is fairly unkempt but put together well with a general colorscheme of white and black and teal. She's usually carrying around a clunky device that she sporadically types upon, usually after a little gasp of "WAIT A MINUTE!".

Name: Emrik Renvald III
Identity: Legend's Inheritor Forging His Own Name
Known History: Emrik Renvald III was born into greatness: his grandfather a living, albeit retired, legend among the Knights Wyvernia, and his father a noble with a high ranking office in the order. However, he was never pulled towards the official family motto of "win in a blaze of glory, or die trying". He still loved riding dragons, and was welcomed into the order himself, along with receiving the family heirloom riding equipment. Still, his predecessors' pressure looms over him, leaving him so desperate for acclaim that he signed up for what he believed to be a suicide mission: crossing the Runewall.
Physical Description:
Emrik is a shorter man with blue hair and a resolute look in his eyes. He's wearing a gleaming red riding gear and a green-and-yellow bow, obviously forged as the same set long ago, although impeccably maintained.
He's also accompanied by a large red dragon.

Name: Engh
Known History:
Engh, born in the subrealm of Leytik, was orphaned by a Spirit Beast attack when he was a child. Alone and lacking purpose, he was recruited by a sect of Empty Monks in an effort to gain the strength he would need to protect those he loved, should he ever find some of them again.

However, after years of training, he finally looked outward and saw the trouble caused by the empty monks, both among civilians and the recruits, and resolved to leave. He stole away in the night, carrying his only possessions, a brown cloak and the greatspear he was given as a gift for completing training.

For a while after, Engh hid in an abandoned outpost on the outskirts of a village, scavenging food and resources where he could. Unfortunately, he would again run afoul of a Spirit Beast, who nearly struck him down. If not for the sheer dumb luck of running into a Realmstorm, Engh would have perished.

But instead, he found himself aboard the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Engh is a short young man (probably like 5'3" idk) with a light brown skin tone and scraggly black hair. His deep red clothes are frayed and worn, and are usually covered by a similarly frayed and worn brown cloak. About the only thing on him that's been kept at a reasonable level of repair is his greatspear across his back, with a silvery broad head and finely carved black haft.

Name: Enlai
Identity: Merry Farmhand Entering a Wide World
Known History:
- Resident of Bingchuan village where he earned a living as an ordinary farmer, gifted with a green thumb (or just plain good luck)
- Befriended a Jinshi martialist, Yang Xiang, who exchanges cups over discussing the Dao of the Drunken Master
- A yokai invaded the village and ruined their hard-earned crop, inciting Enlai to chase it furiously
- He unwittingly crossed a realmstorm onto the Worldhelm, and wishes to experience the joys of a broader world
Origin: Bingchuan Village, Jijing Xiantiao, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Physical Description: The Vanara stands just over 5 feet tall with a lean toned physique earned from laborious farmwork. Wears peasant clothing, a straw hat slung over his back and a stalk of grass in their mouth. Rarely seen without a smile on his face and a bottle in his hand.

Name: Enoch
Known History:
Enoch's life was fated to be marked with misfortune. As a child, he wandered the streets of Lastport, orphaned and starving, until he was taken in by a passing traveler known as Kannon Maruyama. 

This woman was in truth a communist revolutionary devoted to fight against the world's bourgeoisie, and a swordmaster who held the legendary cursed sword Kisshoten-Ichimonji. Under her wing, Enoch studied the sword and pen, and found a true family.

However, the Kisshoten-Ichimonji's curse built up over time, and Enoch realized that the next bout of unluck would deal grievous harm to his master. He stole the sword from Kannon's study in the hopes of transferring the curse to himself, as gratitude for the home she had given him. Unbeknownst to Enoch, Kannon had followed him, and he watched in horror as she died protecting him from the being that the sword's curse had summoned--the wielder of the Izanami-Ichimonji. 

Since then, Enoch has devoted his life to hunting swords.
Physical Description: A tall, lithe male standing at about 5'9'', with locks of grey hair that fall to his shoulders. His dress lacks ostentation, instead emphasizing practicality and durability, such as a padded mercenary jacket or hidden half-plate armor. The two swords he most often carries are Meteor, his personal longsword with a dark meteoric-iron blade, and the Kisshoten-Ichimonji, a legendary cursed katana with a beautiful crimson scabbard. Sometimes, people swear they can see large furry ears on his head, but it's just an illusion of his hair.

Name: Ephraim
Identity: A Mercenary Who Swallows his Sadness
Known History:
A nightmare, fires roaring through the village. It wasn’t supposed to be like this. The cries were deafening, and there was no sign of orders to stop. Men were descending like wolves, releasing an anger that had lain beneath the surface. These were his fellows, his comrades. They were no longer human. Ephraim shields his eyes, wishing to be anywhere else.

He wakes in a sweat. The stray dog he brought home licks his face, and he is returned to the present. Dawn. He had work to do, the bounty board would be empty and then so would his stomach if he didn’t hurry. To think… If his old crew saw him chasing down criminals, they would have called him a traitor, a dog brought to heel by the Nezzim. 

He wasn’t sure they were wrong. Sometimes it was meaningful work. Many men he brought in were wolves themselves. But other times it felt like he was the boot being placed on someone’s neck.
Physical Description: Ephraim is a mercenary with an easygoing attitude. He stands at 5'11'' and has hair the color of tarnished bronze.

Name: Epsilon
Known History:
They have a Master's in chemistry for fuck's sake. Why is his boss holding their reins so tightly when it's clear he can pour and mix circles around everyone else. They even set himself up with that efficiency upgrader, just to get that bonus to make rent in the small apartment they share with his partner.

God. They wish that he could open his own shop. All of the regulars here and half of the others would follow them there.
Physical Description: Epsilon Affogado, a tall guy with light brown skin, a hot enough body, and currently white techhair, enjoys bartending.

Name: Erdene
Known History:
- Erdene (ER-deh-neh) is a towering apothecary specializing in herbal teas and remedies. A Cultivator of Crystal Qi, he has developed a unique means of delivering his remedies in hardened packets of natural sugars for ease of administration.
- Despite his scarred face and brawny appearance, he bears little desire to pick up weapons unless in the necessary defense of himself and those of his community.
- A follower of the Holy Harmony, he has no love for the authoritarian control of the Empty Monks, and his village is one of the few left in the western riverlands that have escaped their influence.
Physical Description: A massive, tawny-furred Yakshi standing around 7' tall and weighing about 300 lbs. Always donning hide armor, a brass shield on his back and a club on his hip.

Name: Erin Glassvelle
Known History:
- I was born In Silverdale to the Glassvelle family, long standing retainers for the Morris house of nobles.

- My father is a well-regarded advisor to the current head of the household.

- I worked as a tutor/retainer of their heir to the house, Master Lucien Morris,

- He, alongside my father were falsely implicated in a scandal regarding stolen jewelry from the queen and for conspiring against her.
 
- I managed to make a deal with the judge, to travel to the runewall in exchange for them to not be jailed and or executed if the worst comes to pass.

- "I'm hoping behind the Runewall I'll find the answers I'm looking for. That information could be the leverage I need to find my father & lord, alongside tracking down who is truly behind all this."
Physical Description:
"I stand at 5'2 , my weight is my own business." (It's 48 kg) 

"I adorn myself in the colours matching the house I serve, being blue & gold. 

Hair tied back for practicality, tunic & boots. That's all that needs to be said."

Name: Erin Shephard
Identity: Interstellar Train Attendant Prepared for Battle
Known History:
Erin, or known as Erin-31 by those in Steelbin, was born in the civilized zone of the reflection. There she was raised with her brother Anthony where they had a simple life with her parents being mechanics for Machina. 

Erin is far from the ideal paladin, having been able to join the academy due to her brother's recommendation to his patron. Whether or not it was a poor investment is still up in the air, though, as while her mechanical skills have improved, she continues to only barely pass on her grades. If only she applied herself more to school.
Physical Description: Erin is a 5' 10 young woman with tan skin and shaggy brown hair. She is often seen in her uniform though it has the wear and tear of being in it when she is both training and working. A mechanical board is often slung over her shoulder that has become a staple for many who see her.

Name: Eris L'arca
Known History: Eris grew up in a forest of Fae, spending her time performing dances with her family, spending every moment of every day in celebration. However, she woke up one day to find the party had mysteriously moved on elsewhere, leaving her in a fit of confusion and unrest. She desperately wandered through the chaos of the Fae Realms to find her family, eventually stumbling into a Fae Crossing, where she suddenly finds herself in a small but bustling town in the middle of Kor'Tarion's fields, constantly under attack by the darkness spilling from the realm. Seeing Kor'Tarion's suffering, she learns to fight the darkness to bring light and happiness to the realm. After a time, the town is suddenly struck by a Realmstorm. Eris had no time to react, getting pulled into the storm and onto the floating ship of the Worldhelm, where she finds herself lost once more. She sets off to become an adventurer to find her lost family, and bring hope and freedom to the rest of the realms.
Origin: The Faerie Realm and Ruined Kingdom of Kor’Tarion
Physical Description:
Eris is a Faerie with many rabbit-like features standing at 4'1". Small, but with plenty of presence. She has dark fur with a bright blond muzzle and short, puffy white hair with springy rabbit ears poking out from the top of her head and bright white eyes. Her favorite attire for dancing is a flowing green two-piece cloth adorned with flower patterns that leaves plenty of room for her to breath during her performances. A small, round fluffy rabbit tail sits on her lower back. 
During her dances, she sprouts bright glowing wings that seem to radiate with the colors of a peacock, leaving a torrent of feathers in their wake, which often depends on the dance she performs.

Name: Ernest
Known History:
Ernest was a city guard in Hedgeberg for most of their life. Within the city walls they settled down, and with their spouse they started a family.
One day, when they returned from their night shift, they found their only child missing. Unbeknownst to Ernest, they were taken aboard the Worldhelm.
Once every attempt to find their child failed, sadness and helplessness started to kick in. They retired and grew distant from the other people in their life. Most of their days were spent polishing their old uniform, checking every surface of their motorcycle for bumps or dirt and mindlessly carving figures or tools out of wood.
Very recently, they noticed a surprising calling, a rare feeling of purpose. They were led to the Worldhelm, and embarked on it in a search for... something, anything.
Physical Description:
"An older human. Their face is ugly with age, but their lineaments still have a softness to them. Their white hair is usually messily tied back, and it is not uncommon to see them wear a beret or cap.
They are always dressed with modest clothing, kept to near perfection.
Their posture is usually weary and tense; could it simply be the weight of their years?
Strange, they only go by their first name."

Name: Esmon Stark
Identity: Rising Angel Protecting What He Has
Known History:
Esmon is one of the survivors of Morgan that happened 20 odd years ago. He has been taken in by Charlotte Luther Von-Handwick, raised by her and living with Cassidy - another child of Morgan. The two grew up together, close to one another given their shared history, Esmon acting as a protector and guard dog for Cassidy. Esmon joined the Angels at the same time of Cassidy loyal to the cause of Merrane. After all, Karlsguard took his home. 

After graduation, Esmon was in a pair grouping with Cassidy, making sure that her condition is under check and that she herself was safe. This is shown in the design of their mechs, both of them designed to meld with one another for when the two are of the appropriate skill.
Physical Description: A bit taller than average man, 5'10 in height. His slender form marked with black hair and various faded scars from the devastation of Morgan. He has stark purple eyes.

Name: Estelle Dubois
Known History:
Estelle is the single daughter of a family that held the old teachings from forest spirits dearly, having taken the forest spirits' belief of caring for the land to heart. In her home, she was taught in the magical arts of Virelia and Anima due to her family's connection to the land they spent generations caring for.
As time continued, the spirits began to become silent and no answers for the hostility that was once considered guardians and Leirsins who warned of worse to come. Estelle would try and beseech the spirits, but at no response, she began to look outside Rocade for help or answers.
At the news of the Expedition to the Runewall, Estelle took it upon herself to join the numbers to find something to help her home.
Physical Description: A 5'3 woman with brown skin and dark hair with bright red carnations that decorate her clothing and armor. She often is seen with a positive smile and the smell of different flowers surrounding her.

Name: Estrella Von Gilded
Identity: The Burning Monarch From Beyond The Veil of Time & Space
Known History:
- Born within Belfrost, her parents are dead and is the adopted child of "Baron" Von Gilded

- Seems to have the idea she is some sort of Monarch from Eurys, though with no real Territory or Titles other than that of a well taught mage
Other Names:
- "The Monarch From Beyond The Veil of Time & Space"

- "The Crimson Blaze Searing The Corrupt"

- "The Gift of The Great Stars Above"
Physical Description:
About 5'6" in height, she wears a well-made short white dress with red spikes near the bottom. The brought together by a star coloredcloak she wears, tied together by a large white bowtie with a star emblazoned on it.

The most eye catching piece of her outfit, is the large hat she wears bearing a star at the tip of the hat and the crown created at the base. Both a sign of her magic expertise and "royalty".

Name: Euri
Known History:
- A Sparrow who was born and grew up constantly on the move, his family never staying with one group or community for very long.
- His constant movements led Euri to learn a little about many cultures around the Firwood, absorbing the stories and survival lessons of different groups.
- Those stories would become seeds he would inadvertently plant among the flocks he briefly encountered before moving on.
- Lacking in strong social anchors or sense of community, he is a flighty and eccentric bird who treasures his freedom and always looks for the next new discovery on the horizon.
Physical Description: A diminutive sparrow of 3' with tawny eyes that always seem to have a far-off look about them. Cream and chestnut accent his feather pattern, and he is rarely seen without his traveling gear, usually composed of a light shawl, scarf and messenger bag.

Name: Eurydice
Identity: Aspiring Weapon Saint Walking the Path
Known History:
- Eurydice was born within the Bazaar, not only an accidental birth but one believed to be born stillborn or sickly if the birth was even successful. 

- she had a normal upbringing, her father a blacksmith and her mother a merchant so life within the Bazaar was tame for her. Her parents were Keepers of the 4th Grave, Ogum.

- however, at a very young age she was discovered to be a Herald, a walker of Eminence's Path. 

- due to this, she was picked up by the Seven Slaying Arms Sect and trained under them to better foster her abilities. 

- either by her own desires, or the sects, to better honor the Path of Eminence, they set out to conquer an impossible challenge of taking a pilgrimage to the 5th grave, Apep.

- many lost their lives on this pilgrimage, and once they did get to the grave they were attacked by ghosts and spirits. Eurydice herself doesn't remember fully what happened.

- Eurydice now has a connection to ghosts and the Afterlife, having spirits bound to her.
Physical Description: A woman that doesn't stand too tall, only at around 5'4, 5'5 if the day is going well for her. Her hair a stark white like the color has been shocked out of it, half her head shaven as long loose strands of hair hang down one side of her hair. When open her eyes are a sterling silver, a glint in them as if she's seeing more then she should. Adorned in golden jewelry and a mantle of white feathers along her shoulders, her clothes the simple wear of a traveling exorcist. On her person are always an assortment of weapons be them swords to firearms. Most notably are two, one a simple blade perfectly made for her while the other is a broken sword once made for two hands but now fits one. Always, spirits or other ghostly figures are near her person as if tied or drawn to her. A constant friendliness and passive gentleness to her nature.

Name: Eusebiu "Seb" Atent
Known History:
- Affected by the Thinning as a child, grew worse reaching adulthood
- Left family lands and went to Veyrhold to get more life experience and learn how to control the Black's influence on him
- Joined the DMI to access some of their research in exchange for being used for experiments with Vlach magic
- Cooperated enough to earn restricted permissions with the DMI's Arcanum
Physical Description: Slender dark-haired dark-eyed 6'3" man with a unnaturally pale complexion, even by Myist standards. Usually wears a longcoat. Always seems tired, and sometimes his physical form seems to waver or blend in with shadows. Bleeds black when manifesting the DMI's arcanum.

Name: Evelyn Antonov
Identity: Wilkin Engineer of the Violet Barons
Known History:
* Graduate of Korala Academy, Majored in both Mechanical and Magitech engineering 
* Assigned to work on the [Gleaming Goose] to retrofit it for military use.
* Using discarded parts of wrecked Merrane mechs, created the Protoype: SARoS
* After the [Gleaming Goose] was commandeered, reluctantly she stayed on with the ship. Especially after seeing Lindsey Beck.
Physical Description:
A blue haired Wilkin woman standing at roughly 5'8", a rather strong build bearing the scars of a mechanic across her arms. 

Her eyes carry the energy of a tired but determined woman.

Name: Ezekiel Faranda
Known History:
Being the son of a successful start up CEO, Ezekiel had an easy early life, growing up interested in weaponry, machinery, and science. However, after an accident caused by his father's drunken stupor. Their life derailed into a living hell, and after a chain of events, they both ended up as insolvents and property of ETA.

Ezekiel had worked under ETA for almost 9 years. Experiencing all of the typical aspects of it being one of their insolvents. Eventually hitting a point where trying to get out of his position felt like a hopeless endeavor.

Then he got onto the Worldhelm, and started meeting people that would change the course of his life. 

Not long ago, it was revealed to him that during a prime company meeting, his friend Basil had gotten hold of his insolvency contract and debt. Finally freeing him from bane that was forced upon him, and life feeling brighter every single day since.
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'10". Ezekiel has canine Terran body mods to allegedly hide his insolvency. The scarlet eyes of his and his general slothful movements however make it still plainly obvious to anyone of his undeath status. He wears consumer quality "trashy" clothing to save on money, and carries himself in a nonchalant yet bold manner.

His mech, The Reliquary, is modeled to resemble a jackal with large blades floating behind it. One that Ezekiel helped design alongside Tubal and Cain while testing the experimental technology behind it.

Name: Ezra White
Known History: A freedom fighter from Nezmira. He spent his youth hiding away from the world, his disabled caretaker taught him how to fight. When he came of age he began fighting against the oppression the people of Nezmira faced from the lizards. However on his last mission he was killed. But a young woman managed to connect their souls together. They live separate lives but beat the same heart.
Physical Description: A cat-eared skinny young man. He dresses primarily in red, tattered clothes, jewelry hang from his body. As if he wants to be the centre of attention.

Name: Fable
Known History:
They awoke, cold and alone in the darkest corner of Kor'tarians woods. But not alone? Feelings, needs, duties? A guiding ghost of dozens of histories that is there and not. But they see the threads, in everything, and know that it is their duty to bind them.

But this world is so cruel, so bitter, and there are so few, certainly none alike them. Do they do as they are compelled? Or do they do as they feel they must? A world in peril needs heroes. They cannot be a hero, but perhaps they can be a heroes hero. If Destinies villains draw blades and blood, so too shall they in defense of the fated hero. Oh but so many have fallen this way despite their best efforts.

But here, a higher purpose? A greater opportunity? They will take it, and see where it takes them.
Physical Description:
Fable is a tiny little thing, still standing as tall as they can at 4' total (but they float to about 5'7", usually) A body, bleak as ink, is blotted with tufts of fluffy snow-white fur. Flanking each side of their head are two perky, long ears like a rabbits, and a crown of jagged horns like those of an upturned buck. A floofy white tail, like a wolves sways behind them, and their slender legs end in a pair of tiny paws. They are decorated with muted cloths of black, and blue, bits of armor and metal protecting important bits. A large, blue-green gem hangs off their neck on a thick loop.

In total shadow, their moony yellow eyes breach the dark, as do the ends of their horns, and the bases of their ears in an eerie white and violet glow.

Name: Fabri Caetspells
Known History:
Coming from the famous "Caetspells" Family, she was raised as a point of controversy, because despite being part of said famous high lifes, she was a supposedly a mage. Despite being called and trained as a spellcaster her whole life, she simply could never get the hang of casting spells. it never clicked, but her brand was created and the public had there eyes on her, so she went to her inventor uncle, Dupal, to help. He created forms of micro spells that makes it look like she is actually casting spells! This and the brand her mother, Vindi, created the storms sweetheart! a new face to magic to make it more friendly and light hearted. Regardless, Fabri is going to try and be the best heroine she can be!

How much of fabri's upbringing had good intentions? 
Whos to say!
Physical Description: A smaller slightly wider woman with sparkly eyes and large poofy curly hair tied back with blue highlights in it. She is dressed as a lightning themed magical girl with slight Mechanical accessories, including her gloves that has her magispheres inside. She also has a cute little umbrella as her spellcasting implement

Name: Fafnir
Known History: Once a Patron Angel of Asga made of Ivory with a beautiful and immaculate warrior’s form, now entirely changed into human’s form from the melding and twisting of blood, madness and dozens of bodies into one into the appearance of a mix of mankind and demonic creature with features like that of a dragon. In the Three Faced God’s ruination of Idyll they lost everything including their name. What now sticks is the name Fafnir, due do the extreme violence they radiate from their presence, features and uncomfortable heat the pours from their body. Seeking vengeance for the one who brought murder into their home and protecting the layer from those who were twisted by madness.
Physical Description: Tall with a head of red hair like blood and fire, eyes that smolder like the inside of a volcano. Red scales lineing different parts of her body in clusters from her scaled and clawed hands and around her neck. Two black horns coming from the top that curve and curl into sharpened points along with large black wings that sprout out from the back. She stands at 6'3 normally, constantly radiating warmth and at times under certain situations smells of blood.

Name: Familade
Identity: Beastly Outcast of the Winter Court
Known History: Familade is a tall, proud woman, who always maintains a serious manner, addressing even the most trivial of situations as if they were of dire import. Despite her confident nature, however, she shies away from personal contact and having a close proximity to others, preferring to keep a moderate distance away from others. While she does not expand on her history too heavily, she does make it known that she hails from Kor’Tarion’s winter court, and was exiled due to a lack of discipline; a failing she seeks to remedy.
Physical Description:
Familade is a 9’2 behemoth of a woman. From the waist up, she appears to be a tall figure with wild, messy hair, and ashen skin. She wears simple clothing, adorned with all manner of charms, trinkets, and magical components. Her arms are black, with short, fine fur covering their surface.

Below the waist, however, Familade is a massive beast. A furred, lupine body contrasts with her dragonlike wings, marked with patterns resembling eyes, and her large, violent looking spines, upon which several silver rings rest. There isn’t any one animal sue resembles most closely, but rather, a chimeric fusion of many different aspects of many different creatures.

Name: Fancy Mouse
Known History: An Orphan, Mikkel fights to have his parents returned to him, and justice dealt to all who deserve it.
Physical Description: A man with decent looking features, but ones that would allow him to blend into a crowd. He has bright blue eyes and dirty golden hair. His skin is weathered, with decent scaring. Mikkel stands before you at 5'9, weighing a lean 210lb.

Name: Fang
Known History:
A bright, bubbly, and enthusiastic wilkin, Fang grew up as the adoptive son of a low-ranking member of the Merrani Angels. Trained from a young age towards a future at the WWA, Fang's ambitions, much to his father's chagrin, leaned more towards fashion than securing peace. Though one would be remiss to believe Fang's trainings with blades and minor magitech have garnered no results, as he utilizes the techniques learned both in combat and in pursuit of his work as a fashion designer. 
After finding himself drawn through a Realmstorm to the deck of the Worldhelm, Fang was enthralled with wide-eyed wonder at the idea of the intermingling of the fashions of multiple realms, and seeing what his muse could seek out amongst them all.
Fang's father, by contrast, upon being excitedly told the news on a return trip, sees Fang's status as a, pun intended, golden opportunity to spread the Edict of Savior beyond Lhodos' borders, and thus encouraged his wayward son on his journey.
Physical Description:
A quite effeminate young man with a lithe build, Fang stands at around 5'4" and 102 lbs. A pair of canine ears poke above a head of light auburn hair, tied back in a 'stylishly unkempt' ponytail and pigtails combo. A matching tail often swishes eagerly below any number of cute outfits, many of which were tailored by Fang himself.
He often wears a pair of odd gloves: stylish, but with a dull humming of magitech woven through the fabric that allows him to manipulate the small blades he utilizes in both dressmaking and combat.

"I'm not a girl, I'm just FABULOUS <3"

Name: Fayn SilverHeart
Known History:
- Father an Immortal Patriarch of the Wintercourt 
- Mother Niad of the Court of Storms.
- Trains in Fae Magic.  
- Wanders Kor'Tarion after Moonfall. 
- Meets boyfriend in the Vicinity of Lastport 30 years Moonfall 
-  helps boyfriend in Teashop with Magic.
- Boyfriend passes away 40 years later.
-  Fayn's Greif phyiscaly manifests as Ice in his soul
- Fayn encounters a Realmstorm  while wandering again and ends up in the Worldhelm
Physical Description:
- Blue hair (shortish)
- Golden Eyes 
- 5'9"/175cm 
- 144lbs
- White shirt 
- Dark Blue vest
- Light Blue Neckerchief 
- Grey pants 
- Blue Boots

Name: Felicia Rehinsfel
Known History: Felicia isn't well known to be the second heir to the Rehinsfel family. The noble house itself is known for its contineud pursuit of magical knowledge since before the colonization of Wulforh in the lands it originated from. However due to her inability to use magic, she was deemed a failure and was sent to Gaius Military Academy away from the oldest heir, her twin sister. Though she had been sent away, she still caused trouble for the family due to her insatiable hunger and constant mischief. However when she heard her sister had been sent to the Runewall as an execution, she dropped everything to go with her.
Physical Description: Dressed in comfortable and form fitting blue and black attire, contrasting with the typical attire one would expect from a noble daughter from Wulforh. Standing annoyed at five foot, six inches, she usually has her brownish red hair set out into a long ponytail with her leirsin ears and tail proudly on display. Carrying the air of almost always being annoyed.

Name: Felicity Rehinsfel
Known History: Felicity is known to be the oldest heir to the Rehinsfel family. The noble house itself is known for its continued pursuit of magical knowledge since before the colonization of Wulforh in the lands it originated from. She is now a student at the Breusen Mage Academy and trained with/under the Prosperity Heir, Alain Meyer. In a magical accident she harmed her fellow classmates and an heir of Desire. Getting her sent off for execution via the Runewall.
Physical Description: Dressed in the standard Wulforh red and golds and the robes one would expect of a student from Bresun Academy, Felicity is an apprentice mage from the noble house of Rehinsfel. Standing at a proud five foot and five inches, she usually has her brownish red hair done up in a pair of twin tails with her leirsin ears and tail propped out of her outfit and hair. Along her right arm is her family's magical crest. Something their bloodline has worked on to perfection even before the colonists arrived in Eurys. It's bright, crimson markings hold the wealth of knowledge from her ancestors, waiting to be unlocked and added to with time.

Name: Fenja
Known History:
A subject of an old Baylore project in Termina.
The first successful human seaborn hybrid.
Been in stasis since the bombs fell.
Recently woke up and arrived to the world helm.
Physical Description: Green skin, and a vinelike tail, dressed in comfortable clothes bordering on a militaristic style, and with a height of about 5'5.

Name: Fenn
Known History: Formerly associated with the Autumn Court, Fenn was kicked out of the Feywild after a prank gone wrong.  She was imprisoned by a noble in Lastport, from which she escaped and fled to the Gwaed Forest.  She survived by stealing from various settlements and travelers, and amused herself by playing tricks on humans.
Physical Description: Fenn is a short foxlike humanoid with a wild mane of hair.  She wears a ceramic white mask, behind which can occasionally be seen emerald green eyes.  She wears fairly simple clothes often dull in color.

Name: Fernia
Known History: Fernia was just a simple traveling botanist who had gone out to the Irathwood to find some flora to study and perhaps gather some seeds from to sample. Little did she know that as she started pushing deeper into the woods that something had been stalking her. Eventually she paused to reference her notes of the rumors of this plant she was looking for. That is when whatever had been stalking her struck. When she woke she found a plant that she was unfamiliar with growing onto and into her body. Its roots seeming to have stitched up the wounds. While this strange bloom seemed parasitic at first with time she has developed a symbiotic relationship with it after hunting down and slaying the demon that had originally attacked her, with the help of Saki and Kawa. While she does still hold her home dear she has begun to grow interest to learn more of Terra the place the person she cares most about comes from.
Physical Description: Dresses modestly with most of her body covered and has an eye patch over her right eye. Seems to wear several colorful flowers in her hair. But with close inspection or high observation skills can tell those flowers are actually growing from her body. While her hair split between white on her right side while the left is brunette.

Name: Ferry
Known History:
- Lived in the ruins of Vale all his life. Raised by the scientist that gave him his oversized limb replacement.
- His mechanical arm is apparently a reclamation target for a subsection of Merrane operatives, as he spent the few months before his Realmstorm avoiding them.
- Has spent several months on the Worldhelm, making friends and meeting people willing to help him find his caretaker.
- One of the first to discover Heaven, meeting all three angels of Antikythera and becoming interested in spacetime.
Physical Description:
Ferry stands at a powerful 152 cm (5 feet) with a slim, almost malnourished build. Visibly swaying with the weight of his mechanical arm as he walks, the scavenger usually cradles it with his natural limb to help keep balance. On occasion, his figure is covered in soot mainly on his right side, a consequence of messing with and practicing using his prosthesis.

If he's out and about, one will normally find him with a sack fashioned from a patchwork of worn fabrics, undoubtedly jingling with the fruits of his labor from scrounging in junk piles and trash heaps.

Name: Finnley
Known History: Some people like to stay in one place , Make a home, But that's not for everyone some people like to roam and wander exploring what's out there, Finnley is one of those.... except he got lost and didn't realise till it was too late... WELL best not to dwell on that and keep moving forward in that case .
Physical Description: An average height individual of slim build adorned in "stylish" attire ,and pale hair

Name: Fionne
Known History:
A young adult witch hailing from Draenog, Kor-Tarian. At a tender age, in a different time, she found herself lost in the woods, eventually stumbling into the Fairy Realm, where an old fairy took pity on her. For many years, she resided there, aging and honing her magical skills under the tutelage of the warmhearted fairy. She became proficient in the arts of magic and potion-making, dedicating herself to healing fairies and other enchanted creatures alike. However, as time passed, the overwhelming magic of the realm became too much for her, compelling her to return to the human world. Yet, upon her return, she found that much had changed in her absence.

Resettling in Draenog, she utilized her skills to aid those in need. Alongside her, the Construct Flying Broom Stratus accompanied her from the Fairy Realm—a parting gift from her savior.

Then, she stumbled upon the Worldhelm, deciding to join its journey in an attempt to reclaim the wondrous life she once had in the Fairy Realm.

Name: Flare
Identity: A man who will never grow old
Known History:
Flare isn't shy about talking about his situation when asked. The magiseed embedded in his chest saved his life with its magic a long time ago and his body healed around it. 

Someday, this plant will constrict Flare's heart, killing him.
Physical Description:
Flare is 6'/183cm and 150lbs/68kg. He sports a head of "Hair" comprised of purple leaves. Though it does cause mild pain to pluck them out, he isn't terribly bothered by it, or by people who take interest in his unconventional physicality. 

Along with veins that show slightly through his pale/olive skin, keen observers will also notice a network of roots that spread through what little of his body Flare deigns to show. In combat, he rolls his sleeve upwards, revealing the magiseeds that are imbedded on his forearm. By channeling his magic, the seeds are temporarily "activated" and bloom to impart beneficial effects through their pollen. 

There is a single, larger magiseed imbedded in Flare's chest. The plant in question here is deep-rooted and has coiled itself around many of Flare's bones, making it slightly harder for him to move around.

Name: Florian Valstrider
Known History:
Born the second child of a nature mage father (one of few in Forest Home), and his war hero mother, he and his sister (Isabella) studied the traditional ways of magic and magical beasts. But Isabella went to join White Wing Academy, wanting to combine traditional magic with the piloting of mechs. Far too soon they were told she died in combat.
He felt it right, then, to follow her path with her mech Andromeda. Spreading magitech seemed to be a way to a brighter future – clear from contrasting the smog of the South with Caldera’s beauty. At the Academy he felt far from home, and learning to pilot was hard.
Recordings from Isabella inside the mech helped him learn. However, when he reached the final one it was purely dark. But he could hear his sister cursing, a struggle, and then silence. He knew in an instant he couldn't stay. That something was terribly wrong. With Andromeda stored, and his thoughts swirling, he snuck to the woods as a storm picked up and the world began to spin.
Physical Description: Moderately tall, and wiry for a would-be soldier, Florian dresses in a variety of well-tailored paints and vests with a long formal coat. Soft leather boots, suited for hiking, are the only part of his outfit that would suggest he was anything different than the average Merrani young noble or academy student. Wearing glasses over green eyes, his intricate staff and a crystal amulet tucked under his vest are the only weapons and/or magitech visible.

Name: Flynn Hyacinthus
Known History: Despite his appearance, Flynn was born to a poor family in Tradefair. His father, unknown to him, left Flynn's mother before he could ever remember. He did his best to help support his mother in any way possible, even at a young age. Taking odd jobs as a mercenary or whatever else he could find. Though now, his story has taken a drastic turn that he now realizes has been the best change in his life. He arrived in Worldhelm a year ago. During that time, he has made countless friends and found a family among these fellow Goldhearted. Now, with the aid of the Trueheart Coalition, he realizes that his dreams are even closer to a reality than he ever believed. With recent developments, he often spends more time in Tradefair working under his fiancée Victoria Voclain to further their goals of becoming nobles. After assisting Song-5 and other Goldhearted in the battle against Kor'Tarion's Utopian, Halycon. Flynn pledged himself to the Court of the Goldhearted.
Physical Description: Flynn stands roughly around 5'5 (165cm), decorated in noble styled clothing and different jewelry. On top of his head is a pair of cat ears with tuffs of fluff coming out of them. A large, fluffy tail that often tucked beneath his cloak. His hair a natural blonde, being normally unkempt despite his best efforts. An aura of confidence and chivalry comes from him and his actions. A smile always present on his face.

Name: Fox Kensington
Identity: Lieutenant Fox Kensington, Loyal Officer of the Merrane Empire
Known History:
Born in Caldera, the Capital of the Merrane Empire, Fox Kensington comes from a long line of loyal Imperialists who served Emperor von Merrane's army since the earliest days of the war. The youngest of four children, Fox was conscripted into the Imperial Army at the age of 18. He first served as a footsoldier but was then later trained as a Cavalryman with the 8th Imperial Calvary Regiment at the age of 21. 

IAs his career progressed and the war grew more in scope, Fox rose from a lowly private to a fully fledged Lieutenant; having only lost two Automaton Steeds in his nine year Career. In his most recent operation against the KPLA, A weather anomaly occured and caused mass chaos on the battlefield. Soldiers on both sides of the front were considered either KIA or MIA in the aftermath of the storm's disappearence, including Lieutenant Kensington.

If only they knew the truth.
Physical Description: Fox Kensington is a young man in his mid to late 20s. He stands at a height of six feet and one inches tall with dirty blonde hair. espresso brown eyes with a 5 o’clock shadow growing across his androgynous face.

Name: Franz Alberic
Known History:
A mage from Delsatz who began studying Animism and Thaumaturgy in his late teenage years, however has found difficulty with grasping magic beyond beyond its fundamentals, however as it so happens thaumaturgy and animism fundamentals are pretty useful

Journeyed out from home to seek perspective, Delsatz in Franz's eyes struggles to actually get things done in its neutral state eventually joining up with the expedition and becoming (at least as far as he currently knows) the only expeditioner from Delsatz to survive within the runewall and come out the other side.
Physical Description: a man standing at 5'11ft and 190lbs with white hair and a fairly stylish outfit, is very rarely seen without their sword and even rarer seen with some some kind of small tome in which they use to take notes

Name: Freddy The Chef
Known History: Freddy's story starts in a small village in Kal'Tarion. His family was descended from a moderately powerful fire mage who abandoned magic upon the moon falling. Eventually losing almost all their connection to the element of fire until Freddy was born with an affinity for it. With that fiery soul came a passion for cooking. His fascination began when he was 5 years old and has grown since. He would spend time going to the town library to learn more about cooking and happening upon a book for cooking monsters. Which only added to potential culinary ideas in his head. Spending the next few years looking up and trying to cook various things he eventually turned his sights to monsters when he felt his food needed more. He took up learning as much as he could about monsters and spent some time training before going out to kill some common and considered relatively weak monsters. This hubris got him a scar that he uses as a reminder. Now he travels to find monsters and rare ingredients.
Physical Description:
Height: 5'11"          Eyes: Red
Weight: 195 lbs     Hair: Light Red
Chest has a scar from his first battle against monsters. It is in the form of 3 claw marks.

Name: Freyr Branson
Known History:
Born the Eldest Son of three in Gravslenge.

Spent over a Decade and a Half working in Smithies, Forges, and the Great Forge within Gravslenge.

Once tutored, and became close with, a particular Smith Slave. Was suspiciously absent when she later escaped, though nothing was ever traced back to him.

Headed to the Runewall expeditions in hopes to find someone, though he also plans to share his art of Permanence
Physical Description: Nearly always seen within his armor, those who manage to get a glimpse of him outside of it note his messy brown-red hair, and the large scar over his right eye. His left eye has a piercing Green Gaze, which when combined with his 6' height and heavyset build often paints an imposing figure.

Name: Friedrich "Frederick" Schmidt
Known History:
Frederick, along with his twin brother Alphonse, was born into House Schmidt, a fledgling noble family who had gained their wealth not from inheritance but from adventuring. He was raised in a loving and caring environment under his mother Emelia and any servants who were loyal to the house. Like many other noble families Frederick was private tutored, and often taken out to learn of his responsibilities as a noble.

Quite frankly, he found that life boring, but he and his siblings always looked forward to their private tutoring sessions since each of them would become a prodigy in their own field. Frederick himself seemed to have awakened eidolian magia and despite his mother initially wanting him to pick up swordsmanship, he found an art in marksmanship. And throughout his childhood his simple adventures into Silverdale's wilderness led him on going on an expedition to the Runewall with his brother...who he was separated from before ending up in Worldhelm.
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'3ft, Frederick is a young man with porcelain skin, bright blond hair, and a pair of mismatched eyes (the left being gold, and the right being an indigo blue). He typically wears a indigo hat with the left side pinned up, his diamond patterned longcoat (with fur on the collar, sleeves, and end of it), white gloves with blue roses embroidered onto them, and a surprisingly practical pair of pants with cuffed leather boots.

He also has a holster for his twin pistols strapped on each leg and despite never seeming to use it he has a rapier sheathed at his side at all times.

Name: Frigg Engstrom
Known History:
- Child of Jarl Warrior Kind Niklas Engstrom
- Was kidnapped by their mother for a while, but got back to Karsbren a few years ago. There was even a celebration about it.
- Was sent to the great march as a representative of Karsbren.
Physical Description: Lanky pale, and with slightly dead eyes. Long black hair usually at least partially braided in fine clothes with a clear Karsbren origin, perfect for cold weather.

Name: Fuchiko
Known History:
A fugitive experiment from Lumina Prime. She believes that somehow Providence is trying to connect with her because of her ability as esper. Often spotted on the rooftops of Haven making ringtone noises, claiming she wants to get a good signal.

Does various odd and part time jobs to stay afloat.
Physical Description:
A 164 cm tall woman with dark skin and toned build.  She has short black hair with rabbit ears with one of them flopped forward. Her eyes shine blue and gives off an empty look as if she always stares beyond whatever's in front of her.

She always wears clothes that allow her to move freely, often opting for t-shirt, short pants, gloves, and sneakers as core of her outfit.

Name: Fuji
Known History:
Fuji Iwai was born in Twin Peaks, to a nomadic group of Birdlike Yokai.

5 years ago, during an attack on her nomadic family, she was captured and enslaved by Sakura the Skalded.

Her wings were clipped to prevent escape, and also for the madman's amusement, being a fan of irony. Instead of being used as an experiment, she was tasked with handling toxic reagents.

At a point in her captivity, she was given the call of the edge.  In a spur of decisiveness, she ran, as far as she could. She followed her urge, hoping it would bring her safety.

She was cornered at the edge of a cliff, was she forced to make the choice of life in servitude, or freedom no matter the cost. With a scared breath, and the yelling of her master behind her, she stepped off the ledge.

Before she could meet her demise, she was swallowed by a realmstorm. Her life starting a new chapter.

After a meeting with the Utopian Archangels Morningstar and Klein, she now has a part of Banshee's Storm inside of her.
Physical Description:
Fuji stands at slightly below average 5'6. She has emerald green eyes and hair like snow, she also has small animal ears on the back of her head. her body wiry and pale, strength that may have once been there seems barely a specter. 

Her wings are truly the sorriest sight to see, feathers burned and plucked deliberately with seemingly regular intervals. The pride and joy of any bird, what helps them fly, has been clipped. Now only serving as a reminder. 

Her face is surprisingly clean. Her forearms are covered in scars and burns. All of which she hides underneath some leather bracers. Her feet are scarred too. Still bearing some punishment from the day she was forced to flee on foot instead of flying away.

Name: Fungee
Known History:
- Grown from the mycorrhizal network—a vast, living fungal web that stores memory and emotional resonance across the land.
- Formed in a grove centered around Echobark, an ancient tree that serves as the deepest node of the local network.
- Regarded by some pilgrims as Echobark’s spirit or child.
- Spent early life listening and interpreting the network, gently resolving spiritual imbalances in the realm.
- Joined the Goldhearted seeking connection through joyful presence and emotional resonance.
Physical Description:
- 3'9" (114 cm) fey of fungal origin, with a soft, spongy body resembling living mycelium.
- Wide mushroom cap for a head, speckled with bioluminescent spots that shift color with mood.
- Communicates via melodic, vibration-born sounds.
- Emits faint ambient spores that glimmer softly in the air.
- Wears a layered robe stitched from petals, moss, lichen, and leaf-like fabrics.
- Makes squeaky noises when walking.
- Overall aesthetic is whimsical, organic, and otherworldly.

Name: Fuyuki Omura
Known History: When Fuyuki was still a child, his family had to move to Merrane for economic reasons.  In that completely new environment, however, he had several problems being with his peers and found himself isolated: the people he had met in that city were too different from Fuyuki and he couldn't understand them.  Eventually, as much as his spirit could stand, he fell into a period of depression wanting to end his life: one day he began running out of the house, heading far away and towards a cliff from which he threw himself, but this did not die thanks to a traveler who managed to save him.  The Wanderer then told him everything about his life experience.  From that story Omura decided to follow the goal that the savior also had: to be able to help all the people who need it.  Before leaving, the Wanderer will show him the dawn: with a vermilion sun and the sky with pink and orange ripples of the sky: "See? Even if there will be night in your mind, somewhere there will always be a dawn"
Physical Description: Fuyuki is a young man with slightly wavy, short, dark brown hair and narrow, dark brown eyes.  His bangs frame his face, while some are gathered in the center of his forehead.  He is 1.81m tall and weighs 67kg and especially likes to wear black, brown or white clothes

Name: Féin of Lionheart's Reach
Identity: The Little Wolf with a Lion's Heart
Known History:
A Daughter of the Pariah Noble House Faolán, a Knight at the Lionheart's Reach Hold of a house that fell out of grace. She along with her family live on the edge of Hearthome at a Hold that over looks Murkwood as they have for many winters. in self exile. Only the House knows why they've chosen this and not the entire history at that.

Those who only know of her either call her Faolán out of disrespect, purposely not using her given name or as Wolf Knight Faolán out of respect.
Physical Description:
She stands tall but not proud, no she stands resolute at 3'4ft to see her duties done. Grey fur with slight patches of black around the ears and on her back, Féin stands tall to walk the wall that oversees her charge until her final breath. To many she seems such a serious and possibly unfun person to be around but to those who serve with her, know how kind hearted and strong her heart is and unreasonably focused she is on what her duties are. Her steely eyes gaze ever onward to the threats and the weight bared. 

She carries with her a weapon her back, far larger than her, too unwieldy looking to be a sword and too sharp to be maul. A Fang from The Great Wolf.

Name: Féng Líhuà 「冯丽华」
Known History:
Hailing from the callous Demonic Isles in the Tianjie Shenpaan region of Wujing Guo. Líhuà was born into a loving family and seen as a fortunate boon to the rest of the villagers in Yuānshì. However, it is said that one day when her parent's were out foraging in the sub-terranean Mòguāng jungle, they got killed by one of the ferocious beasts lurking in the dark. Since then she has been one of the many pupils that village elder Wǔhào has, training her body and cultivation. However, ever since she reached Qi condensation at the ridiculous age of 16, she hasn't seen much growth. With that, she set out to the world hoping to hone her cultivation and broaden her horizons.
Though in that journey she made herself to the Worldhelm, and on there she met Guo Muchen, who would take her under their wing and help train them within the Bloodied Lion Sect which they run.
Physical Description: A blue and crimson scaled Bishi'e with silver hair and tufts, along with mellow gray eyes. Lihua stands at 5'6" and carries herself with a level of confidence, arrogance (and ignorance). After joining the Bloodied Lion Sect, She has predominantly started to wear red coloured clothing with a focus on athleticism, around her neck is a long bead necklace and her arms are fitted with bracers.

Name: Gabirel Moonfallen
Known History:
Gabirel was born inside a cult, worshipping the now shattered moon. The cult believed the moonshards would bring them closer to their moon, making them more monstrous. At age 20, Gabirel was forced to be transformed, the cult using a moonshard to corrupt their body. With a new monstrous body, they escaped, fleeing deeper into the woods. 

Years passed, Gabirel become a traveling self-proclaimed monster who seeks to free people from their shackles and to pursue their passions. They do their best to guide others to freedom. They are now simply a priest without a god. Eventually, they found themself in a realmstorm and encountered the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: A six foot lean androgynous person, covered all over in white feathers with two large white wings on their back. They have clothing that covers part of their head and neck. Their chest is mostly exposed (they have a male body) and they have a skirt made out of their own feathers down to knee length. They have bird like claws instead of hands and feet.

Name: Gabriela Josephina Caladrius
Known History:
- On that faithful day, a Lunar Eclipse covered the sky instead, blocking the sun from the prophesized blessing of the High Priestess' Daughter. Gabriela has lived in the shadow of that event her entire life, far weaker than she should be.

- She took solace in her older sister's guidance, and her nephew, who was similar of age, and acted like her sibling. She found talent in her physical capabilities, a side effect of the Eclipse.

- Not a month after she turned 11, her sister was killed by demons during a mission to a Coven Town. This changed both her and her nephew's lives forever.

- She threw herself into her training, molding herself into a vessel for Exorcism, her touch of the eclipse able to channel the Sun's Wrath at high intensity.

- She continues her path of Fury, with Heron as her stalwart guardian. Following the path of righteous indignation.
Physical Description:
Gabriela is a average height women adorned in white priestly robes with symbols bearing her lineage as a daughter of the High Priestess. Her eyes are a steely gray, remaining sharp and poised. Her stance is strong and regal, holding a dignity and grace in her steps. Her hair is a snow white, and cut short to ensure it does not get in the way.

Her disposition is cold and unflinching, and her head is always on a swivel.

Name: Gabu
Known History:
- Formerly the incarnation of the demon of Envy, whose essence was tampered with by the Dream Weaver to create something less dangerous
- He spent 72 years claiming a semblance of humanity, eventually making a name for himself as Gabu, protector of the Mirland Coast
- Eventually, to save a friend they turned back into his old form, temporarily regaining his more demonic and envious persona.
- During the confrontation with Loftur, he showed his best self and reclaimed his Gabu-ness.
- Was finally turned into something more by the Queen of Hearts, Song-5.
Other Names: Sir Gabu, First Knight of Dryholde
Physical Description:
The Protector of the Mirland Coast takes on the appearance of a young man wearing flowing clothes, with white hair and red eyes. What remains of his demonic origin are just his sharp, sharklike teeth - all in all, he looks like a pretty normal guy!

He's usually carrying a kite or two on him, since he loves flying them with friends!

Name: Gadget, of Malagar
Known History:
Gadget lived a moderate life throughout his childhood and teenage years. It was standard one could be in a foxen coven afterall, basically having an expanded family of roughly 80 kin. His main interest involved collecting, especially things that came from other tribesfolk. He’s always had a way with words when it comes to getting what he wanted. That all changed when he was 17

With the foxen covens coming together to launch their assault against the blight, Gadget was ready to volunteer himself but being just shy of an adult, Gadget had no choice but to stay behind. He watched his own family walk offand little did he know, it was the last time he’d see them. The news spread like wildfire about the carnage that had happened, people came back changed, different…corrupted. Gadget had to leave, he had to *live*

Gadget spent the last 10 years a wanderer (or as some say, a Stray) He stuck to what he knows best, selling and collecting until a chance encounter with a certain mouse occured.
Physical Description:
Standing at a “tall” 4’7”, Gadget stands out amongst his Firwood peers. With a comfortable tunic and colorful silks that drape from his waist, Gadget moves with a certain grace that befits a fox of his stature. 

In terms of accesories, Gadgets has pockets and pouches aplenty, always seeming to have *just the thing* when the time arrises. What stands out most is the portable marketstand he has on his back, *always* ready to strike a deal when the mood is right!

Name: Gaius Decimus
Identity: Seeker searching for a new Dawn
Known History: Originally born in Last Hold, Gaius came into contact with several key aspects of the Culture of the empire early on: Being oppressed due to being a human, the branding and exploitation of mages and the hunters, going out into the desert to cull the Kiir. All of this has influenced him to go out into the desert himself, to escape the constant oppression, but also to hide his nascent magical abilities from the Nezzim. He became a skilled hunter relatively fast, but much changed when he stumbled upon an old stone tablet, talking about Falak-khan in the Short Peaks. He had heard rumours of this god in the past, but was now completely fascinated with him.  Nowadays, he's wandering the dunes, trying to find a sign of this god to enkindle the spirits of his fellow oppressed  against the Nezzim. To this end, he's seeking out everybody who might know more about the ancient stories, but also talking to other people, especially hunters, to slowly spread the tales and a hope for a new dawn.
Physical Description:
Gaius is of average high, but is obviously quite fit. His mid length hair is a wavy, dirty blonde and the most striking feature of his face are the odd-coloured eyes. One is brown and one is blue. He tends to wear rather light clothes under his armour and when he can he at least carries his weapon everywhere, but quite often he can be seen with his shield as well. 
While he often looks serious or even anguished, he has a light smile and a friendly demeanour once people talk to him, which can clash with his martial appearance.

Name: Galavan Riverstone
Identity: Book Character Writing His Own Story
Known History:
- Simple young man from Belfrost
- Seeks knowledge to the Sanctuary of Wisdom in Stratford
- Becomes a follower of the Beacon of Wisdom Julius Miquel, admires him a lot
- Julius sends his disciples out to seek wisdom, Galavan is one of them
- Tasked with understanding the Watcher's Tome by Julius himself
- Joins the expedition and goes through the Runewall together with his best friend Rhys
- Now holds a copy of Wisdom's Book to tell his own story
Physical Description: A scrawny young man with unkempt red hair and inquisitive grey eyes hidden behind thick glasses. A permanent slouch usually steals a few inches from him, and the air of someone who's always lost in his thoughts follows him like a loyal dog. Usually clad in warm and sensible clothes, Galavan is just your average Silverdale inhabitant.

Name: Gareth
Known History:
He has lived in Idyll for as long as he can remember. He was originally born on Terra, but the memory has faded such that he doesn't know what his life there was like. He doesn't even remember how long he'd been in Barza when he met Mya. She was exactly what he needed to face the layers of Idyll-- quick and decisive when he was uncertain, ruthless and cutting when he was gentle. They made a good team. They made their way down over the course of years, until Gareth could scarcely remember a time before he had Mya. Down they went, layer by layer, until they got stuck in the sands of Sum. And when she hardened too much, when she turned to stone... he couldn't lose that. 
For the last two years, Gareth has been painstakingly moving Mya's statue with him through the sand. He is determined to find a way to fix her and bring her with him when he finally escapes Idyll for good.
Physical Description: Gareth is tall and pale blonde, with tan skin and dark eyes. He dresses in light layers and carries everything  he owns in a bag strung over his shoulders.

Name: Garmir Eidolon
Known History:
- Raised in an orphanage in Silver Rock, has no idea who his parents were
- More or less had a decent childhood, destitute but had a sense of community around him in his orphanage
- Was kidnapped when he was 17 and taken to Cabre by T&C to be used as test subjects, using augments and mind control to develop a living weapon
- Next six years of his life he can't really remember, but one day the device controlling him failed, and using his newfound strength and desperation he escaped
- Stowed away on a ship and returned to Haven, where he took up doing odd jobs to make do while lying low in North Rock
- Got a TEMP license using a fake name
- Swept away via Realmstorm to the Worldhelm, he intends to take the newfound opportunity to right the wrongs done to him, and stop it from happening to others
- Is not accustomed to being around so many powerful allies, and is afraid of being the weak link in the group
Physical Description: Muscular 6'9" wolfman with dark sclera and red irises, wears a cap and an open jacket with leather pants. When fighting, summons additional appendages, usually dark tendrils brimming with fire magic from his back, to help subjugate his opponents.

Name: Gawain Elysia
Known History: Gawain, or at least that is what he calls himself, was born among the New Moon Tribe in Rimanska. Soon after being discovered by the Victory Beacon he was brought to the court of decision and trained as one of the few Successors of Victory. Having been trained by the many disciples and the Beacon himself he found the world lacking in what he sought. His own true version of Victory. Lacking such a thing he set off to find the meaning to this all. To not let the world stagnate into nothingness.
Physical Description: Standing roughly at 6'1 (185cm) Gawain is a fairly well built Lerisin man. Usually dressed without much armor he carries a multitude of swords with him at most times. Along his arms and some parts of his chest has blue crystals forming over where scars would be. Along the side of his face has a much larger and more pronounced blue crystal as well. He carries an aura of pride with him at all times.

Name: Gerard de Montagne
Known History:
Born of humble origins, Gerard’s father was an engineer who built and maintained the Mecha used by the people’s guard. After securing the backing of a nobleman, he attended the white wing academy, going on to become a mech pilot of notable skill. Even becoming one of the empire’s hallowed angels.

At the height of his distinguished career, fell in love with a seamstress who made and refitted military uniforms and after a lengthy courtship the two wed and were expecting a child. However while on the front lines in a prolonged campaign, he began to question some of the orders his unit were given by command… and then the crushing blow.

He received word his entire family was massacred, caught in the crossfire of a political conflict back in Caldera brought about by the succession crisis. This finally shattered his worldview, peeling away the shining layer of imperial doctrine, filling him with guilt and a need to escape.

Now the only thing for him in the empire is duty and bitter regret.
Physical Description:
6ft’6, 162lbs.

Surprisingly athletic build for someone his age.
Piercing hazel coloured eyes, greying charcoal coloured hair with a well kept, short, full beard.

Rarely seen out of his armored pilot’s uniform, preferring to keep his helmet on unless absolutely necessary (or he needs fresh air.)

His voice is gruff yet often carries a caring or forlorn tone to it.

Name: Gerel
Known History:
- An Earth Cultivator from a nomadic clan of Yakshi, native to the northern forests and mountains of Leytik.
- Apprenticed under a shaman of his clan from an early age.
- Follows the Dao of Farming, with a particular focus on soil cultivation, and has a special aptitude for manipulating Earth qi.
- Has a strong sensitivity to Metal qi that unsettles him, causing him to avoid long periods of skin contact with metal whenever possible. As a result, he refuses to wear or wield any equipment containing metal.
Physical Description: A tall, thick-bodied Yakshi, covered from head to hoof in fur that ranges in color from gray to dark brown. Dressed in simple robes with many pockets. Always carrying a large staff on his back and a small, soil-filled clay pot on his hip.

Name: Gin
Known History:
Formerly a slave of the Oni who reside in the Shrine of Inexorable Tides, this past is far behind Gin at this point. 
Having received the acknowledgement of several entities including Musashi the Sword Saint, Nobunaga the Last Warlord of the War of Heaven, and Tsukuyomi, the goddess of the moon, Gin had been thrust into the role of becoming the future Emperor of Teisei. 
Now, Shuye lives, and he no longer is on that path. While he has shed the title of Emperor, he has not shed what he learned while pursuing it, nor the authority with which he now walks.
Origin: Tian Yin, Teisei, Shrine of Inexorable Tides
Physical Description:
A lithe swordsman with feminine features, Gin stands at roughly 5'3"/160cm. Cerulean hair cascades over sapphire eyes and porcelain skin.

Their neutral expression conveys mixed feelings. A stern countenance wrought by grief and obligation, but a soft look in their eyes that conveys deep empathy for the pain of others.

Name: Gladiolus Amendola
Known History:
- Septid, born and raised in South Rock, in an apparently well-off family. Used to be a problem child until the age of 14, kind of a jerk and a bully.
- Parents die and they're suddenly responsible for a younger brother and an incredibly high debt inherited by their parents.
- Decides they'd better work to repay every single zenit of it. Clean themselves up, tries becoming a better person and works for ETA as a debt collector.
- Went to get a payment, debtor pulled a gun on them. "Guess insolvency it is", they thought. Instead, they were summoned to the Worldhelm
- Eventually became an insolvent to save Termina and two ARMY-grades who just wanted to live.
- Had a close call with the son of Lilith Tychon and Utopia that brought tragedy to Terra, but they survived and are trying to clean up their messes.
Physical Description:
A somewhat strongly built septid that seems to always be walking around dancing from joy. They usually dress in heavy clothes that cover all of their body, enjoying baggy and larger ones as well as dresses. Strong cinnamon smell.
They have a tail-like implant that serves absolutely no purpose other than the fact of them having a tail, and slightly sharp teeth.
Bright yellow hair and the typical insolvent’s red eyes and pale grey skin, dotted by patches of flesh turned to porcelain.
They tend to act friendly and confident, a chuckle always in their speech.

Name: Godric ~~Ashmont~~
Known History:
Godric was an Ashmont, heir to a corrupt noble house of Brightshield. When he discovered that it had been his family schemes that caused him to kill his childhood friend, he cast away his name and inheritance. Pride and defiance made him a failed mercenary, and on his way to his last resort at Hudal Academy, he was chosen to be a Goldhearted.

He was desperate to prove himself a Hero, to embody the title of Goldhearted, mistaking pride for conviction. Every triumph and failure stripped that illusion away. Through the struggle and hope of other Realms, and the friends who saw behind his mask, Godric began to understand and forgive himself.

Now the Shield of Teisei, he walks the Dao of Heavenly Justice. His loyalty to Shuye guides his path, as he strives to restore Teisei to what it's meant to be, and, beyond it, Tian Yin itself.
Physical Description:
Godric stands at 183cm (6'0"), often in heavy magic-infused armor, or a shogun's kimono. He has grown to be steady and quite at peace.
To any who can discern it, he has a strong Heavenly and Earth Qi, while his usual leaky Mana is a controlled undertone to his presence.

Name: Gojko
Known History:
- used to be a high rank soldier among the mouse king's forces a long time ago
- made friend with the king and a certain former spy spider
- had to lead incursions against the Blight, a moth predicted he'd flee
- was scared and ran away, returned to the mouse king with great dishonor
- was exiled instead of being executed, roamed the woods for years and found a mentee in a blight-affected frog
- was called to the mouse king to mentor his oldest son
Physical Description:
An old bat of median stature, curved under the weight of age. He's crooked, stumbling, and unsteady, and sometimes might sound outright delirious to those who don't know him.
Always with a dumb grin on his face, he always carries with him bags of berries and pouches of poultices, bundles of bandages and tons of tinctures.
He sports numerous scars on his body, the most prominent of those being the one running across his face punctuating his glass eye. one might wonder what caused those.

Name: Graveyard
Known History:
Brittle Winter Ground, The Graveyard Empty and Still, Welcoming the Warmth is a living person.

They must remind themselves of this fact from time to time. In their life of relative solitude, they either meditate alone, tend to the shrine and graveyard they live at or combat the occasional antagonist that approaches.

But they do not complain about such an honorable task, to watch over the Temple of Broken Blades. They were busier some decades before, but now it seems that their graveyard is emptier.

Oh well, they surmise. Soon, they will be given another task with great import. For now, they will make some more tea and meditate.
Origin: Teisei, Tian Yin [The Temple of Broken Blades]
