Physical Description: Light brown skin, a youthful and hale visage, empty yellow eyes, and wisdom that also forgets how much time has passed.

Name: Grimalkin II
Known History: Grimalkin II is the son of a feral creature with whom he shares his namesake. This creature happens to be his mother, and the two shared a strong familial bond; before suddenly, Grimalkin II awoke one day, alone and seemingly abandoned. No longer was he the creature that he once was either, as he now had a new bipedal form, and the ability to understand and use spoken language for the first time. He understood this to mean that he had been gifted by the goddess Kuzunoha; however, he could not understand what this meant for his mother nor her disappearance. His search was dramatically cut short wherein mere hours after his transformation, Grimalkin II found himself chosen by a strange vessel and whisked away to adventure.
Physical Description: Grimalkin II is reminescent of a calico cat (albeit much larger), with the apparant mannerisms of housecat. The similarities stop there however, as Grimalkin II now walks on his hind legs for most of his immediate travel, he dawns a colorful cloak as a form of attire, and his tail is split in two at the base. When in his beastial form, Grimalkin II returns to his quadrapedal stride, and his body grows in proportion to that of a true coeurl (9feet long, 600lbs).

Name: Grün
Identity: Calm Woodsman with a Heart of Gold
Known History: From a lineage of woodsmen blessed by the trees for their service in protecting the woods, Ancestors were Lumberjacks. Word of tragedy and horrors in the world had reached him and so he went forth to aid any who would need of it.
Physical Description: A broad man who would seem entirely human if not for his body being green. He is adorned in a cloak of grass.

Name: Guiying 「桂英」
Identity: Quiet Musician With a Burning Heart
Known History:
- Born to a family of mortals, seen both as a good omen and as something to hide not to be persecuted
- Grew up passing from minor sect to minor sect, fleeing every time they were destroyed
- Learned cultivation from a manual from Wen Oina’s sect, teaching about music Qi
- Lived mostly as a beggar and hiding his horns until the realmstorm took him
Physical Description:
A Bishi'e of average stature, with platinum blonde hair and bronze horns. He presents himself as quiet and demure, not really talking much unless addressed, always with a good word for everyone.
When it gets to playing his huqin, he changes as he pours his soul into his music, passion burning in his eyes and in his wild smile.

Name: Guo Mùchén
Known History:
A humble and quiet guardian of the hidden village within Jijing Xiantiao. Someone who for a while now has kept to themselves and only focused on guarding their home, not much is known about the man. Due to being a Jinshi, avid user of Body Cultivation, though his own personal Cultivation stems from Blood Cultivation.

Trough trials and tribulation, he now stands as the Successor to the Jade Emperor. Having reached towards the very heavens to sculpt his body to it's proper form, to waging war against his partner Saroja Narayan within her home of Bahata against the False God Maharaja. Muchen now stands at a height of Cultivation few reach with a desire to continue onwards and forward with his home and people on his back.
Origin: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Jijing Xiantiao, Bingchuan
Physical Description:
A dark skinned and tall man, bearing clothing of Tian Yin, specifically that of Wujing Guo. Loose and open robes along with more martially inclined clothing. Underneath these robes a more tight black outfit that hugs his body. Lion like ears sprouting from his head and a lion's tail flicking behind him. His eyes bear with them an animalistic look, his expression is usually calm or a tame smile. His body denotes one who relies on strength, having more of a "strong man's" build rather than one aesthetically please. Heavy and dense muscles lining his body from top to bottom. On top of his clothing he wears what looks like hand-made jewelry. 

When he is fighting, on occasion scarlet red blood can be seen as he uses his very own blood as a form of cultivation. The energy itself being derived from both Wood & Water Qi, a crimson hue that matches his hair.

Name: Gwendoline Faolan Tarth
Identity: The Lions Hedge Knight of the Realm
Known History: The daughter of a noble house that lives within Pride Rock, a well known individual for her readiness to aid those in need. Many problems the common folk have that don't reach the attention of those of import found resolution from her. It's surprising she's not home, and even more so she's wearing the mantle of a knight given her father's dislike for such a station for her.
Physical Description: Standing at a titanic 3ft, Gwendoline bears the visage of many mousekin from Firwood. Dressed in armor and gambeson denoting her house, well cared for weapons on her person. The most stunning aspect to her attire is the gem like jewelry she wears.

Name: Gwydion
Identity: Fae Duelist of the Spring Heart
Known History: The whims and desires of fae are as wildly varied as their appearances, and Gwydion is no exception. Prior to his arrival at the Worldhelm, Gwydion hadn't seen much of the mortal realm within Kor'Tarion, having lived most of his life in the Faerie Realm in service to the Spring Court. While some fae broker bargains, deals, or gifts, Gwydion holds a special reverence to what he views as the noble art of formal duels. He travelled out to hone his craft, see the world, and on occasion help others.
Physical Description: Standing at roughly 6'2" (not including horns), Gwydion is a tall faefolk. Broad-shouldered but willowy, shades of dark gray, brown, and black fur cover corded muscle across his body and lanky limbs. His fae being is unmistakable, with an elongated goat's head, fanning ears, tail, curling horns adorned with small bits of jewelry, and sturdy hooves. Orange eyes take in the world with an almost perpetual smile on his face. Clearly enjoying finery, and willing to spend for it, his clothes are often more of a mimic of Kor'Tarion mortal nobility. His movements are relaxed, even lazy at times, but his eyes move constantly in delight at seeing all that he can.

Name: Gwydion Tlepsh
Known History:
- A blacksmith for Castle Ladon’s knights, so dedicated to the forge he was blessed to always have a part of its fire in him
- Dreamed of crafting marvelous legendary weapons during the mystical sleep created by Regus
- Woke up and realized his legendary crafts were just dreams, but instead of crying over it he became thrilled at the idea of bringing those marvelous dreams to life
- Joined the Goldhearted as where heroes go, legends follow, and he wants to see the stories of new and old friends become grandiose
Physical Description:
A mountain of a man with vulpine features, Gwydion is a middle-aged dreamite with a jolly smile constantly present on his face like it was painted there. He just really enjoys life, is all.
His fantastical animal features present as tails and ears of a white and red fox, which compliment white hair kept in a long braid, and white beard.
Most of the scars on Gwydion's body are from accidents during the process of forging weapons or from the process of testing out such weapons with the knights who would wield them. As for himself, however, he does *not* use weapons or armor.

Name: Gwyneth
Known History:
Gwyneth was fished up out of the ocean by a fishers near Traeth Village. She still does not know her real parents. Her parents were the ones that taught her to find the beauty in others, the kindness in strangers, and the responsibility it means to keep everybody safe.

Growing up, it was evident she was a little different from other villagers: taller, stronger, much more hungry than a normal person. It wouldn't stop her from taking up the axe and the armor to protect Traeth from the many threats that lurked along its edges. She was one of the many commonfolk inspired by the acts of heroism spreading through the realm, deciding to leave her village to spread her desire to protect and help beyond the little bubble of Traeth.
Physical Description:
Taller than most. Carrying a larger axe than most. Eats more than most. What isn't clad in armor is her face. She wants to assure others that she isn't a threat.

Smiles often. Laughs even more.

Name: Gyalwa Jigme「རྒྱལ་བ་འཇིགས་མེད་」
Known History:
- Used to be a problematic student at the Temple of Strife, often coming at odds with teachers and more diligent students.
- Discovered a passion for maths and physics, integrated those in her cultivation while leaning on her Heavenly affinity.
- Left the Temple and got swept up by the Worldhelm, her adventures i Terra bound her to the realm.
- She acted as Terran but had to change her cultivation completely to solve an unexpected issue, purifying herself.
- Now developing an understanding of the Dao of Time as she returns to her roots in Kalahala Mandira.
Origin: Tian Yin, Leytik, Temple of Strife
Physical Description:
A woman with a tan complexion, orange hair, and golden eyes. Her skin is covered in scriptures that shine in a golden light, enumerating the twenty-five postulates of the Golden Spiral Circulation and Harmonic Spiral Circulation, the sacred texts she has taken onto herself to master and one day teach. Her clothing is a mixture of Terran streetwear and traditional Leytik Empty Monk robes, decorated with accessories from her travels.
This is accompanied by an ever-present smile.

Name: Hamra Al-Ayn
Identity: The Enslaved Forgemaster Raising Her Dragon
Known History: Hamra is private about her life. The broken gaia crystals on her face are emblematic of her enslavement in Karsbren as one chosen by the Path of Permanence. Her name and skin show she is from Grestazs and the dragon by her side is one from Mestraz. Wulfroh is at the center of all three of these places, and given her demeanor, it is no doubt she was once a slave.
Other Names:
She with Eyes of Fire [Ormen]
Successor of the Permanence Stone
Physical Description: A short 5'0" woman with a frail, delicate frame. Her dark skin is complimented by her bright red eyes, but stained with burning fractured blue crystals on her face. Black mana-burns like her fingertips and lower lip, it heals with salves and light ointments she wears. Though, most of her hair and body is covered with several layered shawls. She has a perpetually paranoid if not afraid expression, and her voice is raspy and dry with her words usually stuttered.

Name: Haoran
Known History: Haoran is a natural Metal Qi cultivator, as well as a fairly good dancer. He is a novice of the spear after events in his life led him to the Worldhelm.
Origin: Tian Yin - Wujing Guo, Secret Fern Village
Physical Description: With a body mostly covered in shimmering scales the color of sapphires, he possesses luxurious white hair which winds down his back and along the thin tail behind him. Additional lengthy tufts at his elbows and knees lend a gentle countenance to him, reflected with his equine-esque face, plated ridges along the bridge of his nose leading to a single antler-horn arcing gracefully from the middle of his forehead.

Name: Haruka Satsuki
Identity: The Last Embers of The Mournful God
Known History: Haruka Satsuki hails from Sakai and was raised by the shrine maidens there. While the shrine maidens would try to keep him within the shrine grounds he would often sneak out and go around Sakai helping out and keeping spirits up. Once he was an adult he would use his training from the shrine maidens to assist the warriors of Sakai repelling the Tengu.
Physical Description: Satsuki stands at a staggering 5’6” tall. He has hair that is brownish at the top and blonde at the tips. He dresses in a very ornate white and gold with filigree of the sky on the collar and sleeves.

Name: Hazel von Nausicaa
Known History:
- The ~~eldest~~ youngest daughter of a renowned Merrani scientist and a decorated military woman.
- Graduated from Korala Academy, began working in a lab for Merrane.
- Arrested in ignominy ~~for the misuse of a chemical weapon resulting in civilian casualties~~ in place of her sister through use of magic to permanently transfigure herself to look like her.
- Recently freed from Heaven's Gate and brought to the Worldhelm.
- Trying to make up for the her own sins and Merrane's
- Swore to protect her family no matter what
Physical Description: Magically disguised as Sienna von Nausicaa, a tall woman in her thirties with long, green-black hair, dressed in stylish if somewhat avant-garde clothing. She carries a magitech bow on her back.

Name: Heinrich
Known History:
Heinrich was born into Empire of Merrane, and as a child he believed, as most, in the justice of his homeland. He, too, wanted to fight for the people. As he grew older, the thought become more mature, but never really left. When the chance came, he signed up to join the army.

To this day, he's not really sure why that happened. Was the whole Empire involved in such things? Or was it individual, illegal cell that he had the misfortune of encountering? Whatever the case, he was found to have certain "potential", and next thing he knew, the Empire he so trusted was performing on him inhuman experiments. The goal was to somehow fuse a human with an elemental into some being of power for use in the war effort.

Though others died, the experiment succeeded with him, and he was brought to the frontlines. He already distrusted the Empire, but before that, he thought it was just "whatever necessary to win" kind of deal. Then he saw the reality of the war, anger filled him, and he escaped.
Physical Description:
183 cm tall, average build

Usually seen in silver armor with blue accents covering his whole body, especially the helmet. Even without it he usually wears clothes with long sleeves and high collars.

His body is covered with ugly scars that glow and buzz with elemental energies, which is why he prefers to keep himself hidden beneath armor. His hair is green, short and unkept, his pale skin has strange green tinge to it that makes him appear sickly, his face seems to have settled into a permanent frown, and his nose looks like it got broken and healed improperly. His eyes too glow with elemental energies, changing colors with his surroundings, and his Heterochromia is the only part of his looks that he actually likes.

Name: Helios, The First
Known History: Helios is a human soldier from the Islands of Samsara. Trained in the lost art of dragon fighting, he seeks adventure to issue in peace across the realm. He was granted the moniker of "The First" by his comrades, being the first of his name as well as the first in many generations to rekindle the art of the ancient Dragoons.
Physical Description: Helios has been described as a stoic, but gentle person with a fierce aura of determination and purpose. He stands relatively taller than most of his kin at 6 feet, 6 inches tall (198cm), and sports a short cut to his shock white hair. His eyes are a piercing gold compared to his complexion and armor. He also has a notable scar across his left cheek and lips.

Name: Hemlocke Perditos
Identity: Traveling Apothecary searching for a Breakthrough
Known History:
« ...Born in the Perditos family, in a small town in Lhodos, my boy Hemlocke was subject to a strict education and high standards since his childhood. Bringing respect to the Family Name has always been his highest aspiration. 
You see, all of Perditos family tree's names have been inspired to flowers. *Poisonous* flowers. The reason behind this "tradition" of theirs has been lost to time, unfortunately... but I think it's due to their w... [ this part is illegible ]
 
...When his hometown became a battlefield, his family nowhere to be found, he had no choice but escape to the north. I found him on the streets and offered him rest in my caravan. He helped me in my daily duties for years, even learned the job. When we ended up stayin' in Korila, he was allowed in the academy. Hells, even graduated. 
I'm sure he's doing alright... He's got the will, and he's got the brains. May his future shine bright. »
– An Old Man's note.
Physical Description:
Hemlocke is 186cm (6'1) tall. He's not particularly brawny, as physical exercise would take him precious time otherwise spent in deep thought. 

He features dark hair, except for a single white strand of hair... seems to be a "family trait", according to him.
When he leaves his lab, he always brings some tools, trinkets and little bottles filled with ingredients along. And don't forget about the notebook! There's always something new to discover, even in Lhodos!

Name: Henrik Nagy
Known History: A young man born into the world of Humans as a werewolf, his life uprooted. He now carries the honor and expectations of one within the Sündisznó Tribe where weakness isn't tolerated. Now forced to work alongside a painful reminder of his past to find and kill one who dares threaten both werewolf and vampire kind.
Physical Description:
A man standing at 6'4 with dark black hair hanging down the sides of his face that occasionally catch on his beard. A set of sterling green eyes, the man himself very clearly is tribalistic in his style of furs, bone, and leather clothing. Tan skin that's been worn like leather, a number of scars and wounds all over his body. Burly and muscular with hair all over him even outside of his shifted form. Along his body now are red thorn like marks infused with his blood. A binding vow of his cooperation with another individual. 

When shifted, he grows in about half his size, hulking out of his body into that of a werewolf. Grayish fur with blue eyes that almost shines like moonlight. His Sündisznó heritage only further showcased in this form as he towers as a powerhouse.

Name: Herb
Known History: Herb is a Heavenborn from the Island of Deleria. He lived in the Heart of Ladon, helping the settlement establish itself by taking up a role of craftsman and trader, wheeling and dealing in all sorts of useful goods and useless trinkets. When Deleria fell, he unexpectedly ended up on the Worldhelm, instead of Polis like many of his friends and neighbors. While he misses them dearly, becoming a Goldhearted was an auspicious turn of events to him, as he finally feels ready to listen to the intrinsic call to adventure that his people all have.
Physical Description: Anthropomorphic goat-person. 5'10" tall and weighs about 175 pounds. He has two short horns protruding through his hat, a beetle-shaped backpack, and white fur under his multipatterned green robe.

Name: Heron Caladrius
Known History:
A child sworn to protect the only child of High Priestess Caladrius, Gabriela. He's served her loyally, but beyond that, much of his history and origin are a mystery to the people of Proudrock. He was born in secret, and raised in seclusion. He wasn't on the peoples radar until he was around 12, at which, he was always seen with Gabriela. 

Since then, rumor has spread that he was the estranged child of the High Priestess, while some say he's an orphan raised in secret. Others in the know have let slip the truth, that Heron is the child of the High Priestess' first daughter, who went missing about a decade ago.
Physical Description:
A young 5'3'' man with darker skin and crimson eyes. He has an impossible to ignore irritance about him, eyes cold and hostile. He's light, but muscular, weighing no more than 130 lbs. He walks with perfect posture, and every move he makes is disciplined and deliberate. 

He doesn't fidget or pace. He's focused and practiced.

Name: Heywire
Known History:
Heywire is a renowned exosuit Test Pilot in Lumina  Prime and daughter of Annete Line CEO, Marie Annete, an exosuit test pilot.

Even as a company test pilot, she also takes on different missions in areas close to Lumina Prime or further for live combat to gather data for futher exosuit development. 

Heywire's true identity is Mariane, who had happened to disguised herself as her sister, the real Heywire. Maribeth, after the latter went missing. It was out of an impulsive obligation that she assumed her sister's identity to. not just simply maintain her mother's company's public standing, but to safeguard Maribeth's life's work once she finds her, continue living as her if she couldn't.

Further impersonation might have spiraled her to more complications or worse if she had not been taken to the Worldhelm. 

After Witnessing many conflicts within and outside Terra, she decides to help pave the way for a better future as Marianne

She is currently a member of AGES under her real name.
Physical Description: Heywire is short in stature of 166cm/5'4" ft. Her hair is about shoulder length with asymmetrical bangs, sporting the hair color of white with orange streaks. Her pupils are orange with four sided star irises.

Name: Hibiki Fujimori
Identity: Passionate Yokai Chef Full of Grit
Known History:
Hibiki is the son and student of two prestigious yokai masters, one practiced in the martial arts, one in the culinary arts. He wished to show off his prowess by going on a long hunting expedition in the snowy plains of Aldistir, where he finds a kitsune yokai under attack from an Ald hunting party. He strikes at the Alds, only to be immediately humbled, leaving a massive scar across his eye. 
He returns to his village only to be reprimanded by his masters, as he risked revealing the location of his home. Hibiki stands, exiling himself until he can prove he is strong enough to protect himself and his home. Maybe he can open his own restaurant somewhere... maybe he can reunite with that kitsune he saved...?
Physical Description: A nekomata yokai, he stands proud at 5'8", with a three-toned face of yellow fur on his right, black fur on his left and a white muzzle and body with two tails curling behind him. He has burning red eyes and a scar running across his right eye, with equally fiery red hair that is tied into a ponytail. His typical uniform includes a blue gi and a headband wrapped with a red apron with sun and moon patterns printed on it. His favorite accessory is a pair of round glasses with blue and yellow lens.

Name: Hikmah
Known History: Originally from Windhaven, she spent most of her time studying.  She was enrolled in a school that dedicated it's resources to documenting the history is Nezmira.  Along the way, she learn to fight using elemental infusion to exploit the weaknesses she learned in her studies.  During one of her outings to study a ruin, she was picked up by a realmstorm.  (Leaving vague, will update later)
Physical Description: Height: 5'3 not counting ears, Weight: 71 lbs

Name: Himerope-Carmillia (Ri-Ri)
Identity: Paladin With a Ruinous Siren's Call
Known History:
- Cecillia was born in Ripplith as a man, Her family carried a gift from the Ocean Singers, a magical weapon that resonates with songs of the ocean. She at first couldn't lift it.

- Even before her transition, she was talented in the roles of a woman, taking the skillset far easier than the ones given to her as a man, this helped her realize that she was more comfortable presenting as a girl. She sought out a Seamother.

- After going through the ritual, she found a weight lifted off of her and was able to carry her family heirloom. Her family sent her to Gnosis Academy.

- She is quite the character, and so regularly had friction with stricter teachers due to her bubbly and excitable personality.

- She didn't get into too much trouble thanks to good grades. But that all changed when she heard about remedial classes and the opportunity to go to new places.

- Despite the look on her academic record, she tanked her grades to get into the remedial course. She is hungry for adventure.
Physical Description:
Ri-Ri is a energetic 4'11 girl with a lean but powerful physique. Her skin is a pastel shade of pink and her eyes sparkling a curious ocean blue. Her hair is dyed a midnight black with some of her normal shade peaking out.  Other notable features is the quite large tail which serves greatly in the ocean, but seems to only enhance the girl's clumsiness on land.

Her heirloom has long since been shattered, now replaced by the metallic twang of an anarchy amplifier laced with the shells power and propelled forward by a curse of misfortune which she weaponizes against the enemies of Gnosis.

Name: Hira Mae
Known History:
Hira was born on the outskirts of Brightshield to an ordinary family. Since a young age they've had the strange ability to see flashes and dreams of the future, and one day was able to use this power to save their friend, Heath, from a demon.  

Inspired by this, Hira decided he would enlist as a knight and do all he can to use his power for good-however, his power is near completely uncontrollable and often shows him unrelated events in different places, leading to him coming off as airheaded and distracted, though he tries his hardest. 

Working as a knight, Hira reunited with their childhood friend and developed a friendly rivalry with him. But soon after martial law was declared, his friend vanished with rumors of him turning traitor to Lastport. Hira tried to continue with his own duties, but eventually met an adventurer named Aile who claimed to have been friends with Heath, and he decided to work with her to find him.
Physical Description: Hira's usually in his knight's uniform, lightly armored and wielding his staff. His fighting style is similar to that of a lance user. They're about 5'7, and often seem rather distracted in demeanor, quick to apologize for it with a cheery smile.

Name: Hiya Dai Salamin
Identity: Princess Architect of the Divine Forge
Known History:
Coming from a long line of Glass Cultivators centered around the volcanic peaks of Pagapalay Village. Hiya despite being born a male in a matriarchal society was born into a hopeful position. 

But, as she practiced her lineage’s cultivation, she struggled to cope with her feelings of self-doubt to the dismay of those who practiced before her. Eventually, she learned to channel her cultivation into a glittery avatar of glass resembling one of the auspicious beasts. 

For a while, she was satisfied with that progress. It wasn't until her little insulated world was nearly shattered by a catastrophic event stopped by the gold-hearted that she finally dared to step away from her mundane existence to investigate the volcano. 

Fortune would have it that one decision would lead to her being taken into a realmstorm, displaced from her home, and joining the World-Helm.

As of recently, she has been officially adopted by the Emperor of Teisei. Officiating herself as Royalty.
Physical Description:
Hiya Salamin is a woman with much warmth that stands at 5'6. She holds a steady and kind air of hospitality. Her Hair cascades in three braids down her shoulders and her back. She wears robes fit for a princess, and is never not seen with her tiara. A symbol of status and pride of her parent. On her face, she has painted symbols to signify her new position as a Tangbawan Matriarch, as is tradition.

She wields a lantern embedded into a spear, it's welcoming glow also the source of her spritely Apoy, fiery creatures that assist her and represent her adventurous spirit.

Name: Holt McLeod
Identity: Rock star raging against the corpo-state
Known History:
Rumors in North Rock say Holt has returned from the grave.

The rock star is known as the former lead guitarist of Stray Hounds, which gained fame 6 years ago after their album “PRIME Suspects” lambasted every Prime Company in Terra. Their popularity rose again when they got canine augments to match their band name.

However, 2 years later they disappeared after a violent incident at a black market. Officials say it was a band break-up gone wrong, but conspiracy theories say otherwise.

Holt knows the truth. ||The augments were unstable and also stolen. A fixer, probably hired by a Prime Company, traced them to the black market vendor and lured the band into a trap, but they fought back. Holt saw his bandmates die and blacked out. When he woke up, the fixer and his goons were dead.||

He's been on the run ever since. But reports of a wolf-man with a guitar saving people from gangs and corpos still spread.

Holt is aiming for a comeback, and the Prime Companies ain’t gonna like it.
Physical Description:
A blue-haired offensive chanter, 32, with wolf-like augments, a flying-V steel guitar, tribal tats, and a signature pair of pointed sunglasses. Standing 6’5” with a muscular frame, Holt typically wears a black leather vest and distressed jeans. A torrent of sonic energy fueled by his vocals swirls and reverberates around him during a fight.

A silver-chained wallet with [a picture of his former band, Stray Hounds](https://i.imgur.com/xF0SuVj.jpeg), reminds him of what he's fighting for.

Name: Honeycomb Goldthread
Identity: A Fake Wanting to be Real
Known History:
Honeycomb Goldthread, or “Amor” to his family and trusted allies, began his life as a doll made in the image of a Duke’s sickly son, as a form of companionship. The doll was adored by the son, who had wished for the opportunity to see the world instead of being stuck in his bed. As time passed and the son got sicker, he gently whispered his wish to the doll, passing it on, before he passed away…

This wish would get fulfilled, as the doll became passed from hand to hand after the son’s death, being owned by a myriad of people across the realm of Kor’Tarion; From Songstresses to Chefs, from Professors to Students, the doll travelled the world, always seeming to come across someone in need of a companion, or just someone to talk to. 

In time, the doll found its way to the hands of the Fae “Risus” and their own child “Vita”, the former who wound the wishes and stories gifted to Honeycomb into a powerful spell made from threads of life, gifting him with his own consciousness and control…
Physical Description: Honeycomb has a short stature, only being 5’ 4” tall, but he is so much more than his simple- albeit unusual- doll form would make one assume; he is much more than just porcelain and ball joints. Honeycomb’s name is quite accurate to the way his body functions: He isn’t hollow inside, and is actually filled with honey and other sweet ingredients that all function like his blood and sustain his life force. When he cracks, he can repair himself with magic to seamlessly close the gaps, but if he doesn’t have access to that then he can simply repair himself like anyone would repair a china doll; He specifically practices the art of Kintsugi, which is using gold to repair cracks in porcelain as a way of remembering and growing stronger from the damage, showing your history, etc. In addition to this, he paints all over his body, which is mostly hidden by his clothes but he doesn’t mind showing off. Currently, he has stars on his arms and a crow emblazoned on his back, the head on his neck.

Name: Horizon Deneith
Known History:
She is a well known performer who indebt to 777LC after moving from Cabre to Dawnstar, before making her more permanent place of residence within Fortune.

She acts a face for her sponsor, demonstrating her intense durability within the Death games due to the augments they can offer. With use of the augments also put on a show during card games.
Physical Description:
Horizon is a simple woman with medium length purple hair, along with a set of horns atop her head.

She is seen always dressed in a fine black and gray attire. With black dress pants and a pair of polished shoes. At all times she also wears a set of black gloves which she commonly uses whenever she is performing during a game or as a conduit to cast spells.

Name: Hoshiko
Known History: Born a mundane white fox in the woodlands of Aldistir, Hoshiko had the misfortune of being set upon by Ald hunters; she escaped, grievously wounded, but was found by the grace of Kuzunoha and raised from her terrible injuries into the form of a yokai, led to the village that took her in.  Whether by accident or intent, she bore a natural talent with calling to the elements of the natural world, and a surprising vitality.
Physical Description: A petite 5'6" woman, slender and shy, with mid-length white hair, pale blue eyes, pale skin, and a pair of white fox ears and tail.  Quiet and soft of voice with an easy smile, natural things tend to bend towards her in her passage.  She carries a staff with trailing ribbons, as a hiking implement as well as in case of trouble.  She has some old scars on her left leg, though usually covered with robes.

Name: Howi "Atlas"
Identity: Tough Warrior with a Heart of Gold
Known History: To be discovered and learned(And Totally not made up on the spot)
Physical Description: Standing at 10'5  wearing what most would consider rags or basic leather armor eitched with runes and markers. Brown fur with spots of reds mostly around the head with a small puff of jet black hair at the top.

Name: Hua Ying
Known History:
All that Hua Ying can recall about her mother is that she was rather young when she was entrusted to her adoptive father after her mother's passing. He was strict but kind both as a father and an instructor in the art of cultivation, always striving diligently towards the peak that his ancestors had once reached.

With each passing year she and her father would grow more withdrawn from the village as his training grew in intensity and their perilous trips outside the village grew ever frequent. Something had changed about the kind man from her childhood but she was unsure when it had happened or to what extent. Only one of those questions would be answered when she was brought to the brink of death and left to die by the one she cherished most. 

She knows not why she was chosen by the Worldhelm but after years of wallowing in doubt and grief she decided that she would get her answers, no matter the cost.
Physical Description:
Hua Ying stands at a respectable 5'5" (horns and okobo included), paired with her slender and androgynous build people foolishly assume her to be younger than she actually is, much to her ire.  For the sake of her pride she goes to great lengths to combat these assumptions, painstakingly curating every aspect of her appearance and the way she is perceived by others, making a point to always carry herself in a dignified and sophisticated manner.   

In these efforts she takes special care of her hair horns and tail, despite the latter's constant betrayal of her emotions at inopportune situations. 

Unlike the clothes she favors her body is largely monochromatic with sparse accents of color at the ends of her tail, hair, horns and ears. Along with a striking golden eye that's left uncovered by her mane.

Name: Hue
Identity: Something Else Looking For Something New
Known History:
A fae born into a world of color, they learned to love the new and exciting. From the orange of the sunsets and blue of the seas. And what was one to do with what they loved but create something new from it? So they did as such, using themselves to pull color from and create their own masterpieces.

Now they are sure to share their works from making new faces to play amongst the mortals or to leaving smidges of their artwork behind, both literally and metaphorically. Who knows what will happen though, they simply follow their artistic flow.
Physical Description: A humanoid-looking 6'8 creature, their body itself has little to no color. Their hair though often times swirls with different hues and shades of color that they pull from for their art. The only thing that seems human being stray articles of clothing they have picked up over the years simply because "they looked nice."

Name: Huong Jin
Known History:
Ever since joining the Worldhelm, they haven't shared much of their previous experience, aside from the select few. With background in alchemy and engineering, they've become a core member and a founder of The Future's Anvil, along with Myffa Sirrokh and Enoch. They've also been seen alongside the proprietress and the head maid of The Golden Hearth when off-duty, hanging out in her maid cafe after working hours.

After the defeat of Halcyon, they've pledged allegiance to the Queen of Hearts, turning from an elfkin of Lhodos to a fully fledged Goldhearted faerie. Surprisingly enough, very little has changed about them.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'10" and weighing 145 lbs, Huong Jin boasts a slender but defined figure with feminine features, which they proudly boast through the crimson flak jacket, simple brown pants with a belt that stores their infusion ampules, and some leather boots made for kicking. They sport medium-length black hair, ruby red eyes and pointy ears.

Name: Huxley Rubarb
Known History:
Huxley will share with any who asks of a home in the Erdelward Forest, amongst a commune of his peers. Fellow Leirsin and others found peace foraging and communing amongst the woods they call home. Though, Huxley foresaw disaster to strike his commune, and left to pursue a way to “fix fate.”
He went on a pilgrimage, first to the stone of longevity then on to the front lines of the assault through the Runewall. Though he left it with a slightly marred soul, he finds relief amongst others with the Goldhearted. He still pursues a way to stop his home’s destruction.
Physical Description: While he resembles a human from afar, Huxley has a pair of rounded ears which blend into his dark hair slightly. Slightly freckled face with eyes of yellow, his gaze is hopeful to all he meets aboard and below. His clothes are roughly spun silks with a smoother overshirt/poncho to cover. His fingers end in sharp claws though they are trimmed for cleanliness and ease in holding his crooked staff. Hidden by a sleeve, his left arm holds a slight abnormality; around the wrist is a growth of geode like material a light yellow-ish blue. This being his gift from the stone of Longevity from what Huxley calls his home world.

Name: Hydrangea
Known History: Hydrangea was originally a simple spirit of a tree in the village of Dryholde. She enjoyed watching the lives of the citizen around her for many years. Until a portal opened up in the village, spilling forth demons that killed the town. Filled with sadness after watching this unfold, she used all her power to grow a humanoid body for themselves with the intent to avenge the town. However, just as she was about to start her mission, she was taken by a realm storm.
Physical Description: Normally seen in wooden armor, Hydrangea is a 5'8" collection of plants in the shape of an average human woman. Most of her leaves are a bright green in colour that get lighter in the face, with a large flower on her head that changes based on which magiseed she is using. She has short "hair" black eyes and a mouth with noticeable fangs. She is normally seen with a hopeful smile across her face.

Name: Héng Xià Xīn
Known History:
Once a proud metal cultivator with friends and sister
Swore to defend those weaker then him
Corrupt cultivators kidnapped sister and forced him to work in bloodmines to get her back. 
found out that it was all for not and tried to raid the corrupt cultivators. 
The cultivators, fueled by negative emotion tried to drain Heng of his, but instead took all of his emotions.
now, fueled by metal and logic, found that this could be a newfound way of life. Metal is strong and stern. 

Long live metal, May it forever protect the weak flesh.
Origin: Xuanwu city, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Physical Description: 6:3 not including the metalic horn on their head. They have covered there body in thick layers of armor and grafted metal onto there skin. They have metal scraps flying into and off of them as well as some magnetic jolts. The only piece of humanity that is easily seen is one eye that can be seen past the helmet. They also have two large fused slabs of metal magnetically floating near them or attached to their arms.

Name: Iara Amrade
Known History: A Refugee of Dryholde. She's been to worldhelm for a month or so and just got used to life there. She doesn't talk much about her past beyond that, but she'll be glad to treat any wound from any person.
Physical Description: Slim, Tall (1,85m), with a faint blue for hair color and silver for eye color. Thick eyebrows and a face that portrays a distant look.

Name: Icarus Vittore
Known History: Considered to be a failed experiment by a scientific collaboration between NTTech and DHK Heavy Industries, Icarus was cast out of the facility he was born in and left to die in the Terran wilderness, alone. His body was meant to be a perfect fusion of human and a currently unknown avian creature capable of powerful telekinetic abilities. However, such was not the case as Icarus only presented with fragile and hollow bones, and nothing more. His determination to survive proved to be his salvation as he grew stronger with age, and was able to turn his deficiencies into gifts. Quick and light on his feet, with a penchant for silence, Icarus found himself winning against all odds; and eventually his deadly skillset found him at the doorstep of the Vignettes. With a gun in his hand, Icarus proved to be a force to be reckoned with, and his kill count rose to obscene numbers.
Physical Description: Icarus is a very slender, young man with a permanent grimace towards the world. He moves with a graceful precision, and his fierce golden eyes convey a sense that he is always intently focusing on something about to happen. He has light skin, and even lighter, platinum blonde hair. When fully clothed in his traditional Terran streetwear, one would not be remiss to assume him to be a perfectly normal human being. However, when exposed, one can see transluscent feathers erupting from the skin on his forearms and calves. These are a mark of his experimentation, and he hides them at all costs, ashamed that they remind him of failure.

Name: Ilhuicatl
Identity: Daughter Holding Her Head Above Water

Name: Iman
Known History: Having joined the Adventurer's Guild less than a year ago, Iman's known history is sparse. She had some involvement with a group of Delvers in the Bazaar, but that business partnership abruptly ended after a failed expedition. As an adventurer she is known for positive thinking and the usage of archaic magic.
Physical Description:
As an Exo, Iman has an insectoid appearance with two sets of arms, long antennae and a chitinous exoskeleton. Her legs and forearms are somewhat spiky and her hands each have only three digits.

She stands at roughly 5'7" and is clothed is in loose, comfortable fabrics and a variety of jewelry. She carries a well-crafted dagger as well as a small buckler.

Name: Ineza Brightscale
Identity: Nezzim Merchant Delivering Potions, Poultices, and Freedom
Known History:
For as long as she can remember, Ineza has been learning the art of the deal from her mother. From haggling with sandsailors, to crafting potions and poultices, tonics and tinctures, to upsell, upsell, UPSELL! For years now, she's worked alongside her mother, learning and aiding in the family business.
It wasn't until she was 15 that she was clued into the family's OTHER trade: people. More specifically, utilizing a bevy of contacts and favors owed, alongside the cover of legitimate business dealings, her mother acts as part of a group that aids mages in escaping beyond the iron grip of imperial doctrine. While it undoubtedly came as a shock at first, she quickly strove to aid in what ways she could.
At present, Ineza primarily operates on the surface running the more mobile parts of the family business, along with discrete message exchanges with underground contacts, primarily in Windhaven. But soon, a different wind will wisk her away, far beyond the white sands of her home…
Physical Description: At a mere 4’7”, the oversized merchant backpack Ineza carries around with her only serves to help make her look even smaller. Sporting bright red scales and the piercing eyes of a saleswoman always ready to make a deal, her practiced grin is about equally likely to bring comfort as it is mild suspicion.

Name: Ioes
Known History: Born and raised in a small town in Terra his life was immediately ruined by his parents overbearing nature which caused him to resent and despise them with no access to any entertainment. One way or another he eventually found out about twinworld and was enamored with its style and mechanics. He decided one day that this was the life for him so he left home and decided to work for sword to both earn a living, get a T.E.M.P. License and save enough money to be able to play triworld. Casually walking the streets looking like a warrior Ioes is nothing more than a huge nerd for a game he’s really really into, so into in fact that even his cosplay is considered military grade.
Physical Description: A Terran with brown hair with a black and blue aesthetic wearing armor similar to what an android would look like. Often carrying around a railgun under his big cloak. His armor seems flexible to where even his helmet asks more as a mask with how it comes on and off with a simple press of a button.

Name: Iori Hirose
Known History:
Born into the Hirose Clan, Iori was destined for a life of silk and servitude, but her father defied tradition, to forge her into a warrior. In Sakai, even daughters bore steel, and she was no fragile flower. She was a rose with thorns, both beautiful and deadly. When the Oni came, the capital fell, the emperor was slain, and the samurai, refusing to kneel, waged one final battle. Beneath a rain-darkened sky, they were defeated. Ready to die, Iori was instead forced to flee by her father, carrying the shame of survival.  

Beneath the raging storm, she cursed the gods, demanding a reason for her survival. And one answered. Lightning struck, searing through her, leaving power thrumming in her veins. When she awoke, she was changed. Now she has vowed her blade to the Shogun. Never again would she bow to an emperor. Her sword would be sworn only to a cause worth dying for.
Physical Description: She stands at 5'8, carrying herself with unwavering pride, her stance firm and assured. Once a deep, natural black, her hair now bears a striking blonde hue. A permanent mark of her ordeal. She wears a modified yukata, tailored for combat, blending elegance with practicality.

Name: Iris Blue, The Bleeding Heart
Known History:
being mages in Kor'Torian, Iris's parents wanted a simple life, which caused them to make a deal with fae. They traded the ability to live normal lives "by taking away there magic" for the eternal service of there daughter. they traded with a smaller sect of the autumn court known as the vine puppets, a collection of plant like fae chaotic hivemind that are linked together by vines in there back.
Iris has spent a majority of her life as a slave to these fae, including hunting down more innocent people to become slaves to the court. She became a kor'tarion myth known as the "the bleeding heart" and hating it. She was bound by semisentiant vines rapped around her arms and neck. During her imprisonment, a band of Goldhearted seized the place in a search and rescue mission. in the confusion, she broke parts of the vines off of her and snuck onto there ship, which only did spit her out because it recognized her as someone who could be goldhearted, despite Iris not thinking she is one
Physical Description: Iris is a 6:3 thin rail of a woman with the look of failure that can be easily spotted under the bags under her eyes. She has long black curly hair that looks unkempt and is over one of her eyes. she is wearing black leathers with a hunters skirt over her legs and riding boots, both with old insignia scratched out.  around her wrists and her neck is a large thorned vine that moves on its own. the ones around the wrists curl up to the elbows and the ones around her neck dangle down like a danger scarf with a blue bleeding heart flower that hangs lie a tie in front of her

Name: Irius Barnes
Known History:
* Born and raised as a hands-on farmer yearning to expand opportunities; shortly finding them through a Temporary Limited Enforcement License, or otherwise known as a TEMP License.

* Went overseas to distant Sparrow occupied land to help with farming and any work requiring a TEMP License.

* Found his first time of TEMP License combat and his first kill during a bulk crop produce shipment on the road, leaving a deep impression of the state of Terra as a whole and what others try to do to survive.

* Irius barely manages to escape such aforementioned events after the delivery ended in a colossal failure. He will likely have a debt to pay because of it. On the plus side, his escape was possible from the local gang members after taking a last second turn around a corner and ending up in the Worldhelm.

* After such an escape; he had realized such problems had lengthy roots, so he sought to be able to one day uproot those problems with the precision of a farmer.
Physical Description: Irius stands as a 5'8" male, brown hair and green eyes ready to see their job through, even if trouble gets in the way. A body fit for a physically inclined farmer and by extension an adventurer with a  generally fair complexion despite his profession. He almost never leaves home without his weathered straw hat and industrial grade hoe he carries from his time in Terra, he typically wears lighter colors; most commonly his sand-colored overshirt, paired with typically a sky blue t-shirt or whatever color he decides to wear that day.

Name: Irobe Akinaga (色部 燦長)
Identity: Half of a Whole, Proving Herself
Known History: Akinaga and Nagazane were twins born to the Irobe Clan. Due to a blessing upon the clan, the two had a mystical connection to each other. During an attack on the clan's home by the Kujo Clan, their estate was burned, the two were seperated, and Nagazane died. Akinaga was taken in by the Koga Clan and trained to be a samurai. Before leaving to prove herself as a warrior, Akinaga returned to the smoldering ruins of her clan's former home. There she found an ember that followed her around, Nagazane's lingering spirit that longed to accompany her sister.
Physical Description:
Akinaga is a tomboyish young woman, standing at 5'5" with a well-trained build. She wears formal clothing befitting a member of a noble clan.

She's oft joined by Nagazane, a magical flame that accompanies Akinaga wherever she goes. Nagazane 'wears' a wide range of lanterns, though is usually seen in one decorated with cherry blossoms.

Name: Isadora das Ondas
Known History:
- Grew up in the port town of Maraluz, hearing tales of adventure and heroism.
- Mother was an adventurer who went missing in an offshore delve when she was young.
- Lost her arm at age 14 trying to fight a small sea monster.
- As soon as she was an adult she secured herself a place on an expedition, hoping to make a name for herself as a hero.
- Spent a few years doing nautical mercenary work and causing problems for the Imperial Navy.
- Eventually got in on an expedition to an offshore Elden ruin her mother was visiting before she went missing.
- Found no clues as to the fate of her mother, but bonded to a strange Eldentech device in the ruin that rooted into her body and replaced her missing arm.
- With the power of a magic transforming sword-gun-robot-arm, she joined the Adventurer's Guild in hopes of expanding her horizons.
Physical Description: A young, dark-skinned woman of athletic build, standing at around 5'6''. She wears loose and practical clothing, often in bright colours. Her left arm is missing, replaced by an Eldentech prosthetic arm made from a complex arrangement of brass-like metal plates. From between the plates emanates a gentle cyan glow.

Name: Isagani
Known History:
-Born in Tangbawan to the sister of a Matriarch, making her the Matriarch's niece.

-As a child, she was older and more skilled at cultivation than her cousin, the Matriarch's daughter. So, the Matriarch wants her out of the picture in order to secure succession.

-At 12, she is taken from her family and given to the Kabiya. She's old enough to understand why this is happening and is bitter about it.

-Lives among the Kabiya, learning how to survive the dangerous wilderness. Focuses on cultivation and self-reliance rather than trusting people.
Physical Description:
A muscular woman standing at 6' even. She has multiple piercings, tattoos, and scars, and its often indistinct which is which. 

She wears simple clothing, usually favoring styles that fit lightly or that leave her arms bare. She moves with an easygoing confidence, though it is harder to read her expressions on account of her yellow, catlike eyes.

Name: Iseult Medicus
Known History:
Despite the near extinction of his people, Iseult holds firmly to a promise they made made long ago: der Orden der Sieben Leben, or the Order of Seven Lives. His life is that of the healer, Medicus, and as such he is expected to heal, protect, and preserve the people of Vale and, as it seem, beyond. The Silvery Waters must have lead him here for some reason, after all. 

The work of a healer is never finished...
Physical Description: 5'9" | 140 lbs. | Silver-y Blue Eyes

Name: Ishaan & Ignacio Vol Sieve
Identity: The Dependable Griffin Knight-Courier(s) of the Woods
Known History:
- Earliest memory is surviving in the slums as a child.
- Rescued a poached griffin while stowing away in a merchant caravan.
- Raised by the Witch of the Jarwood alongside the griffin, Ignacio.
- Reintegrated into Tradefair under the Helping Hands guild, gaining renown as fearless couriers tackling extreme conditions.
- Earned heroic recognition for aiding Hafod (Midday Sun) and Doana Village (development & Night of the Red Sky defense).
- Knighted in Brightshield on ‘Knight’s Day’ during King Marcello’s coronation.
- Marked by battle scars from Sakura the Skald, slew the Sinner, and embraced the Vol Sieve family.
- During a battle for the fate of Kor'Tarion, as Ishaan rose back from defeat, Ignacio evolved into an angelic descendant aspect tied to Antikythera
Physical Description:
Ishaan is a tan-skinned man with red hair tied in a ponytail, standing at 177cm (5'10").  He has a bit of fuzz of a goatee.  He's adorn in a blue long coat with a sash around his waist, and beige pants with traveling boots.

Ignacio stands at 390cm (13') as a griffin of the twilight. His upper body is similar to an eagle with black, shimmering feathers while the hindside is that of a lion. Despite the black feathers, there is a hint of radiance from the griffin.

Name: Ishida, Yariko
Known History:
A young woman of Amagi. Like many from there, her story was long defined by the five year occupation of Oni. She worked hard. She struggled.

And then she had a front row seat to its liberation by emperor Dai Tenbin.

She has dedicated herself since to fighting wholesale in the Emperor's name. And doing so with an easing smile ever on her face.
Physical Description:
A tall, but not towering, woman, Yariko always seems to have some sort of grin on her face. She prefers simple clothing, a blue kimono tied with a plain white obi is more than enough. 

Despite her being from Teisei, Yariko is often smiling and even laughing. She brings a joy to combat that permeates in everything she else She does as well.

Name: Ishikawa Shishirō 「石川 獅子郎」
Known History: Born Jinzō, the son of a Nishibi merchant, Ishikawa Shishirō survived his family’s caravan being destroyed by ronin. Rescued by the Konoe Clan, he endured years of harsh training, rising from servant to Bushi. During a border battle, he lost his left eye shielding his commander, for his bravery and sacrifice he earned the name Shishirō, Lion Son. Soon after, a mysterious white cat which he later named Koma, appeared at an abandoned Hachiman shrine. After nursing them back to health, Koma would follow him on his travels to the confusion of many. Now the Lion of Konoe, he wields his blade and Hachiman’s favor in defense of his clan as war looms.
Physical Description: Ishikawa Shishirō is a tall, broad shouldered samurai with a hardened, practical appearance. His dark hair is worn long and tied back loosely, and a short, rugged beard frames his face. His one good eye is sharp and observant, while his left is covered by an iron eyepatch engraved with the lion crest of the Konoe Clan. He typically wears black and gold lamellar armor with a fur lined mantle, and carries himself with the steady posture of a veteran warrior of his station. A fluffy white and black cat named Koma is often seen nearby, usually looking far less impressed than its master.

Name: Isobel Ashwynd
Identity: The missing heir of the Ashwynd family turned experiment
Known History: Isobel, a wolf of the Ashwynd family, the heir to the legacy, or at least she was, she went missing. But now she's been claimed by the worldhelm, and has returned, but changed, monstrous. Can she fins a cure or a way to channel these abilities to be worthy of going home? Will she find a new family in the mean time?
Physical Description: Tall, and with a body that shows clear signs of a physical life, one spent fighting.  Those that knew her before would notice her slightly more angular features, and how her naturally tanned skin has grown ashy and pale from extended lack of sunlight.

Name: Isolde
Known History:
A child destined to be stillborn, Isolde's mother made a pact with a devil and fled Aztlan to escape execution.
Isolde was born alive but demonically marked. After years drifting, they settled in a frontier town willing to tolerate the cursed child.
As Isolde grew, strange powers awakened. When she tried to stop a fight involving her mother, she accidentally froze several townsfolk to death.
Exiled, they took a risk and sought refuge with Antikythera’s coven. Fortunately, the enigmatic witch chose to harbor Isolde and teach her to control her power.
Eleven years later, outlaws seeking a pardon attacked the coven. Isolde fought to defend the witches, but was gravely wounded.
A devil-touched gunslinger, Axel Reed, arrived to claim the bounty, but turned on the hunters to protect them at the last moment.
Both dying after the battle, Isolde entwined her soul with Axel’s to save their lives.
Now bound together, the two wander Deadstone until encountering a Realmstorm.
Origin: Deadstone Gulch // Hermandad de las Estrellas
Physical Description:
Isolde looks almost hauntingly ethereal, everything on her swirls into glacial shades of purple or blue. 
She is short with a full-figured body and ghostly, pale skin that almost sparkles. Her white hair cascades down her back like snow caps upon a mountain. Icy horns curl up from the top of her head, and she stands on similarly-hued cloven hooves. A thickly furred, long tail trails down from the base of her back. Her eyes are a brilliant icy blue.
She is visually based off of the white bison, and has leucism.

Name: Isolde Forvelkanta
Identity: A Name the Gilded Warden Kept
Known History:
A student of Gnosis Academy whose existence was once prone to fragmentation, leaving her forgotten by many despite her quiet acts of care. Over the past year, she has taken deliberate steps to stabilize her existence, successfully halting the fragmentation she once caused in others.

She aided in addressing the vampire threat in Kor’tarion and has spent extended time in Teisei, becoming familiar with its culture and earning the trust of its emperor. She is also a resident practitioner at the Serene Heart Medical Center, where she continues her work as a healer and as its secretary.

She actively supports her class’s efforts to save Kaiway and works closely with the Goldhearted, offering help wherever needed, whether through research, healing, logistics, or emotional support.
Physical Description: A young woman often seen with a warm smile and a relaxed posture. She has short, wavy platinum hair that has been seemingly dyed mint-green at the ends and bright green eyes. Her usual outfits consist of either her Warden uniform or simple and comfortable attire.

Name: Ixtab K'awixi
Known History:
Ixtab grew up in a big, loving, yet inherently racist family. Society in the Scalefire Empire was normalized for her, but she was more than happy to take her leave once an adult. Years dungeon delving and tomb raiding lead her to discover the ancient temple dedicated to the great Rajul-Kha, Son of the Sun Serpent.

Her delve was arduous, a once beautiful temple desecrated with kiir, fighting until she and her group reached the center where he was sealed. While Ixtab was reading the runes on the walls, her group greeded for his treasure with haste, Rajul-Kha awaking from his slumber, slaughtering all but her. The young serpent spared her life in exchange for being her vassal on this world, binding his soul into her right arm. 

Nowadays, Ixtab has grown into liking of her "partnership." Liberating slaves and stirring rebellion within the empire with a drop of a coin was hella FUN man! Her antics were about to catch up with her, but then a realmstorm sweeped over her to save the day! :D
Physical Description: 6'7" | 171 lbs | Red Eyes

Name: Izanami Shoshio
Known History:
Izanami Shoshio was born into a proud warrior clan in the Blood Grotto of Aldistir, a brutal land shaped by the constant battles of the Aesir. Her clan, like many others, fought daily for survival against the harsh environment and the twisted creatures corrupted by Godblood. From a young age, Izanami was trained to wield her family’s heirloom greatsword, learning the ways of battle.

Tragedy struck when a dark presence attacked her clan, leaving her unconscious during the battle. While she lay hidden by luck, the cursed Godblood rain fell upon the battlefield, reanimating her family, friends, and clanmates as mindless Draugr. Upon awakening, Izanami was forced to fight and kill the people she once loved, each cut of her sword corrupting the weapon further. By the end, the blade had transformed into the cursed "Soul Maw," a weapon that devours the souls of those it slays.

Now, as the last survivor of her clan, Izanami wanders Aldistir as the "Slayer of Horrors".
Physical Description: A woman with long, red hair and an athletic build, she is dressed in the traditional garments of her homeland. Her hazel eyes hold a sharp, determined gaze, and she wears sturdy battle gloves to wield the cursed blade, Soul Maw.

Name: Izumi Shiori
Known History:
* Appeared out of the forest when she was probably 4 years old.

* Her adoptive parents disappeared when she was young.

* It is known she spent some time in the forests around Hanae, and that when she returned from the forest she had displayed a great deal of talent as a swordswoman. She will now say that her Father taught her all that she needed to know at the time of the Sword.

* After a journey into the Zoumeng, Horoko discovered that she is only half human, and that her other half is that of a Living Dao of the Sword.

* Just eloped with Izumi Keiko :sunglasses:

* Defeated her sister without killing her, claiming mastery of the Dao of Swords.
Other Names:
Horoko (former given name)
Izumi (Surname)
Shiori (Chosen name)
Musashi Shiori (pre-marital name)
Physical Description:
Shiori isn't outwardly a terribly intimidating presence. She is calm and quiet, often seen smiling when not in the middle of a battle. She wears a simple blue kimono and hakama, and carries a rather nondescript katana at her left hip. She'd almost be easy to miss if not for the striking white hair and icey blue eyes that make even her smile just a little disconcerting. Still, she seems harmless enough, and her light, cheerful voice always speaks words of encouragement and cheer.

Shiori stands with a confident posture. If there is one thing that she is sure of... it is that she is one of the best Swordsmen of any land she stands on.

Name: J'yuto
Known History:
The son of one of the houses of the City of Scales, having been banished for fraternizing with a human house slave. 

He now works to bring salvation to Nezmira from those who would rob the masses at a chance of becoming better.
Physical Description: A Nezzim of blue and white scales, standing 6 foot even, light blue eyes and legs that end inf three clawed feet. A long tail accents their backside

Name: Jacomo Seidita
Known History:
- Hidela Academy drop out, and overall hooligan.
- Penchant for flirting and pranks
- Attempted a very high level ritual which failed
- Ripped from space and time; saved by Antikythera
- Currently fading from existence
Other Names:
The Jack of Hearts
The Devil
Jackie Six-Fingers
Physical Description: Jacomo is moderately tall at 6'0", but is exceedingly thin. In fact, his presence often goes unnoticed despite his statue; something that he often uses to his advantage. His hair is a raven shade of black, and his eyes are a dull crimson hue. He dresses in dark robes, which conceal the many surprises he has up his sleeve.

Name: Jaith Stolz
Identity: Struggler For the Common Man's Tomorrow
Known History:
- An ex-soldier of Markensburg, Wulforh, who voluntarily left to follow his sweetheart Clara to Wincomb, Silverdale.
- Reportedly killed three guards upon arriving in Wincomb, as they attempted to seize his property and dowry to Clara wholesale.
- Fled the scene, with public sources having no clue as to his current location. Goldhearted who know Jaith know that he was smuggled north to Stalmer, and joined the ranks of the Crownless at the Anarchy Stone.
- Jaith has vowed to overthrow governor Nefius Kaur, whose corruption leads to many poor and innocent peoples being fleeced of their life's savings in Wincomb.
- Jaith has also expressed sincere disdain for Wulforh's council, where he used to serve as a guard for the elections.  Merchants meddling with public affairs via vast sums of gold, to the detriment of all common folk, are what initially turned him to the path of Anarchy.
Physical Description: A rugged dark-haired man in his mid-twenties, often wearing loose-fitting attire suitable for fighting and wearing multiple bandoliers and belts with various tools and resources needed for travelling light. His well-built frame betrays his military background. Jaith always carries a Wulforh-make broadsword on his journeys, never letting it from his side. Often gruff and standoffish, though not meanspirited. Bears a locket and multiple charms which he defends fiercely and treasures dearly.

Name: James Braughton
Known History: Little is known about them since they seem pretty hesitant to tell anyone anything before they arrived at the Worldhelm. They don’t even seem comfortable talking about where they’re from, always avoiding the question or trying to find some form of diversion. Clearly they’re hiding something, whatever it is however it’s easy to tell it’s of shame rather than fear or malice.
Origin: The Realm of Aldistir, Camp Von Kibo
Physical Description: A somewhat fair skinned man standing at a tall 6’ 2” often seen wearing a full set of armor that covered every inch of their body. Their facial appearance is unknown as they never take their helmet off in public however they do often spend time relaxing in causal wear that excludes the rest of their armor. Any time their body leaves the armor it’s hard to tell how many battles they’ve been through due to the egregious amount of scars on them.

Name: Jane Martin
Identity: Cog Yearning to Break the Machine
Known History: Recognized as possessing Military-grade hardware in her cybernetic arms and a MILITARY TEMP license on her person. Clearly Insolvent to those who know of them/have met them. Former member of a small street gang, "Rat Pack," that was dissolved after a turf dispute. Shares her time serving in an ETA paramilitary squadron to clear her Insolvency debt, something she garnered to pay for the cybernetics in the first place. She also readily shares her hatred for ETA and the Insolvency system, which neatly converts into her new nature as a Goldhearted and other systems of oppression that exist in these new worlds she has discovered.
Physical Description: 6'3", 220 lbs., Lean physique supported by cybernetic enhancements to improve strength, long, wavy black hair, red eyes.

Name: Jane Winter
Identity: Schizophrenic Sniper with a Pet Rock
Known History: Jane Winter, known as "The Shadow" by those that they end up working on. While folks may not know their true identity, those in the city of Bastion with something to hide or enemies to fear fear the nickname. They say you’ll never know when they’ll strike. The person they have as their target is already down, or at least threatened, by the time you realise you are being watched. No one knows who this person is or anything about them, and most don’t want to know should you become their next target.
Physical Description:
Height - 5’7        Eyes - Lapis Blue 
Weight - 130lbs  Hair - Dark Grey

Name: Jiafei Lanying
Known History:
The only member of this generation of his family of guardians who had protected the Jijing Xiantiao for as long as they've been around. While normally they have many children, which all train to be powerful warriors, the hard times of the recent century have limited offspring. Only Jiafei has managed to survive to adulthood. Despite this, he fails to live up to his families warrior reputation, and has been cast aside by the common people as the end of his lineage. The Lanying family has lost it's prestige.

However, in the wake of their name's tarnish, the Jinshi of Bingchuan have risen to great heights. Alongside his peers, Guo Muchen and Lin Shen, the three have risen as immortal protectors of the village, replacing the role of the Lanying.
Other Names:
- Guardian of the Silent Heartbeat
- Successor to Li Jing
- Master of the Vanishing Guardian
Physical Description:
Jiafei is a just under six foot tall thinly built man. He has a mane of thick white hair that frames his face, and falls far down his back to nearly his knees. His two lion ears flick side to side passively at each noise or voice.

When he is focused, however, his body twists and changes. Mist pours off of his skin, as he grows nearly a foot taller, and his hair falls down well past his feet.

Name: Jing Táoshǒu 静 桃手
Known History: Jing is a traveler and Wood cultivator from Xiexie village within Wujing Guo. Raised by a spirit beast, Jing is a strange and eccentric individual, with a laid back, carefree personality, taking intense interest in the most mundane of things as if they were as important as his cultivation. Despite this, however, he is known within Xiexie as a kindhearted soul, who always aids his fellows in matters of foraging, fishing, and village defense.
Physical Description: Jing is a short, pale man with dark hair, a slender frame bordering on femenine, and a constant, calm expression on his face. He clothes himself with simple traveler's garb, common amongst the people of Xiexie village, and carries with him a large variety of other recreational tools. A fishing pole, a walking stick, a peach basket, a flute, a gardening trowel, and many other strange accessories are stored within the basket that serves as his traveling pack.

Name: Jiān shī
Identity: The Beast with a Human Heart
Known History: He was raised in the small secret fern village, and when he was born, he worked hard to survive and eventually develop a martial art with the village to fight back and become a cultivator so he could protect his village.
Origin: Tian Yi, Wujing Guo, Shouwang Senlin
Physical Description: 6"10, Tian Yi, Jiān shī is a tall, built man who has thick, coarse white fur on each of his lion-like limbs with long hair that reaches just past the middle of his back. He wears an assortment of hides from beasts he has hunted.

Name: Jodi Finch
Known History: Worked for T&C weapons development in Terra. Effectively gone rogue while still on the books, due to their esper breakthrough. Now on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description:
Jodi's curly short black hair frames a pale and unemotional countenance. She wears engineering overalls with Tubal & Cain's logo, has tools and spanners on her waistbelt and in her downtime often has a mug of coffee to hand.
She lives in a battered old helicopter, which doubles as her workshop.

Name: Jodie
Known History: Born to nothing and inheriting nothing, Jodie learned the hard way that anything gained in this life must be earned, and she earned it through theft! She'd often steal food, water, necessities and whatnot for the lowly and downtrodden of the city, and occasionally stole the nice piece of jewellery or nice clothes from an unsuspecting rich person. Anything to get by.
Physical Description: A tiny woman, she stands at 4'11 and has a very lithe, lean body that contorts well. There aren't any major blemishes in her skin, although she does carry a few scars beneath her cloak from close calls. She has bright orange hair and always has a stupid smirk on her face

Name: Johann Ackroyd
Known History: An ex-detective from the realm of Kor'Tarion with a strong sense of justice and an abhorrence for murder, he learned the hard way that with enough zenith even human life can be bought. Using his experience with crime, he takes up the sword during the night to commit  perfect robberies against people his daytime self cannot touch.
Physical Description: A lanky man with long red hair pulled into a short braid with a rapier and parry dagger sheathed over a long coat.

Name: Johanna Atherton Verstappen
Identity: Steadfast Lantern-Bearer of the Rebellious Angel
Known History:
Before the fall of Idyll, Verstappen was known for her gentle nature and healing touch, offering solace to both body and spirit. In the afterlife, she lived in peace among Hinno's snowy hills, guiding lost souls who drifted her way. But when corruption twisted her tranquil home into a frozen wasteland, Verstappen took up steel to protect those around her. Her courage and unwavering compassion caught the attention of Lilith, who offered her a choice: eternal rest in Nirve or the mantle of an angel to fight the encroaching horrors. She accepted, now dedicating herself to guarding the caravans venturing into corrupted lands.

Since arriving at the Worldhelm, however, her life has changed significantly. After months of trials and tribulations and the aid of many Goldhearted, she has regained a part of herself that she thought was gone: hope.
Physical Description: Verstappen is a tall woman with an imposing, almost oppressive presence. Despite that, she often wears a kind expression to those that don't draw her ire. Her long blonde hair is kept practical, usually tied in a high bun to not interfere with her duties. Despite the wear and tear on them both, her ornate plate armor and weapon are immaculately well maintained, serving both a practical purpose and faithful devotion to her lord. There are a striking pair of black wings on underneath her cape, though they are not majestic and regal in any way. They’re scarred and covered in burn marks, though she does not shy away from showing them.

Name: John Sawyer
Known History:
A hired gun who rarely stays in one town for long, lingering only long enough to resupply and claim his next bounty. Taking up all sorts of work (including demon hunting), his gruff appearance is offset by his light-hearted banter and jokes even in the midst of battle.

He used to work alongside his faithful hound and a woman who was presumed to be his lover, but any rumors about him would indicate that he has been travelling alone for quite some time.
Physical Description:
A rugged man with a confident demeanor and a relaxed smile, he stands at 6'2" with a fairly sturdy physique, though his fighting style relies mostly on the use of firearms.

His clothing and equipment are well-worn, bordering on disrepair, with the exception of his two guns (a rifle and a revolver) and a pair of glasses (which have no clear benefit to his vision) that are maintained almost religiously.

Name: Johnathan Southworth
Known History: Once the captain of Vale’s Royal Guard, Johnathan Southworth was captured during Merrane’s first offensive after staying behind to protect fleeing civilians. Presumed dead, he spent a decade imprisoned and forgotten, until Merrane reassigned him as protection detail for Lisa Aeingradt, a promising tech specialist and pilot. During a supply mission outside the city, they were attacked by the Prime Colossi Vanagandr. Gravely wounded shielding Lisa, Johnathan was saved only by the experimental Pandora serum, at her insistence. Though alive, he emerged changed—his body unstable, partially monstrous. Now, he serves quietly, a man half-lost to the past, carrying the burden of survival at a terrible cost.
Physical Description: A tall seasoned soldier. Has short, messy white hair. Dressed in tactical, rugged clothing: a dark, form-fitting outfit layered with a flowing cloak that’s torn and weathered at the edges. Has green shoulder armor, worn leather belts, and gloves. You can spot scars on his exposed arm and face, and his hand is gloved and ready, like he’s used to drawing weapons fast.

Name: Julia Moors
Identity: Thief that only took an apple
Known History:
Once a simple girl from Old Melin, Julia wandered into the Gwaed forest looking for food after her home fell under rough times. At once point she found a simple fruit and took it for herself to eat.

Now she pays the price of taking something without asking.
Physical Description: Appearing as a normal human should appear as, Julia stands at 5'7" and due to her cursed nature, has a set of horns upon her head and two serpents along her body.

Name: Juliane Florou
Identity: A doctor that helps other people stay on their feet.
Known History:
Not much of Juliane's early life is known, in part because of her own conscious effort to let the past stay buried.

But what is known is that she was born to none-too-wealthy parents that were only barely able to keep their heads above water in terms of finances, in part because of their own irresponsible spending, and part due to simple bad luck.

In her early 20s, she had managed to break into the Mercenary market by acquiring a Legitimate TEMP license, and spent almost half a decade working as an enforcer, frequently under the employ of the prime companies.

In more recent years though, she had buried her old name, and stopped taking Mercenary jobs, settling into a quieter life as a Doctor in a street clinic. She still keeps the license around, she can't convince herself to get rid of it.

Since coming to the Worldhelm, she's started answering the Calling, now motivated by desires beyond something so banal as money.
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'10", and weighing around 150 pounds, Juliane is fairly lean, but somewhat clumsy.

The clothes she wears are sturdy, meant to resist the wear and tear of travel, complete with a heavy coat and tall boots.

Her hair is a silvery blonde, and is kept long and braided, as she has emerald green eyes.

Name: Juna Azelhart
Identity:
An icy doctor with a caring nature.

"You're being far too reckless. 
Here. Take this medicine."
Known History:
* A medical practitioner & professor from Lumina Prime , Terra.

* Known for her distant nature , she took on an assistant so she may open herself up more.

* Mentoring the assistant, eventually they brought in their sister for treatment for an undiagnosed condition.

* Juna and her assistant committed themselves to her care, however one day her condition reached critical and she died.
