* Unbeknown to Juna , her assistant started dabbling in into unethical practice , desperate to find a cure for what took their sister away to save others from the same fate.

* The assistant was arrested eventually, however Juna feels she could've prevented the situation.

* Due to the encouragement of her fiancé Frederick & aided by her robotic drone dog Bertram, she's been showing her more caring side while on missions.
Physical Description:
“ I stand at 5’5 and weigh 72.8 kg. 

I was allowed some liberty in how I adorn the typical uniform for a practitioner of Lumina Prime, hence I've styled my look to my own needs."

Name: Kaigan Orun
Identity: A survivor bound to the skies, last of the steppe's sacred riders.
Known History:
Born among the wind-swept steppes of Leytik, Kaigan was one of the rare few chosen to ride a Khünchin: a sacred, large harpy spirit beast. His people taught that they once roamed freely, until the Heavenly War shattered the realm and forced them to settle. 

His people had kept to old traditions, however when Void Monks came, preaching annihilation and order, they branded the their riding traditions as heretical and slaughtered them to the last. Kaigan and his Khünchin survived only by chance, becoming the final echo of a culture erased. 

Though his mount is a creature of legend, Kaigan still keeps a small steppe eagle; a living link to the world that shaped him. Trained in the old ways of his people. Where the Khünchin embodies his bond to the heavens, the eagle represents the earth - the mortal, grounded half of his soul. 

Now, having become a goldhearted after flying through a storm, he carries his people’s memory in flight under the endless blue sky.
Physical Description: Kaigan is a weathered, broad-shouldered man in his late thirties, built with the lean, enduring strength of a lifelong rider. Sun-browned skin and wind-etched lines mark a life spent on open steppes, while keen, hawk-gold eyes track the world with a hunter’s precision. Beneath each eye runs a thin slash of red pigment - a tradition he keeps alive even as the rest of his settlement is gone. His dark hair, touched with early grey, is usually tied back beneath a fur-lined hat adorned with a few long feathers, relics of a rank once held among his people. Layered steppe leathers cling to a rider’s frame, patched and reinforced from years of use, and he moves with the grounded, balanced gait of someone who grew up in the saddle. Quiet, steady, and carved by loss, Kaigan carries a calm gravity - and when memory or purpose stirs him, the gold in his eyes flares like a spark caught by the wind.

Name: Kaiten-Shi
Known History:
Kaiten-Shi was born as the son to Dryholde's local apothecary and passing "witch's" fling. His name was given in the culture favoring his mother rather than local tradition. His mother gave him up to his father after needing to complete some manner of duty thrust upon in her homeland. He spent most of his youth engrossed in alchemical experimentation with his father: learning how to make antidotes and antitoxins from the local flora, shaving elemental crystal into smaller pieces to mix into powders and so forth. 
It wasn't until he turned 20 that he started wandering the lands of Kor'Tarion to strike out on his own. He spent a few years going from place to place: Eventually settling in Lastport peddling medicines and visiting Hudal Academy to listen to public lectures on new alchemical discoveries. He even had a small stint (2 years) working as a field medic to a mercenary group....until a surprise attack by criminal group wiped them out...
Now, the Worldhelm has called Kai to action..
Physical Description:
Height: 5ft 10 inches, 
Features: Of vague eastern descent, with dark hair and green eyes. 
Weight: weighs about 175lbs.

Name: Kana Hyderlan
Known History:
A human girl raised in the Azatar tribe of warriors, Kana was looked down on for her heritage, only elevated somewhat by her aptitude for magic. What made things worse was her defiance of the Azatar's principles of pursuing power at all costs and never displaying mercy.

During a raid on a village of rebels, Kana came face-to-face with one of the Azatar's targets - another human girl named Yuki, who had lost everything to the warrior tribe attacking her hometown. Kana did not kill her, instead vowing to protect her and help her recover. Even as her own tribe called her out on her "treachery" and exiled her at bladepoint, she never left Yuki's side.

In search of a safe haven, Kana has wandered onto the Worldhelm by herself.
Physical Description: A short, pale human girl standing at 5'7". Her horns are the result of her magic reacting volatilely to her brand, and her clothes cover the tattoos of her former tribe.

Name: Kaneko, Ichirō
Known History:
- First born to a small merchant family
- Was a fairly rowdy and mischievous child
- Once his first sister was born he seemed to calm down, growing more protective of her and his family
- While protecting his youngest sister, he was injured and lost most of the use of his left eye
Physical Description: While Ichirō is fairly tall, standing at 6'1, he doesn't have much muscle to go with it. He is usually seen carrying a parasol but is most recognizable due to the black and green eyepatch that covers his left eye.

Name: Kasagi Miyuu
Known History:
Miyuu grew up isolated, with only her mother; her father was never spoken of, beyond his species. Encounters with others were rare and short, with them almost always taking her for a monster. Most often an oni. Her mother was very protective, and taught her in cultivation, how to harness her natural affinity for demonic qi and techniques in healing arts and onmyōdo. She speaks wistfully of this.

Then oni found their home. Taking Miyuu to be a half white oni, they spared her life, taking her back to Ishiyama to make her a useful tool. To stay useful as they waited for her to develop soul-devouring powers, she honed her cultivation. Still, impatience mounted, and eventually she ran; a Realmstorm took her. She speaks of this in short bits.

She happily admits she is half-yokai, but denies being a half-oni.

||Her father was human. Her mother is yokai; a karakasa-obake. Disguised as an umbrella she stayed with Miyuu in Ishiyama. They both escaped, but were separated by the Realmstorm.||
Physical Description:
A very tall young lady, 6'6" (198cm). Thin and lanky build. Beanpole.

Long light-grey hair, wavy, put up in a ponytail with a large red bow, faded by age.

Pale skin. Has one small horn on the left side of her forehead, the same color as her skin.

Wears a simple paper mask dangling over her face,  covering where her eyes would be, with one large central green eye drawn on, among other designs. It is opaque, but she seems to be able to see just fine.

Wears simple kimonos with hakamas, with another large bow on the obi belt. Always carrying a red umbrella with her.

Name: Katya Yakhina
Known History:
Yekaterina Yakhina—Katya to her friends and most everyone too—is a Septid from Central. One of her moms had a history with NT-Tech working in the Old World but for some reason or other ended up in Central. Her other mother just saw *Gas Station, Shithole Desert* as a step up from a Septid slum.

Katya loved her dying little podunk and the others like it, and wanted to do what she could to spark some life back into it. Being Terran about this, she made a living with it: Going around, selling stuff she salvaged and brought from where it wasn't needed, doing odd jobs and most of all making things. Especially with plants and basic medicine.

Raised as a big believer in NTT, Katya still loves nature. Through some unburnt connections she even got a TEMP license from the company. Came in handy when she took in an exotic rattlesnake somebody had dumped for getting too big to be cute. (And too big for a rattlesnake in general.) They ended up inseparable. She named her Kelly.
Physical Description:
* 3'8" (112 cm) tall

* Orange eyes with distinctive 'bar' pupils

* Long, shaggy grey hair

* Pale greyish skin, getting progressively greener in her extremities

* Dresses in practical, worn clothing, fairly covered up; fit for the desert. Has a big, wide-brimmed hat. Looks *so* much like a witch.

Name: Kazuhiko Sojizaki
Known History:
Kazuhiko’s early life is mired in awful memories and poverty growing up an orphan in North Rock with no family besides his brother. To survive on the streets of North Rock, Kazuhiko became a con artist and thief, coming up with all manner of schemes and petty crimes to separate chumps from their cash. However it wasn’t until he met his partner-in-crime, his lightning snake… thing, Ryuga, whom he tamed that Kazuhiko started to grow bolder in his schemes since he had some protection.

Kazuhiko was slowly making decent money and gaining some local notoriety when he was approached by a member of the Goldnails for a “job.” Though normally wary, Kazuhiko ignored his instincts when he saw the amount of 0s in the cash payment. However this cash was never going to be paid.

The job turned out to be a set-up, framing Kazuhiko for crimes he didn’t commit that were getting too hot for the Goldnails. As a result, Kazuhiko would end up getting arrested and sentenced to life imprisonment.
Physical Description: Kazuhiko is a lanky human with some animalistic body modifications. With a purple scaled tail and and his sharp fangs, he looks like some cross between dragon and snake. He is seen almost exclusively in urban streetwear including an oversized coat to help obscure and enlarge his silhouette, only changing when he has to. Though his clothes appear normal, they are of somewhat higher quality than one would expect, revealing themselves to be made to last and resistant to damage. Despite his height coming at around 6', his posture often has him slouching, making him appear shorter and subsequently more approachable or easier to miss as a result. The natural eyeliner he has only helps add to the vibes he gives off of either being overly casual or sleazy. Lastly, often seen wrapped around his neck, one of limbs, or sticking out of a coat pocket is a slender, serpentine reptilian creature with wings matching him in color scheme.

Name: Keiji Saito
Known History:
Keiji S. grew up in North Rock, Haven’s roughest district, where survival often meant rebellion. As a teen, he joined a gang, lashing out at corporations he blamed for his community's struggles. His considerable strength made him a force to reckon with, but his world shattered when his mother was killed in gang violence. Devastated, Keiji abandoned the gang life, vowing to use his power for good instead of destruction.

Now in his late 20s, Keiji lives in North Rock, working to protect its streets from the chaos he once fueled. By day, he takes freelance jobs that require muscle and street smarts; by night, he’s a bouncer at Phobia, an entertainment bar in Silver Rock. While North Rock is gritty and dangerous, Silver Rock buzzes with life and diversity, offering Keiji a connection to Haven’s brighter side. Though haunted by his past, Keiji strives to make a difference, one act of strength and kindness at a time, in a city teetering between chaos and opportunity.
Physical Description:
Keiji S. stands at just over six feet, his muscular build hinting at years of grueling dock work and street brawls. His wild, fiery red hair frames a face that’s sharp and unmistakably human, albeit with some distinct fox-like features. Cybernetic implants enhance his cheekbones, lending a subtle metallic gleam under the neon lights of Haven. His ears are modified to a pointed, animal-like shape, and his mouth carries slight augmentations that give him a vulpine edge, with slightly sharper canines that enhance his intimidating aura when needed.

Despite his imposing presence, Keiji's freckled face and often goofy, unguarded expressions soften the effect. His usual attire consists of practical clothing: a sleeveless hoodie draped over a tank top that shows off his broad shoulders and toned arms, paired with rugged pants and combat boots. Keiji's style is as practical as it is distinctive, blending the rough-and-tumble resilience of North Rock with just a hint of Silver Rock’s flair.

Name: Keiko, Izumi
Known History:
Keiko's parents were killed by Oni when she was young, leaving her to care for herself and her younger sister Homura.  The pair were taken in by the leader of the village's dojo who taught them swordplay, both of them showing exceptional promise.  The two would occassionally brave the world outside the village, fighting monsters and retrieving resources.  One day Keiko returned to find Yamashita awash with blood, every single villager having been slain by Homura.  They fought, but were unable to kill each other, and Homura fled.  Keiko began to wander in search of her sister, with the goal of slaying her.

After falling in battle against Horoko's Halcyon doppleganger, she no longer has a heart that glows in Tian Yin.

Keiko managed to find her sister and with the help of the Goldhearted, managed to keep her from falling fully into corruption.  Choosing to save Homura instead of executing her, she's joined her on the Worldhelm as a Goldhearted.
Physical Description: Keiko is a tall woman wearing colorful clothes and a bright expression.  She carries a sword in a lavender sheath and moves with exceptional grace.  A small scar crosses her nose, and she has an almost permanent smile on her face.

Name: Keith Walker
Identity: Amnesiac, Cultivating Street Boxer Finding His Path
Known History:
- Life prior to abduction remain a mystery due to traces of his life wiped
- Keith was abducted as a candidate of the "Farseer Project", joint project between DHK and 100G to create Psycho Powered super-soldiers
- Escaped the lab and found life in North Rock under the care of Marcus Almasi and Maya Smith through the Rogue Reactor
- Gained notoriety as "The Stray", a Temp aimlessly wandering the streets and getting into brawls with various gangs throughout Haven, mostly North Rock
- Learned Cultivation under divine knowledge and as an unfortunate consequence of falling against a Corrupted Cultivator
- Eventually came to terms with the Demonic Qi which consumed all traces of the Psycho Power experimentation
Physical Description: Keith is a very tall dark brown-skinned man at 200cm (6'6") with his hair braided in cornrows. He is often with a black hooded jacket, a green undershirt, gold chained necklace, a pair of black slacks, and sneakers.

Name: Kelda
Known History:
(Because backstory is too long will just use the bullet points XP)

* Parents, both Ald and Yokai, killed while she was young so became an orphan.
* Left eye shows that portion of her Yokai heritage, but hides it after the ire of others causing her to run away.
* Taught how to fight and survive from a loner Yokai that help her survive.
* Part ways on good terms with the Yokai.
* Likes to collect weapons after hearing stories of the Aesir, Tubalcain.
* In no clan but does stay around places that have Ald and Yokai in peace.
* Caught in a realmstorm after battling monsters.
Physical Description: A 6'2" woman with sliver-ish hair and white skin. Under her armor is muscular/toned kind of body.

Name: Kelden
Known History:
Kelden was something of a prodigy in the small village of Dorlak of SE Pravaha Mandiva that secretly practiced the philosophy of "cycles" and kept snakes, while paying lip service and tithes to the Empty Monks. They believed that one merely needs to wait out their rule, and eventually they will be free.
Kelden, however, sought to leave to usher this dark age out. He was too valuable to let go, and was imprisoned. Soon he gained a cell-neighbour, a snake spirit beast captured by the village to coerce into teaching venom cultivation.
When Kelden saw one of these “coercions”, he grew enraged and with forming a bond with the spirit beast to gain access to some of its qi, managed to break both of them out. The newly named Norbu taught Kelden freely what Dorlak’s elders tried to force from it: venom cultivation, completing the bond. Eventually they took to wandering the mountains, helping people, only falling (quite literally) to a ravine where a Realmstorm rescued them.
Physical Description:
Kelden is a taller human with a lithe build, white hair with teal streaks in it, and inquisitive brown eyes. A single teal horn protrudes out from above his right ear.
He's dressed in loose Tian Yin clothing, and draped over his shoulders is a teal-coloured sake with two horns.

Name: Keldrin Embershield
Known History: Keldrin was a wandering adventurer who became an unlikely hero after his village was attacked by a monster. Despite his carefree drifter lifestyle, he bravely led the defense and saved survivors, catching the eye of noble knights. They inducted him into their order, and Keldrin reforged himself from an aimless wanderer into a protector knight of Kor'Tarion over years of valiant service. This earned him a summons onto the skyship Worldhelm to join other champions against greater threats.
Physical Description: Keldrin stands at three feet, five inches (3'5") and has spiky black hair and reddish highlights. He has striking teal eyes with the absence of a pupil. He wears a black combat tunic with a rerebrace on his right arm, paired with a pauldron that covers the shoulder.

Name: Kenji Midoriyama
Known History: As a mercenary, Kenji usually takes on jobs that usually falls within escort missions in Central, Terra. He initially worked as a construction worker in Vinland back then before shifting to a more dangerous job.
Physical Description: Brown haired, somewhat short with one bang covering his right eye. Has green eyes, has a slight toned skin color. About 5'10"/179 cm.

Name: Kerra
Known History:
She is one of the few experienced warriors that was left in her pack, forcing them to conduct smaller raids on thinly defended settlements, leading to a lack of resources. Out of desperation she was swayed by Volga's promise of prosperity, joining the ranks of their army. It wasn't long before she realized those words were simply an excuse for wanton destruction, yet she lacked the courage and means to defect. 

The failed siege on Lionheart's Reach changed that, banding together the other tribes had repelled what she thought to be an unstoppable force. A new path was revealed to her and she would choose to walk it, narrow and steep as it seemed, for the hope for a better future. She would follow Fein and join the Brave Asphodels.
Physical Description: For most other tribes Kerra strikes an imposing figure, towering over most others at 6'2". For her own kin however, she's rather lanky and could stand to build some muscle, despite this she's deceptively strong, a trait that's helped her survive this long.

Name: Khaal
Known History:
Born a half-Rakshasa, Khaal is the son of a Rakshasi woman and a father who relentlessly honed his mind and body. In the Tiger Lands, he walked the middle path between humanity and the bestial spirit. From his father, Khaal learned the importance of self-improvement, striving to be just a little better each day. His mother instilled in him a deep connection to the land and an unwavering courage. With these principles guiding him, Khaal faces the world, always ready to test his claws and be a steadfast ally and supporter.

With a number of adventures behind him and his power constantly growing, he's always prepared for the next battle.
Physical Description: Khaal stands tall at over 6 feet, with an athletic, muscular build. Tiger ears emerge from his head, complementing his slitted pupils, black stripes that run down his body, and lethal claws.

Name: Khasir Vol Seive
Known History:
Khasir was born into servitude, his own mother a house servant of the Alaoui family. Whereas some might be cruel enough to toss out a child who couldn't work... The master of the house, one Theoris Zeofar Alaoui, saw it as an investment. Care for the boy, keep him around, and bam, a few years later that boy is able to work, and incredibly in your debt.

Working for the Alaoui estate wasn't the worst thing. Hell, Khasir loved it. It was cushier than what work most humans could find in the City of Scales; he had a bed, good food, and even more, the family treated their servants rather well.

Through the years, Khasir bounced from job to job about the manor; cleaner boy to whatever else... But once he landed in the kitchen, it was set. That was his talent. Of course, when the old Head Chef fell ill, Khasir took their place in presiding over the meals of House Alaoui.

Under his care and exacting eye, every meal enjoyed by the house would be nothing less than perfect.

That is, until...
Physical Description:
An older man of 42, Khasir stands at about 5' 11" with a slim, yet fit, build. He keeps himself well groomed, with snipped hair and a trimmed beard. Lately, Khas has taken to experimental fashion of the realms he has ventured into.

However, once the need arises, he shifts. At the whim of a needle and a ritual scroll, Khasir grows larger, darker, with long purplish hair and a third eye upon his brow. Sometimes, being human isn't enough. And when those times come, there will be The Bullion.

Name: Kim
Known History:
-father is biology teacher and they tried to follow in his footsteps by becoming a scientist.

-went into debt and let themselves get killed by a random gang  on purpose to become an insolvent. 

-became an insolvent  to stop aging and be able to do research forever

-had an assistant called Elena and considered her as an intelectual and friend but they unfortunatly stopped being friends after kim made the reckless decision of becoming an insolvent without informing her.
Physical Description: Kim has short and messy black hair, gray skin and red eyes. they are often seen wearing a lab coat alongside a purple shirt and black pants. they stand at a height of 171 cm (or 5,6 if your american)

Name: Kimoto Kanae (木本 叶恵)
Age: Appears to be in her mid 20s
Known History:
* Spent years traversing Nishibi. She travelled from village to village, quietly intervening where the law fails the innocent and offering her steel to protect those who cannot protect themselves and learning under anyone willing to teach her.

* Eventually settled in Taira Clan lands after her arcane magic was accidentally discovered while saving a small child. Taken in by a Samurai loyal to the Daimyo as a student.

* Known to blend arcane magic and swordsmanship in a flashy and deadly display while engaged in combat.
Physical Description:
Kanae appears to be in her early 20s, with dark black hair that seems to shimmer with a deep purple in the light. Her attire is not quite traditional, but it is practical and kept meticulously clean. She is always barefoot with wraps around her ankle and arch of her foot.

178cm tall and slim, she carries herself as if she weighs nearly nothing, moving fluidly and gently like a ballerina. In combat this changes to a precise meticulous stance, only moving when need be.

Name: Kinmei
Known History: Born in Murata and regarded as a poor omen, she lived with her mother on the fringes until their hut was burnt down, scapegoating them for a late frost.  Maigo lived alone, stealing to survive and eavesdropping to learn, enlisting a washed up cultivator's help via stolen booze to learn how to cultivate her own qi.  She left the village after a misunderstanding made her accused of arson and drawing spirit beasts to attack, despite that she was trying to save the granary from the beasts, and fled into a realmstorm to be swept onto the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Lanky and slender at 5'11", Kinmei has mixed black and brunette hair, a bit like a tortoiseshell fur pattern, with feline ears perking out of it if not wearing a hood.  Slitted amber eyes habitually flick about.  She rarely wears any makeup, with a dusting of tan from outdoor life.  A tail matching her hair and ears flicks about behind her when she doesn't keep it covered.

Name: Kit Grannus
Identity: The Evaluator of the Mortal Era
Known History:
A victim of human experimentation,

The adopted son of a guilt-stricken scientist,

A vagrant slum doctor,

A Goldhearted,

A researcher at the Serene Heart, then its director,

The father of the Pilgrim,

One of the heroes to called upon face the Archangel Suriel,

And now the Evaluator of the Heaven's Pavilion.

Kit's journey has carried him far beyond the dark room which once gripped him with fear of abandonment. No longer afraid to achieve greater things, he turns his sights to the future of the Heaven's Sea.
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'9" with an average build, Kit has tanned skin and hair that is dyed blue. His right arm is a prosthetic, a replacement for the mutated limb that was amputated.

His arboreal characteristics allow him to grow bark and magical plants from his body.

Name: Kiva
Known History:
* Left the Fae Realm in search of knowledge. Attempted to join Hudal Academy multiple times, but was consistently turned away.

* After much wandering, eventually joined the Goldhearted Coalition as a researcher shortly after the Night of the Red Sky.

* During an expedition, fell into a Realmstorm while off alone investigating some strange magic she felt, ending up on The Worldhelm.
Physical Description: 5'2" Long messy pink hair. Floppy, yet pointy ears. Always carries a book.

Name: Klaus Silver
Known History:
"You might be wondering why I have a mobile workshop, and why it's trusty engine has been forgone for this stubborn bull of mine. Well, Back before Magictech I decided I was done with military squabbles and became a deserter to Karlsgard and smuggled my way into Merrane with a fake identity... That didn't last long. Was only a few years later Magitech and "Edict of Savior" happened."
*Long cigarette drag*
"So, I did what any reasonable person would do, I stole a steam engine that was about to be decommissioned,  and made a run for it getting caught up in a scuffle and riding into a realmstorm... To arrive somewhere? The rules were weird, As was the politeness. Now I have a vengeance spirit sharing my mind, and Orloh pulling my home."  
- Klaus Silver a very tired toymaker
Physical Description:
standing 5'3 and weighing 108lbs Klaus is a short wirey older man. 

He has long Bassett Hound ears that have faded and grayed over the years. 

A prosthetic silver hand he occasionally takes of to charge , a large umbrella, and yellow tinted glasses to have any gloomy day seem brighter and happier. 

He is often at his mobile toys store making oddities and cursing at Orloh his cart pulling "bull"
Theme: The Lazy Toymaker Host to a Spirit of Vengeance

Name: Klein
Known History:
-Was genetically designed to be a living conduit for ambient elemental energy as part of a program to produce more Geomancers to serve the Southern Colonies. Received Arcane Implants to further boost his capabilities at the age of ten.
-Grew up with a revolving door of tutors and caretakers.
-Became severely ill around the age of seventeen. A rare but known side-effect of Arcane Implants.
-Received Elemental Infusion to reduce the ambient noise of other elements. However, this left him physically weak and vulnerable particularly to Earth.
-Spent much of his time jacked into the Soul-Net and became quite adept at Cyber-Infiltration and Extraction (stealing data.)
Origin: Southern Colonies, The Old World, Terra
Physical Description: Short and slight, with a dancer's build. Blue eyes, medium length spiky light hair and pale skin.

Name: Klez
Known History:
Klez is a former "employee" of QiLink Cybersecurity, a discarded faulty product from their prior attempts to bolster the talents of their workers with Ai, possibly supplied by Lorel.Ai in the earlier days of the Link Network, when other companies were still scrambling to compete with it. 

Klez's mind has long been corrupted by the work, as eventually his Ai assistants became bugged, and they, along with the rogue virus programs and AI from QiLink's former opposition were burned into his mind. He's likely fighting for control of himself against them, even now.
Physical Description:
Klez is 6'2", but is often slightly hunched over at 5'11. He wears a tattered suit that seems to have been repaired on several prior occasions. The back of his head and their spine are obviously chromed, and the exposed hardware at the base of his skull seems to be fitted with several dangling wires, many of which seem to be plugs for various computer ports. 

They occasionally let off barely controlled crimson/black sparks, a telltale sign that this person has been cursed by the Soul Network of Terra. Their eyes glow with the same baleful colors, but this is only noticeable if you manage to make eye contact with him.

Name: Klyra
Known History:
During her childhood Klyra read a lot of old stories about heroes and villains. She started idolising both, though leaned heavily to the plights and moral arguments of the antagonists. Inspired by these tales and battles she trained for a time with her mother Akeer, a Sparrow diplomat, before having to flee from their territory because of her criminal activity. She visited her father Marna at End Time Acquisitions but was disturbed by their policies and left to seek out something else.
During her roving, she was joined by two sentient masks created by her parents to spy on her and or convince her to head back home; one violent and narcissistic named Morden, the other benevolent and diplomatic named Firie. They joined her and began coaching her while trying to impose their polarised ideologies, putting up with each other only so they could continue to care for her.
She was eventually caught up in a realmstorm and landed on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Klyra is usually completely obscured by a massive dark purple cloak that reaches the floor, containing a plethora of archaic technology from The Old World, and a mask that covers her face. In this outfit she appears around 190cm but in actuality she's a shortstack who wears stilts and the intimidating garb to try and look more villainous. She's always accompanied by a pair of floating masks similar to the one she wears, one blue, the other a dull magenta.

Name: Knox Tantolos
Identity: Warrior Chef Seeking Those in Need
Known History:
Born to two merchants in Lindstroffe, Knox didnt see his parents much as they were always traveling to Hallenrup to sell their wares, mainly food. This lead to Knox's uncle raising him as a child, trying to be the father Knox was lacking. Because of his parents culinary background this made Knox want to be a cook as well and began to teach himself about flavor pallets and different techniques to cook. However most of his time was taken up with training to be a soldier, as his Uncle believed he would get the best out of life from being a trained warrior. 

It is not known why he did it but eventually he left his home town behind and joined an expedition to the Runewall where he was thankfully saved by Worldhelm. He doesn't like to talk about that part of his history as whenever he does, his happy mood disappears and he becomes much more...upset looking, though he'd never admit he's actually upset.
Physical Description: Knox is a young man that is 6'1" (185 cm) and weighs 187 pounds (85 kg). He has white skin and dirty blonde medium length hair with an unshaved stubble. He wears large heavy armor with a white cloak for warmth.

Name: Kohaku Aiuchi
Identity: Hopeful Diplomat from an Old Bloodline
Known History: Kohaku has spent most of his life in Murata, maintaining careful diplomatic ties with the various Yokai in order to benefit the people of the village until the Goldhearted first returned to Teisei - with their help they repelled a group of Oni that would put Murata in ruin. Afterwards, with the encouragement of the Mayor of their village, would leave with the Goldhearted and now he aids where he can both on the ship and otherwise.
Physical Description: Kohaku is a slender man, standing at 5'9" typically wearing formal garments - strangely immaculate and obsessively clean exterior though suitable for his prior occupation.

Name: Koishi
Known History: An orphan originating from an oni-controlled town in Teisei, with half-oni heritage. After losing her mother at a young age, Koishi survived via begging and working in the mines. She has trained in cultivation to a degree, and claims that one day she will destroy the oni in Ishiyama.
Physical Description: Koishi is a girl in her late teens with two red horns protruding from her head, slightly covered by a huge mane of white hair. She stands tall at 6ft and lugs around a great waraxe by her side.

Name: Koishikawa "Kawa" Sasaki
Known History:
Koishikawa Sasaki is one of a pair of twins born to Sayumi Sasaki, a well respected member of 100G Security. While she had excelled well in her schooling, she chose to not pursue college in favor of taking care of the twin's younger sister, Minebea. She currently works as a freelance hacker.

[HPD file Codename: Crow]

[Possible affiliation with the Goldnails. Suspected of a few armed robberies in relation to Goldnail activity. Possible link to cybercriminal activity.]
Physical Description: Kawa is 4'11" with a thin frame and pale skin. With long, white hair that is typically stylized and well-kept. She is fairly expressive, wearing a smug smile in conversations with strangers. Typically wears a jacket, with a tank top underneath,  as well as pants, and boots. But likes to dress up often.

Name: Kori von Kleist
Identity: Regent who Lives for her Wielder
Known History:
To the Worldhelm, she is a mystery wrapped in an enigma.

But in Kaiway, she is part of the renowned von Kleist clan. A history of Paladins of Lillith was broken when she chose to join the House of Treasures. This scandal has created such distraction that Kori finds herself in the greatest horror: Remedial classes.
Physical Description:
Kori is a relatively tall woman at 5'6. The best word to describe her would be: Well put together. Her brown hair is immaculately kept, her glasses are always clean. If she is not wearing her school uniform (always pressed), she is wearing a lovely, regal green dress (always immaculate). The closest to 'unkempt' one could argue for her is her freckles, which she never bothers to cover up with her make up.

Kori never wields a weapon, and the reason why becomes very clear as soon as conflict begins: She becomes a long, heavy spear. The spear has an impressively keen edge, and seems to truly come to life when battling truly impressive foes.

Name: Krod
Known History: Krod is a Beast of the northern dune sea. The warrior long since decided to live free of Nezzim rule. Since to be human was to suffer their leadership, Krod decided to become a beast instead.  Krod lives in a cave hidden by the shifting sands of the dunes. He leaves this cave to wage battle against the Nezzim and those that would serve them. Krod is unsure what he is and why he has been gifted his shifting form though believes it to be a thing all can do should they simply decide to stop being lmited to being human. Krod does not attack things weaker than him, believing this to be below the rule of beasts, a complicated and vexing moral code that the caveman has developed. He lives to prove his blade and see the Empire brought to ruin. Kiir blood awakened mutations. Krod doesn't realize this
Physical Description: A muscular tan man dressed in scavenged armor. His body is riddled with scars notable a twisting strange one around his right arm.

Name: Krynn
Known History: Krynn left her family at a very young age, disliking the rigid nature of their tradition. She moves to Veyrhold and has spent the rest of her years living among with the humans in the city. with the looming threats such as the Black and the Forsaken, she joins the SIA under the DSE to protect the peace in the city she loved.
Physical Description: Blue haired and red eyes with fair complexion, with a long braid, average in height, wears an overcoat with belts of array of throwing knives.

Name: Kunzang
Known History:
For all his life, Kunzang has been a steward to his people. He grew up in a mostly-Yakshi populated village on the edge of the Tanggula Mountains, overlooking the Chamado Forest. Though a relatively peaceful existence, there was the occasional Spirit Beast attack either from the mountain or on groups of foragers sent out to gather what they could from the forest. Still, these were at most a weekly encounter that never really ended in significant bloodshed... until one night.

In the wake of one Spirit Beast's rampage, after fighting all night and into the morning against this beast, Kunzang swore to himself and his herd to always protect the innocents from any being seeking to do harm. Over the years, he's had practice against Spirit Beasts, raiders, and the occasional Empty Monk squad seeking to "pacify" the region.
Physical Description: Standing at a rather imposing 8'5" before factoring in his horns, and weighing in at roughly 650 lbs, Kunzang is an absolute fucking unit, even for his people. This massive specimen sports a two-tone fur pattern of white and red, large horns that turn black as they go on, and traditional clothing of the Holy Harmony's practitioners.

Name: Kurso Breckett Fleiss
Known History:
Those that know him closely, are familiar with the fact that he had gone to Korala academy as a student in Magitechnologies until he suddenly left out of nowhere, and as much as his close friends and even his sister in Korala try to reach out for him they were always out of reach for some reason.

However years passing he would arrive at Karlsgard and is recruited to the KPLA with a group of what seems like test subjects for an experiment called the Full Metal Militia Project where he exposed their secrets since he was a scientist that helped out in the experiments. From there he would join the KPLA and incidentally join in those chosen by the worldhelm.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'0 ft tall with Dirty blonde hair, wearing a white jacket and carrying a brown backpack, he carries a magitech railgun and also has a prosthetic arm due to him losing his original one on his operations to fight merrane.

Name: Kushala of the Blood Scarves
Identity: Shrewd Heir to the Fallen Khaganate
Known History:
Kushala was born and raised in the merciless wilds of Nezmira by the Blood Scarves tribe. Stories tell of a civilization of humans that supposedly reigned over the sand dunes millennia ago, led by a khagan recognized by all as the greatest leader throughout the plains. The tales end with the arrival of both Nezzim and Kiir and an internal power struggle in the khaganate, bringing an end to that glorious age of humanity.

Kushala was raised on such tall tales, and yet never believed in them personally. They saw these stories as naught more than fairy tales spoken to children to soothe their worries in a nigh-inhospitable world... at least, that's what they thought before they stumbled across an old woven scarf in an ancient ruin. The same crimson as the Blood Scarves' eponymous garb, Kushala swore they heard the words of the first khagan, imploring them to seek strength in the Realmstorm... now, Kushala seeks otherworldly strength and influence to bring peace to the sand dunes forever.
Physical Description: Kushala has a lean build, but their most immediately noticeable features are their sky-blue eyes, porcelain pale skin, and shoulder-length, snow-white hair, highly unusual in the endless sand dunes of Nezmira. Their appearance was seen as an omen from whatever gods that had long abandoned the tribe - that this child of light would lead them out of the darkness into a new, brighter future.

Name: Kviss Nergath
Age: At least 73 years old, but arguably 0
Known History:
Kviss used to be part of a little-known species that occupies more fantasy books than scholarly documents. They were discovered emerging from the wilderness north of Snowmaw quite recently. They spent a few weeks in the town but not of it, following eccentric but ultimately benevolent whims centered around helping the denizens of Snowmaw. Kviss' unnerving nature and strange altruism led the people of Snowmaw to refer to them as a helpful spirit. Kviss didn't linger for long; they threw themselves at the first realmstorm shortly after, saving a young child from being swept up from it in the process.

Since then, Kviss has been relatively reclusive, showing up for missions but scarcely involving themselves beyond that unless called for. As of 7/25/2024, they have somehow become biologically human. Then on 4/20/2025, after messing with fate in ways mortals shouldn't during the siege on Utopia, she was reborn a Nephilim. Now, she's far more extroverted & dedicated to her ideal of heroism.
Physical Description: A 5'10" woman with antlers (6'2" with antlers included). She has purple eyes, and hair that's green on one side and black on the other. Her skin is brown. Her attire is a weird mix of Kor'Tarion and Lhodos, wearing a wide poncho with several completely unnecessary belts. For those well acquainted with Dhata, they seem like they could be cousins, aside from all the clearly inhuman influences.

Name: Kxaxukluth
Identity: Terrible Monster with a Good Heart
Known History: Kxaxukluth was wrought to life by strange means in the dungeons beneath the ruined Caer Moryd. The magicians who created him sought to harness the natural world for a living weapon in the form of a monster, and he prowled the surrounding area for many nights under their beck and call. When they completed Kxaxukluth by making him intelligent, he realized quickly he did not want to be this. He freed himself.
Physical Description: This lean humanoid usually resembles a bipedal cat, just over 5'6". The resemblance is superficial. The line that runs across their back is not coloration; it is a long row of teeth and fangs which open to a terrible tendril-filled maw that spans its entire body. To be polite and prevent panic, Kxax covers this unnatural form with nice ponchos, though he more often lets his head free now.

Name: Ky Kusho
Known History:
A sinister looking cultivator roaming and offering guidance, healing and protection on his path.

Tends to glare and or smirk and nothing in particular sometimes.
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'11

He has a refined yet sinister appearance, he has long dark hair with and usually has a constant smirk or seems to glare at something or someone. 

An eye patch covers his right eye, and the left red eye often glints with a  supernatural glow especially when using his magic. 

He exudes a cold confident energy surrounded by a faint dark aura, on his neck a tattoo of a snake biting a dagger atop of some flowers

Name: Kylean Z'kirio El'dialso V
Identity: Eccentric Fae In Search of A Real Hero
Known History:
- From the Faerie Realm in Kor'Tarion
- Has two hand puppets with him at all times, the Bird named Marintide and the Fox named Selicine
- Assists travelers in Kor'Tarion, generally friendly if a bit sporadic and unfocused
Physical Description: A 6 ft tall fox like creature, with one half of his fur being white and the sleeves of fur on his right arm having green colors with his left arm having purple, the bottom half being black fur and the only coloring near the knees with 2 green stripes on both sides of 1 large purple stripe. He has many eyes, 7 eyes total all of them different colors as they constantly swap between colors.

Name: Köll Akihiko Vol
Known History:
There once was a Miko named Akihiko, a shrine priest of no renown, dedicated to the service of Lorelei and Kuzunoha. This boy, a yokai, had a dear friend, Köll. 

Akihiko loved his subjects, in his shrine in the Sea of Blizzards. He would do anything to protect them, sacrifice anything. His resolve was tested when Köll was infected with Godblood, and so Akihiko undertook a journey to find a cure.

But that journey ended in tragedy, for Godblood is not to be trifled with. Akihiko lost his memories, his identity, and his family.

Now, taking the name of his lost friend, Köll wanders the tundra of the Blood Grotto, protecting Yokai and Ald alike from the dangers that hide beneath the ice.
Physical Description:
A short and meek boy, Köll wanders the tundra of Aldistir in search of people to help and warmth.

Altough he is a Yokai, his only bestial trait are his sharp claws and teeth. He wears a fur mantle to keep the cold away, and under that he dresses as a shrine priest. His eyes are two cold blue rings within darkness.

Name: Ladora Cascella
Known History:
Ladora grew up in the countryside of Delsatz, surrounded by folksongs and humble traditions. Entrusted with *The Chord of Resonance*, a living grimoire of her bloodline’s songs and stories, she devoted herself to preserving their memories. 

As the Calamity grows, Ladora has inherited the duty of carrying her people’s songs beyond the Runewall, using their stories to guide others through the trials ahead. Her voice now carries the memories of the past, breathing life into forgotten melodies while creating new songs to inspire hope for the future.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'6", Ladora's presence is marked by long sapphire curls that cascade and ripple over her figure, adorned with golden beads that glint softly when she moves. Even in simple clothes, she accents herself with carefully chosen jewelry. She typically carries an iridescent grimoire close at hand, cradling it like a cherished companion, and seems attuned to the melodies and stories woven into the land around her everywhere she goes.

Name: Lady Kezhari
Known History: Lady Kezhari was once a proud noble lady in Skamos, but never one with an incredible standing. She is a practiced spiritist, but also studied law in order to change the Nezzim empire for the better as she detested how humans could be abused so freely. As such, she frequently petitioned for laws against such poor treatment of the Empire's slaves, however she still held onto notions of Nezzim superiority over humans. In order to silence her, those in power fabricated a scandal which left her in utter disgrace, though she refuses to speak on the specifics. Her career was destroyed overnight, and she was treated as the laughingstock of Skamos. Khezari couldn't go anywhere without being recognized, and so she fell into a deep depression as all hopes she had of changing the empire were washed away. In her misery she freed all of her slaves and then ventured out of Skamos alone, waiting to die at the hands of the Kiir, only to find a realmstorm instead.
Physical Description: A tall, lizardlike humanoid standing at 6'2". Kezhari's purple scales are smooth to the touch, and she has floppy ears with a doglike muzzle to boot. She typically wears a long, flowing robe and hats of questionable fashion sense.

Name: Laeli
Identity: Broken Soul With A Yearning Heart
Known History:
- Laeli grew up a slave in the Black Wolf Warband, along with her younger brother Ikko. Having grown up around suffering, the sight of another's pain never failed to wound her--so she offered her strength to those who couldn't bear their burdens. She knew how little it mattered--but if she could do anything to make their lives better, she did. 

- The chance came to help in an escape, and the two siblings stayed behind to distract. They fled last, but the results were disastrous: Ikko perished, and Laeli was dragged back. The death of her brother destroyed her spirit--even after lashings, she wouldn't work--so she was sold to the now-Blood Wolves for sacrifice.

- Later in the year, the day came. Still gripped by soul-crushing anguish, Laeli bargained herself in place of three children. She could endure far more before passing, and her suffering would appease the Great Wolf. They listened. Just moments before she succumbed to their terrible work, a realmstorm snatched her from the end.
Physical Description:
A towering, 6'5" hare yokai with white fur and rough scars. Powerfully built, uses both plate mail and a heavy waraxe in battle. She has an eyepatch on her left eye, which partially covers a brand-mark on the left side of her face. The mark resembles the visage of a snarling wolf. 

Laeli's strength and height hardly match her demeanor. She's pensive, thoughtful, and exudes a gentleness that shouldn't belong on someone as scarred as she is. If her appearance indicates anything, though, it is that the young yokai has endured a great deal.

Name: Lanelle Silver
Identity: Thief learning to become Giant Guardian
Known History:
Lanelle is known to be from Eurys, and if anyone asks, she says that she is from Rocade and doesn't like to speak of it much. She came to reside in Delsatz after an encounter with a rampaging mad nature spirit left her on the brink of death, and only the lucky intervention of  a band travelers saved her.

She spent most of her life in Delsatz "doing odd jobs" which is a transparent euphemism for doing some kind of criminal activity. After "acquiring" the towering stone construct she pilots she was chased across Eurys before fleeing into the Runewall and ending up aboard the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: 5'10 panther woman with tan skin and dark fur. Two ears perch atop her head and a long tail swishes behind her.

Name: Laura Schlächter
Known History:
• Her father was a wandering cowboy jumping from town to town, and her mother was a Warlock of the Qilin Coven. They met when Laura's father wandered into the coven town where her mother resided, and his interest in the mysteries of magic sparked a connection, and eventually they got married.
• Being a Warlock, Laura's mother naturally spent a lot of her time studying demons and demonic phenomena, and even wrote a fiction novel based on her findings. Due to the limited functionality of the printing facilities, not too many got fully published, but the most important one she gave to Laura to keep.
• During a summoning gone wrong, Laura's father was taken, and she lost an arm trying to save him. Her mother was also injured in the conflict by the devil's gun, but Laura wrestled it away soon after and before her arm was severed, which left her near death. However, as they were over a leyline, Laura's mother used that and a magic lightning bolt to revive her, and grant her a second chance.
Physical Description:
Laura stands at a tall 6’ 7”, with a lean but athletic build; abs but not bulky. She has tan skin, olive eyes, and long, strawberry blonde hair that’s tied into a single french braid that runs down to her back. She only has one natural arm, with the other one- her left arm specifically- being ghostly, monstrous, and spectral in nature.

Being the perfect distillation of both a cowgirl and a witch, her style is a combination between the two: From top to bottom, she wears a long-brimmed witches hat, and two golden rings as earrings hanging from both earlobes. She wears a cropped short-sleeve shirt that shows off her belly, a short poncho around her shoulders that stops at her elbow on one side and shoulder on the other, and a fingerless glove on her normal arm alongside a chain bracelet that connects to a golden ring on each finger. She wears an open skirt below all that, with long boots with heels that go over her pants.

Name: Lei-Lei
Known History: Lei-Lei is the twin sister of Mei-Mei. He grew up with her under a cool old man he calls "Gong-Gong." He taught him how to fish and how to fight, and when he introduced Lei-Lei to fireworks, the Vanara's absurd interest and affinity for the things made itself known. He searches for yet more beauty to inspire his displays and more people to show them to, and to do so (but also cause he was bored) he leaves to go on an adventure with his sister. After making one funny chaos formation, they end up in some trouble.
Physical Description: Lei-Lei is a 5'8" Vanara boy with a thin build and a lithe frame. Even though he works with dangerous, explosive alchemy, he's always well-kept and dressed in blacks and reds that compliment his own colors.

Name: Leilani
Known History:
There are rumors going around the streets. At night, make sure to keep you doors locked and your gates guarded. Unless you want to wake up with your valuables whisked away, as if they were never there. The Cat Burglar strikes at both big businesses and the mansions of wealthy individuals. She comes in and out without a sound, taking various precious trinkets with her.

But this got nothing to do with Leilani (obviously). The demi-human is a mercenary of little note. She is most often seen taking jobs that involves escorting refugees and protecting vulnerable areas of the city. And playing with the children at the orphanage too.
Physical Description: Standing at a glorious 5'6, with her head covered with short silver hair and a large pair of ears. Her golden eyes rarely stand still, always looking around.  Over her feline tail is her bag tied to her waist that she carries around at all times.

Name: Leobald Mountainspine
Identity: Devout Paladin of the Old Faith
Known History: Follower of an old faith, previously worked as a guard.
Physical Description: Dark hair and blue eyes, a tall athletic build adorned in armor and a cloak. Leobald carries a shield and axe, both engraved with the symbol of his fellow paladins.

Name: Leolis Sciena
Known History:
- Always been intensely curious, seeking out knowledge in any way he could.
- His heavenly blessing made it so that he processed what he learned quickly, and could remember it nearly perfectly.
- He read every book he could get his hands on again and again, combing over them all in an attempt to extract any knowledge to be found.
- Being stuck in his village, his access to knowledge was rather restricted, so he has felt like a plant starved of water his whole life.
- When the mist disappeared from Jijing, he took the opportunity to seek knowledge from other villages, and hopefully find the reason for the qi oddities he has felt since the mist vanished. One day while traveling he was caught in a Realmstorm and then woke up on the Worldhelm.
- As a Bishi'e, he started cultivating early and instinctively, finding an affinity for steam qi. He cultivates less then others, instead devoting his time to the pursuit of knowledge (and in turn gaining a shallow understanding of a myriad of Daos).
Origin: Zhēngqì Village, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Physical Description:
- He mostly looks like a normal human, except for the two antlered horns, one blue and one red, which stick out from this head, and the scaled-to-furred tail he has.
- He is 5' 10" and 180 lbs.
- He always seems spirited, as he is constantly filled with curious energy, examining anything he can. Sometimes, he even has difficulty staying still and calm enough to cultivate.
- When he is particularly excited or happy, his tail slowly swishes from side to side.

Name: Leopold Vogel Reinbold
Known History:
Leopold was born with too much power. Anytime the child would cry he would send waves of power throughout the air, so he learned to be silent. Leopold began to listen instead of speak, and recorded the stories his mother (an adventurer) brought home. 

On his 18th birthday Leopold was gifted the Golden Tethers, a magical set of bracers that would restrain the magic inside of him. He could speak, and turned these stories into his tales he would regale to others. Each person was special and Leopold was determined to leave no person silenced.

Leopold spent ten years traveling around Delsatz with heroes, writing of the people and their achievements. This lasted for ten years until he met Josef Hrodwulf. He was a soldier looking for magic, and so Leopold joined him to Silverdale. 

After Silverdale came the Runewall. A gathering of heroes ready to die.. their stories needed to be remembered. He left with Josef and found another adventurer, Celestyn to be attached to, before seeing the wall
Physical Description: A tall man at 6'2, Leopold has dark skin and long hair. It is usually tied up in a big ponytail to contrast his light colored outfits. Leopold sports a number of accessories: piercings, necklaces, rings, and golden ribbons tied on his forearms (heirloom). Leopold sports kind eyes and a small smile; he prefers vocal expression rather then facial expressions.

Name: Leslie Shay
Known History: The Shay's were once a well known name in the smuggling business, at least until the law caught up with them and put most of the family behind bars. Now all that remains of the once proud family is their eldest son who - after a fateful encounter with a drifter in the desert - travels around taking on all manner of odd jobs.
Physical Description: A male standing at 5'7 with dark brown hair and similarly colored eyes. He is often seen wearing a dusty poncho, wide brimmed hat, and dark sunglasses. Has the kind of smile that makes you clutch your purse or reach for your gun.

Name: Levan
Known History:
Two brothers were born to a Hiear merchant family in Windhaven—twins, always together, always in step. They spent their early years traveling with their family caravan, learning the trade and following the quiet traditions of their people.

On their 17th name day, tragedy struck. Their caravan was attacked. Only Levan returned.

He changed after that. Quieter. Distant. Some say he turned to old, forgotten rites out of grief. Whatever happened, he began traveling alone—though many claimed he still spoke as if someone else was there.

Years later, after a strange flash in the sky, Levan was seen again—no longer alone and now a Goldhearted upon the Worldhelm. Though he doesn't quiet know that yet.
Physical Description:
Levan is lithe, sun-kissed and slightly shorter than his brother, standing at 6'0" (6'10" with his ears upright). His hair and fur are the same striking white, though his features are softer—his face framed by long bangs and a calm, almost wistful expression. His eyes are a warm amber-gold, more curious than piercing, with a faint melancholy lingering beneath them. Unlike his brother, Levan’s presence is quiet and subtle, with a grace that borders on delicate.

He wears light, travel-worn garb—white layered cloth and fitted leather armor, practical and modest, with subtle patterns hinting at Windhaven craftsmanship. A choker sits snugly on his neck, etched with the symbol of his family’s patron.

Name: Levius C. Kennedy
Known History:
- Born in the slums of North Rock
- Was a delinquent, reformed by boxing
- Close ties to Keith Walker (boxing mentor)
- Wants to be a hero like his idol
- Wants to do Mama proud
Physical Description: Levius stands at a modest 6'2" and currently sports a short crop of spiky black hair. Recognized by his impressive athletic build, he draws no questions to the moniker he has earned -- "Underground Champion". Curiously, his eyes seem to change in the heat of the moment, going from dull almost lifeless pools of black to living embers of gold. His dress style leans on the edge of guady, a leftover relic of his delinquent days, as Levius is often seen barechested in bright orange, fur-lined coats and training shoes. And in his troubled youth, as an act of rebellion, Levius acquired two magical augmentations: a devil's tail and horns. He's kept this hidden from his mother for years, as he can adjust when they appear, but those in the slums of North Rock know his motto well -- "The Devil's Luck".

Name: Li Dan-Dan
Known History: Li Dan-Dan, an orphan raised by Master Ghanzi in the secluded Peach Blossom Sect, grew up mastering Earth Qi and the ancient Blossoming Blade technique. Known for her sword dancing, tricks, and pranks, she brought joy to those around her despite her playful nature. However, her recklessness in fighting injustice led to the accidental revelation of her identity as a Goldhearted, forcing her to be constantly on the run from villains. Despite this, she continues to protect others and pursue justice wherever she goes.
Physical Description: A lavender swordswoman who leaves trails of vibrant peach blossoms in her path. Tall and slender woman with jet black hair tied in a high-top ponytail, eyes the color of violets, wears a slim battle tunic and pants, carries a Jian sword in the scabbard by hand. Height 5' 8".

Name: Liberation
Known History:
* Born in Charizs, to a set of parents possessed of great wanderlust.
* Because of this, she was often on the road for a long time.
* Once, on the road, her family was beset upon by bandits. All seemed lost, and the threat of being sold into slavery was present... until the Freedom Beacon suddenly appeared. 
* After being saved by the Freedom Heir, the girl was obsessed. It was also during this time that she began noticing the tell tale crystals growing around her neck.
* When she was 18, she traveled to the Freedom Stone. It was there that she came to realize that she is, indeed, an Heir of Freedom.
* Eager and excited, she immediately ran off, trying to emulate the Beacon of Freedom in freeing those bonded with... mixed results.
* Realizing she needed allies, she made the only logical choice she could make. Going through the Rune Wall.
Physical Description: Possessed of dark olive skin, the middle height Heir of Freedom is possessed of a free, cheerful demeanor. It is almost impossible to imagine the young woman *not* smiling at any given time, in fact. She prefers loose clothing and shiny jewelry, and her brown eyes almost seem to glow. For now, the crystals that indicate her as an heir are hidden underneath her choker. But really only because she likes the choker.

Name: Lilac Brightshield
Identity: Unlucky and Exiled Princess turned Clothier
Known History:
Lilac is a clothier, a craftsman of garments. She hails from the City of Brightshield, in Kor'Tarion, and once upon a time, her name meant something. Those days of nobility are over for her though, exiled by her family and the City. Those who reside there may have heard of this incident, transpiring some couple years before Lilac arrived at the Worldhelm today, but the cause of her exile remains unknown. 

Nowadays, she roams the land, practicing her craft and honing her talents. Her privileged upbringing allowed for a variety of lessons and tutors, and in this time, she became a skilled dancer. With this, she now takes her ballroom dancing and royal etiquette to the battlefield.
Physical Description:
Standing at around 5'10" and wielding an oversized pair of scissors, Lilac appears intimidating, to say the least, despite her elegant dress sense and slender frame. She has long, white hair, purple eyes befitting of her name, and carries herself with poise and precision.

The strange scissors she carries everywhere is made of a pristine silver, inlaid with gems of varying purple shades.

Name: Liliwen Bremblebery
Known History:
Liliwen hails from an old Honeydew farming family. But between the founding of Tradefair and her father's fateful run-in with a fae, they're just one more landless poor family in that great city. Liliwen was always a rambunctious child, enjoying physicality and playfully throwing her surprising strength around.

As an adult she went into mercenary work, making something of a name for herself despite her obvious peculiarity. Not nearly enough to buy land and restore her family to the status they should have, but plenty to pay for their food and rent.

After a job went wrong, Liliwen encountered a Realmstorm and ended up on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: At 4'10" with massive furry brown ears and a pink tail, Liliwen looks mousy in more ways than one. Despite her stature, she is strong and built with the muscles to show it. Not that they're often visible, with the bronze plate she wears over deep green padding. Her hair is long and pale blonde, falling quite far down her back when not tied up neatly to fit in her helmet. Her eyes are ruby red, and when she opens her mouth one can notice slightly pronounced buck teeth.

Name: Lillian Vox
Known History:
Arianwyn Wood, born and (mostly) raised in Brightshield, rejected the town's gloom and reinvented herself as Lillian Vox, a traveling entertainer. While many believe she's a true mage, she insists she's just a street magician: “Real magic? I’m not that blessed.”
Others whisper she’s faetouched, mistaking whimsy for otherworldly ties. Driven to spread wonder, she roamed from town to city, going wherever joy was needed. One day, she stumbled upon a realmskipper and, trusting in luck, stowed away. Arriving at the Worldhelm, she realized it wasn’t luck—it was fate. Ever eager to dazzle, Lillian keeps a card in her hand and a trick up her sleeve for anyone willing to watch.
Physical Description: Lillian is a living burst of carnival chaos—decked in vivid reds, purples, and electric blues stitched into a deliberately asymmetrical ensemble that seems stitched together by whimsy itself. Golden bells and patterned fabrics dance with her every step, while her patchwork jester’s cloak swirls like a stage curtain in motion. Her silver-white hair cascades in tousled waves, crowned by a flamboyant hat adorned with feathers, cards, and just enough flair to draw every gaze. Her heterochromia—one eye bright and curious, the other bold and mischievous—only adds to the mystique with quirky makeup always in place and cards never far from her fingertips.
Species: Human? Fae? People argue about that.

Name: Lin Baimei
Known History: ||A woman from Xuanwu City, a hoarder of junk and knicknacks. Sometimes treasure, who knows. Not even she, she kind of forgot what she has in her home on the giant turtle.  But within the bowels, she met and was saved by a Spirit Beast, that changed her forever.||
Origin: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Xuanwu's Grave
Other Names:
Lin (Family name)
Baimei (Given name)
Madam Lin (Business name)
Physical Description:
A pale lady seemingly in appearance around her late twenties, with long white hair and a keen eye. Standing at 170cm in height, she carries herself with grace until she loses herself, in which case she becomes enthusiastic and eccentric to a degree.

Though always uses her right hand, even if using her left would make more sense.

Name: Lin Shěn
Identity: A Disgraced Student, Living In Self-Exile
Known History: Due to his sudden disappearance from his home and appearance on the worldhelm not much is known of Lin. He is a young man, hailing from the realm of Wujing Guo, living in self imposed exile with his adoptive brother Xuhu. After years of solitude and countless battles he was whisked away onto the worldhelm.
Origin: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Jinjing Xiantiao, Bingchuan
Physical Description:
A tall and imposing man, this Jinshi warrior possesses a powerful, towering physique. His broad shoulders and well-defined muscles sculpted through years of battle and cultivation, his chest and arms are marked with scars, each a testament to past conflicts. A thick, wild mane of dark hair flows around his face, further emphasizing his  guardian lion-like heritage. His clawed hands are large and calloused, built for both combat and protection. His legs are equally formidable, covered in patches of fur that lead down to powerful, clawed feet, giving him a beast-like stance.

He wears a flowing green robe adorned with subtle, intricate patterns, tied at the waist with a wide, crimson sash decorated with cloud motifs. A large fur pelt drapes over one shoulder, hinting at past victories over formidable beasts and spirits alike. Hanging from his waist are gourds and additional cloth ornaments, resembling ceremonial talismans and protective charms against corrupt cultivators.

Name: Lindsey Beck
Identity: Fiesty Benefactor of the Violet Barons
Known History:
* Born to an affluent military family in Caldera
* Spent his youth rebelling however he could from his strict father
* Upon inheriting the family fortune upon his father's passing, and with no other family to speak of, he donated all but a small fortune of his wealth to various charities, dissolving his estate.
* Using what remained of his fortune he purchased an airship "The Gleaming Goose" and an exosuit named "Throne"
* Spent a few years blissfully independent until he and his ship were comandeered for the war effort.
*Many years with the military wore down his hope to ever escape his legacy until a plucky young Welkin pilot was assigned to his ship.
* When she realized she no longer wanted to serve Merrane he followed her happily into Vigilantism (piracy is such a droll word) as the Violet Barons!
Physical Description: A gorgeous, flamboyant man dressed in fine silks, tight leathers, and adorned with a greying blonde mane and a luxurious mustache. Shirt eternally open baring a hairy chest, or an armored chestplate when in his exosuit. Yes, thats right. The shirt goes over the exosuit, eternally open.

Name: Lindwa Ddraig
Known History: Lindwa is a Dreamite, hailing from Castle Ladon. Having put herself under a powerful spell of slumber for countless years beforehand, she excitedly seeks the adventure and intrigue that the Worldhelm has to offer.
Physical Description: Lindwa is a clumsy, lumbering woman, measuring at 6' of height, and weighing over 400 pounds, due in large part to the draconic horns and huge, unwieldy tail she has, as if someone took the parts off of a fairytale dragon, and placed them onto her. She dresses simply, in a fashionable and exquisitely crafted dress not unlike one a princess or noble would wear. Her demeanor is generally calm and collected, though there is always some level of movement present in her body even when at rest.

Name: Lionel
Known History:
- Born to a noble family in Ripplith, Lionel was the firstborn daughter, and the heir apparent, set to inherit the authority of the family.
- They come out as trans, and go to a Seamother to undergo the ritual to fit into a body of their own.
- Now a man, and unable to hold authority in the matriarchal society of the Galeo Empire, their family looks down on him for throwing away his birthright and responsibility.
- He is then sent off to the Gnosis Academy to find his own path, and so as to no longer be in his mother's sight.
- Lionel takes well to the classes and the trials of becoming a Regalia yet all the while there is a sense that something is wrong. He struggles to make friends and socialize, and after some months his grades begin to slip...
- Thus, he is in the remedial program.

- After many trials, Lionel has renounced his family name and birthright... He wanders no longer, now he is the Wayward.
Physical Description:
About 6ft tall, Lionel Il'Hrarra is a fount of little guy energy. To combat his little man aura, he dresses up in a style reminiscent of sailors and their ships in Ripplith, always decorated in a coat and a set of boots, usually with some sort of net for an accessory.

It is a rare event to see him in normal clothing.

Name: Lisa Aeingradt
Known History:
- Merrane raised aspiring logistics and technician who tries her best to go above and beyond at what she believes in.
- Connections were used to make her a subject for Esper pilot projects to become better use for the military service of the empire.
- Due to the shift of roles, she came under the protection of Johnathan Southworth, a POW turned to asset for the military.
- During a mission near Suntower, she was protected by Johnathan from the sudden emergence of Vanagandr, nearly costing his life.
- She convinced and authorized the use of the Pandora serum in the hopes of saving Johnathan's life, though at a cost.
- She remains protected by Johnathan but is now in constant worry about his state of being and feels an panging guilt about being the reason he is the way he is now and the fact he so readily nearly died for her.
Physical Description: Lisa is a young woman with a fairly serious expression and demeanor at all most all times, someone who takes things generally serious especially when it comes to tasks or jobs of any sort, failure is something she simply desires to not need to content with. None of this means she is unknown to the taste of defeat, as a tech trial and error can become common place to find solutions to issues. She stands at 5'6 without her heels on and is a rather beautiful looking individual with her blue eyes.

Name: Lissander Velkov
Known History: Lissander is often silent, when not spoken to he often rattles on about the lost, dead, and forgotten. When he is spoken to, he answers in short and direct sentences.
Physical Description: Lissander wears more conservative, but still fancy ceremonial armor with cloth coverings and a full metal helmet as well as metal greaves. A color mixture of dark gold, brown and blue/white for the cloth parts, it is obvious the armor is more for looks but also made to fully cover his body. Though the eye slots for the helmet are dark, his blue eyes are barely visible from beneath.

Name: Lizbern "Liz" Harfell
Known History: Liz was born in the town of Vale in Karlsgard.  When she was a child, Merrane's forces attacked her town and destroyed it, leaving her as the only survivor as far as she knew.  She was rescued and brought to Ionian Village where she joined the KPLA at a young age.  Liz acts as a member of the KPLA, fighting to free the land from Merrani rule. One day, she and her allies discover the location of a prototype mech, and plot to steal it.  Lizbern is trained in the basics of piloting using stolen acadamy materials.  Getting to the mech goes as planned, but as they make their escape, Merrani angels descend on the rebels.  Liz chooses to fight, holding them back with the prototype while her comrades escape.  The prototype is badly damaged and Liz mortally wounded, but as the enemy approached to finish her off, a realmstorme rescues her to the Worldhelm.  Laughing at her fortune Liz christens the prototype "Liberty Wing", and resolves to return to Lhodos and finish the fight against the Empire
Physical Description: Lizbern Harfell is an average sized young woman with short red hair and green eyes that bear a slight glow. She typically wears dark cargo pants, a plain red shirt, and a long black jacket regardless of the weather.

Name: Lloyd
Identity: Naive Wandering Warrior Trying His Best
Known History:
Lloyd is a an orphan from the town of Dryholde who ran away from his orphanage, only to end up being saved and apprenticed to a wandering hero after a series of unfortunate events. Despite being otherwise bumbling and uncoordinated, Lloyd was found to be a quick learner in the art of combat - and soon, mentor and mentee became more like father and son.

Years passed by as Lloyd and his mentor wandered about, saving people from all manner of bandit and beastie. However, after a particularly successful adventure, his mentor suddenly disappeared without a trace. Driven to find out where his mentor had gone, Lloyd struck out on his own - wielding his spear and shield to protect others when he could!

... well, that was his plan, at least. Alas, only a week after making this decision, he was caught by a realm storm in the middle of an otherwise peaceful nap - waking up dazed and confused on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: 5’6 feet tall, 140 lbs. Looks somewhat scrawny, but is just rocking a sleeper build. Never seen without his helmet on and his weapons close by, even when relaxing and sleeping. The only thing you can make out through the helmet's visor are piercing blue eyes. Gives off an intimidating aura that very quickly melts away the moment he speaks.

Name: Lochlann Carlisle
Known History:
A quick search on the Terran net for Lochlann will yield hundreds of results about him being the second son of Magnus Carlisle, the ruthless CEO of the family-owned Regenekhan Pharmaceuticals. Lochlann is employed as a head researcher and inventor for the biotech company beneath his older brother and heir apparent, Alistair. He holds Ph.D degrees in both medicine and business from Haven University.

Interviews with Magnus have him proudly share that Alistair and Lochlann are his clones through the use of Regenekhan's proprietary gene editing techniques that allow for augmentations of DNA in the womb. The expectations he has for both of his "sons" to take over the company are substantial.
Physical Description:
Lochlann is a lion-augmented businessman flecked with white, gold-tipped fur who stands at an impressive 6’9”. Contouring his muscular frame is a kevlar-lined suit that protects him in the boardroom and the streets of Terra.

His gentlemanly demeanor and typically warm smile can quickly turn cold when his friends and colleagues are threatened. Along with a power watch capable of creating energy shields, an unusual black device affixed to his belt reveals his technical skill as a medical researcher.

Name: Lock
Known History:
Not much is known about this mysterious little fox! Though she's clearly some kind of yokai, she claims innocence as to what *exactly* her nature is.

What she *is*, though, is an excellent salesfox! True to the necklace they wear, they have come to wear petals and peddle wares.

With a stock of nearly anything in her cute little backpack, she's ready to take on the world!
Physical Description: Lock is a regular-sized fox - about a foot and a half tall at the shoulder, and weighing 25 pounds. She wears a backpack perfectly sized for her!

Name: Locke 🔥
Known History:
Locke's upbringing was shaped by his hatred for the way the Scalefire empire treated his mage parents. In his desire to change his parent's circumstances, he wanted to become a force of nature. Something *angry*, and *hateful*. Something the empire would fear *more* than mages. In pursuit of becoming this terror, he attempted to bind himself to a demon arcanum of vicious burning, Tubalcain. This demon felt Locke's anger, deemed it worthy of his blessing, and allowed the boy to inflict himself with an arcanum of ineffable inferno. This created the half-demon burning with hate that we know today, Locke. Since then, he has acted against the empire - and has been taken away to the Worldhelm.

On the worldhelm, he must learn to control and direct his hatred now more than ever.
Physical Description:
5' 9"
190 lbs.
Locke wears a bandage-esque talisman wrapped around his torso, as well as baggy pants tucked into metal combat boots. which binds him to the flame demon arcanum, Tubalcain. Locke's right-half is perpetual inferno, while his left side is (most of the time) skin.

Name: Loveno Beaumont
Known History: Loveno is a member of the SIA's Lycanthropic Neutralization Program. Cold, and calculated, Loveno prioritizes the safety of himself and his unit first, and the success of the mission second. He oversees experiments done by the rest of his division, ready to step in to protect the researchers at a moment's notice. After being victim of a Werewolf attack, he joined the SIA at a young age as a provisional agent, and quickly climbed the ranks to where he is today. Outside of work, the only thing he seems to do in his free time is work on his car, and reading up on various SIA mission reports and studies, though some of the theory is lost on him.
Physical Description: Loveno is a tall, broad man, with a body that has been conditioned through rigorous physical activity throughout the years, hidden away by his SIA uniform. On his hip is a pair of holsters, containing his SIA service pistol on one side, and  a heavy, serrated shortsword in the other. There is always an amicable smile painted on his face, an expression that never really changes unless the situation is dire, or he's working on repairing and upgrading his beloved vehicle.
