Name: Loxias Thaumastus
Known History: Loxias is a simple grave-tender that wanders the Selene Woods. Giving all that have died in the forest a proper burial and the toll to cross. Many of the woods refer to him as the "Ferrymen of the Woods".
Physical Description: Stranding at 5'10 always wearing a white toga with a blue sash, he has several jewelry all over his character. A golden necklace with multiples gems, an earring with a sapphire, and a ring with an onyx fitted in. He has short black hair, with blue eyes with heavy bags underneath.

Name: Lucena Belmonte
Identity: The Ballad of a Glass Swan
Known History: The young daughter of a merchant's family in Brightshield. The Belmonte family has been  known for their established jewelry crafts. Lucena was raised to be a proper elegant noble lady through dance lessons, etiquette, and strict maintenance of her looks until the day Lorelei cursed her. She has been hid away from the public eye years after.
Physical Description: Normally, pale frail short woman with light blonde hair and periwinkle eyes. Her physical appearance shifts contorts and bends with her curse.

Name: Lucia
Identity: Nihilistic problem child, with a spine of steel.
Known History: Lucia, sometimes called 'Luce' by her few acquaintances, is a young woman struggling to survive. She reluctantly takes on the few jobs she knows how, debt collection and strong-arming being the most common. In her few years of work, she has claimed a small reputation as a somewhat talented fighter, and claims a meager wage doing so - barely enough to live on. Deep down, she hates the way that she lives, the way that this world forces her to be to survive, and has become quite nihilistic as a result. To her, the circumstances that led her to the worldhelm are, naturally,  just an accident - a freak accident. There's certainly no way that the ship would select her, of all people, to be a Gold-Hearted. Absolutely no chance.
Physical Description: Lucia has a lithe-lanky mix figure - a result of physical training/work, as well as malnutrition. She stands just under average height - about 5' 3", and has shoulder-length grey hair. Her usual attire is a large jacket or hoodie, paired with whatever combination of combat boots and shorts or pants she fancies that day. She speaks with a rough tone, and is quite quick to resort to physical violence when things aren't quite going her way.

Name: Lucia Vitarex
Identity: Royal Healer with a Heart of Gold
Known History:
Lucia was born into a long line of healers and priests, which served the royalty of the city, at least before the last day of the moon. After the disaster struck the lands, the Vitarex family concentrated their efforts on the safekeeping of the city and its people, which not only brought them trust and respect from the common folk, but also a lot of money, thus making them one of the more influential families in the city, but of course not on the level of the old or new royalty. 

That is the world Lucia was born into, which gave her the advantages a rich house has while still needing to prove herself by helping those in need, whether it be with her medical expertise, preparing meals for the poor or helping the city guard defend against outside threats. All of that together made her a person that understands royalty while still being very humble. 

That's why, when a storm took Lucia with it and gave her the opportunity to help many people on different worlds, she accepted.
Physical Description: Lucia has a rather small build, standing at 5'2 (160cm) and weighting about 130lbs (59kg). She has her hair in a bun most of the time and is either wearing a brown sweater and a pair of black pants or a, for her physique, surprisingly heavy armor, depending on whether she is helping out in the kitchen or is out in the field. On special occasions, one might also spot her in a priestly robe

Name: Luka Penrose
Identity: Inventor in Love with the World
Known History:
- is an inventor, scientist and technomancer
- has an exoskeleton that he calls Seraphim
- can use hardlight, can't use spells but has Magispheres that copy spell effects
Physical Description:
Luka is extremely bubbly. He enjoys talking, but really loves listening to people talk about their past, or things that interest them. He is often seen writing in a notebook of sorts, though his notes are indecipherable because his handwriting is god awful.  Except to him, it seems. He is somewhat short, but that doesn't appear to bother him at all. He has reddish-purple hair, and orange eyes that are almost always wide in fascination. He sometimes has wings and a halo, thanks to his exoskeleton, Seraphim. He loves learning how anything works, and will often take things apart to see what inner mechanisms drive them - except for living things. He is very kind, and well-intentioned, even if he can be a bit much sometimes. He has had an easy life, full of pursuing his passions, and wants nothing more than for everyone else to have the same.

Full -
[Oh! You wanna know about me?](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1KHpC8xRy16ah63FRpailBKFMFYtdGm184LmOVlN0_HM/edit?usp=sharing)

Name: Lumio, Last Warden of Idyll
Identity: Dissonant Protector on a New Path
Known History:
Carson died and was sent to Idyll. They spent two hundred years watching people died and soon dedicated himself to helping others escape. After the first few decades it became so taxing that they started hallucinating. With a new name to inspire hope, Lumio, they started to spend their time trying to protect caravans everyday. They failed. Every day. For 200 years. They eventually escaped though. Alone, but escaped to the Worldhelm.

Now Lumio is known as a glowing shield beside his best friend; Echo the Battle Fox, but has sustained many traumas on the Worldhelm. They faced their nightmares in Idyll, watched the moon fall from Terra, fought against Loftfur, was injected with the memories of ATLAS, given visions of their best friend's death, and failed to uphold a promise to their hero (Verstappen).

The worst part is, they know it isn't getting better. Echo died. Their heart has shattered. Their smile gone. What's left of them is a husk trying to pick up the pieces..
Origin: Fourth layer of Idyll, Maze Elysia
Physical Description: Lumio is semi-ethereal, 5'6 man that looks in their mid twenties. Their limbs, as well as their hair seem to fizzle into wisps on certain parts of their body. They have orange eyes and crystal blue armor to protect. Now armed with a pulsing axe, Lumio’s toothy grin has disappeared and replaced with a saddened look.

Name: Luna
Known History:
*  Parents left when she was a young Kitsume
* She started hearing rumors of people needing protection and started to learn to be a lightblade
* She quickly learned how to wield a sword from her uncle
* Set out on her own adventure to find her parents
* Fell through ice during a storm and woke up on the world helm
Physical Description: blond hair, ears, and tail. she has fair skinned, is 5'6", she has fuzzy shoulder pads and brigandine with long white leggings and brown snow boots.

Name: Lunira
Known History: Lunira was outcast from her home on Kor'Tarion after an encounter with a shard of the realm's shattered moon that left her permanently changed. She's been on a few journeys since then, but eventually she found her way to the Worldhelm, called in by the chance to make a difference.
Physical Description: She stands at a mighty 5'6" and while she used to be a normal human, she more closely resembles a humanoid monster in appearance after her transformation. Her skin glows with radiant light as her body struggles to contain the power stored within it and her head is adorned with horns formed to channel the power.

Name: Luo Kai
Known History:
- A petty thief from Xuanwu City. 

- Orphaned at a young age, most of Kai's life was spent simply trying to escape notice and survive, taking what he could, where he could.

- Has developed a hatred for corrupt cultivators because of the suffering he witnessed under their control. 

- Chanced upon an old scroll outlining Cultivation through the "Dao of Wind" while trespassing in an abandoned training hall. From that day on, he committed himself to learning the fundamentals described within, working to master the whims of the wind.

- Four years have passed since he found the scroll, and he has hit a dead-end in his Cultivation progress. There is only so much he can do without real tutelage.
Origin: Xuanwu City, Wujing Guo, Tian Yin
Other Names:
Family name: Luo
Given name: Kai
Physical Description: A diminutive Bishi'e man with pale gray eyes and long, unkempt bone-white hair through which a pair of dark brown horns protrude. Standing no taller than 4'6" and with a slight frame, one could easily mistake him for sickly and frail. But the movements of his body tell a different story: sharp, practiced and quick.

Name: Lupo
Identity: Psychic Pilot from the Sapper Core
Known History:
Orphan abandoned at the frontlines of the war that was taken care of by the KPLA. Grew up in a orphanage, then joined the ranks of the KPLA in the search for meaning. There, he found himself training harder and harder to eventually join the Sapper Core, a special anti-mecha division of the KPLA, where only the best of the best could join. 

When he finally managed to get himself in their trainee ranks, a nightmare triggered his Esper powers, leading to a massive fiery accident that culminated in him fleeing from Karlsgard with his training mech and a stolen airship. 

Months later, he paid back all of his debt, exorcised the demon that was born in the barracks that day, keeping his rank with the Sapper Core, and returned to the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Slender male, shoulder-length black hair, purple eyes ever since he awakened his esper powers. Has a calculated look to his face, and a weathered expression most of the time. Smiles to most jokes, but rarely actually laughs.

Name: Lyle Whitlock
Identity: Courier Tinkerer turned Combat Medic in Training
Known History:
To the people of Kaiway, Lyle is a well-known figure, often seen alongside his best friend, Vial, a Machina from Steelbin. Lyle has made a name for himself by handling deliveries for most of the students at Gnosis Academy, with Vial's assistance as they move swiftly around Heartdom, often using freerunning to navigate the city’s tight spaces.

It’s common knowledge that Lyle comes from the Whitlock family, renowned couriers who run Whitlock Deliveries, the primary messengers of Heartdom. However During his second year at the academy, in an attempt to cast magic, he nearly lost his life, only to discover that his body could not handle the strain of magic use.
Physical Description:
162 cm (5'4") tall, young, effeminate-presenting person whilst doing deliveries they wear a bulky white jacket and has black hair under a cap with goggles and equipped with various gadgets. 

Whilst at downtime he wears his Gnosis academy uniform, wearing a red scarf and an emblem of the House of Paladins.

Name: Lynne-4
Known History: Hailing from the reflection of Steelbin, Lynne was separated from her family as a child, during an ambush by a gang of Machina outside of the Civilized Zone. Escaping into the wilderness, Lynne fought to survive, until after a number of years, she was happened upon by a Paladin and Regalia duo, who took her in, and enrolled her in Gnosis Academy. After three years of attendance, she was consigned to the Remedial Class, and sent to the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Lynne stands proudly at 5'10", with long, silky purple hair, and a mouth full of fangs. Currently forgoing the Gnosis Academy Uniform, save for the badge denoting her as a Paladin, she can be seen wearing a modified Terran bodysuit. Her skin is covered in glowing circuit-like magical tattoos, each leading to a metallic core in her chest.

Name: Lyrric Dust
Identity: Warlock with a Debt to Pay
Known History:
*Travelled with his family and helped train magical beast as mounts and work forces.
*Deserters from an army turned bandits attacked while they were on the road. During the attack Lyric desperately prayed for help and Something answered.
-This Gifted him his Elementalist powers and gave him his staff.
-The deal meant he would be called on in the future by said power.
*He left to travel the world so that any stigma of him being a "warlock" as his magic was not really his, would not stay attached to his family or the lively hood.
*During his travels he was caught in storm near the Runewall and the winds forced him and his mount through.
Physical Description: Lyrric stands at around 5'6" with a slender build. Usually found in a comfortable robe with a high collar to keep the wind off some of his face. He does have a scar that travels down the left side of his face that seems to be from a burn or claw.

Name: Lyssa
Known History:
- A Lerisin that practices Anima as a Shaman by learning from the forest spirits of Rocadian
- As the spirits began to go mad through the calamity, a morbid curiosity leaned practices into Thauma 
- Despite the spirits of the forest going mad and being more violent, has a fascination with possible strength that chaos can bring
- Wants to protect her homeland and believes chaos must meet chaos to restore order with the spirts
- Desires to explore and study other places and magic
Physical Description: Slightly above average height, dressed modestly, brown hair/fur, tail usually concealed

Name: Mabilis Na'ulan
Known History: Mabilis Na'ulan is one of the few surviving cultivators who took the righteous path after Xiang Shinan waged the war against heaven, having been a young cultivator under the boot of the Blackhearted, he trained in secret alongside another student under a righteous cultivator, Master Na'alon. During his time as a wandering warrior, his cultivation base was shattered, and remains in a state of recovery, severely limiting his potential despite his relative experience. Mabilis is accompanied by a spirit beast he calls Gan-Gan, who supplements his weaknesses, acting as a reliable companion, and old friend.
Physical Description: An old man who's appearance is hides his true age, Mabilis stands at 6'1 with an athletics build, bearded with a disheveled head of grey hair held up by a headband. He wears light clothing covered in a heavy cloak dyed a blue reminiscent of the ocean, a style recognized easily as that of a martial artist hailing from Tian Yin. His face is deep set with scars and wrinkles alike, but Mabilis often wears a smile despite the clear toll the life of a cultivator has taken.

Name: Madhuri Somasundaram
Known History:
Madhuri is a demonkin born in the underground city of Little Lantern in the Bahata Khajaana.

Her mother is a fire cultivator, and Madhuri pestered her for training from an early age.
While hotheaded and impulsive, she is also stubborn and dedicated. She put in the mental, physical, and spiritual work to become a cultivator of fire qi, in the old ways, banned in the Khajaana.

As she came of age, she was chomping at the bit to somehow help with things. To resist the Maharaja's forces, somehow. To hunt down dangerous spirit beasts before they struck. Or to venture elsewhere to help defend a smaller demonkin village. *Something.* She never took well to being told she needed much more time training first.

Eventually she set out to assist a small group on a short journey, and faced real dangers for the first time, narrowly all surviving. Only to one night be swept into a Realmstorm, leaving those she was escorting behind.
Origin: Little Lantern, Bahata Khajaana, Tian Yin
Physical Description:
Madhuri stands 5'10", or 178cm. Her frame is slight, pear-shaped, with very long legs... Which resemble that of a chicken, scaled from the knee down, with ankles resembling reversed knees and ending in very large feet. She wears fitted metal claws for use in combat.

She wears baggy, concealing clothing; not out of shame of her scales and feathers, but simply because she likes how she can move around in it. Her hands are also scaly, and end in claws, fairly blunted by work. She likes flower motifs.

She has long hair, which she tends to put up in a high ponytail. *(It's not nearly as much as in the picture.)* With very pale skin and white hair, Madhuri is noticeably albino; her eyes are even fully red, rather than the normal colors in human albinism. At home, though, it's not particularly remarked on. Few colors are exactly *unusual* for demonkin, after all.

Name: Mae Lavery
Known History: Mae works as a temp for T&C in addition to working in the explosives development program. Her temp work involves a lot of doing field demonstrations of T&C's experimental projects, primarily explosives since that's her area. A year ago was involved in an accident that claimed her life before she was brought back as an insolvent. The events of Skyfall when parts of Terra's moon rained down seemed to have been the push for her to get recognized as a Goldhearted, as not long after helping during those events she was picked up by the ship.
Physical Description: Mae is a young woman who stands at 5'8". She normally wears a bit of an angry expression when she is in thought or not actually speaking, which things then quickly change to a smile and she gives off a more upbeat energy. She skin is pale and her eyes read giving clear signs of insolvency to those who are familiar with it. Her normal attire would be a bit punkish in style.

Name: Mafqud Gazzlan
Known History:
Skamos always attracted people wanting to dive into the nearby ruins of Ista. So of course, some people tried to use that as an opportunity - like the Gazzlans, a family that made it their business to become guides to and in Ista. To be recognizable (and to distract the occasional Undead there), they started to wear Skeleton masks. 

As Mafqud's Grandpa died, something changed. The already quite curious and crafty Mafqud inherited an object the Grandpa found on one trip. A cabinet, seemingly able to attract lost things and gadgets. 

As that clearly was some kind of magic, Mafqud started to travel around, posing as peddler, to hide from the Branding as a Mage. In the nights, he fiddled around with the things from the cabinet and realized that he can make them make ... stuff. Just not very reliably. 

Just when he was about to be found out by some inquisitive guards, he got the call.
Physical Description: Mafqud is a slender man, not the buffest, but buff enough to carry the small cabinet on his back - which he also uses to hide behind when feeling anxious. Almost always wears a skeleton mask to hide his face. In the rare moments he takes it off, he looks like a shy man with black hair, a stubbly beard and tan, olive skin as many people living under the Nezmiran sky.

Name: Mahuizoh
Identity: Death Exorcist Seeking a Fitting End
Known History:
Mahuizoh was an exorcist who traveled, banishing undead and generally killing things that breathed too much for the common good. After a chance fight with his fellow exorcists, he found himself responsible for watching of Risata, a woman who eventually came to be his wife. 

Despite his apparent blindness, he's fairly canny, and has a lackadaisical attitude.

He REALLY loves his wife.
Physical Description: 5'10, wiry muscle, blind, tattooed up

Name: Majesty
Known History:
The burbling of a rock-choked brook, the crash of great waves against high cliffs, the gentle hiss of autumn rain... Each an instrument, a song in its own right. And Majesty was born of this song, birthed into cognition by the overactive minds of sailors and school children. The Muse in The Rain, The Naiad, The Siren, The Mermaid... 

Majesty was born alongside the merfolk, filling in the edges of storybooks and fairy tales like spilled ink on a square of pale cloth. And from there, they took flight into their own story.

A knight, a poet, a mage... They've played and sung for fae kings and fae queens, from the lowly gnome to the highest elf. At least, that is if you believe what they say. Why now are they Goldhearted? Why now must they act within the ballads they once sung? Who knows...
Physical Description:
Standing at 6'7", Majesty is a towering, slender shape with thin limbs lined with folding fins. Colored in shades of blue, with midnight black hair and a mouth of teeth that fold against their mouth, it is extremely apparent that they are nothing remotely close to human, no matter how human their song might sound...

Majesty dresses lavishly in flowing silks and satins, always wrapped up in loose fitting clothing. If not for social expectation, this emperor would have no clothes.

Name: Mako Torres
Known History: To those in Tangbawan they would know a family which was created thanks to the union of a Goldhearted and a Local. The young child of Mako the latest generation of the Torres family has been training in isolation for a while and has not been able to get too close to society in a long time. However as their master left for the heavenly war he was left to guard a place he called home, and as the realm was torn he was left with no one but himself. With the goal of completing his training.
Physical Description: Standing at about 5'9 with a very twinkish build, he's wrapped in bandages and has scarfs surrounding his neck and waist. He has brown hair dark brown eyes and emits this balanced energy of light and dark.

Name: Mara Zofia Jedvaj
Identity: Crimson mage and werewolf liason for the DSE
Known History:
Born in Veryhold Myist and grows up as a bit of delinquent to a family selling and repairing crank cars.

Gets into a whirlwind romance with a werewolf, unknowing of her nature until she one night lost control even just for a second. She was saved by the SIA, and  begged for her partner to be saved. She was, but was sent out of the city, joining a heretic group.

Mara for her part, now knowing of the unseen world, joins the SIA, and bounces around the different departments for a few years, until she settles as a werewolf liason for the DSE.

She has spent many years with werewolves, learning their ways, traditions, ways of suppression and magic, doing experiments on herself, sometimes with the help of the heretics she is helping and gaining the power to harness the magic of the land.
Physical Description: A wild and scruffy looking woman in her mid 40s, with long unkempt hair, and a lanky frame that hides a surprising amount of muscle. Dressed in comfortable clothes, somewhere in between city wear and outdoors attire, and always with her signature round crimson glasses she claims let her see magic better.

Name: Marcus Robinson
Known History:
Born in the poorer areas of North Rock and lost his family during childhood, Marcus was took under his wing by an expereinced Goldnail to be brought into the family.

Was unable to afford any martial weapons or proper training so Marcus relied on his fist, training and using them on various jobs to the point he did not need other weapons

He saw the Goldnails as new form of family in his teenage and young adult years gleefuly taking on missions to prove himself earning the title of "Goldnail's Fist" when he offically joined the Goldnails

While the year goes on by Marcus started to notice the corruption that runs rampant in the crime family which he had ignored due to blind faith until an extortion job went wrong in which he took a bullet for a hostage with the remaining Goldnails leaving him behind.

The hostage ended up being an 100G asset which thanks to their explanation of the scene granted Marcus a path he did not think would get after so many years, one of redemption.
Physical Description: A scarred 6 ft man with blond hair, he keeps a nice suit despite his rough appearance. His bare back has a scratched out tattoo of the Goldnails

Name: Mari
Known History:
A self-proclaimed fighter who made a living by actively hunting monsters that emerge across Kor'Tarion, typically going for days at a time on hunts, endlessly beating down on the monsters one by one all day, keeping himself active with magic he'd aquired through exposure to the moonshards. While fighting a mage and bleeding out, everything went blank. His eyes opened, what's left was scars to remind of what could've been, he'd been brought back just so they could fight longer. The mage's hubris let him fight for another day, and perhaps more.

He's laughing........
Physical Description: A man with a thin, but muscular build. Blue eyes and brown hair that partially covered his face. Carrying scars across his entire body. Around 180 CM tall, and weighing 71 KGs.  Wearing a rather light hoodie and wields odd weapons instead of any traditional fighting equipment.

Name: Mari and Mori
Identity: The Silent Jester of Kingdom Road
Known History:
Mari and Mori travelled the Kingdom Road alone for many years. Long enough that rumors of a jester-child and a mechanical puppet assailing or harassing passerby's live in the ideas of legends as far back as a decade ago. Though, she's always simply been an agent of chaos, and never villainy. Scaring people, only stealing from the wealthy, and warding off danger from travelers.

She's shown herself a few times on the ship, but is rarely onboard.
Physical Description:
Mari is a 4'8'' girl wearing baggy mismatched patchy clothing. She has jesters cap on her head with a pair of red striped horns that rests over her messily cut hair. She weighs about 80 lbs, and is built like it. She walks with a dance to her step and never speaks. Inside her collar is the stitched name `Mari`.

Mori is a pink dog-mouthed stuffed toy, with patchy spots where holes have been filled. They're soft, and smell like an attic. They have heterochromatic button eyes, and are stuffed with something that feels akin to wool. Though, squeezing them reveals the metal bones that fill them, and the warm crystal at the center of their chest. Inside his collar is the stitched name `Mori`.

Name: Maria
Identity: Foul Mouthed Fist Fighting Magical Girl
Known History:
- Lost place of residence and employment during the events of Skyfall.
- While searching for new work to be able to pay the bills stumbled upon a job listing for SWORD.
- Mistook the listing as just running and action on a social media account for a character created by SWORD.
- Had a history of being in fights and the ability to use some magic.
- SWORD found reports of her abilities and police records of fights, which helped her actually become a good candidate.
- Got the job and became part of a SWORD TEMP group called EntroPRISIM who act like a magical girl team for entertainment reasons while handling proper jobs.
- Took on the role of "Flare Gem Phixia" as part of the EntroPRISM Squad
- Loathes her current employment but is stuck with a long-term contract she doesn't have a good way out of. Despite this she plays her character well.
- Is always thankful when work is out of the way of public eye and she can drop the character act and really let loose with her true feelings.
Physical Description: Dresses in relaxed comfortable clothing, t-shirts, skirts, ect., long read hair with purple eyes that almost seem to shimmer. Has spiked horns as an augment. Once in character however into a black dress with with murrey colored material on the underside and edges that seem to smolder paired with a jacket with black sleeves and gloves that have a harmless heatless flame around the wrist.

Name: Maria "Sabuesa" Irene
Identity: Officer Who Stepped Too Far Into The Night . . .
Known History:
- Respected Officer in Ashreach, as well as in the Investigations Branch of Veyrhold

- Often found at night times, doing patrols or in scenes of various crimes. Shootouts are common if she's around so, people stay wary

- To some her presence is a bit unnerving, to others not so much. Strange, but unexplainable to most

- Any from the SIA would know about her work within the DMI as an on field investigator, though she has tensions with them. Most her friends are from the DSC
Physical Description:
5'4" foot tall woman, auburn eyes and brown hair. She often wears a relatively heavy dress with many frills, black gloves, black boots, and a large jacket she often keeps wrapped around herself. 

In addition to a couple other accessories, such as her hat.

Name: Marianna Caletre
Identity: Jovial Witch guiding souls to rest
Known History:
* Daughter of a coven witch of Hermandad de las Estrellas and a graveyard keeper.

* The two travelled Deadstone via wagon as a pair of fortune tellers using tarot cards. Specialized in giving closure to the loved ones of the deceased.

* Marianna was born with the ability to speak to ghosts, and she'd communicate with the dead for those who'd use the wagon's services,

* When she took over the wagon, she'd travel as her parents did, befriending a demon-touched mariachi she had met as a child due to both being seen as outcasts.

* She invites him to travel with her, the two travelling and meeting a "buffalo demon" Miguel was familiar with.

* In return for a tarot deck portraying spirits during their time of death and teaching Miguel how to control his demonic magic, the duo are soul- entwined and tasked by the demon with sending the restless undead to the afterlife until being brought to the Worldhelm.
Origin: Deadstone Gulch / Hermandad de las Estrellas
Physical Description:
An eerie young-woman dressed in black and red robes adorned in the same marigold flowers that some use to decorate an ofrenda.

Her face is painted to invoke a calavera  and can often be seen plastered with a mischievous grin. 

She often tells people that the way she dresses was what she had died in. This is a lie Miguel frequently has to debunk. 

In reality, her attire is borne out of ceremonial and spectacle.

Name: Marianne Cheon
Known History: Raised single-handedly by her uncle after losing her parents before she even developed object permanence, Marianne developed a love for video games and the occult, both of which her uncle regularly exposed her to. Her inquisitive mind allowed her to excel in her studies, eventually leading to her dream job of becoming a developer at SWORD. Unfortunately, just as she got promoted, her uncle fell ill and could no longer run his business. Feeling like she owed her life to him, she decided to take up moonlighting as a rookie exorcist to keep his business going. She now tries to maintain both her jobs and her social life without crashing out.
Physical Description: A young woman who stands at 5'6. She keeps her hair short and parted to left, wears an oversized blue hoodie, and running shorts. She also has an assortment of prayer beads, both on her neck and wrist, as well as an ornamental sword on her back.

Name: Marina Evans
Known History:
- Orphaned at birth, lived in an orphanage in Secura until 11
- Found by prof. Estrella Raposa in the search of a compatible host for the artificial conscience of an incredibly powerful daemon under NTT’s control, moved to Downpour City
- Aces all tests but is deemed too old. Still, an attempt is made
- The procedure is a success, but Marina’s willpower survives and she’s put under prof. Raposa’s care, befriending her daughter Ceri
- Eventually the two become close and even work together as TEMPs
- One night they party too hard and somehow find themselves on a weird huge ship
Physical Description:
A woman of average-tall build, with rose-blonde hair and blue eyes. Can be usually seen in combat-ready attire, fit for ease of movement, even when not on the job. While working, she adds padded protections to her outfit, although she keeps it light since not getting hit by the monsters she has to deal with is still preferable.

Outside her job context, Marina presents herself as a pretty normal young woman, enjoying life, spending time with her friends and adoptive family, and trying to live every day to its fullest. Maybe sometimes even a bit too much.

Name: Marlo - ᵀʰᵉ Deadweight
Known History:
Marlo is the youngest son of the Serracosta family, loansharks from Cavelle. Used as a messenger since childhood and later as a collector, he left home at 15 and survived through dangerous sea work.

At 19, he barely passed into Gnosis. He became a Regalia and partnered with a friend for two years, but made a scene during his Rite of Binding and cut ties. After almost failing his second year, he joined the Coop Program.
Physical Description:
An athletic and loudmouthed 5'9 shark merfolk.
His Regalia form is that of a 6'0 tall steel anchor. It sometimes gets covered in ice.

Name: Marzanna
Known History:
* Served as a vessel for the Aesir Vanagandr under the Black Wolf Warband of Aldistir.
* Followed one clear purpose: Enact the cycle of death, exorcise that which should not exist.
* Eventually, realizes that she is being used as a weapon, begins to change and self-actualize.
* Bonds with her companion, Fenrir, another effigy of Vanagandr imbued in her shadow.
* Breaks away and becomes a wanderer, acting as a conduit for the cycles of change and death.
Physical Description:
Marzanna is a strange, solemn young woman standing at a mere 5'2" with stringy, pale-white hair and worn, heterochromatic eyes. Her abnormal frame quickly gives the impression of a possessed doll, her movements stiff and uncanny and her breathing eerie in its irregularity. Upon closer inspection, one can notice the strips of patchwork flesh and synthetic skin keeping her body together. Most notably, her shadow is unnaturally stark, and bears the distinct outline of a monstrous wolf.
Despite her off-putting nature, Marzanna acts rather polite and cordial in conversation. She possesses a unique mannerism and etiquette that captivates the attention of most she speaks to, one that's combined and contrasted with a curious, almost naive outlook toward her environment.

Name: Matilda Shaw
Known History:
* Appeared as a member of the SIA about a year ago.
* Has been moving around where she may, trying to help. Though her help has been considered... controversial at times.
* And now is suddenly in the Worldhelm.
Physical Description:
Matilda is not outwardly an intimidating woman. She is commonly smiling, standing an average 5'5. She is often wearing a lovely suit jacket on her shoulders with a very femme blouse and long skirt. By all accounts, surely she is normal.

Well. "Normal." In battle, she seems to channel dark energies that physically change her. Long horns grow out of her head, and that normal smile becomes more than a little sadistic. As if she is... enjoying the suffering being caused.

Name: Max Volume
Known History:
A life in North Rock came with its challenges, especially for an older brother such as Max. Born as the eldest of three children, it would always fall on his shoulders to keep his younger siblings out of harm's way in the dark alleyways of his home district. Being conditioned to endure hardship from such a young age, both his body and his resolve would be tempered as steel in a forge.

In his later years, in a bid to protect his family and the rest of his community, he would join the reformed Saitos, acquire a TEMP license, and get his hands on his signature exosuit. It was during his activity within the gang that he managed to recover a decades old neural implant dating back to the Baylore Company days, a veritable relic that served to enhance his combative capabilities even further.

Alas, as luck would have it, while on a mission in the deserts of central, he was swept up by a realmstorm, and his traces were lost...
Physical Description: Max is seldom seen without his exosuit on- most people never getting to witness the face beneath. He stands at a somewhat imposing 6'2'', usually wearing some manner of coat or suit over his armor, and on some occasions, is accompanied by rather loud music blaring from a set of speakers that seem integrated into the apparatus.

Name: Maxilos
Identity: The street mage turned corporate asset
Known History: Maxilos is an Insolvent for the ETA acting as a consultant on more magic oriented matters and security. Outside of that their past is unknown, the only clue being the extensive damage done to their body that either was too great for the ETA to fully fix or that the ETA didn't care to fix...
Physical Description: Maxilos is clearly spotted by the tear in their left cheek exposing their teeth. They're 5'10"and gaunt, with very pale skin with an almost greenish tint. They tend to dress in Sturdy workers clothes or on rare occasions very dark suits. They also tend to wear masks that cover their mouth and nose.

Name: Maximilian (Nickname: Max)
Known History:
- Born in a Military family from Merrane, specifically the Wall.
- Raised to be a hardline believer of Merrane propaganda.
- Believe hardened further from living at the Wall and seeing the Colossi.
- One day transferred as part of war effort against KPLA and as test pilot for prototype magitech, an Exoskeleton.
- The war against KPLA causes him to doubt.
- Doubt intensifies after the easy abandonment of Pikeway and their citizen.
- Doubt reaches its peak when Prince Damian defected.
- Feels lost
- Doesn't know if what he believed in is right or wrong anymore
- Results in running away with the prototype Exoskeleton to try reaching Suntower City
- That's when he found himself in Worldhelm
Physical Description: A lightly armored and fairly tall green haired young man.

Name: Maximillion (Max) Unicron
Known History:
Max was born in Haven, and always had a particular fondness for games. Throughout his early years, he'd often dream about creating something truly everyone could enjoy playing. 

He attended college and graduated as a Game Developer, though originally he attended for business. Coming up with the idea for a card game that people could physically see played, he went to SWORD to pitch the idea. Their R&D department happened to want to test some experimental new tech, and thus the Mix of AR and Hardlight Constructs they gave Max made his dream start to become a reality.
Physical Description: Max is a 6' tall man with a slender build, a kind face, and kind demeanor. He is usually seen with a smile on his face, and a spring in his step. He often wears frivolous clothes as a way to garner attention (Just to talk about the upcoming card game, of course!)

Name: Maxwell
Known History:
Maxwell is an engineer who specializes in robotics and machines. Although originally from Babyl City, She had taken up a legitimate job within Steeldome Facility as one of its engineers and researchers. 

At some point, she was caught in an accident that resulted in Maxwell loosing her legs and arm while burning her lower torso, but somehow survived either by a miracle or sheer luck. 

She would continue to operate in the said facility's mining operations by then.
Physical Description:
-164 cm/5'5" in height. 
-light green hair with dark green ends, resembling a leek. 
-Legs and left arm are cybernetic. Head, right arm, and torso (lower torso half burned) still natural. 
-Horns are curled.
-Green eyes.

Name: May Shuggar
Known History:
May likes to keep her past to herself. She's open about certain parts, primarily that she's Vale born, isn't in contact with her family nor knows of their whereabouts, and has been drifting place to place for longer than she'd like.
Given her track record of financial instability, May's pursuits are often driven by monetary gain, out of a sense that she's personally justified in taking whatever she wins at the table.
If anyone asks about the arm, they always get the same response: "This? Lost it in a poker game."
Physical Description: Pale skin, freckles, dyed hair, unnaturally pink eyes, relatively short

Name: Mei Takamaki
Known History:
**__Let's Learn About the Cyber Ranger__**
*"Transcode-002, Banshee!"*
Her name is Mei Takamaki, a passionate woman driven by her insatiable thirst for knowledge.

A charming office worker employed by Tubal and Cain as a data procurement specialist, recruited for her ability to traverse along the Soul Network.

But in order to combat the monsters that terrorize Terra, she transforms using a mobile terminal called a Solbrace—becoming the Cyber Ranger, Banshee.

Using the Solbrace's battle card system, she can morph her arms into a multitude of armaments and materialize digital beings to assist her in combat.

Before this, she was a licensed adventurer like her family. Whose legacy is known for their long military service, engineering expertise, and resilience.

As of right now, Mei conducts operations as T&C's weapon. But she feels restrained, despite the qualities of life she has obtained.
Physical Description:
A taller than average, bewitching woman. She carries herself with a stern expression while at work, as if walking with a consistent barrier to entry around her. 

But beyond that stern expression, lies a hidden passion that loves to talk about history and chronicle it for future generations. Despite her professional demeanor, she is a very outward and positive person.

Outside of her combat uniform, she wears a white blouse and a tight pencil skirt, paired with black nylon pantyhose and high heels. She cares greatly about her appearance, almost to a model-like sense, much to contrast with her mother, who couldn't care less.

She transforms into her combat uniform using a device, instantly donning a skin-tight vinyl dark blue bodysuit with glowing blue power cords stretching across her body, powering her weapon systems as well as regulating her body's condition.

Name: Mei-Mei (美美)
Known History:
Mei-Mei is the twin sister of Lei-Lei. She grew up with him under a cool old man she calls "Gong-Gong." He taught her how to fish, how to fight, and most importantly, how to play mahjong. She vows to be able to beat him in a game one day, and to do so (but also cause she was bored) she leaves to go on an adventure with her brother. After making one funny chaos formation, they end up in some trouble. 

Thankfully, a realmstorm saved the day! :D
Physical Description: Mei-Mei is a 5'8" Vanara girl with an incredibly light and nimble frame. With every step, she carries a natural, floral-toned scent of wild berries, matcha, and ginkgo leaves. Her hues of pink and purple clothes and fur ribbon downward and compliment her light brown skin.

Name: Meira Sarasti
Identity: Debt Collector Solving Problems With Time
Known History:
- Born in Helios, though moved to Haven

- Runs Sarasti Debt Collection in North Rock

- Anyone from more criminal backgrounds from Terra, ||can recognize her as someone who offers her services to various gangs or criminal organizations on the side.||

||A brutal debt collector who uses time to extract her price and more often than not a piece of their soul||
Physical Description:
Around 5 feet 9 inches tall, she wears casual clothing for someone from Terra, her hair kept in a double bun with smaller framed circular glasses worn never hiding her red eyes. 

She carries an umbrella and a shoulder bag with her at all times, but never actually openly armed.

Name: Mel
Known History:
Mel's from a carver family in the city of Brightshield, Kor'Tarion; a very much needed profession during its rebuilding. However, when she discovered a weak affinity to elemental magic Mel joined the city guard and only partially learned the family trade. She thought that, as long as the people in the city were safe, it would recover the wellness of the old days that old mans always moan about. 

She's learned to use the bow to fend off monsters, and also to pour her magic into crystal shards, which later imbue her arrows with elemental energies. And she's been of great help to fend off monsters threatening the city walls. 

However, Mel's yet to see any achievement significant enough for the people in the city. She understood that safety and time were not enough to bring people a brighter future, and that she'd need to do even more if she wished for it. 
Before she could even think of her next step, she found herself in the Worldhelm.
Physical Description:
Mel stands at a moderate height, around 1,75 cm. A dense high ponytail, woven with an intricate braid, showcases her striking yellowish orange hair, resembling that of a lion. Her brown eyes bear sparkling traces of yellow, showing to the future a bright view with optimism. 

She dresses in hot and sunny colors, which complement the looks of her hair and the little but furry tail on her back. Those colors exhibit her liveliness and her bright, positive view in life.

Name: Mel Monroe
Known History:
A retired monster hunter from Terra. Before ending her contract with PARABELLUM, she used to be one of their leading Hunters in the Battle Enforcement Division, but had to step out after her wife passed away.

Now, living her life as a widow in a corporate world, she tries to be her best self while living alone as an old woman.

However, as she was fighting a monster that invaded her neighborhood, after slicing through the creature, she was sent through a rift in reality into a flying ship above golden clouds.

It was time to take the dust off her old weapon, and bring back the meaning to her life.
Physical Description:
Melinda is a slim, tall and sharply dressed female human from Terra. Her white hair is often arranged in a high ponytail with little hair streaks by the side, hiding the handles of her round reading glasses she sometimes puts to good use.

Her style is often high class, after already having seen the lows of life, usually sporting a black tie as a habit from her monster hunting days at Parabellum. Her go to colors are white and black, matching her hair and overall personality.

A smile for the welcome, a fist for the wicked. This is the philosophy that has carried her for the last few decades, and will continue to until her last breath.

Name: Melinda Valentine
Known History:
Melinda was an activist that spoke out against the war in Lhodos. For this she was abducted and used as a guinea pig in Merrane's experiments for over a decade.

After many years Melinda is reunited with her child on the Worldhelm. The child she found has grown into a capable woman without her. Idyll made her realize Monique doesn't need her mother anymore. She would only slow her daughter down...
Physical Description: Melinda stands at 6'4" with pale skin and slender figure. Her short hair and eyes are white, a pair of fuzzy antennae sprouting from her head. She is often accompanied by a swarm of moths attracted to her like a flame.

Name: Melinoe
Known History:
Before Melinoe was born, the Village of Morde was under attack by a powerful Winter Fey called Meillath who wanted control of the town. The people, in desperation, made a deal with the fey, promising “All the love and joy they would have, and every wonderful sight they would ever see” of the next baby born in the village. In return Meillath would instead protect the village from other fey hoping to claim it and leave its inhabitants alone.

Melinoe was born with her sight taken by the fey, and the inability to feel any positive emotion. She had no last name, as she was in essence the savior of the village and claimed by all... and none of them. Growing up a pseudo outcast, when she was old enough she left to wander Kor’tarion rather than stay in a village. There she met wandering fey, and was taken in by them until ending up on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: A woman, with long tangled grey hair on her head that hangs down to her lower back. Her face is fair, and always emotionless. Her skin nearly snow white and pale, it even glistens a little like freshly fallen snow. The dress she wears a black combat dress with a short skirt with white frills. The black blindfold around her face is lacy and likely wouldn't block sight at all if she could see. A small cape wraps around her shoulder, that flutters around her.

Name: Melissa Reina
Age: Looks to be late 20s? Insolvent, so actual age unknown
Known History: A budding Chequeromancer in training and one of ETA’s most fanatical supporters, Melissa gave everything to the cause, even opting to volutarily enter insolvency to prove to herself and to other that it was the way forward. As one of the biggest up and coming soulrunners and her skillset into Chequeromancy, wealth came easily, and her insolvency almost became a null-issue. This left her with a broken view of insolvency, seeing it as simple and easily manageable, no matter what others said. Though she clung to her beliefs, she was swept up onto the Worldhelm, some say just weeks before her point of no return, before she became a corporate monster like so many others. Now she stands at the precipice, at the edge between her blind faith in the ETA propaganda and the cold realities of corporate life. Perhaps there are more out there willing to invest in such a “great opportunity” to become the best version of themselves, just as she still believes.
Physical Description: Melissa is a tall, curvaceous woman with the pale complexion, red eyes and fangs typical of the Insolvent. She favours high-class tailored outfits, switching between sharp suits and elegant dresses on a whim, each framing her long, raven black hair. She moves with the grace of someone born to power, her posture flawless, her steps measured, her body commanding the room, yet there is a warmth in her low, silken voice that leaves them wondering whether the cold, corporate monster is real outside of the exterior.

Name: Melody Chère
Known History: Melody lived a fairly isolated life, not stepping outside often or talking to people much. She mostly experimented with alchemy. Her family was always poor, but as she got older, they struggled more and more to make ends meet. Eventually, she decided to set up a small time potion shop to try to help them out. Some time later, her shop managed to attract a wealthy patron, which was great for a while, until she discovered that they were using her potions for rather shady operations. She cut off her dealings with them, and tried to work with law enforcement as best as she could to get them taken down, but they disappeared before she could. About a year later, while gathering ingredients in the wild, she got caught up in a realmstorm, which leaves her where she is today.
Physical Description: Melody is roughly average height (5'7" / ~170cm), with an almost unhealthily skinny build (104lbs / ~47kg). Her red hair is long and unkempt. Her clothes are always a mess, and much of her possessions have been patched up multiple times. She wears a dark purple robe, with pockets and a hood, and has a satchel at her side full of ingredients for her alchemy. She keeps a knife on her, as well as a crude bronze shield. She is always visibly tired.

Name: Mercedes Soto-Mendoza
Identity: New Hero Finding Her Own Way
Known History:
Mercy is a bit cagey about her past, but will freely share that she was born into the neighborhood Soledad Church on Mount Providence, near Haven. There she lived with her aunt and uncle, and worked repairing vehicles from a young age to help support the household. She had an older brother, Mateo, but he passed some few months ago.

Secretly, Mercy is the Blue Bolt, a dashing hero that's fought crime in Soledad Church for the past six years. She took on the mantle after Mateo, the original Blue Bolt, died in the line of duty.

In these past months aboard the Worldhelm she has performed acts of heroism across the realms as the Blue Bolt, but returns to her home regularly to protect it like her brother once did. She's also come to make friends she trusts with her secret identity.
Other Names:
Mercy 
Secret Identity: The Blue Bolt
Physical Description: Mercy is a young woman of a lean build that stands at 5' 8". She usually dresses for comfort over style, oft sporting a sweater, an old pair of sweatpants, and her favorite pair of slippers. The keen eyed might notice that her black hair and off-brown eyes are intermittently flecked with a blue-ish energy.

Name: Merlin Orien
Known History:
Born in Wimcomb, Merlin's youth was mostly ordinary. That ordinary life, though, would soon end with his being drafted into the Silverdale military, where his actions and conduct, or perhaps blind luck, caused him to develop a connection to the Longevity stone.

Having acquired this power and being determined to use it to help his home weather the calamity, he set off towards the Runewall, and ended up acquiring a mysterious cursed blade along the way.

[For a longer read, you can check here.](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mg6kcRaxn-jfxZehUzxbQzhYWdgZk_i5jHwL3TbTaI0/edit?usp=sharing)
Physical Description: Merlin stands at a modest 5'7'', sporting a lean but athletic build. Silver locks of hair fall from his head in a cascade, the shimmering grey hue giving way to a brighter, almost unnatural golden color as they reach past his shoulders. His usual outfit is designed to be deliberately flamboyant, mixing dusty yellow and bright lilac. The overcoat he wears on his shoulders serves a mostly stylistic purpose, but can double as protection from colder weathers if the occasion calls for it. Lastly, whenever his left arm is uncovered, it glows with pulsating golden energy, and has a somewhat ethereal quality to it.

Name: Merrick Wolfsgar
Known History: Merrick was a runemage of Vanagandr from Alidistir before falling on a battleground soaked in raining Godsblood.  Rather than succumbing to his infection then and there, he woke up on the Worldhelm, dazed and confused.
Physical Description: Merrick is a taller blonde human man with hazel eyes and a Godblood infection spreading across his body.  Some simple tattoos are visible from under his armor: celtic knots and valknuts alike.

Name: Mervei Retz-Yiloğan
Identity: The Fisher Who Became a Knight
Known History: Mervei grew up fishing with her father in Atreus. When she was a teenager, a sea monster and its brood attacked the Gulf, leaving her father mortally wounded as she fought off the monsters with a fishing spear. A knight of Daermon upon his drake rescued her from certain death, and she became a squire to their company. After a few years she was permitted to imprint upon a dragon hatchling, who was given the name Rhauzaten. Once she became a knight proper, the two began their work as protectors in earnest. When prophecy called for those to face the Runewall, she did so, taking the place of another knight. A quiet selfishness, a hope to find an answer to the Calamity that slew her father and so many others.
Physical Description:
Mervei is a dark tan-skinned young woman with curly brown hair and sharp, dark eyes. Her armor is of fine make, gold-toned and filigreed and worn atop a muscled figure. She often wields a spear in hand, utilized with deadly power and practice.

Rhauzaten is a heavy-set drake with scales the color of rust, arched horns, and massive wings. His tail is thick and deadly, heavily scaled at the end with protruding spines and built to be swung as a lethal weapon. His four legs are stocky with thick claws. There is a perpetual scent of salty sea about him, and... well, blood.

Name: Metztli
Identity: Daughter Holding Her Head Above Water
Known History:
Metztli was born in Aztlàn to a coven member on a full moon. In her developmental years she was relatively no more remarkable than an average newborn. Perhaps she had more of an innate connection to the possibility of magic but nothing truly of grand note. Still, she was was decided to take Greatmother Lorelei’s place once it was seen to be appropriate.

As soon as she was old enough to speak, she was pulled into partial isolation. Her first few years taken by Lorelei before Itzel took over as her mentor.

Once she was seen as grown, she was brought out of isolation promptly. Metztli was tasked to begin learning from the other covens as well, to prepare her for her role. There she began her studies by starting as a student of the Hermandad de las Estrellas. 

That was until she was pulled into being a Goldhearted.
Physical Description: A Woman with long dark hair and brown skin, dark fins decorate the side of her face. She often tries to hold some grace, but her emotions are often written across her expressions. Some dampness often clings to her skin and hair as well.

Name: Michael Adder
Known History:
- Born in the Kígyó tribe as Mihály Kovács, raised to be one of the Shapers
- Later joined the heretics and learned of the Forbidden Research, wanted to investigate theories on werewolves further
- Went to visit Ashreach to find information, took to living on the outskirts for his own salvaging
- At some point, found a discarded work harness and refurbished it to be used for protection, also incorporated silver elements to it to further restrain his transformation
Physical Description: Large 6'7" man, typically dressed in a hat and trenchcoat and usually reading a newspaper. Stony-faced and tends to speak in short sentences.

Name: Miguel Calavera
Known History:
Born marked by a demon due to a contract that his parents signed. However not wanting a child cursed by a demon they left him at the base of a coven that treated him with disdain outside of Aurora.

Left home after becoming 18 to per-sue answers on how to control his demonic magic and to help the dead pass on peacefully. Joined Marianna on her adventures as she too was letting spirits pass. On their travels they made contact and eventually a contract with the buffalo devil who tied their souls together to pursue their goals in tandem.
Physical Description:
A well kept multi piece suit with a big red bow tie and a large rounded hat. His clothes while black and white outside of the red bow tie and belt are embroidered with a golden trim to pop out and catch attention. 

They have long black hair which they put a lot of effort into keeping clean. On their back they have large black vulture wings marked by skulls that they keep tucked behind their back most of the time to not draw attention to it.

Name: Miike
Known History:
- Born to a clan of snow leopard yokai living around the Kullroc Glacier. The patches on her fur were seen as portentous.
- Taught her clan's techniques in illusions, symbols and fate magic, in order to aid them in hunting and avoiding danger.
- Her clan fell to misfortune when they were massacred by a horde of Draugr from the Blood Pools. She only managed to escape when the Realmstorm spirited her away.
- Since then, she has been trying to rebuild her life and find new friends on the Worldhelm. She even has a shop now!
Physical Description: Miike is a very large (3'2" at the shoulder) but lithe snow leopard (132 lbs), with mottled brown and black patches of fur dotting her spotted white coat. Said patches appear to be *drifting* across her fur over time, if one gets to watch her closely.

Name: Mika Uhara
Known History: Adopted daughter of a SWORD scientist, before she came to the Worldhelm she was heavily involved in RWO playtesting.
Physical Description:
A tall woman with Green hair. Her professional clothing is always worn exceptionally loose. Very rarely seen without a cigarette in her mouth.

She wields a weapon near twice her size like it was nothing. It is very concerning.

Name: Mikael Everest
Identity: Archivist Mage of Stories and Stars
Known History:
"I don't know much when I woke up but all I know is a someone gave me power and told me that there's a story out there for me" 

Mikael Woke up somewhere in Kor'Tarion with no knowledge on how he got there nor who he was before then. He was approached by a Cecrae who knew their story would end way too soon if they weren't given a blessing by them. After this as part of the universe's will he was taken to Hudal Academy and there many mages took him under their wing the more prominent being Secretary Wills who seemed to have a soft spot for the little guy but never really showed it outright, but thanks to them Mikael learnt Entropism. In this journey he met many other professors including the Environmental Professor Rowan whom left due to personal reason was what Mikael was told. As life continued on Mikael continued his studies learning about the worldhelm in the process thanks to some expeditions done by them. He would brave a realmstorm hoping to see one of many origins for stories.
Physical Description: A young Looking Rat Demihuman standing at 5'0 wearing either a casual looking dress or their mages robes and a hat, they have a deck of tarot cards in which depict the previous incarnations of the cecrae that blessed them when they woke up. They have black hair, fairish skin and a black rat tail that they use to carry things around. When Casting Mikael summons weapons and or entities via his arcanum cards that help harm or even heal members of the party.

Name: Mikail Aerlae
Known History:
* Mikail was born in Sandsailor's city,
* At young age he got interest for books,
* Being a human in Nezmira his access to books was short,
* Having no more options he started to steal them
* Quickly his talent for stealing was recognized by a group of pirates with the promise of giving him food and books he was recruited in a crew
* years passed and he was captured
* He lied about being the captain as thanks for his captain help giving her less time in jail,
* When he became 19 he was placed in the execution list
* There, in jail, at few days from his execution, he was transported to a different place, starting his adventure
Physical Description: He is a dark blue haired guy, with white skin and generally using pirate robes over his armor, his heights can be called short just being 5.5 feet, you can say he has an aura similar to that of a wise old man.

Name: Mikkel Oaks
Known History:
- Mikkel grew up poor, hunting rabbits and other small game. However, he could not afford a bow and arrows so he hunted with a wooden dagger.
- His home, Yorme was attacked by Merrane when he was 9.
- His entire family was killed, or they escaped and he will never find them.
- Mikkel was imprisioned by Merrane, shortly moved to the Great Monastery.
- Mikkel learned how to clean, cook, and fight from his mentor and the scholar Thorne.
- He ignored his mentor and went into the forbidden part of the library, learning Necromancy.
- Learning Necromancy was a part of his downfall. 3 years after reading these books, he became Grave-born.
- The Necromancy books that were locked away were, because, they messed with the person both physically and mentally.
- These books messed with his mind so badly, that he thought Thorne could not teach him anything anymore and left the Monastery.
Physical Description: A man with decent looking features, but ones that would allow him to blend into a crowd. He has bright blue eyes and dirty golden hair. His skin is weathered, with decent scaring. Mikkel stands before you at 5'9, weighing a lean 210lb.

Name: Milo Fleiss
Known History:
Riding a prototype motorcycle built by his father, Aravik Fleiss, Milo has been running messages between the Karlsgard Resistance and the city state since he was a kid. Only in recent years as the war has developed and in the wake of his fathers assassination, did he find himself joining the KPLA. He fought as a soldier, delivered messages, and so on, after leaving his family behind in a heated argument with his Mother and Sister.

Now he acts as the ace courier of the resistance, acting as their primary messenger, as well as a powerful soldier that can be used as a trump card against mobile enemies or ground forces. Though, he doesn't answer to anyone but the Crowndrake, despite the fact that he's only a Drake.
Physical Description: Milo is a lightly tan skinned man with blonde furred ears and shaggy hair, ending in a ponytail. He stands at 6 feet tall, 6'2'' with the ears. He's about 180 lbs. of muscle, but isn't the brightest. He finds himself in a constant state of brooding, with a resting glare. He hates this place, and the fighting it comes with, and he broadcasts that with his body language and his expression.

Name: Mimic
Identity: I am you, I am Them, We are Us
Known History: I was an apprentice to a shoemaker, I was the man on the side of the street looking for food, I was the local businessman making illegal trades. I was the old lady whom would feed the cats in the alleys, The knife in the dark who accepted much less pay for killing than most, The investigator who worked counteless extra hours because the people they wanted to protect. I am the soldier who fights for their home, The mentor to those in their time of needs. I am all of them. They are all me. We are us.
Physical Description: In long robes and garbs, face always hidden in shadow. Hands a dull almost claylike grey that form and morph to look like the hands and arms of others around them as they do things. Is exactly average height and weight. Varying slightly depending on the area they are in.

Name: Mimsim Samak
Known History:
Child of a family who trades aquatic goods in and out of Skuala, both through mercantile middlemanagement and the ownership of many fishermen. The Samak family treats those slaves with the standard one is to expect in Nezmira - a standard that Mimsim came to resent.
They speak out against this treatment and do what they can to thwart those who revel in it. This has often motivated them to light vigilantism with their implement of choice - an ordinary fishing rod.
Physical Description: A not-so-imposing nezzim. They're barely five feet tall, and carry a fishing rod of similar length instead of a weapon. Mimsim dresses in drab, baggy clothes that go well with their dusty scales and makes their bright yellow eyes stand out.

Name: Miruna 'Rue Dzata
Identity: A daughter of Akala, instrument of fear
Known History:
- Born into the Dzata family, the closest thing to a noble or royal house in Akala city, mama is Dzata and mother a warden from Heartdom.

- Was more protected than most Dreadlan people, protected by her status, her three eyes, and her parents, but in a place where might makes right she quickly discovered that she needed to hold her own somehow.

- Was sent to Gnosis academy to grow stronger and become the best Paladin she could.

- Became a Regalia :)
Physical Description:
Pale, with blue eyes, blue hair, even a natural blue tint to her lips. her pointed ears and her third eye hidden half way behind her bangs betraying her not completely human origins. 
Always dressed smartly, and with a posture that takes advantage of every inch of her 5' nothing stature.

Name: Mitaria
Identity: Sellsword from an old and forgotten army
Known History: Lost after a battle that saw many of his fellow soldiers fall overwhelming odds, Mitaria wandered, or at least attempt to wander back home only to find those seeing a his tattered uniform as the sign of a defeated loser. With little to no sympathy to his plight, Mitaria became a wandering mercenary for his services. Sometimes playing bodyguard, other times playing a cold hearted assassin, Mitaria gazes ever so often at the tattered feather on his helmet as it wanes and becomes more tattered as his wandering continues, forgetting the color it once was that adorned his proud head. That head now feels heavy with uncertainty and loss as he finds it harder to motivate himself to still use his skills he learned in the military each time he is hired for a job. Surely duty can still be found when one's banner is burned to ash to match the shade of color left in his very eyes.

Name: Mitchell Quill
Known History: Very few know Mitchell Quill, the self-proclaimed "greatest novelist of all time". Those who do, however, know that he's a remarkably poor writer with little to no sales, who uses any rumors about recent adventures to write stories about a self-inserted unnamed antihero. Even fewer know about his interest in entropic magic, and even fewer still know that his delusions led him far enough to purchase a crossbow and start going on his own "adventures". What no one knows, however, is that during a rainstorm, he got struck by a lightning in the middle of the woods and sucked in by the Realmstorm, which, to his surprise, got him aboard the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: A rather tall man with average body complexity, standing 6'2" and weighing 168 lbs, sporting short dark brown hair and sky blue eyes, Mitchell is almost always seen wearing black. From the fedora hat to the his beloved trenchcoat, partially fingerless gloves and pants, down to the lightweight boots. The only glimpse of another color can be seen in the underlying shirt. He always carries a small leather bag with a notebook and writing utilities, usually a quill and some ink.

Name: Mitsuhime
Identity: Shrine Maiden heir of the sun goddess' teachings.
Known History:
*Born in Sakai as a descendant of one of Amaterasu's  emissaries' who fell in love with a human.

*Raised by a small group of people still loyal to the Sun Goddess and was taught healing and cleansing rituals since an early age.

*Was tasked to help safekeeping her community's last remaining sacred sites from evil spirits as well as heal the wounded. 

*Mitsuhime is a firm believer the Sun will shine once again and vowed to do her best to keep people's hope alive.
Origin: Tei Sei - Sakai - Shirasagi Glade Shrine
Physical Description: A petite woman with white hair, amber eyes and delicate features. Always wearing either priestess's robes or traditional Tei Sei's long sleeved kimono, Mitsuhime has an air of serene grace and a kind expression. If her ethereal aura is not enough to convince you of her youkai heritage, the large white wings on her back certainly will.

Name: Mizuki
Known History:
Mizuki was left in the Temple of Hotei as a toddler after her family could no longer deal with their daughter’s awakening powers as a medium. This temple taught her to control those powers as well as prepared for her role as a shrine maiden in the future. During this time she still struggled to connect with other normal people, having few friends among the other orphans in the temple.

Later, when she reached her majority, she was taken in by the Konoe clan, as a gift to Shion Konoe, one who shared her powers and was a well known exorcist in the region. She works under her new teacher at the temple of Izanami in Mugestu, learning the trade of the exorcist under their careful, and often harsh, eyes.
Physical Description: Mizuki is a thin young woman of around 5’2” in height with long straight black hair that falls down to her lower back. Her eyes are a deep crimson that almost seems to glow when she taps into her powers as a medium. Usually she is dressed in Miko robes befitting her current station as a shrine maiden of Izanami.

Name: Mokah
Identity: Shaman of the wilds and beacon to the lost
Known History:
When one travels the western region of Aldistir, they may come across a silent cloaked yokai.  This figure would use the bells on their staff to get the traveler's attention, and then guide them safely through the wilderness towards nearby villages and towns, vanishing without a word once their job is done.  Mocah lost their parents to a blizzard when they were younger, and chose to become a guide, helping the lost in the best way they can.  Too shy to speak to most people, they usually gesture with their staff in order to communicate.  Mocah lives alone in a hut in the Silver Spire mountains.  A follower of the Aesir Seraph, they're a small kindness in the harsh lands of Aldistir.

After losing their best friend.  Mokah called upon the spirits of the Sea of Blizzards for an ally, needing to become stronger.  They were answered by Vigdis, an ice spirit.

Mokah later joined with Tzera, Raia, and Neishin to become part of a Coven to protect Aldistir.
Physical Description:
Mokah is a small rabbit yokai with white fur covering their body, occassionally with spots of blonde and grey. They're usually fully covered by several layers of cloaks, mittens, boots, and a wooden mask. They carry a black staff with several small bells on the top. They're typically shy and say little, and can move very quietly.

They are accompanied by Vigdis, an ice spirit in the shape of an owl.

Name: Monique
Identity: Cunning Trickster of the Smokey Slums
Known History:
• Monique was raised as a son of a thief in Smokeside, Hidela, after her mother disappeared 11 years ago.

• During a change of heart, she suffered a horrible accident in the middle ground from a landmine. Her father decided to leave her in the hopes that the Merrani that found her would give her a better life and away from his crime. He believed her dead after, something he regretted everyday. She survived, but lost her legs in the accident.

• Despite being a ne'er do well in general, the people of Hidela committed to her recovery, and with their help and ingenuity she relearned how to walk.

• Once she recovered, she took on a new name and new look, promising to be her authentic self and repaying the kindness of those around her forward. During her adventures, she discovered a new companion, Monique Halcyon, her soul treasure.

• After a long grueling journey of self discovery and self love, she has found belonging in the Worldhelm. As well as made peace with her disparate families.
Physical Description:
Monique is a woman with a staggeringly beautiful complexion, she has soft skin that holds a nice porcelain white. Her garbs are a mix of flashy and stylish streetwear and functional skullduggery gear. Keeping things cute and crafty. Her hair is a sea foam blue with a mix of her previous pink. An acknowledgement of both her previous appearance, and her old one.

She wears her father's old dated brown cloak. She also wears her old circular glasses that she had thrown off ever since she lost her soul treasure. One eye glimmers with a familiar celestial white of her twin. While the other gleans with a passionate pink.

Her eyes are like that of her fathers, cunning and determined.

Her face is dotted with a beauty mark. 

She is roughly 5'9, with an lithe figured that is practiced and toned.

Name: Moranoe
Identity: Dragon Maid who wishes to become a Knight
Known History: Wielding the sword and armor of the Hero of Old, Lumina, she wanders the Realms in search of Dragons to slay, all the while being a polite maid to those who need it!
Physical Description: A charming girl with dragon traits. She spots light green scales and horn nubs, the same color as her hair. She also has an extremely large and long tail. Her eyes are golden with dark vertical pupils.

Name: Morgana
Known History:
Once the guardian a sacred grove in Deleria, Morgana bore witness to many of the Dreamites' greatest stories. That's in the past now; the Brecilient, along with the rest of Deleria, is no more.

When the people of Deleria were reborn from Wulfric's dreams, Morgana stayed aslumber even as the others awoke; Regus had erased the pain of what they'd lost, but Morgana? They had lost it all, their identity inseparable from a home that no longer existed.

It was only when memory began to return to the Dreamites that Morgana awoke. For weeks, they were consumed with grief, refusing to leave the Castle's garden. But when Ladon reappeared to defy the Fate of Heaven, something stirred in her heart.

*"I am an echo, a memory of a being created to guard a place that no longer exists. I am nothing. I am not real. And yet; I **am.** I live. I breathe. I dream. And I **refuse** to let it all be for naught."*
Physical Description: A four-legged, rabbit-like creature, standing at around 3 ft at the shoulder and measuring 5 ft from nose to tail. It sports snow-white fur, pale gray eyes, and long lop ears, and its brow and left tight are adorned with vines and flowers, serving as their Floralist's Garden.

Name: Morgia Sophus
Known History:
Morgia was born as a normal human, however her heart contains a fire-attuned moonshard. Forcibly changing her form into part flame dragon. If one were to put out the flames or remove it, it's speculated she would die. 

Morgia was raised by a priest who worships Caladrius. Living in a cabin all the way out in the Farwood in near isolation. Raising her into becoming a young woman who devotes herself into healing magic, as well as apothecary.

However, recent events has forcibly removed the moonshard. Thusly her flame traits have faded away. Relying on her faith, her knowledge of medicines from multiple realms, and her resourcefulness.

But after remerging back with her Soul Treasure, she returns back to her original form. Visibly much happier nowadays.
Physical Description: A woman who stands at 5'6" ft/167 cm, with long, platinum blonde hair and green eyes. Now recently picking up a set of blue and white robes that she sewn herself one day. She has draconic horns, a large tail with fire lit at the tip, and her chest glows a fiery glow. Dressed in a white dress and carries a staff.

Name: Mori Cadwal
Known History:
Born and raised in Brightshield, Mori spent much of her life wishing she was somewhere else; jaded with urban living and desperate to see what else the world held. This made her easy prey for the fae that abducted her.

The Veiled Stewards, as they called themselves, insisted that they were doing her a favour when they stole her from her home and reshaped her into something new. She spent her next years in their "Menagerie", kept within a gilded cage to sing for strange fae nobles, all while yearning for her freedom.

Her chance came when one of the Stewards' new "catches" proved to be too much for them to handle, and she escaped in the ensuing chaos. When she returned to the mortal world, she found that only months had passed. Her family, wary and distrustful of everything the fae touched, rejected her for what she had become.

Torn between two worlds and truly at home in neither, Mori sought out work as a courier, hoping it would provide her the feeling of freedom she yearned for.
Physical Description: A short, scrawny young woman with tan skin. She sports white feathers over much of her body and two large, flight-capable wings, along with other avian and inhuman features, such as talons and sharpened teeth. She favours light, practical clothing.

Name: Moritz Von-Suntower
Known History: Moritz Von-Suntower is a Vale refugee and ex-Merrani Angel who was adopted by the retired General Charlotte Von-Hardwick. After a silent graduation from the WWA, he's had experience as a Strategic Supervisor under Commander Hailey Bennett, Commander Erich Valn, and now Prince Damian Von-Suntower. After Suntower's succession, he works at the First Knight of Suntower, swearing to make every one of his prince's (and his sister's) dream for Lhodos come true! He can see the future of the people, and it is a bright one. Even if he is shrouded in darkness, that just makes the light that much brighter.
Physical Description:
5'7" | 151 lbs. | Silver Eyes
Moritz is a felkin man with a perpetual smile on his face. His healthy, live frame hosts twitchy ears and flickering silver eyes. A faint apple, cinnamon, and lavender tone wafts around him. When compared to his first arrival on the ship, he his happy, healthy, and particularly clean looking, despite being on edge.

Name: Mort VanSigil
Known History:
-Mort only has hazy memories of his early life and his apprenticeship with a Symbolist
-His mentor eventually left and Mort stayed by the academy in Kor'Tarion to continue learning Symbolism and how to tap in the colors of the world
-While not  teacher students at the academy were sent to Mort for an introduction to Symbolism and their magics
-Now Travels in search of something that he can not name
Physical Description:
-Slender built man at about 5'6" with Auburn hair and hazel eyes
