Known History: Born in Sampaguita Village, Petra was lead to fear the demon, and seek a nice and quiet life. Despite her best efforts, trouble would always find her, which lead her to seek cultivation. In mastering her own body and spirit, she found herself with a natural affinity for Demons, or Yawa. With this affinity, she bound a lesser trickster demon to her will, and now roams the land to do as much good as she can with her wicked power.
Physical Description: 5'6, Light for her height, Petra sports a somewhat lanky lean build, but is covered in cyan tattoos that crawl all the way up to her neck. She does not think herself worthy to cover her face in tattoos as of yet, she has not become a true warrior yet.

Name: Petra (#2)
Identity: The Bestest and Most Dangerous Wild Wolf
Known History: During Petra's Winged Pilgrimage, herself and several others were separated from the rest of the Solyom due to an attack by another tribe.  The youngest out of the survivors,  Petra and the rest of her group were unable to reunite with the tribe, and had to survive on their own for several years.  One day, a group of rogue SIA agents captured Petra, and instead of handing her over to the agency, kept her for study.  Petra was rescued by an SIA agent named Cordelia Hartwood.  Not knowing which of Myists many forests was her home, Petra stays by Corde's side for the time being, hoping to find her family one day.  She currently helps out with the SIA.
Physical Description: Petra is a short, young woman with wild black hair and green eyes.  She often runs around on all fours.  She has a cheerful personality but tends to bite people.  Transformed, she grows to over 7 feet tall, grows thick black fur, and takes on a far more monstrous wolflike appearance.  Her clothing is ragged and clearly scavenged.

Name: Phoebe
Identity: A Pair Pursuing a Better Tomorrow
Known History:
- Once a loyal officer of Merrane, she was given a demon originating from Designation: Seraph.

- For her safety and from orders, her demon wiped her memories.

- After a confrontation within the Soul Network she regained those memories and purified her Mind Demon

- Phoebe and her demon now stride to a better tomorrow. Uncaring of anything that may attempt to hinder them.

- Now after freeing Designation: Seraph. Phoebe now strives to make the realms a better place for tomorrow.
Physical Description: Phoebe is a 5'2" human woman. She has black long hair with some scars upon her head. She wears a simple outfit with suspenders. With her whenever at the Worldhelm she holds a mech, though not able to be operated at this time, it appears a Merrane ace and has been dubbed "Stolen Valor".  On the left chest of the mech, there is a purple heart sprayed onto it. As a memory of her final medal before the surgery.

Name: Phoebus "Fee" Scium
Known History:
Phoebus has always liked trying to understand things, so why not try to make money doing what he loved?

Unfortunately for him, he was banned from the Academy after his internal stores of magic were too weak to let him do any subtantial magick. His saving grace came in a sudden flagship project while he worked as a theoretical arcane contractor. The deck of cards that suddenly appeared in a wayward person's home, filled with latent magic activated by games of chance became a recent obsession to find other forms of magic that he can control outside of his own aetherial stores. He finds the charisma to be granted permission to do a longer study involving personal usage. To continue such a venture, he takes on separate projects to keep up funding.
Physical Description: Average build. 5'10 (177cm), dark brown skin, braids and cornrows. Always wearing some sort of overcoat.

Name: Phor
Known History: Phor was born near Hyacinthus Village. He took up an apprenticeship as an herbalist and earned his keep gathering herbs in the nearby forests. One day, while gathering herbs with his teacher and fellow apprentice, his normal routine turned to horror as a rogue group of monsters attacked. Saved by a group of wandering adventurers, Phor was the sole survivor. He was devastated by his own helplessness in the face of danger, having watched the people closest to him die before his very eyes. After he recovered, he studied magic as he swore to himself that he would never have to see this happen again.
Physical Description:
Phor is a 5'2'' Faetouched with White hair and a small pair of goat horns atop his head. His slight build makes him seem fragile even for his size. 
He always carries a worn-looking satchel on him and smells faintly of herbs.

Name: Pierre Galois
Known History:
The former youngest heir to House Galois, Pierre is most known for starting a major scandal to his own house by speaking out against the major houses of Belfrost for ignoring the plights of the common people. 

With his family rapidly moving to exile him Pierre left taking with him The Vituroso, a rapier that was passed down in the House Galois family. 

While now wanted by Belfrost, Pierre is still also being hunted by his own family and others who would desire his weapon so he set off to the Runewall to gain feats worthy enough and strong enough to one day return to Belfrost.
Physical Description: A very young looking man wearing the classical Silverdale noble attire modified for dueling and carrying a elegent rapier.

Name: Poppy Sparks
Known History:
To anyone that looks her up, they would identify her as a student currently attending one of Lumina Prime's prestigious universities via scholarship. However, she would be seen usually alone and is described to be a recluse. Having trouble speaking up when spoken.

Another thing that would be noted was her magic seems to be monitored constantly by QiLink, and periodically has semi-weekly visits to a QiLink-affiliated doctor to check on her. As her magic requires to be suppressed to avoid causing trouble.

Occasionally can be seen working part time at a coffee shop.
Physical Description:
Poppy stands at 5'0", with long pink hair that is usually tied in a braid held by a ribbon and a headband. Her feline ears curved down, and her pink tail swaying with a darker color at the tip. Shy, innocent, and yellow eyes darting around would be what people would see when they look at her. Typically dressed in casual Terran attire, with a skirt, pink jacket and a backpack.

Poppy's vocal pitch is considerably soft. She has trouble maintaining eye contact in conversations, and stutters in her speech. Her emotional state is telegraphed in her motions and tone, such as slumping when feeling down. One can rightfully assume she wears her heart on her sleeve.

Name: Primrose
Known History: Primrose and her family were once comfortable enough in South Silver Rock. Her hobby was dancing, both artful and new, and it was her life until an unfortunate accident paralyzed her from the waist down, stealing her mobility. Her parents urged her get surgery to install tech and grant her access back to her life's love even if it would put them back several steps in their financial security. Working to repay the debt for her family, Primrose took on what jobs she could as a courier, especially if the money was good, until one day her coveted cargo made her a target. Attacked by gang members, they took their haul and ripped the tech out of her that granted her mobility and threw her down an open chasm unknowingly into something old and ancient. Whatever was down that chasm, however, is what granted her new life. And so, she's back, ready to repay DHK and those gangs for their exploits. To be their problem as much as they've been hers.
Physical Description: A 5'5'' petite young woman with pale yet pink-toned skin that's soft to the touch like flower petals, yet with dark veins here or there. Dark red scleras make the bright burning pink of her irises stand out from beneath her equally bright pink head of hair with ends that fade into remnants of her blonde hair that's tied into high pigtails trailing from thorn-wrapped buns. Fingers are pointed into sharp wood-like tips, and thorns dot up and down her spine from beneath her skin-snug white clothing and her favorite luminescent jacket.

Name: Priscilla
Known History: A devout priestess to the Theocratic Monarchy of Merrane, until her belief structure was upended by the Worldhelm itself. Other than spreading her religion priestess primarily tends to take advanced courses to act as coordinators that help and guide Merrane Angels in combat. As such she has been more known to coordinate and command despite assuming a visage of a healer. Very curious about the people of the Worldhelm and these other realms she had no idea existed before her arrival, it has also caused her to question the breadth of power the divine actually controls. Intensely curious, she seeks answers to many questions as she travels and learns of all realms.
Physical Description: A short unassuming-looking blind girl, usually garbed in a white veiled priestess outfit.  Most notable are her clouded pink eyes, unable to see naturally.  Despite this, she has a knack for fashion and can also be seen as a realm-specific dress of different types. She holds a white cane that looks like a complex technological key.

Name: Prof. Elvis Alden
Known History:
Elvis will humbly share that he is a former scholar of Hudal Academy. He will perhaps overshare that besides that he has accomplished remarkably little otherwise, especially socially. This is due to having quickly developed into a total shut in who did nothing but study for upwards of a decade. A period of his life he is not... proud of.

Now however after his time exploring and growing Elvis is a man he can be proud of, and has taken a position as a Professor at Hudal Academy, not yet permanent, but once things settle...
Physical Description: A tall, gangly and all too pale Elven fellow. His notable features are his somewhat feminine face, and his absolutely absurd bundle of fluffy red hair.

Name: Professor Ozu
Identity: Wandering Spider With An Endless Hunger
Known History:
Some have seen him travelling around with his companions in their caravan amongst the Kabiya. His companions sell various wares to villages and other Kabiya. He in particular is the alchemy vendor, selling various pills of healing and remedies. Some have referred to him as the Wandering Spider, others who have gotten to speak with him call him Professor Ozu, and the ones closest to him just call him Ozu.

He has study and practices cultivation of Void, Alchemy, and Web Qi. He has taken up Aria as his pupil and is training her in the ways of Cultivation. His goals are to continue the research of remedies and aids to fight against the new reality of Tian Yin in hopes of being able to live without fear.
Physical Description: A masked man clothed from head to toe. His outfit is a mix of light grey and purple with accents of gold throughout. The most obvious things about him is the giant Spider symbol on his chest. He has a slim, but not too thin of a frame. His baggy clothes hide the true physique underneath.

Name: Professor Sigma
Known History:
A man fitting Sigma's description was once a professor at one of the universities around Haven, with a research focus on both physics and meta-physics. Said man used to go by the name Logan Briar, but has since seemingly retired. Said knowledge is likely only relevant to those that studied under him, or those that dig quite deep, though.

Sigma has for quite a few years now been working within PARABELLUM's R&D branch. Eventually, he submitted designs for a Suppression & Immobilization Guardian Mobile Apparatus, a S.I.G.M.A. suit. The design was approved, Sigma was granted his codename and permitted its use.

Sigma's role was still mainly that of a researcher, though with the added responsibility of being a containment specialist that protects employees and occasionally accompanies BED on capture missions, though mostly to help with post-capture containment.

Sigma was last assigned to a lunar mission to aid with an entity's capture, but has since been declared MIA.
Physical Description:
6'2'' man with messy black hair, pale skin, and heavy bags under his eyes. Clearly has the dress-code of an academic that contrasts with the build of an Athlete. Always seen dressed in a suit and tie if he can help it, with a labcoat that stays on top at all times- though it's disheveled enough to not be up to par in a lab environment.

His spine is pronounced to an unrealistic degree, as on his back usually is a compressed S.I.G.M.A. suit; a black, blue and white exosuit that integrates his normal suit and labcoat into its look.

Name: Qu Fuling
Known History:
Qu Fuling used to be a statue of the Kami Jizou near the village of Hanae. One day, the curse Yato no Kami manifested in a young red-headed boy who used to use the statue for protection together with his brother Kidomaru, but when he grew to adulthood, the protection of the statue was gone. The statue animated then, but the now Qu Fuling was too weak to do anything but send him "on a different road", which even then drained all of her powers related to the domain of "Road".

She spent a few months afterwards cultivating to delay her return into the statue, until the ship picked her up to help people of the many realms.
Physical Description: A daintly pale beauty with long black hair. She is 5ft 4' and thin. She dresses in greens and whites, often wearing a white veil covering lower half of her face. Her skin is cold and almost like stone to touch, and careful observation will reveal that parts of her skin are in fact white jade rather than skin.

Name: Quill Iburri
Known History:
A stray fox from the Iburri Coven. He seems like a black sheep among foxes, boisterous and forward and always wandering; he usually relies more on his archery and his wit than his magic, too.

He travels the Firwood now, seeking thrill and fame and good deeds in equal measure to protect and inspire his fellow kinfolk.
Physical Description: A lithe fox who stands proudly 4'3" with a bright coat and dull green eyes. He's dressed nice-ish, in clothes that have clearly been worn many times and to many places; a fiddle and a bow rest with equal importance on his back. He hardly ever seems anything but relaxed.

Name: Quincy Ashlock
Known History: Known daughter and heir of a minor company beneath Lorel.AI. Besides that some people invested in the inter-workings of Lorel.AI would recognize the experimental nature of her wings. Now a known temp working within Haven and the nearby cities with a Lorel.AI temp license with the callsign of "Guardian Angel".
Physical Description: Quincy is a red headed, and rebellious individual. Standing roughly at 5'7 she is usually seen with spray paint stains on her clothing or hands. Materialized fragments of the soul network float around her and form a shape akin to wings behind her back. Besides for her youngish appearance and the soul network fragments she seems to have nothing very notable about her. Usually having a temp license hanging from the front of her shirt given by Lorel.AI. (Everything else is as shown in art)

Name: Quivira
Identity: Devout duelist inventor from the high academy
Known History: she was born and raise in Korala and move to Caldera to study at the high academy, after graduated she focus on very kinds of games right now she focus on cards.
Physical Description: She is a girl with blue cloths, silver hair and a cute hat. she really likes any kinds of games but she likes to win even more.

Name: RVN-H1 "Reaver"
Known History:
* A street kid from the Outer Ring, he traded his identity and much of his biology out for metal, success and a shot at the good life. 
* Burned his memories of harder times away, but shadows of his own past linger in his instincts and sympathies, mistrusts and mannerisms.
* To date, seems unconvinced by the sanctity of a particular magic bunny and holier-than-thou attitudes of some Goldhearted, but he always has his crew's back regardless.
* Highlight reels of Reaver dunking and styling on Moonfallen and other twisted abominations throughout Termina City, along with a live recording of his crew duking it out with the Hound have gone viral. Founded Wildcard™ off the back of this.
* To some on Terra, a successful streamer's still just a streamer though.
* Sides instinctively with the poor, downtrodden, criminals, and anyone who's down to risk everything for the dub.
Physical Description:
He is a forged likeness of some human ideal, with a million-zenny smile and aura self-assured enough to mog fake temps and soft, squishy meatbags into desperation bonesmashing.

Cybernetic enhancements pulse, blink, and scan his immediate surroundings, at least one often indicating that all he does is a moment from being clipped for the next upcoming highlight reel that posterizes the opps. 

A barcode and a **777LC™** logo are emblazoned beneath his technological, glowing-red left eye.

Name: Rachael
Identity: Sequestered Scholar Finding Sanctuary in Slumber
Known History:
- A Figure rarely seen by other Dreamites, any that would know of her from Castle Ladon would mostly identify her as the Archmage's Apprentice.

- She has a tendency to be quite timid, and skittish. And so not much is known about her besides the rarity of her appearances. She is an extremely rare sight, only appearing once or twice from her where she calls home during her two years as the Archmage Regus' Apprentice

- She says with reluctance that she's here to help learn to control her magic involving dreams, and to continue to develop her aptitude as Regus' Apprentice. She keeps a dragon backpack close to her at all times.

- She is very adverse to going out into the world after her long solitude, but has deemed her task too important to hide away despite her fear.
Physical Description:
Rachael is a 4'11 short and stocky woman, having many prominent features that are sheep-eqsue. Her arms and legs up to the lower thigh are covered in soft plush wool that she regularly grooms to keep fluffy. Her hair shares a lot of similarities to the wool, though is less dense.

On her head are two spiraling heavy horns. She wears quite fine looking robes that hold markings of the Archmage Regus, and on her back is a backpack sewn to look like a dragon, it has the size of a backpack one would give for a child.

Otherwise, on her hip, she holds a tome bearing Regus' Symbol which she regularly flips through absentmindedly.

Name: Rahim
Identity: Discarded Mutant on a Journey of Self Discovery
Known History: A slave living in The Last Hold of the Nezmira Empire and a victim of the Empire's disregard for human life. He was abducted by scholars and was used as a test subject.  In his confinement, he was force-fed Kiir  parts and Kiir blood to figure out its effects on Humans.  During one of the experiments, he manifested mutations which allowed him to escape the facility. He survived but  not unscathed - the experiments resulted in both his body and his mind being damaged resulting to permanent mutations on his body and amnesia.  Deformed and mentally scarred from the experience, he currently roams as an escapee, he seeks to figure out his true identity and the truth about what happened to him. The only thing he knows about himself is what he assumes to be his name written in a band attached to his legs.
Physical Description:
Hair: Brown
Eyes: Black
Skin: Brown
Height: 172 cm (5'8")

A young man with simple clothes often wearing a cloak or poncho to hide his disfigured arms and scarred body.

He often carries a blank expression as if in contemplation most of the time. Although, he also shows a friendly demeanor to offset the quite scary nature of his mutations.

Name: Raia
Identity: A Shaman Kitsune who loves Cooking
Known History: A yokai who had partaken in the war of the Fox and Hound. But he is known for using his foxfire to create campfires, cooking for the local community and providing bits of joy whenever he can.
Physical Description:
Raia is 5'10" (178cm) tall with a very fit body. White hair that ends on his shoulders, icy blue eyes, fox ears with gray tips, and a noticeably large tail that is very soft to the touch. Along with red highlights that radiate traces of magic.

He currently a set of white and red kimono robes, with black fur trim around his neck. Usually wears a smile on his face when in safe company.

Name: Rain
Known History: Not much is known about Rain besides that she has strange shields and that she appears to be a prisoner(?) of some kind back in Terra, she doesn't seem that keen on talking about the past and often walks away swiftly when approached by the topic.
Physical Description:
Standing about 5 feet tall, Rain has a rather frail appearance. Wearing a ragged yet refined white dress and obstructing black shackles from her wrists, ankles, torso, and neck that seem to glow a dark redish hue from time to time. Having feline traits, Rain has two cat ears instead of normal human ears and a cat's tail that normally sways rather lively since coming to the Worldhelm. 

Besides her physical appearance, her shackles seem to construct two blackish red crystalline shields that protect Rain from any danger that approaches her. She is often spotted laying on top of one of her shields from time to time as it flies around the Worldhelm, like a sleeping cat on top of a moving box.

Name: Raine Levia
Known History: A gifted Soulrunner from Terra who rose to become a "cyber medic" for PARABELLUM, fighting Daemons within the Soul Network and supporting her coworkers outside. With her knowledge and close affinity of the Soul Network, she often targets other companies and hackers, claiming to be a guardian of the "forest" she holds such a close connection to. She desires to bring order back to the realms and acquire more power to protect the home she holds most dear.
Physical Description: A petit Septid of 4'3" and very slender build. She has long flowing lavender hair tied into loops and pigtails with piercing red eyes. She typically wears an oversized medic's cloak adorned with metallic blue decorations and patterns and a long red ribbon wrapped around her neck. Her body is coated in light green, mint colored scales, with a thick lizard-like tail trailing behind her.

Name: Rajke Kolev
Known History:
A leirsin of the deserts of Grestazs, Rajke was born to desert huntsmen. A love for heroics was instilled in him at a young age, with his parents making up tales of the World Heirs. His father had a talent in druidic magic and his mother was a warrior, skills both taught him. 

When his parents disappeared into a haunted storm, he convinced himself that this was simply the start of his own trials. He honed his skills defending travelers and traders through the desert. When his efforts allowed him to eventually merge with Desire's Arcana, he was convinced he was on the right track. 

When he felt he was ready, he traveled to Wulforh thinking to become a successor of Desire. When this failed, he was already so set in his conviction that he told himself he just hadn't tried or wanted it hard enough. Hearing of the expedition into the Runewall gathering in his homeland, he raced back, telling himself all the while: THIS was his ascent to greatness, surely. He just had to want it enough.
Physical Description: A well-muscled Leirisn, Rajke is of roughly average height with a clearly athletic build. A pair of alert, rounded ears atop his head are partially buried under a mane of messy dark brown hair descending to his shoulders, often interwoven with a few pieces of tasseled jewelry. His dark skin across his body and equally dark fur on his ears, clawed hands, and long, patterned tail harken to his desert-dwelling homeland. A pair of fangs are occasionally visible when he smiles wider than the cocky grin he typically has. His clothing is often casual and loose but, like himself, well-maintained and well-groomed. He carries himself with a calm and confident ease, but there is a distinct hunger burning in his mismatched, heterochromic brown and gold eyes.

Name: Rama (राम) Huracupriya
Known History:
A Slayer born under the blessing of the Second Grave, after Rama left the Shiva Tribe she quickly began making a name for herself through hunting beasts and wanted criminals.

Rama is also known for being a rather greedy person, often times taking unnecessary risk for just a couple of additional zenits. At the same time, she also yearns for worthy challenges, and has been referred to as an "adrenaline addict" on multiple occasions.

Strangely enough, even though Rama is often seen gaining large profits, she doesn't live lavishly and instead prefers to humbly wander Aranova in search of her next target or adventure.
Physical Description:
A rather tall and agile girl, Rama stands at 5'9'', with light dark skin and pale blonde hair. Her right eye is blind, with a scar through it, a wound taken in battle.

Rama usually wears large green ponchos or cloaks, usually to resist the strong currents of wind she rides using her blessing.

Name: Ranmaru
Identity: Adroit Fox with a Hero's Mask
Known History: An exile from his people in the Farwood after his faith in Kuzunoha grew too doubtful. He speaks just as fondly of his early days with the yokai there as he does of the time he spent wandering alone.
Physical Description: Ranmaru is 5'7, and hides a lithe figure beneath heavy cold-weather dress he doesn't seem to want to depart from. His faceless mask is supernaturally expressive, eyes moving like lights, and it never comes off. That, his clothes, and his wild white hair that is only sometimes tied into order leave no skin visible most of the time.

Name: Raphaël
Known History:
- Born in Melery, Rocade.
- Weak of constitution since childhood, Raphaël found solace in his loving parents and his best friend Sacha.
- Taken on a ten-year pilgrimage to the Longevity Stone at 12 with his parents to find a means of curing his constitution.
- Over the ten years he remained at the Longevity Stone, he dedicated himself to intensive study and ultimately underwent a trial given by the Beacon. He passed, and was gifted a portion of the stone’s magic.
- When he returned, his condition had not been cured, but he gained a passion for healing the sick.
- His gifts from the Longevity Stone and his Leirsin foresight allow him not only to heal, but to turn the tables on those who inflict harm and suffering, weakening the oppressors with inverted healing magic.
- Now on another pilgrimage with Sacha to the Runewall, aiding the group as both healer and seer.
Physical Description: A smallish, frail-looking Leirsin man with olive-toned skin and soft, amber eyes. Born with a weak constitution, he suffered constant illness in his childhood, though his Longevity-given power has at least stabilized his physical condition.

Name: Rasho Tenderfoot
Identity: The Mighty Dam Shielding the Weak
Known History:
Rasho is the last of his blood. He lost everything as a young pup in what he refers to as "The Silent Night". He carries the scars as a constant reminder of what he is fighting for. He  greets companions with a smile and evil with an axe! Those who have come under the protection of his shield will remember The Dam and those who threaten Hearthhome will suffer the crushing weight of it. 

If you can't find him standing watch you will probably find him enjoying a nice bowl of Crawfish stew.
Physical Description:
Height: An astonishing 4ft!

Weight: 100lbs of pure fur, muscle and heart!

Rasho has deep black fur, broad shoulders and a smile that brightens even the blackest of nights. His golden honeyed eyes can be seen from atop the walls as he stands guard.  He carries three vertical scars across his left eye and one on his cheek.

Name: Ray Midnight
Known History:
Member of a Travelling Carnival/ Circus/very large extended family
Midnight Carnival
“Everyone Deserves and Escape”-Family motto
Was contracted to/Joined 777LC to ensure they could continue what they do
Gambling, performances, and some shady dealings
Acted as Barker and Poker dealer for both Midnight Carnival and for some members of the 777LC corp.
Was selected to run a poker game for a member of 100G Security
Over the course of the game, he convinced them to give the 777LC a better deal
Undermining the goals of the 100G Security agent
This led to him being able to Bind with 777LC
Continued to work as a deal softener for 777LC
Eventually returned nearly full-time to Midnight Carnival and became a full-time dealer there
Inherited his grandfather’s Van, old, but it works well.
On a trip from the Carnival to a 777LC office, he ends up getting caught in a world storm, ending up on the WorldHelm.
Physical Description: Ray is about 5'10" tall with a fit build. He has dark nearly black hair slicked back with the sides buzzed nearly to the skin. A dark gray stingy brim hat with a Joker tucked into the ribbon of the hat. He is usually wearing a white dress shirt with the sleeves rolled up and pinned in place. Over his shirt he wears a Violet vest with a pocket square tucked into the breast pocket patterned with different card suits. He wears black slacks with a belt and black boots. On the belt a set of Throwing knives can be see one one side and two cases on the left, one for his phone and one for cards

Name: Raye
Identity: A young woman lost in a fake world
Known History: Raye was born under the name Roze Shizuku but little of that girl remains now. Roze always had an affinity with games and with some rather wealthy family came the benefit of being able to afford all the gear and the new games to match. Her parents didn’t have much time for her so what they lacked in time they tried to make up in entertainment. Roze spend most of her life immersed in fantasy worlds under the name Raye and when she got her hands on the hit game SWORD it became her life. In the real world she worked as a performer portraying her character as a persona and in her time of she continued that persona in the game. So it only was a matter of time that she was more Raye then Roze. She fell victim to Dive Corruption fully identifying as Raye and unable to tell reality apart from the virtual world.
Physical Description: Raye is a 5‘8 tall, commanding figure with long, flowing blonde hair and almost always with a look of determination in her eyes. She is mostly seen wearing the armor that she made inspired by her character in the SWORD Game.

Name: Rayyan
Known History:
An unwanted child of a Nezmi slum, Raye was taken into the hands of labour young. She was wilful, unrepentant, and oft punished for her attitude and behaviour. 

It was not until she was taken into the custody of a wealthy merchant family in Windhaven that she saw any glimpse of hope for freedom. She yearned for escape, and when it found her, all she could do was take the hand of her partner and run.
Physical Description:
An athletic and sharp young woman, Raye’s muscles are not flashy or toned; her body is simply built for labour. Whether it be physical work or physical violence, Rayyan is perfectly capable. Her face is often stern, her eyes resting in a narrowed position and her lips pulled into an intimidating scowl, though her expression often takes on a cynical edge when she speaks.

Raye’s outfits change often, often not of her own desire. Shale simply will not accept either of them looking as casual as Rayyan would often prefer to.

Name: Reflection of Summer's Shine
Known History:
- Born in the Emerald Forests of Summer.
- Curious about the world, learning from the creatures and fae there, but something always felt missing.
- Eventually, they came across something new, stepping through it and passing into the Realm of Mortals.
- Immediately set upon by a human hunting party in a strange forest under a strange sky, Reflection of Summer's Shine fled. But this meant something to them. Experience.
- Eventually finding another Crossing, the season had changed. They stepped into Autumn, and another unfamiliar sky.
- Wandering the fields, they found something else. Maybe this will lead to answers.
- They found themselves next to a strange fountain in yet another strange sky. But this felt right.
Physical Description: Tall as an elder oak sapling and heavy as a sun-dappled rock in a summer river, Reflection of Summer's Shine is shrouded in mystery. That's not quite a metaphor. Their cloak is stitched together from the thousands of grasses within the Emerald Forests they called home, lending them familiarity even in strange environs. The mask of their face is expressive, but a large majority of their expressions seem to be curiosity or vexation. This world of mortals truly is a strange one.

Name: Reginn
Known History:
- grew up begging in Hallenrup
- lived as a fence in Myrdel
- was part of a heist to kill a knight and steal dragon eggs
- attacked by a monstrous moth, cursed alongside one of the dragon eggs by its magic
- dragon egg hatched, abandoned banditry to go into exile
- went to the Runewall to investigate a rumor
Physical Description:
Standing at 6'3'' with swept back hair that is turning white on one side, with eyes of an unnatural blue glow that marks him as touched by magic. He tends to have a patient approach with people, slow and gentle. 

More striking than the man by far, however, is his adolescent drake with animalistic features and shining, iridescent wings that resemble stained glass.

Name: Reino "Archangel" Valerius
Known History:
- Born in South Rock, Haven

- Is an Insolvent that works with 100G Gate Crasher Squad, a group sent when the chance of capturing a criminal safely is low to exact judgement

- Was arrested in a scene where the Midnight Express was put under attack by a possible ARMY-Grade, though no charges were ever pressed
Physical Description: A 5'11" foot tall man, of average build. He walks around dressed in an average two-piece suit colored black with a white dress shirt. Though, this is mostly covered by the quite long black trench coat he wears, allowing only his white shirt to be visible.

Name: Renard Sinclair
Identity: Fae Hoarder Learning to Live Amongst Humans
Known History:
- Doesn't really remember when he came to be, but has always enjoyed adding to his collection of baubles and trinkets
- One day, picked up and pocketed an earring that turned out to be a family heirloom belonging to a high-ranked noble
- Was discovered on him, and he was given the choice between exile from the realm or to be skinned and used for the noble's next coat, he somewhat preferred the former option
- Was stripped of his belongings and booted near the city of Lastport, where after wandering into Karl's Glasswork he tried to pocket one of his potion bottles
- Was caught and made to do work at the Glasswork, where it turned out he had a knack as a merchant and alchemist
- Offered an apprenticeship, which he was initially offended by until it was explained to him that he could use the money he earned to acquire goods and services
- After some time working there, actually finds living and negotiating with the pitiful, delicate mortals around him strangely fulfilling?
Origin: Lastport, Kor'Tarion (Formerly of the Autumn Court)
Physical Description: 6'1" blond vulpine man who wears a robe that seems to contain an almost uncountable number of pockets on the inside. Inquisitive, restless, and usually can be found searching for what he calls 'garbage'.
Species: Fae, likely Faetouched but he doesn't know the difference

Name: René le Sanctuaire
Known History:
Found as a child near their Sanctum, René was taken in and raised by the People of the Ashes. Trained as a warrior due to his tactical acumen and strong will, he himself preferred to adventure into the forest, playing and dancing with the creatures there. One spirit in particular, a cantankerous spitfire of a phoenix named Ishara, was offended by René's meager skills and took him under her wing.

He left the People of Ashes shortly after their assault on Rocade. Distraught by the destruction, and humbled by the heroes for being the ones to ultimately cure the phoenix spirits, René followed the Goldhearted's trail back to the realm storm. As he did, he was joined by Ishara, who carried with her an artifact from the Sanctum that had often fascinated the dancer as a child. 

Drawing upon his courage, will, and bond to Ishara, he delved into the storm, and found himself aboard the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: A young man who carries himself with an easy grace. Dark shaggy hair sways with his movements, parts of it permanently stained with ash. He wears loose, breathable garments, paired with a bright cloak shaped from feathers. The cloak itself always carries a strange sheen to its color, the sunset palette rich and flickering with a dark warmth, edges glow with magic. In combat, rising energy dances alongside him, striking out as whips of flame resembling the tail of a phoenix.

Name: Retti
Identity: Irregular Who Returned to His Roots
Known History:
Grew up among his kin in the Fae Domain of Pryn, in affiliation with the Spring Court.
Strived to be a knight, protecting his people from injustice and peril, but never quite had the skills to bring this to fruition.
Fled his home out of embarrassment and feeling useless, hoping to start a new life - which he found on the outskirts of Tradefair, doing his best helping people with chivalry aplomb, although it was no easy task and many hard lessons were learned. Years later, Retti considers Tradefair his home away from home.
He continued to work to become his ideal knight, using the tools of all the realms at his disposal to supplement his perceived incompetence.
Physical Description: Retti is a 5ft tall elf with pale skin and light blond hair. A slim but firm frame, usually garbed in fine clothes and jewellery, his smiling visage gives off a natural air of confidence and cheer. Lines of emerald-green magical conduits shine dully from within his body.

Name: Revin Aegian
Identity: Earth Mage of an Ancient Lineage
Known History: Student of the Earthbound Temple, now journeying in order to know the world beyond.
Physical Description: Short, a bit thin, blonde hair, jade green eyes. Wears white robes with golden dragon embroidery, the mark of his order.

Name: Rex Deckard
Known History:
Rex had once worked for Tubal & Cain Company, spending 16 years of his life slowly building his career from being a gofer, until he eventually became one of their more reputable transporters of goods.

But as he rose through the ranks and participated in more and more of the company's darker side of arms dealing, handing off powers into the wrong hands and seeing their consequences first-hand, his heart also grew wearier by the day, burdening his conscience.

The final nail in the coffin is an incident during an off-the-book transport mission between T&C and The Olympians delivering a batch of firearms, espertechs, and temp licenses, where upon the successful delivery of the goods, an unfortunate series of events culminated into the deaths of 3 homeless young teens from Central Outskirts.

Shortly after, Rex decided to retire from T&C and has since spent his days working odd jobs such as delivery, transport, and procurement, mainly for the underprivileged community outside of Haven.
Physical Description: Rex is a rugged-looking, weary-eyed middle-aged man wearing a Terran leather coat over his relatively tall build. He had thin unshaven beard stubble spread across his chin, and some mildly greying hairs on the root of his head. Multiple signs of old scars can be seen across his face and visible neck area, accrued throughout his years serving as a transporter for T&C.

Name: Reynaud Girardin
Known History: He has been all around Kor'Tarion in the passed decade in some way shape or form. Little is known of his deeds aside from the fact that he spins tall tales and writes. Much of the stories of any sort of prowess he would have is dubious at best and an outright lie at worst. The prevailing opinion of the rumour mill about him is likely that he is an alright enough man, that he has the spirit, but just is lacking something to actually make him great.
Other Names: The Snow Covered Swashbuckler, The Brilliant Bastard, The Steel Poet, The Mistcutter, The Wandering Comet
Physical Description: A wiry man passed his prime. Wearing an ensemble that seems to be the spitting image of what a Swashbuckling Hero would wear. The frayed edges of his clothing imply that he is a man of action despite looking very well put together. He wears a well-kept moustache on a face that always seems to just be bordering on a smug grin.

Name: Rezul
Known History: Calling the fire shrine his home for most of his life and training there, he still can't control his emotions that easily. He still feels guilty about heavily injuring one of his friends when he lost his temper. He believes it might be the area he lived in that affected him. Hoping in finding new shards of the moon and getting his temper under control, he sets out on his journey and soon gets discovered by the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: He is a pretty skinny and fairly tall warrior monk, who in the shrine has trained his mind the most, at the cost of his finesse and body.

Name: Rhea Hart
Known History: Born and raised in North Rock within Haven in Central Terra. Grew up in a low income family steeped in music and the tech that surrounded it by her musician parents.  She grew up to be musician herself who writes political charged dark angry music. One day on the way to a gig she got swept up into a Realmstorm and brought to the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Human woman of average height, cropped bleach blonde hair, piercings, spikey jewelry

Name: Rhea, Daughter of Athelios
Identity: Warrior Scholar of the First Truth
Known History:
* Born fully grown and aged from her mother. 
* Spent a decade learning art, tactics, and combat.
* Reappeared in Aeolia 3 years ago and joined the Sky Legion.
* Is currently in command of a small platoon.
Other Names:
Spear of the Sky
Scholar of the First Truth
Physical Description:
Not immediately imposing at 5'9, Rhea nevertheless cuts an immediately intimidating figure. Piercing red eyes and light brown hair center a feminine face that is smiles only when the smile is well earned.  What appear to be tattoos mark her face, her legs, even on her bronze armor, marks of divine heritage.

Out of battle, Rhea prefers masculine clothing, preferirng a well fit chlamys or Chiton. The glowing marks of her armor show on these clothes, no matter where they show up.

Name: Rhys Caldrith
Identity: A Warden of Wisdom in a World Unraveling
Known History: Rhys hails from the distant nation of Silverdale, a land of icy coasts, constant snowstorms and hidden depths. Little is spoken of his past beyond whispers of study, loss, and a wisdom tempered by hardship. Whatever his path before, it has now led him across realms to the Worldhelm, where his journey—and the Stone’s call—continue.
Physical Description:
His time on the worldhelm has changed Rhys in more ways than one. He no longer hides his form behind armor, or constraining leather. Rhys has fully embraced themself as they are, wearing a garment fit for an Heir, while also feeling like himself after so long. The dye in their hair has also started to fade, revealing the whiteish silvery hue beneath. 

Due to recent events the crystals on his body have begun to spread once again, far more violently than they first appeared as Rhys continues to strain and push himself to his limits as an Heir.

Name: Rika Carpenter
Known History: A boy who grew up in the slums of C-Sec in Hidela, and eventually found himself enlisting in the military to help pay for his families expenses. He was with the Peoples' Guard for a number of years, joining when he was 18 and remaining until he was discharged and arrested for disobeying orders when he was 22. After an operation went poorly, and an unlikely series of events resulted in the deaths of his mother and sister, Rika demanded his unit call off their mission. He was rewarded with swift punishment for his bravery. He remained in Heaven's Gate, where he withstood the near-isolation, until recently.
Physical Description: Rika is a few inches over six foot, weighing around 180 lbs of leaner muscle. He's a rather unkept person, with greasy dirty blonde hair tied back and kept beneath one of a few trucker-style caps he hides it under. He's not particularly fashionable, and his body language and ways of speaking are similarly inelegant.

Name: Riley Knight
Known History:
Riley grew up without a mother and memories of a father who didn't deserve the title. When she was 13, her father died due to a job as an assassin. This was a positive for Riley as her sister took over as her guardian and pushed for her education.

Over time, Riley discovered that she had an innate skill in the soul network that she ingrained into herself, even at her detriment herself, as the soul network was unstable.

Through time and proper schooling, she became more educated than her sister and later...adopted brother? She took this privilege and did well with it, learning to become a soulrunner for a small subsidiary of Qilink, AEC Network.

She was looking forward to what she may achieve before losing herself in a realmstorm and coming to the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: A woman standing at 5'5, with short white hair and large curved ram horns, Riley is often seen dressed well by Terran standards.

Name: Rin
Known History:
Rin's secluded village in the mountains has always had Oni troubles. A particularly powerful white oni has lurked nearby for centuries, and to keep it appeased and at bay, they had to sacrifice one of their own every decade. By a stroke of bad luck, a very young Rin was chosen for this duty. As the horrid oni attempted to consume her soul, her latent psionic abilities awakened, protecting her. However, the process still corrupted her soul with the white oni's essence.

In the chaos, Rin managed to escape, but she was tainted and changed. As she grew up, she developed features similar to those of the oni that had tried to eat her soul all those years ago. She could not return to her village, so she learned to use her abilities and what little she learned in her short time in her old home to survive.

These oni traits included a semblance of its overwhelming hunger. Rin tries to channel her monstrous appetite into rare exotic game to avoid her urges leading to more humanoid targets...
Physical Description: Extremely pale skin, red-tinged horns, bright crimson eyes, squishy, wears a loose-fitting light gray tunic with a sash and sandals

Name: Rin (#2)
Known History:
Those from or who live around Murata would have heard of a Half-Kitsune who was thrown out of the village many years ago. During those years Rin had taken it upon themselves to protect the village's outskirts in whatever way they could. Since some of the villagers at least still cared for Rin. Though after many years Rin was forced to leave the outskirts of Murata after they discovered how much of a monster Rin's cultivation made them seem.

In recent times, Rin has gone through many difficulties while aboard the Worldhelm. Losing his cultivation base to a purifier kitsune. He embarked on a journey with only borrowed time to keep him alive. Eventually after surviving his tribulation and purifying his soul he was able to enter Baihu's domain and assist with their battle against the Yeti. Baihu blessed him with knowing his new goal. To Usurper the Fox Goddess Inari and replace her with himself.
Physical Description: Rin is a Half-Kitsune standing roughly at 5'10 (180cm) with a head of messy black hair and tall fox like ears. A pair of yellowish irises that faintly glow in the shadows. Due to their cultivation they often dress lightly with baggy pants or other clothes they've managed to piece together. Their forearm and legs are covered in a thick, matted black fur that goes into a pair of claws and padded paws respectively. Different animalistic parts may grow due to their cultivation technique but those are not always present.

Name: Rinchi Amaya
Identity: Half-Yokai (Kitsune) From a Fallen Warrior Family
Known History:
From a fallen warrior family who once protected a small village from threats. After her mother, the head of the family, was forcibly impregnated by a kitsune, there was nobody to protect the village as the elders of the family had retired.
Doom swiftly fell upon the village as monsters attacked, wiping half of the village out. The survivors cursed the family out and exiled them.

Now 19 years old and having been trained in the ways of combat and magic by her mother, Rinchi sets out to take revenge on her father to restore her family's honor.
Physical Description: 167cm tall, long teal hair, teal fox ears and tail with white tips.

Name: Risata
Known History:
Risata lived in Providencia for a long while taking care of children in the orphanage. Life lead her to joining the exorcists. In an attempt to seal away an ancient evil, she exchanged most of her power and life. The reason she's so open about this? She's a woman on borrowed time. It's important to accept the end of all things. 

Despite her stoicism, she remains happily married to her husband Mahuizoh. 

He's gives her hope; maybe they can have a happy ending.
Physical Description: 5'10" | Indigo Eyes | Lavender Skin

Name: Ritveja
Known History: A strange and eccentric trader who answers to the name Ritveja. She roams a circuitous path between cities and settlements, large and small, foraging and hunting for unique plants, furs, and other curiosities to trade to the people she meets along the way. While seeming harmless and unassuming to many, in the rare scenarios where she has to defend herself or a town she visits, the knowledge of Formations, and the Void Qi she has cultivated over her travels make her capable of being a steadfast defender when she is needed.
Physical Description: Ritveja stands at 6’2” of height, with a somewhat broadly built frame, as is typical of all of her kind. Her brown fur, which is kept manageably trimmed at all times, is often speckled with simple braids and beads made from shells, rocks, and leather, complimenting the strange ensemble of items that dangle from her robes, causing a light clinking noise whenever she approaches. Apart from her various baubles and curios, she has precious little in the way of other possessions, aside from the large staff she uses to walk, and a large knapsack by her side, always empty.

Name: Robbins
Known History:
Robbins has lived all his life in the Kullroc Glacier, in Aldistir, and was given his intelligence already later in his life, choosing to maintain his animal form. 
In the Kullroc, he created a family for himself and has a partner and three children. Having a family brought a realization to Robbins' mind: he wants them to be safe. He then finds himself reluctant to associate with Kuzunoha, and finds Nimue's values a lot more sensible.
After Nimue's death, Robbins told his family he was going on a gastronomic adventure around the land, to come back with more recipes, but instead, he grabbed an Ald's helmet and left to protect the realm, as best as he could, hoping this would bring peace to his family.
Physical Description:
Robbins is a fat, but tall (for a penguin) creature, standing at 1.25 meters of height and a whopping 43 kilograms of weight. He is often found overencumbered, as he carries his many ingredients, as well as helmet or shields made for normal sized humans.
His bubbly and overly kind demeanor leads him to talk and offer help to just about anybody. While kindness has its bounds, Robbins' regularly increases to match the size of a request.

Name: Robin
Identity: The Yielded Knight of the Sun
Known History:
When he first arrived in Idyll, he wandered its peaceful lands before they were tainted by evil. His journey led him to Nirve, where he became Captain of the Guard. Empowered with authority, he was always ready to help those in need, his dedication serving as an inspiration to the people.

But after the fall of Idyll, something within him changed. Despite his relentless efforts to protect the realm, he eventually withdrew from the fight, abandoning his duties. No longer a hero, he became reclusive and aimless, the fire that once drove him extinguished, leaving behind only the shadow of a once-great leader.

Just like when he was still living in his own and much older Realm.
Physical Description:
Height: 175 Cm
Weight: 80 kg
Physique: Slim Effeminate

Unique Feature: Both of his arms are Spectral and See through. Within them you see different objects, from potions, to chains, to swords, to axes, and more. 

For Clothing and Looks use image as basis :3

Name: Rococo
Identity: Cautious Nomad Guardian of the Spirit
Known History:
- From the porcupine tribe and travels the world both in the physical world and the Rootway
- Home in the Grand Repository was destoryed in recent Wolfkin raids
- Consequentially, goes from place to place; never staying too long, but enough to improve the lives of local Kinfolk and does his best to uphold the Hedgehog's code
- A great focus of his is emotional stability, prioritizing mental stability (or lack thereof) who he meets
- While not attuned to older traditions, his spikes have a natural coating that pierces the spirit
Physical Description: 4 ft tall, somewhat scruffy, spines have a iridescent sheen to them

Name: Rokuro Tamashii
Known History:
Most of his history is kept a secret from others but regardless of where he goes he tends to cause rumors to emerge due to his off putting behavior.

The title Salesman of Souls comes from a belief that most of his wares are actually the souls of anything that crosses his path during his travels though the extent of this has varied with some claiming to have even have been saved from the clutches of monsters due to this tendency.

Some believe that he may have been a former member of a heritage of cultivators but it's been well known that any questions regarding this topic are often ignored.

Some even speculate that Tamashii isn't a real last name but something he simply made up during the fall of the gods.

The truth is that everything people speculate is much closer to fact than fiction yet one thing that's clear is a lack of willingness to share any details himself.
Physical Description:
Brown hair but with streaks of a white that almost looks like the color was scraped out of it over time.

Often seen in his travelling clothes he always wears a calm smile. Because of this he is often seen as shady even by those he conducts business with.

He's taller than most at 6 feet yet not so much that it would seem abnormal.

Name: Roland Pearce
Known History:
Raised in the Hearthbright orphanage in Brightshield. The orphanage is known to train its children in skills befitting high quality servants, children that come of age without being adopted are instead treated as servants in training and hired to be butlers and maids by wealthy families.

An out of town mage sent in a request for a servant to the orphanage a few years ago, Roland volunteered. When an orphanage representative stopped by the mage's residence to check that Roland had been properly treated, the mage had already packed and moved.

In Kor'Tarion, Roland is simply thought to be missing.
Physical Description:
https://malekdesc.neocities.org/ROLAND/Roland little card, if you prefer.

A butler dressed prim and proper, with tired eyes and occasionally brushed shoulder-length hair.

Standing at the fairly average and unremarkable height of 5'8'', the fragrance of flowers and herbs can be easily caught in his presence, by the ever-present air of cinammon and cardamom, his inclination towards teas is no secret.

Name: Rolando Yitters | Sleepy Chef
Identity: Let food warm the body and battlefield.
Known History:
The Faerie Realm of Kor'Tarian, the home of the mystical and magical, hidden away from the mortal plane. A realm where maps are words and grass giggles beneath your feet. One would think that a denizen from that realm would be… boisterous, flamboyant, or even a little crazy…
Not sleepy and dozing off every few minutes.
Rolando Yitters, quite young for a Fae, is a former resident of the Faerie Realm, exiled by the court's decree after feeding mortals food of the Fae, resulting in a… messy outcome.
Being cursed to forever be drowsy and getting sent to the mortal plane wasn't enough to dampen Rolando's love of his craft, and when a realmstorm brought him to the Worldheim, he knew he could spread that love even further, never letting anyone go hungry while he was around.
Origin: Exiled Fae from the Kor'Tarian Realm
Physical Description: 5’ 10” and weighing 177 pounds, he has a rather light stature, but not one that makes him look thin as he is most definitely not malnourished.

Name: Ronan
Known History:
Ronan was once an Ashwynd. Born to a proud line of hunters, raised beneath a name that carried weight. But truth has a way of cutting deeper than any blade. When his Fae blood was exposed, the life he knew collapsed, and the people he trusted cast him into the wilds without a backward glance.

Then came the heartbreak that finished what exile began, hollowing him out until even his name felt like a lie.

Now he walks the worlds as a ghost in his own skin. No family, no clan, no claim, no past worth keeping. A wanderer shaped by loss, guided only by instinct and the faint, flickering hope that somewhere in the dark, he might still find purpose.
Physical Description: At 6'2", Ronan cuts an imposing figure. His skin bears the deep, weathered tone of a man long exposed to sun and hardship. Black hair hangs in wild, unkempt strands, hiding one eye entirely while the other, pale and reddish, stares out with quiet intensity. His cloak is tattered, and the clothing beneath it is the patchwork of a wanderer who’s lived more on the road than under a roof.

Name: Rongshi Hui 「容时慧」
Known History: Born and Raised in Xiexie village, Hui grew up with a natural talent with cultivation, and an Affinity for Shadow Qi. He would occasionally adventure beyond the village's wall, looking for something more interesting than the daily life. On one such occasion, Hui got placed in a Life-or-Death situation, and in order to survive, he took in large amounts of the ambient Death Qi to survive, at great personal cost. Now, as the Death Qi has seeped into his Meridians, every use of Qi slowly kills him, while he searches for any small chance to alleviate his condition.
Physical Description: A Rather Feminine looking man, Hui is 6'2", with Black Hair and Dark Brown Eyes. He is often seen wearing long, flowing robes, and carrying a Fan, though even noticing him at all is surprising, given that he tends to remain quietly in the background.

Name: Rook
Known History: Rook has dedicated much of his life to being an adventurer, spurred on by the events of The Red Sky, taking on the party role of protector. Time after time, he has put his own body and life on the line in the place of others. One day, this would manifest in a moment of true self sacrifice, as a band of adventurers he was a part of had decided to raid and cleanse an ancient castle near his home. The challenges they faced were too great, and it seemed as though they may all perish. That was when Rook chose to stay behind, to slow the monsters of the castle as much as he could so the rest of the band could escape. As the adventures fled to safety, a battered and bloodied Rook stare down undead horrors and things of nightmare with a smile on his face. Right before the final clash, which would have certainly ended his life, a Realmstorm carried him off and away to the Worldhelm.
Physical Description:
6’4” 
Short Brown Hair
Green Eyes
Very Muscular
Tanned Caucasian skin with scaring from former fights

Name: Rosanna Westwood
Identity: Distant Protector with a Heart of Gold
Known History:
Rosanna doesn’t like to talk about her past, but the fading, incomplete set of scaled brands that drift across her collar bone tell part of the story on their own. The usually reserved, often intimidating young woman sticks close to the companion she arrived with at all times, with the two of them frequently appearing to communicate nonverbally and always knowing how the other is feeling or what they’re thinking… Though only those with the ability to see souls would understand how this is accomplished. 

Her presence with the cat-eared young man at dinner every night is guaranteed, yet despite this, no one ever seems to see her eating. A keen eye could catch a glimpse of oversharp canines when she chances a smile. Rose seems to take much interest in experiencing new places, even if she would not admit it, and expresses fascination in what others would deem mundane. Although she appears aloof, even the most oblivious of people would notice how she drools at the sight of a candy shop.
Physical Description: Rosanna is a tall (standing at around 6’2”) young woman with bobbed pink hair and brown eyes. She opts to dress in purples and blacks at every opportunity, but doesn’t seem to mind lace or frills. Her default outfit consists of a dark purple off-the-shoulders shirt with wide sleeves (cinched at the elbows with ribbon), a dark corset, and a mid-calf black skirt overtop a layered purple and black petticoat. She also tends to wear an insulation layer on her legs, hidden beneath the layers of skirt and her boots.

Name: Rose Meiki'tari Albertus
Known History: Rose Mei (Also going by Rose or Mei) was brought onto the Worldhelm after she was given form. With her parents Naiki'tari and Zophiel having been instrumental in the defeat of the Kor'Tarion threat of Sanctimony, she's tried her best to learn what skills of each parent she finds interesting, quickly picking up the talents for magic and alchemy. Now deemed able to travel out on her own, she's ready to pick up where her parent's legacy left off, and to travel the realms helping those she can (and learning whatever new magics come her way too).
Physical Description:
Rose Mei is a thin girl, about 5'4". She has Black Hair and Green eyes, along with two Cat ears near the top of her head. She tends to wear simple clothes, favoring a large hat and the occasional flowing robe.

She's often also seen with a worn grimoire, and occasionally various other books, usually reading.

Name: Rowan Sondergaard
Known History:
At Hudal Academy, there's a common warning - "Don't take Environmental Magic 101".  The head of the Nature Department, Professor Sondergaard has been teaching at the academy for at least 25 years, and has gained a bit of a reputation for being a bit of a scary teacher. His unwavering love for all things natural can come off as a bit intimidating to other, but it is that fervor that has earned him such a prestigious position at the academy. 

Recently, he learned about the enigmatic phenomena known as Realmstorms, and he set off on a month long field trip with his students to investigate. When it was nearing the end of the trip, when Rowan was working throughout the night, he noticed this fantastical show of colours outside his tent, and ran to see what it was. He was greeted by what he'd been searching for, a Realmstorm! He grabbed whatever was near him and just started running towards it. One bright flash of light later, he found himself on the Worldhelm, surrounded by strange people.
Physical Description: Rowan stands at 5'11" with a frail build befitting a researcher. He is always seen wearing his hat and visor, which glows a slight blue hue. Rowan sports a blonde beard he keeps well trimmed, although it can get unkempt if he delves too much into his research notes.  He wears a purple robe adorned with jewels and carries a botany textbook which doubles as a magic tome.

Name: Rowan Vale
Identity: Investigator Who Hears What Shouldn’t Speak
Known History: You were born in the dense city of Veyrhold and grew up in a municipal orphanage. Life in the city’s crowded districts taught you to observe people closely, noticing details others often ignored. That talent eventually drew the attention of the Supernatural Investigation Agency, who recruited you for training. After years of education and field preparation, you earned a position as a rookie field agent within the Department of Supernatural Enforcement. Your intuition and strange investigative instincts make you useful when cases refuse to explain themselves. Even when it pulls you ever closer to the darkness.
Physical Description: A skinny and androgynous figure, often hunched slightly as if listening to something distant. A long, worn coat hangs from their shoulder, fur collar raised, with gloved hands usually holding a notebook. Two tones of black and ginger hair kept loose fall near observant, distant eyes that rarely seem fully focused on the present. In certain light, their outline seems to blur slightly, as if shadows linger closer around them than they should.

Name: Roy ⚡
Identity: Shy but Electric Inventor Who Can't Sit Still
Known History:
Roy is a young electric inventor who evades responsibility, often using the excuse of putting all of his effort into his self-named exosuit, "Megasword". 

Roy grew up in an impoverished family, he and his parents trying to become magitech engineers. His younger years were full of magitech study, his parents holding hope in Roy's genius. 

He was told as he was growing up to not to touch metal, others, or go swimming. They made one exception though, "Megasword". This was something Roy drew pictures of as a child, and worked on all the time. One day, a school friend tried to grab the compressed box that holds Megasword out of his hands, trying to pull a prank. Roy, out of surprise, shocked the heart of his friend until it stopped. The memory rings in his head to this day.

Roy left his only friends, his family, recently after his father begged him to leave the city that already shunned him. He only recently has begun to use his gifts for something other than keeping his family afloat.
Physical Description:
5' 10"
175 lbs.
Bolt Blue Eyes
Contact with Roy Can Shock

Name: Royce Blackwood
Known History:
Royce Blackwood was, for a short time, a young face on the docks of Lastport who learned many of her skills to survive and thrive. While trying to rob one of the docked ships, she was caught.
Luckily for her, rather than suffering any punishment, Royce was given the chance instead to join the ship that was named the Red Otters.
During a terrible storm, Royce fell overboard and nearly drowned before reaching out and making a deal with a demon out of desperation. The effects of her deal have left her mark with visual effects, a supernatural bloodlust, and the ability to call on the demon’s power. Upon returning to the crew and a member leaving, she was caught in a realm storm.
Physical Description: Royce is a 5'7 woman dressed in common Kor'tarion clothing. Her teeth have become unnaturally sharpened due to her dealing with demons as well, but beyond that, she looks like a normal sailor.

Name: Ruby Rivers
Known History:
The perfect soldier, from what they had seen. Nightmare to hostiles, a killing machine.

Codenamed Project R. Instance labelled Rho-Beta. Her self-assigned name came much later.

Ruby is, as far as she's been made aware, the last living result of a Lhodosian black site project to replicate the power of the gods. An attempt to create the perfect adaptable supersoldier.

It didn't go well for them.

After escaping, Ruby was taken by the Worldhelm - presumably an attempt by Yubel to direct and corral this force of nature into something that could be used for good. Though she's certainly taken the long way around to do so, with the help of fellow Goldhearted, she's gotten there.

Of course, she DID have to kill and eat what was ostensibly her brother, but that's a story for another time.
Physical Description:
Ruby is 6'0", weighing 174 lbs. She is generally clad in loose, light clothing, and any extra layers are similarly light so they can be removed if necessary.

When her flesh warps through Akromorphosis or her Therioforms, it seems to liquify, appearing like a non-Newtonian fluid as it shifts into its new form.

Floating behind her at all times are the twin halves of the 77th Holy Sword, Damocles, earned and hard-fought for in a battle against Project Q, or Quinn.

Art from D&D's Tasha's Cauldron of Everything; if anybody finds the actual artist, let me know so I can update the bio.
Species: Human-appearing biological chimera, containing aspects of Lhodosian Nimue

Name: Rudica Zeln
Known History:
Rudica was born in Brightshield to a family of merchants and studied Hudal Academy with an interest in enhancing her own magical abilities and learning about Fae and nature.

One day she got trapped in the Faerie Realm and turned into a fox by a Fae, an encounter that she barely remembers. After some years they woke up in a magical spring as a human again, though a Faetouched one. 

Afterwards they travelled the Faerie in search of an exit while studying her surroundings and eventually ended up on the Worldhelm.
Physical Description:
Rudica is a light skinned fox demi-human with red hair, fur and a fluffy tail dressed in a flexible loose fitted outfit tied together with a hooded leather vest.

They are always armed with books and reed pens to take notes or defend themselves with magic.

The most significant facial features of her are their orange fox like eyes as well as some freckles and nose which shares similarities with one of a fox while still somewhat human looking.

Name: Rulekeeper
Age: Originally 20 but unknown since entering the Faerie Realm
Known History:
Once a student who one day ventured too close to a Fae domain with their colleagues. They all became trapped in the Fae Wilds and eventually were pulled into the gloom. Only the Rulekeeper escaped by making a deal with a powerful Fae, agreeing to serve them and losing their humanity.

However, even the process of becoming a fae could not rid the gloom from them completely and it continues to draw him closer no matter how far he may flee.

Still, they have a large amount of gratitude both towards their Fae master who saved them and their fellow Goldhearted who he believes have saved him again and again.
Origin: The Faerie Realm, Domain of Equinox(Kor'Tarion)
Physical Description:
Wears a large black cloak with further black colored clothing underneath covering most of their body. Even their hands are covered in gloves and their feet with large boots.

They are heavily adverse to any of their skin being seen going as far as wearing a strange mask. The only thing that can often be seen is a pink glow from beneath the eye slots of the mask whenever they exercise their influence as a Fae.

Their exposed skin would reveal the illness that plagues them. A colorless haze that leaks from them as an indicator that the gloom once made direct contact.
Species: Once Human, now fae servant to the Rulemaker

Name: Runihura
Known History: A ex-servant in the palace of the Alaoui family, witness to the destruction and decay left by Vanagandr. The ruin left in the wake was enough for Runihura to flee the city and so he did. His status since the incident has been vague with the occasional spotting in various Nezmiran cities.
Physical Description: Runihura's scaled tattoos would run along their neck and chest depicting their knowledge in Entropism. He stands around 5'9 with long black hair that goes past his waist.

Name: Russo "Basil" Abetti
Identity: No One's Soldier, Hero for Everyone
Known History:
- Born to parents both who worked within QiLink, both parents killed during a "hostile takeover" when they were younger.
- Adopted by the company, raised and joined QiLink's Paramilitary as one of their mech pilots.
- Piloting a full dive suit mech after undergoing extensive surgery to perform within a mech called - "The Dauntless" the runs on QiLink state of the art technology.
- Works under the AEGIS branch of QiLink, their handler being Tiberius Crowne.
- Has built up loyalty to Tiberius Crown & QiLink, more so Tiberius due to the shadier aspects of the company.
- Also performs in Pulsefire/Mech combat during his free time as he simply enjoys mech piloting both leisurely & workwise.
- Now piloting a new machine named The Crucible, with less invasive hardware utilized into it. 
- Is now in an Administrative position for AGES.
- Is now the SOLE Leader of AGES, though has the support of not only friends but his partner Cyrus.
Origin: The Zhuanli Union, Lumina Prime, Terra
Physical Description: An average built 5'9 individual, nothing about their appearance truly is striking or eye catching when it is in comparison to the everyday people of Terra. A face and body that falls into a crowd easily, with a casual lethargy in their face though they look to try and be friendly. Their clothing is more often casual, save for when they are working or demanded to dress professional by their higher ups. A number of piercings adorn their freckled face, and more often than not there is a gapped tooth smile. Never far from on their person is a Terran grade Walkman. Their hair has recently been cut short, a very spur of the moment decision.

Name: SKELETAL SOLDIER
Origin: Tian Yi, Wujing Guo, Shouwang Senlin
Physical Description: 6"10, Tian Yi, Jiān shī is a tall, built man who has thick, coarse white fur on each of his lion-like limbs with long hair that reaches just past the middle of his back. He wears an assortment of hides from beasts he has hunted.

Name: STATIC OOZE
Physical Description: An athletic and sharp young woman, Raye’s muscles are not flashy or toned; her body is simply built for labour. Whether it be physical work or physical violence, Rayyan is perfectly capable. Her face is often stern, her eyes resting in a narrowed position and her lips pulled into an intimidating scowl, though her expression often takes on a cynical edge when she speaks.

Name: Sable
Known History: Sable is the Ambassidor of Ixatali and the Goldhearted. Once her people learned of the Worldhelms existence and Sable's gold-hearted status she was appointed Ambassador of her people to keep tabs on the potential danger something like the Worldhelm could hold on Samsara. More recently her people have begun casting a deadly doomsday spell on the people of Nezzmira below that she dose not support and has been tirelessly working to prevent.
Physical Description: Standing 177cm tall, regal pearlescent swan-feathered Ixitali, with large white wings that bridge out in iridescent color of all kinds. She holds her wings before herself when standing, forming a feathered dress-like visage, and tends to look at things suddenly and directly when giving something attention. The rest of her body is lightly covered in the same feathery down as her wings outside of her stomach area (usually covered by how she holds her wings together in front of her like a veil). Her legs are like two small long twigs ending in two very sharp looking three taloned feet.

Name: Saga
Identity: A Story that Has Lost Their Title
Known History: Most of her own history is obscured to herself, she is aware that she was a Inkstone written to detail a story about Aldistir and often tells what little of the story she remembers. The stories of others, on that topic, seem to catch her attention rather well and this ship she has now found herself on has so many to record.
Physical Description: A generally humanoid woman at 5'10 with white hair that goes just past her shoulders though more notable would be various ink stains that coat their form and the long spindly fingers that constantly drip ink.

Name: Sahar'divh
Identity: Seeker of Knowledge By Any Means
Known History: Sahar did not really know his parents, other than what they left behind for him and his two brothers. That primarily being the grand library of their house filled with collections of books and tomes and encyclopedias of the world from the time his parents traveled it. One day, they just never came back from their travels. So then as Sahar'divh grew up he buried himself in those books those same books that made him feel like his parents never really left. He had a love for reading and knowledge is what led to become a studious mage and travel the world to learn new things above all else to follow in their footsteps, and perhaps along the way, if he is incredibly lucky find his parents or at least find out what happened to them. All the while repressing the feelings he has of abandonment and resentment to those who were supposed to raise him.  As for Sahar'divh's brothers, they were all distant from one another and each pursues different paths. Despite only having each other.
Physical Description: Standing at 5 ft 10 inches with an "unrefined" build a pale non-threatening looking scholar adorned with purple robes, meanders about. A monocle adores his one eye. Whether or not it serves a purpose is hard to tell from a glance. An unkempt mess of light purple hair sits atop his head. At his side and often in his arms resides a book that is often different from day to day ranging from many topics. To describe him, physically, as a bookworm would be an understatement.

Name: Salamander Chloe Fant
Identity: The Weeping Angel of Goetia Squad
Known History:
Born in a small town about five miles away from the Karlsgard/Merrane border.

Was a quiet, gentle girl. Was learning how to be a mechanic

When she was 14, her village was hit with a chemical attack while she was out exploring a forest. She was the only survivor. The chemical cannister had the name 'Nausicaa' on it when she found it later

In her rage, she joined the KPLA.

Was not allowed to fight until she turned 17, but used that time to learn how to pilot.

About 3 months ago, on her first assignment in a border fort, A Sub-designation of Vanagandr attacked. She jumped into a mech and distracted it to give the rest of her team time to prepare and sortie.

She lived through the experience, but her mech was destroyed and she was badly wounded. Recovery took a month

When she returned, she caught the attention of Goetia Squad and Vertigo Abrams.

Promoted to Salamander, and given the experimental GKS-312 Belial.

During a routine mission, her heart becomes gold...
Physical Description:
A medium height woman at a cool 5'6, Chloe doesn't cut an initially imposing figure. The plug suit armor she usually wears, though, adds about 50 pounds to a usually slender looking frame. Her hair is long, but always kept in a very professional ponytail, and her face does nothing to hide how young she is.

In battle, that calm is utterly destroyed by free streaming tears and a face that contorts with anger. The kind of anger that only someone who has lost everything might know...

Name: Sama Shihitsugi
Known History:
- Parents died when he was a baby so he was raised by his grandfather.
- His grandfather held a position of respect within an organized crime family.
- As he grew he developed magics within his voice that allowed him to subdue and harm people without actually laying a hand on them.
- Worked as an enforcer for the family because of his talents.
- Even though the family is in crime they actively work to keep gang street violence and more dangerous substances off the streets in their territory. Sama pushes this a bit further personally using his leverage in the family.
- While wandering the streets during a storm enjoying the rain he gets wrapped up in a Realmstorm and finds himself on the Worldhelm.
