Physical Description: Sama stands at a height of 5' 9" with an athletic build, due to his genetics he has naturally white hair and purple eyes that can sometimes be found in people with albinism but he seems to lack the pale skin that tends to come with it. He tends to dress very reserved and not flashy at all.

Name: Samir Zaid Jabari Castiel III
Identity: The Lightfooted Attendant of The Valdera family
Known History:
Samir is the attendant of House Valdera. A family with a long yet convoluted history. He was brought into the family as a young teen by Lord Valdera after his family was slaughtered.

He spent the his youth acquiring skills and training to better serve House Valdera. Lady Valdera taught him how to be graceful while Lord Valdera taught him the meaning of honor and duty. All combined with what he learned from his parents molded him into who he is today.

Now he works on passing what he knows onto the Valdera children who refers to him as "Uncle Samir". His duty is to his house in which he swear to make whole again.
Physical Description:
Weight: 78kg
Height: 190cm
Tall with amazing poise and posture
Clothes are always neat, creased and perfectly fitted. 
Brown moisturized skin
Hair and Zappa always neat and clean

Name: Samuel Reyner
Known History: Born into Birghtshield, Samuel was a model citizen. Working as a guard in Brightshield for years before reaching the point in his life where he was happy to retire. Until demon attacks spiked and the city went into high alert. Being unable to provide proper work as a guard as his body isn't what it once was, he still looked for ways to help as he felt he still had a duty and responsibility to the city. Until something else called for his attention and now he is here.
Physical Description: An older man, standing at attention at 6'0. Time already turned most of his hair to a light grey while smile lines and crows eyes helped show his age. Most would rarely see him with a supportive smile and a reassuring aura that comes with doing his job well for a long time.

Name: Sara Langley
Known History:
* Came from a dead drifter town to New Jamestown.
* Her stepfather was caught smuggling
* She declared her desire to become a Sheriff the day he was caught.
* Now she's a traveling Sheriff, righting wrongs and upholding justice.
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'4, Sara nevertheless cuts a pronounced, proud demeanor. Her head? Held high. Her sheriff's badge? Well shined. Her clothes? Well pressed even during travel. She's never seen without her trusty six shooter, and intense blue eyes search for injustice to fix.

She is always joined by a black horse she calls Socks.

Name: Sarah Montrofier
Known History: Growing up in slums of Tradefair in Kor'Tarion, Sarah always dreamed of leaving her life of poverty. Although she developed the skills to steal, she only really stole from the corrupt aristocrats of the city. At a certain point, she met a Dancer woman from a traveling show. Sarah saw immense beauty in the Dancer's art form, asking the woman to teach her how to dance, and so she was taught. Over the time that the Dancer was within Tradefair, she taught Sarah to the best of her ability, Sarah taking in every bit of information and move that she could. The Dancer woman eventually left, and Sarah left Tradefair herself to learn more Dancing and Roguish skills so that she could truly become a big shot.
Physical Description: Her skin is a deep tan, her short hair pitch black like the night sky, and her eyes are a grayish blue. She stands at 5'8ft with a slim yet lean athletic figure. Sarah wears a red cape with a hood over herself and her chest covered by a crimson wrap. Sarah's ears and neck are decorated with gemmed silver and gold jewelry, though most of it fake. Below the waist she wears incredibly baggy cloth pants held up by a leather and iron belt with a satchel attached, on her legs are leather boots the go up to her calf and shin. On her hands are fingerless leather gloves with bracelets gemmed with large opals, which are also fake.

Name: Sarah of Lances
Known History: Born into a rich merchant family in Suntower, Sarah was sponsored by the House of Lances to attend White Wing Academy. Put in charge of a squad growing attached to them. Led her squadmates into an ambush that got half of them killed, and severely injured Sarah. Was discharged from the academy before graduation due to her injuries.
Physical Description: Sarah stands at 5'10" with long blonde hair. The left half of her body covered in burn scars. She is often dressed in a military uniform.

Name: Saroja Narayan
Known History: Saroja was born into one of the few villages hidden in the Viper Gardens. There one could say she had a quiet life, living amongst the dead. There she cultivated her own Purusa, connecting with the ambient flow of such things around her, to even gaining a connection with the beings that surrounded her home. So with care she strengthened this connection. And as her spirit connected with the world around her, her body began the spark of a physical transformation. A spark that has begun to be slowly tended to until it was left behind to fix a mistake she made.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'5 , Saroja is dressed in the simple and traditional clothing of her home. Now, she is often decorated with flowers to regain any semblance of who she was before.

Name: Sasha
Known History:
Born in Merrane, his family left a few months after his birth. During the voyage, his mother and others of the group got captured by the Kingdom's army.
As a result Sasha grew up travelling with his father among the refugee camps at the border; he had a penchant for shenanigans and tricks, not knowing his father had built up a group of rebels to storm Merrane in search for intel on the lost members.
In time he got old enough to join the Wayward Bears in their quests, starting with the harshest training his father could devise, which clashed with Sasha's idea of life and got him his nickname "Wayward Rebel". When he finally grew strong enough he was assigned a mission, which went all kinds of wrong. Most of the group got captured, and he only saved himself by highjacking an old magitech Mech. Just when he was almost at camp a rainbow light hit him and he found himself on the Worldhem.
Physical Description: Tall, well built human, usually wearing tank tops, cargo pants and other comfortable clothes. When in mission favours a dark tunic that offers limited protection and helps mixing with shadows. Has two daggers of different intent, one white, the other black

Name: Satsori
Known History: Once part of the Caldera's infantry, Ogha's retired after a failed squirmish against a group of bandit left her scared from a while in both mental and physical state. She would spend the rest of her life training her body as a coping mechanism to forget this tragic event. She put on this face of a tough girl to hide her trauma. Now enlisted as a mech pilot, she hopes to at least prove herselft even if she's haunted by her past, to both herself and others.
Physical Description: 6,0 ft, 200 lbs, broad muscular figure, scars, red hairs, red iris (right) and blue iris (left).

Name: Saya
Known History: Saya hails from Ishiyama, the first Oni stronghold of the realm of Teisei. It is known that she shares a soul bond with some type of shadow spirit which appears to reside in the reliquary on her hip. She has spent recent years combatting evil Yokai and those that would follow them with the aid of her bonded spirit Kyoei, The Lunar Shadow.
Physical Description: Saya appears to be in her 20's with white hair tumbled into a bushy ponytail. Her eyes are violet, matching the color of the shadow flame within her reliquary hanging from her belt. She stands roughly 5'6" with a lean frame. She wears a white and black kunoichi garb accented with red bronze. Her bracers are inlaid with two amethysts from Ishiyama which she once called home. In her hair, a bronze ornament in the shape of two parallel horns. She wears an ornate katana at her side.

Name: Scarlet Alba
Known History:
"They broke me, but they made a mistake... They made my body my weapon..."

Once, she was nothing. Tested and drained until all that remained was a pale, hollow shell—her skin, hair, and eyes stripped of colour as everything that made her human faded away. She had no name, no self. Only a designation: Project 0413.

But the blood remembers. And the blood evolves.

The blood remembered warmth, even when she did not. The blood remembered emotion, even when her heart had long been silenced. And when it finally tore through its prison, it remembered one last thing—not everyone is cruel. Not all hands reached for her with needles and chains. In the chaos of her escape, there were those who whispered her name instead of a number. Those who hid her, who opened doors meant to stay locked, who saw the ghost she had become and chose not to fear her.

A name was given to the ghost,  Scarlet Alba.

Now, she seeks to relearn. To rebuild. To remember, and to make sure no one suffers a similar fate.
Physical Description: Scarlet stands tall, her entire form devoid of colour—a striking canvas of pale white. The only contrast comes from the vivid crimson markings that slither across her skin like living tattoos, shifting and flowing at her command.

Name: Selaphonea
Known History: Once a girl with a dream, to sing for the world with her wonderful voice, she has been disilusioned, still holding on to her dream however, hoping to one day change the world for the better through her voice.
Physical Description: A beautiful and enticing woman standing at a statuesque 6 feet 4 inches, she was engineered by SWORD to not only look as good as possible.

Name: Selene
Known History:
- Lived on the fourth floor of the Pavilion.
- Snuck around when younger to attempt to watch the Deliverers work to keep the Gilded of the floor safe.
- Being one of the few Gilded of the floor capable of fighting eventually approached the Deliverers to let her work with them when needed when she became old enough.
- Due to being of the few capable of fighting, did develop a habit of seeming insulted if not proactively picked as a weapon.
- Spent years working along side the the Deliverers to keep the other Gilded of the floor safe.
- Once released into Heaven from The Pavilion decided to join up with the Goldhearted to keep working to help people.
- Taking what she learned from the Deliverers, who helped shaped what she seeks in an ideal wielder, she closely evaluates individuals to eventually find that individual.
Origin: The Pavilion - The Fourth Floor - Heaven
Physical Description:
Selene - In her humanoid form she stands at 5' 5", golden blonde hair, and pink toned irises for her eyes. Usually dresses in a nice silken white clothing with red on its inside, with golden accented accessories.
ᵀʰᵉ Shredspire - A massive 5' diameter dual ring saw blade attached to a gem encrusted sickle by chain.

Name: Selene Harte
Known History:
Sightings of Selene were quite frequent when her parents were still present - not so much after they had abandoned their child, however. Those who knew the Harte parents beforehand speculate that they could not support a child and therefore abandoned it as soon as it could 'fend for itself'. 

Once alone, Selene's appearances dwindled in number as she sunk into the slums of Genesis - though by no means was this anywhere near safer. Some people who saw the girl on occasion reported her missing for quite some time during her first disappearance - when she returned, she was 'visibly shaken', her limbs involuntarily twitching at times. 

It was only after her second disappearance, returning with what looked to be restraints, did Selene vanish entirely, leaving what very little belongings she had behind.
Physical Description:
Standing at a humble 4'3 (with her boots), Selene boasts messy black hair paired with large glasses for equally large eyes. Most often seen wearing a white cloak, white shirt, black tie and black skirt, there is one thing that stands out the most in her attire: the golden chains. 

The chains in questions are connected to a large collar around her neck -large enough to cover a significant amount of her face- as well as cuffs that keep both her hands firmly close together.

Name: Sella Askelson
Known History:
* Parents are nomads
* parents killed at Kald Forest, passerby warrior saves Sella
* brought to camp von Kibo, grow up
* aim to become a warrior to protect the weak
* in a nearby village when kitsune raid
* Sella attacc, Sella protecc
* Sella barely kill a bit kitsune
* Nimue blesses her
* later kidnapped by snowstorm to Worldhelm
Physical Description:
* Ald woman
* Tall, muscular build, 190cm
* Blonde hair she wears down, ice blue eyes
* Simple bronze sword + large runes-inlaid shield
* Bronze brigandine above chainmail, circlet
* White wings she can extend and retract from her body at will

Name: Selvaria Lightheart
Known History:
Not much is known about Selvaria besides the fact that she cared for those that resided in Camp Von Kibo as if they were her own children, helping the sick, the mournful, and the lost. Her history as being a prominent figure of tending to the wounds within the camp has led her to be known as a motherly woman, always willing to help others with grace even though she didn’t gain anything from doing so.

Even though her transfer to the Worldhelm was abrupt, Selvaria showed no sign of resentment towards her new surroundings but instead extended her own love and care to those around her once more - after all - even in the camp she tended to strangers, there was nothing different than tending to those who are deemed fit for this vessel. Though she often worries about those in the camp, hoping they’re alright - she hopes to visit them soon and aid them once more.
Physical Description:
Standing about 5’11, Selvaria has a rather refined yet somber appearance. Wearing a long radiantly snow white dress with black accents, an ornamental pendant on the left side of her chest, and a shoulder pauldron to protect her from any light attacks. Being blessed as one of the Oni in Aldistir, Selvaria has a pair of long black horns fixed on the top of her head. 

Having long pink hair with redish tips, Selvaria conducts herself with grace and care as her vibrant light red eyes look around the Worldhelm for anyone needing assistance with any particular task or matter. Yet even as she conducts herself normally in her new found environment, Selvaria occasionally shines brightly like a beacon - like a heavenly angel with loving etiquette to match.

Name: Senna Florenz
Identity: A DJ trying to find her missing bandmates
Known History:
- Born in Terra Silver Rock, Haven

- Raised by their dad, a mechanic

- Helped their dad around the store, taking in what he taught them from a young age

- Was anxious at a young age, got into music to make friends

- Auditioned for tryouts with a girlband and got accepted

- Eventually went solo, rebranding herself as a DJ using her mechanic knowledge to create a custom mixing kit

- Members of her old band had begun to go missing, an illegible calling card left at the sight of each disappearance

- The same calling card was sent to her, so she was travelling between gigs to try to find her old bandmates

- Was in the middle of a set before being brought to the Worldhelm
Physical Description:
A young DJ from  Terra, her hair is a kaleidoscope of dyed colours held up in twintails , wearing lilac bodypaint over her skin and using a customized biker helmet that shows different emoticons when she performs with tall laced leather heels making her seem taller than she actually is.

Complimenting this is a plunging crop top and shorts, with colours matching the metallic green and blue in her hair

When she isn't performing, she compliments her look with jean shorts, a biker jacket and heeled boots

Name: Sephi
Known History: She is A working product of the Cyborg-human experiments by Dr Caden. She was sent to an associate for research on mind-control methods, namely the implantation of a 'Control Module', containing an alternate personality which they can program, installing combat data obtained from WWA in hopes of her joining the ranks of the Merrani Angels. Despite their efforts, the attempts to control the other personality was unsuccessful, leading to her escape into the greater reaches of Lhodos.
Physical Description: Black, short-haired girl, red eyes, wearing a black dress with a small tie and a baggy overcoat. Cyan Magitechno markings strewn across her arms and clothes. She is 160 CM tall.

Name: Seraphina
Known History:
There isn't much to say in regards to Seraphina, she doesn't particularly enjoy people calling her Sera nor does she like to talk about her own past. What can be gleamed of her is that she has had a traumatic experience in Nezmira, being the source of a deep pool of hatred towards the Nezzim. 

Even though she appears to be 'happier' ever since arriving in the Worldhelm, she carries a rather fake smile, a defensive mechanism she uses to protect herself and to push those she doesn't find trustworthy away. One can only assume what has transpired in her life to make her such a way, but for those from Nezmira, it's an obvious case of what she is - an outcast who has lived for too long, a girl given another chance at life or another chance at something else...
Physical Description:
Standing about 5’7, Seraphina has a sleek yet foreboding appearance that could often be described as boyish. Wearing a white blouse with long sleeves and black accents, black trousers, and shin high steel tipped black boots. With long silky onyx black hair and crimson red eyes, her appearance leaves a striking impression with the addition of her pale white skin and the adornment of her pitch black draconic horns extruding from the top of her head.

Seraphina acts with suspicion yet expresses a friendly outgoing attitude, even on board the Worldhelm, she conducts herself with respect - one couldn't even know from a glance what her true emotions are underneath her protective facade. A part of her that she doesn't aim to reveal, not to no one but solitude itself.

Name: Seraphine
Identity: A Magical Dancer, ready to protect those in need
Known History: Seraphine worked as a bodyguard and private dancer for some influential merchants before her work eventually led her to some unfortunate exposure to a moonshard, changing her forever. The big magical exposure made her able to adept using magic to changer her body much like the beasts mutated by those very shards. She now uses her new powers and her swift feet to aid those in need.
Physical Description: Seraphine's attire is a blend of ornamental and functional elements. She wears flowing, vibrant garments that allow for fluid movement, adorned with gold and red hues. Her hair, often decorated with magical charms and ornaments, flows freely during her movements.

Name: Serena Ansaze
Identity: ☆ Sparkling ⟡ Shining ♡ Ex-Propaganda Spewing Pop Star
Known History:
Serena grew up like many children in Merrane, listening to stories about brave  Merrani Angels and their good deeds. Unlike many Merrani children, she was gifted with musical talent: perfect pitch and a beautiful singing voice. Music was a part of her daily life, she'd sing songs about the food she ate, the people she loved, and those amazing heroes, the Merrani Angels.
Eventually, she was noticed by a talent scout, who immediately asked her to join their agency, promising much better equipment and other perks. She signed immediately, and began her career as the "Pop Star of Gold, Seri-Nya☆". She stopped writing songs of her own, instead singing songs by management with themes boasting of Merrane's imperialism, and painting them as heroic.
She lived a cushy life, becoming relatively well-known until she overheard her managers deriding, how it was nice to have such a naive mouthpiece. She took her things and ran. She came across a realmstorm, and wanting to disappear, let it take her.
Physical Description: Serena is a 5'3" girl with pink hair that is tied into pigtails. Out of costume, she dresses very plainly, a yellow blouse, brown skirt, and fake glasses to hide her identity. She walks with a hunch and is usually seen either frowning or a deadpan face. In costume, she wears a frilly, flowery, sparkling dress and carries a microphone. She always has a smile plastered on her face. Every now and then, wires can be seen running through the dress, connected to different speakers and mics in the costume.

Name: Shakes The Earth
Known History: A witch from Copsehaven, following in the footsteps of Auntie Kuzunoha to gain a deeper understanding of the wilds, the nature of magic, and the way that the two interact to form the elements of the world she lives in. Using the magic of totems and lightning, Shakes The Earth staunchly defended Copsehaven from attacks from devils and humans alike while delving into her unique application of her magic, until she arrived on The Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Shakes the Earth is a tall woman, with skin the tone of rich clay, and a body as sturdy as fired brick. Her limbs are adorned with magical totemic tattoos resembling feathers, fangs, waterways, and other elements of the natural world. Similarly to her tattoos, her clothing and overly long hair are also adorned with token from the animals of her home.

Name: Sharry Skelter
Known History:
Sharry was born in a small village that cant be found on the map but, according to her, its somewhere in the Albury Hills. Her memory fuzzy but she remembers having parents that loved her, and being alone in her house reading adventure and romance books. She remembers at some point in her young adult life, she was gifted a book by . . . someone. She cant remember who, just that it was someone who was not from her village. The book was on necromancy. She studied the ways of the undead.
She hardly remembers the night it happened but she remembers grabbing everything from her room and running into the forest. Then something or someone knocks her out and then she remembers falling off a cliff into the ocean.  She did not survive, but her necromancy helped her revive herself. She also says that her arms were mangled in some way and she had to get new ones but she never elaborates. Now, she is an adventurer  traveling the lands hoping to prove that she can be a hero.
Physical Description: She is about 6'0" tall human woman. She has pale white skin, silver-white hair, and red eyes. She usually wears black outfits, dresses for non-adventuring and dress pants and suits for adventuring. She always wears long, thick leather gloves and she never takes them off. She also wears the same black boots for all her attire.

Name: Shaw Jaeger
Known History:
One of the scions of the Jaeger family. When he was younger he was clearly being groomed to take over as the head of the Families Philanthropic work. However one day he vanished, quickly the news of his kidnapping hit the papers as well as the man hunt for him. Officially he was found by members of his own family in the Police force and rescued...since then he has stepped away from normal family work, as the experience left him scarred physically and mentally.
However the truth is he was used in Experiments, mutating his body with materials from The Black.
He now works for the SIA in the DSC and acts as  a PI for the normal citizens. He still searches for the people who experiment on him.
Physical Description: Scarred faced and large frame male. Roughly six foot four inches tall, with scars across his face and arms. He almost always has long sleaved suits and sunglasses regardless of time of day. His hair is usually slicked back, partly to stay with modern style and partly to keep out of his eyes. He has to rings, one on his right middle finger in the shape of a snake and another on his left middle that has the Jaeger family crest.

Name: Sheetal the Hornless
Known History:
-Born and raised within Prince Kashika and Suniti's domain to a single refugee mother.

-Identifies more with her demonic peers than her human heritage, viewing herself fully and completely as a demon serving under Prince Kashika. (much to her mothers chagrin) A viewpoint somewhat justified by her celestial attunement manifesting as a child.

-Out of gratitude for the safety and succor provided to her and her mother, Sheetal has taken a position in guiding and protecting refugees from elsewhere in Bahata Khajaana, training intensely.

-She held idyllic dreams of freeing the oppressed and overthrowing the vile, but over a decade of fighting to scrape out the tiniest of victories amid a sea of losses has crushed her spirit (or so she likes to tell herself, to make the failures more bearable).

-Awakened as a Goldhearted during a mission gone wrong, in which a refugee was bribed with a better life to rat out on her peers, leading to the deaths of several of Sheetal's comrades.
Physical Description: Standing at at imposing height, Sheetal makes for weary presence in any room she occupies, with dark circles under her green eyes and darker hair kept in a neat cut. "Hornless" is but a misnomer, a slight, a tongue-in-cheek mockery of her thin, branch-like antlers unfitting of a true demon. Raised as a guardian of the Tulasee fountains, Sheetal has developed many of the demonic features natural to her trueblooded kin. Her prim style of dress belies a well-defined form of toned musculature, and whatever looks she possesses are buried beneath a perpetual frowning visage, the weight of her responsibilities and unhealed bitterness physically drawing the corners of her mouth ever downward.

Name: Shibana
Known History:
- Originated in the Feywyrd from a rosebush
- Retains the memories of past warriors from the war
- They journey Aldistir, broaching peace to Ald and Yokai alike
- Camp von Kibo has been the main area to sympathise with Shibana's attempts, in particular an Ald named Blom has become Shibana's mentor
Physical Description: Shibana is a person born from a rosebush drenched in the blood of Ald and Yokai. Parts of their body are soft and light blueish green like a stem or leaf, others are coarse and grey like scar tissue. Brambles and purple roses wreathe their neck and form what might normally be hair. They wear clothes and armour, usually of Ald make. Around 5'8''.

Name: Shiel Don
Known History: A Warden within the forces of the KPLA with big dreams of becoming his own hero, It is that dream to become a hero and to shield others from as much harm as possible that resulted in him being picked up by the worldhelm
Physical Description: a 6'3 relatively muscular man with brown mid length hair and slight beard, wearing high tech (for the area he comes from) powered armor bearing iconography of the KPLA

Name: Shing
Known History: Shing served as the child minder for a nomadic tribe. His go to way to raise the children's spirits during their harsh life was playing pranks on the other nomads. This behavior was endured until Shing reached adulthood at with time after multiple warnings he was banished. Shing wandered the jungle alone for some time, about to perhaps reflect on his hubris... When he was swept up into the Worldhelm and found renewed hubris!
Physical Description: Shing is a lithe humanoid primate with a normally joyful expression, if a bit more... shifty at times.

Name: Shizuko and Tsubasa
Known History:
Shuzuko and Tsubasa are a pair entwined, their souls tangled inseparably due to the nature of the ritual Lorelei pulled them from the center of when they were young. Their rescue was violent, and fast, and thus their essences did not funnel back to their proper vessels in full.
During their time recovering in the care of Lorelei's retainers, the pair were discovered to have an aptitude for the arcane, bending both the physical and inner worlds to their will. It was found that in straying so very close to the center of things, being pulled against the seams of their realm, the sisters had on some subconscious level grasped the truth of it all. And to witness the truth of something, to see the whole of it, in many ways, is to claim the purest of powers over it.
Physical Description:
Shizuko is a humanoid Yokai. She has a mane of pale white hair which extends far passed her shoulders, seeming to operate under slightly less gravity than the rest of her form as it flits and floats behind her while she moves. From her top of her ear extend two vulpine ears, clad in the same white hair, which twitch often in response to noise, as if always on guard. Her adornment is mostly simple, remaining lightly armored, apart from a white mask which often covers her face almost entirely, shielding her eyes from the sun's reflection on the snow of her homeland. 
Tsubasa is another vulpine Yokai, though her form is quadrupedal and much more bulky and athletic than Shizuko's. Her posture is similar to a typical canine, with rending claws and a thick mat of grey and white fur, though patches of incandescence give her the impression to sometimes be gleaming with a spectrum of light. Tsubasa is larger than most other fox Yokai, and is very capable of carrying another on her back.

Name: Shizuru
Known History: Shizuru was born a commoner in Caldera, she worked as a maid for a wealthy family. Her job gave her the means to attended the White Wing Academy in hopes of receiving enough training and recognition to become an imperial servant. However after losing an eye during combat drills, she was fired from her position as a maid for being "disfigured".  She dropped out of the academy believing her disfigurement put her dreams as an imperial servant out of reach, and is now a freelance adventurer.  However, she keeps a picture of Princess Cora von Merrane as a reminder of her loyalty to the Empire. She believes the Imperial propaganda, she doesn't hate the people of Karlsgard, she thinks they are simply ignorant and mislead by their leadership.
Physical Description: Shizuru is a girl who is short in stature and has reddish gold straight long hair. She wears an eyepatch over her left eye, her right eye is emerald colored. She wears a military camouflage pattern scarf, and a maid outfit. While her face is beautiful, her emotions can be hard to read.

Name: Shēnruì Er Xián (申瑞儿咸 )
Known History:
Born and raised in Xuanwu City, Shēnruì was once spoken of in hopeful tones by elders who expected greatness from him. That promise never came to pass. Years ago, he abruptly vanished from cultivation circles, disappearing into the abandoned stretches of the city itself. Rumors claim he survived in forgotten districts and sealed ruins, living by theft, odd jobs, and constant movement until he eventually resurfaced.

Now he works in his family’s restaurant, a slacker with a reckless grin and a reputation as a waste of rare talent. To most, he’s seen as squandered potential, someone who stepped away when others would have clawed higher. Still, those who pay close attention notice that he never seems surprised by danger, and that his fire, though rarely displayed, remains very much alive.
Origin: Tian Yin, Wujing Guo, Xuanwu City
Physical Description: A lean, wiry man of about 5'8". His long, dark brown hair falls in uneven layers, often partially obscuring half-lidded eyes that carry an amused, watchful glint. He keeps a perpetual slouch and a lazy grin. His clothing is worn and loosely fitted, often hanging open to reveal a scarred, well-defined torso marked by old cuts and burns, while his forearms are wrapped in bandages stained by age and use.

Name: Shī kuǐlěi & Stagehand
Known History:
* Left on the doorstep of a theater in Xuanwu City and adopted by the leader
* Grew up under his training and developed a talent for crafting props and puppets
* Always living behind the stage looking out caused her to become awkward but fond of her audience
* Surrounded by performers, some being cultivators themselves, she was trained in her off time to try and judge her talent, revealing a connection to Earth Qi which she used to breath new life into her shows
* Began noticing audiences shrinking as the world outside grows harsher and people had less time/desire for entertainment
* Deciding the world needed heroes outside of storybooks she crafted her finest puppet ever Shī kuǐlěi
* Despite her fear of the world outside the backstage, she took her puppet forth and began protecting people
* Letting the fiction of the character get to her head she threw herself into an impossible fight  but was saved on the brink of death by Yubel plucking her to the Worldhelm
Physical Description: Pay no attention to the lithe young woman draped in black. Your eyes should ever be glued to the resplendent shimmering robes and handsome face of the puppet in front of her!

Name: Sienna
Known History:
Sienna came from Brightshield, Kor'Tarion. She was strong academically. She would go on to study in Hudal Academy.
Some time during her studies whatever financial support she previously had were either reduced or stopped. Rather than cut her losses she tried to juggle both multiple jobs and her studies at the same time. It ended badly for her; the heavy load left her to little time to study, complete assignments or rest which led to her failing important papers. This caused her to drop out.
Sienna now works various odd jobs to make ends meet. She is both bitter and demoralised by her previous failure.
Physical Description: Women in her late 20s. Dark brown hair that she keeps short. Has an expression that can vary between bitter and resigned.

Name: Sienna "Sweety" Gordon
Known History:
- Sienna lived alone with her father in Babyl City until he died when she was 20 years old.
- She was allowed to work in the same dock thanks to her father's goodwill.
- Her father died by stumbling across a deal gone wrong between some 100G members and the Vignettes with an exchange of stolen cargo.
- Since his death, she has been practicing her shooting skills in a scrapyard.
- A traumatic encounter with a daemon with her friends in an abandoned arcade has left her deathly afraid of screens.
Physical Description:
Sienna is a 4'1" Septid who wears a dirty trimmed jacket for a security firm located in Babyl City.
The jacket belonged to her father and was made to fit him so she trimmed it crudely.
Her black hair is always unkempt, her eyes are bright yellow, and her skin tone is a dirty green.

Due to her septid nature, she smells of lime soda and her ears are fairly long.
She may or may not have a tail and will never confirm it to anyone.

Name: Sierra
Known History:
- She was found and raised by a fae in the forest as a baby
- She was naturally talented as a hunter, seeking smaller prey and berries. She meets a hunter and would eventually become his apprentice, thus was able to hunt larger land prey. 
- She unknowingly gains Banshee's favor by hunting predators while driving off poachers that threatened the local avian wildlife, some endangered, 
- At some point she began to grow an affinity with the storm itself, hunting within it to catch anything hiding from it. 
- She unknowingly entered a realm storm just before she was about to hunt.
Physical Description:
-Rather pretty short in stature at 5'2/158 cm.
-Has aquamarine eyes and a ridiculously long braid twice and ha half her size.
-Mostly wears winter clothes, mostly lavender with white fur around.

Name: Silas Oristal
Known History:
- Of the Kigyo Tribe in Myist within the Rotfall Expanse

- Trained as a scavenger from a young age, and learned the best ways to look for scraps and any  supplies to scavenge from battles.

- Eventually took on a more reconnaissance-style role, scouting out ahead of time to find brutal battles that had just recently finished

- His efforts allowed to him be recognized for his contributions to the tribe and awaken his Alpha Potential binding his body, mind and soul.

- Now, his thirst for knowledge carries him beyond the forests of Myist. From human cities to beyond, there is much to be learnt
Physical Description: A 5'9" moderate-looking man who seems as though he hasn't been out in the sun for probably his whole life. Soft spoken and is always indulging in a tome of some kind. Dangling from his neck is a bone amulet, a small skull with a snake coiled around the eye sockets and out of the mouth. He wears a newly purchased hooded cloak, a black that matches his hair.

Name: Silida
Known History: A painter from the "free" city of Blue, located on the southern coasts of the land of Nezmira, he owns a book of many stories and fables...it's contents shift and change based upon his own knowledge, and what little he can glean of its previous owners causes great consternation.
Physical Description: A boyish looking man of fair features and mid-length hair, he exudes an aura of scholarly wisdom...and mild trepidation.

Name: Simone Katsav
Known History:
Simone was born in the Nezmiran city of scales to a family of butchers. As she grew older though, she would begin to feel that she could do more for her country and its people. So at the behest of her parents, she joined the Nezmiran Army

Her career was a bumby one, but eventually she rose through the ranks and eventially landed herself as a captain within the army. Assisting in the crackdown on the kiir problem as her main duty. 

However, one day she was given a personal invitation by Theoris himself. Ignorant of Theoris' malicious goals, she accepted it and ended up getting experimented on, gaining wings in the harrowing process.

She now assists the Worldhelm with her capabilities. Having felled many great foes, like eleleth of utopia, and assisted in the goal of a free Nezmira. She met many friends and also found love, yet other realms are still under their own plights, so the fight continues on.
Physical Description:
Simone is a 6'4" Nezzim with Crimson colored scales, fiery orange eyes, and curved horns. She can normally be seen wearing either her commemorative sunrise armor or her an assortment of military vestments. She carries herself a level of rigidness almost akin to a model soldier. The biggest oddity to her looks is the two large wings on her back, something that is not at all typical for Nezzim.
Her choice of armaments is usually a spear or some kind of polearm, supplemented with a large tower shield for protection.

Name: Sir Bedivere
Age: Probably late 20s, early 30s. He doesn't know exactly.
Known History:
Much like the rest of Dreamites, woke up two years ago. Chose to be a knight, finding himself either being sent out into the Forest of Loss, or doing weapon and armor maintenance. He carries himself reminiscent of a more experienced knight, even if his own actual prowess is lacking from what he seemingly remembers. He found himself listless, wanting to go out but is bound by their own sense of duty.

Occasionally experiences the dreams of various people that he's spoken to at random intervals. He has a small reputation of suddenly acting eccentric in inopportune moments. So takes to reading all about he could find on dreams, and developing an interest of reading fictional tales.

Then dream of Deleria ends. Wakes up properly is told by his King and the Archmage that they have to leave the Island. From there, he starts a new journey while still having a new home in Polis. Only for the meantime.
Physical Description:
Bedivere is a tall man who stands at 6'3" with long silver hair that reaches to the middle of his back and tied in a messy ponytail. One of the notable details is his ears and tail that are akin to a wolf, much like the beastlike humanoids previously found in Deleria. A muscular figure that has years of experience in the battlefield, capable of achieving great feats of strength that could be considered to some degree superhuman. Typically wearing a coat or a knight's attire, pants, and boots. His expression usually on the less emotive side.

He carries himself in a rigorous fashion, akin to a knight of his station. Having a surprisingly calm tone when speaking, even if his vocal pitch is deep and has the capacity to be booming.

Name: Sir Mordred
Known History:
Mordred woke up in Castle Ladon, Deleria. Among many similar to him, the memories of his past were a bit hazy. He did clearly recall who he was though and roughly what life he previously had, he was a Squire to the Knights of Ladon.

The early days of their awakening, while confusing, lasted relatively shortly, as people began to acclimate to their new reality. Mordred would spend his days like any typical squire would. Do chores for to the Knights and train under them so he could become a knight himself one day. However, when Sir Octavian and others left to live outside the castle walls, Mordred realised how stale and repetitive his everyday was. During this stagnancy, Mordred would pick up reading fantasy novels from Wulfrics study as a hobby. 

However, after Wulfric and Regus announced that everyone would have to leave Deleria, a sense of excitement and wonder filled Mordred's heart. For he was now able to go on the very same adventures that could be found in the books he read.
Physical Description: Mordred is a 5'6" Dreamite of Deleria who's appearance harbors similarities to Dragons and Canidae. His furcoat is white with some black accents, and his eyes are skyblue. He typically wears a mix of leather and steel armor, and can be seen walking around with a bag and greatsword on his back. He typically carries himself in a rather lax and carefree manner, but can get quite competitive.

Name: Sirius Proudmoore
Known History: The commander of a minor mercenary company on Kor'Tarion that isn't around anymore.
Physical Description: Sirius is a warrior in physique and attitude.  Short red hair tops a head left scarred, and an eyepatch covers what remains of his left eye.

Name: Siwu「四五」
Identity: A Stone Cast Into an Ocean
Known History: A young cultivator from an unknown village, carrying an unknown inheritance and a strange form of cultivation, Siwu is truly a fish out of water in a world he knows hardly anything about.
Origin:
Secret Fern Village,
Shouwang Senlin,
Wujing Guo,
Tian Yin
Physical Description:
Standing at 6'0", Siwu has tanned skin, as well as a rugged physique from long hours of manual labor and farming. He bears no scars or other signs of physical conflict, and his cheerful smile is seemingly always present.

His attire is simplistic and his only possession of note is a stone rod covered in talismans which he carries at all time.

Name: Sizz
Known History:
- Born to a moderately wealthy human family in South Rock, owners of a body modification clinic.

- Became obsessed with body modifications from a young age and underwent the initial process as a young adult at his parents' workshop.

- Studied under his parents, though chose not to take over their shop. Instead, he decided to help them develop a series of self-defense modifications.

- Needing good (and legal) testing opportunities, he decided to join Parabellum as a TEMP and Tracker under their Battle Enforcement Division.

- Is considering joining AGES to help Terra and watch over his best friend, Beryl.

- Currently in training to become a Soulrunner after a series of unfortunate events in RWO. 

- His Call Sign is "Sizzle" for the sound his "Wingtips" make when activated.
Other Names:
Birth Name: Reginald "Reggie" Edwards
Call Sign: Sizzle
Physical Description: A 6' tall, 180 lb orange-and-red-feathered avian gentleman with a passion for body modifications. His wings bear tiny devices at the ends of his feathers (affectionately called "Wingtips") which allow him to manipulate moisture to create various elemental effects. Despite the size and power of these wings, however, he cannot fly.

Name: Skada Ralgarsdottir
Known History:
• Born to the small village of high pass in Aldistir
• Trained in healing, and scholarly studies. Known for her kindness and love.
• Due to her younger sister, Sigrid, picking a fight with the Jarl's son and losing. Being the first of kin and Sigrid being a minor, the punishment and disgrace of the name Skada fell upon her.
• Lost a lot of her innate kindness in the struggle for survival in exile.
• Finally was found by Sigrid after Sigrid joined the Warband of the Branded, reuniting them, they were then gobbled by a realmstorm.
Physical Description:
Standing at a lengthy and almost hostile 6'2, Skada is a woman with eyes that are as piercing and judgemental as a crow. Her straight red hair is draped over her shoulders in a slightly wild and unfettered manner, like the licks of angry flames. Her form is tense most of the time, ready. Just in case.

“The unwise man
    is awake all night
    worries over and again.
    When morning rises
    he is restless still,
    his burden as before.”  — The Havamal

Name: Sloan Katsav
Identity: A Once Great Magician Chasing Magic
Known History:
What was once the Pureblooded noble of Nezzmira, is now just a practitioner of the Arcane. No longer pureblooded nor blue scaled, Sloan Roman's heights were in shackling a spell around the Angel of the End, Loftur. Such an act was not left unpunished, as Loftur stripped her of her prestige and abilities, hurling her back to a beginning many Goldhearted start at. Where many would crumble or crack under such strain and torment, Sloan has never looked happier in her life. Able to carve her own path forward unshackled by the weight of her past, or defined by a need to do bad in the name of good. Now she is as any scholar should be, on the pursuit to learn. Setting her sights to better understand magic of every realm. 

"The study of the Arcane, is learning in the end you truly knew nothing and starting again. All it took for me to rekindle my desire to learn, was being a thorn in Loftur's side. Fret not, this is nothing to the likes of me. I will be great again, for I already am."
Physical Description: The once Blue-Scaled Nezzim now bears dark black scales, the occasional glint of purple and blue hues along them. A change in her very magical nature altering her physical form, showing the severing of her magic from the Dragonlords of Nezmira. Standing taller than most women due to her draconic nature, her stature denotes her as a scholar of the Arcane. She now bears the clothes of a wizard or witch, the styling that of Kor'Tarion of all places as if she found a fascination with their style. Even the looks of her magic altered and strange, now taking on dazzling colors and an otherworldly nature to it.

Name: Sol
Known History: Sol, once a powerful Archfey known as the "Guardian of Protections," was revered for his mastery over all elements, including light and dark magic. After a great battle left him weakened, he retreated into a long slumber within an ancient tree to recover. For decades, he lay dormant while the world of Kor'Tarion transformed, ravaged by the destruction of the moon and the chaos of wild magic. Sol finally awoke after the Night of the Red Sky, stirred by the demonic invasion and the loss of life. Now, though greatly diminished, Sol must adapt to this new world. Discovering who he is beyond his time and accept this new life wherever it may lead.
Physical Description: A tall, slender man with long, wispy white hair cascading down his back, adorned with intricate runic tattoos etched along his limbs. Delicate wings made of faint rays of light extend from his back, shimmering softly with every movement.

Name: Sol Anaphalis
Known History:
Nothing was known about them for most their life, until suddenly they started to appear across many battlefields across Lhodos, Especially those near Hedgeberg; Arriving in a sudden flurry spreading poison and fire across the battlefield before disappearing. The only note left would be seeds and a single glowing red flower that seems to never wilt.

Most records would be Sol appearing suddenly to protect trade caravans and those independent from the war simply trying to live their life or when key sections of natural beauty were being impacted
Physical Description: Standing at roughly 6 foot, Thick woody veins making up a good part of her body, rough to the touch stretching all the way up to the face. Her hair looks normal to a distance but up close is composed of leaves and plantlife instead of normal hair

Name: Solaraynn Ista
Known History: Another Ophidiya from Skamos who has rarely if ever been seen dancing in the Ruins of Ista or the coast between those ruins and the Cerulean Bay sometimes even in the dead of night. after many years of being an outcast living with their human parent on the outskirts of town nearly undiscovered, and gazing from across the Bay upon what he believed was Falak-Khan, but upon inquiring about him and seeing how much people were trying to cover up his existence... Solaraynn left home with some essentials, and a book of research that he still uses to improve his dance, with many questions burning in his mind such as "Why was Falak-Khan cast back down to the ground for trying to escape circumstance?" or "What would life be like up there above the clouds looking down on the world that has cast you out?" ... Solaraynn, too has begun to dream of the skies and beyond. but now a new question emerges, will he ever be able to reach that which he dreams of?...
Physical Description: slightly tan with a white, gold, and blue color scheme. Around 5' 11 in height, with some features of his non-human parent showing (such as his horns, tail, and patches of scales on his skin)

Name: Solaris Storm
Known History: loves mangos and was from The fire ant village before going on his own venture. Returned after hearing gold hearted were there and needs to find out why
Physical Description: Lithe Physique, armor focused on protecting the legs more than the torso and up, and a massive slab of metal for a sword that ignites and reshapes to that of a sword. a bandana on his brow and short chopped hair. also just generally exudes heat indiscriminately.

Name: Solomon Winter
Identity: Estranged Son of a Sorcerer King
Known History:
Solomon Winter is not his actual name, but it's the one he gives out to people who ask. Born in Lastport to a merchant's daughter, his childhood was relatively rough, given the seeming lack of father. In his late adolescence, his grandfather disowned him, causing the young lad to adopt his new moniker and work in the streets of Caer Laie.

A few years later, Solomon traveled to Caer Oarid, where he found out the truth. His father was a reviled sorcerer lord, and his mother had wed him in secret. His grandfather, who had basically sold his daughter, was to raise a proper heir, but the boy turned out to be too soft. Distraught by this revelation, Solomon fled until he came upon a storm of myriad colors. Seemingly struck by lightning, he then woke up at the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: A young man of middling height, Solomon Winter nonetheless stands out from a crowd. His hair is blond and tied back, his eyes a soft brown. His attire is an odd mix of a traveller's garb and finery. He carries himself with an air of nobility that belies his inner insecurities.

Name: Solána Olowe
Known History:
In her youth, Solána scoured her family's ancestral journals that contained stories of pursuits for ancient herbal knowledge beneath the sands. Her fascination with healing remedies blossomed, strengthening her desire to counteract the hardships burdening her people under the Scalefire Empire. While attempts at creating traditional medicine were mundane, her enthusiasm made up for it.

Years later, while wandering the hidden alleyways of the Blue City, Solána stumbled across a small, yet vibrant altar dedicated to Al-Shifā, The Maiden of Light. The energy that radiated from this sacred space beckoned her to stay, inviting her to reflect and draw  warmth from within herself. A night of clarity later, Solána felt something awaken within her, as if the very essence of the sun itself imparted her with a promise: to spread vitality to all those decaying under the Empire's malady.
Physical Description: As a young, statuesque woman standing at 5'8", Solána carries herself with purpose and a dash of curiosity. Her rich dark skin serves as a canvas for the delicate spread of freckles across her nose, shoulders, and chest. Being a desert native, she often wears loose-fitting dresses, accessorized with bangle bracelets and large-hoop earrings that reflect the vibrant hues of her amber eyes.

Name: Somnolence
Known History:
- Hails from Aldistir, and felt no sense of belonging in her tribe, rejecting their bloody ways
- Survivor of Godblood exposure
- Hair and eyes were a different color before the exposure
- Caught in a Realmstorm during a blizzard while lost in the wastes of Aldistir
- Often found dancing or singing alone, occasionally seen painting on high vantage points
Physical Description:
With gradient pink hair and lavender eyes, Somnolence stands at 6'2" (187cm). Her eyes are usually sharp and expression neutral or in a frown despite her kind nature, and she stands typically reserved.  She wears a light blue, sleeveless shirt with a cravat, and loose fitting brown pants with long brown boots.

She carries with her a long, cylindrical tube on her back filled with paintings and supplies. She is always seen with a multicolored haori, often worn with it handing on her arms rather than over her shoulders.

Name: Sonam Kham
Identity: The Solitary Bowman Seeking to Rekindle A Dojo
Known History: What is more known about Sonam is the reputation of his father, a man who has a list of accomplishments that are rarely seen, including the fostering of a Dojo in the more distant lands of Leytik - Sansarko's Gasp. The dojo has since fallen in obscurity in recent years.  Sonam has been seen in various villages in those isolated islands, leaving as soon as he can, getting resources along the way though very occasionally he stops and gives his aid to the townsfolk.
Physical Description: Grey and brown mismatched eyes with and long black hair put in a ponytail, braids partially decorating the hair. A bulky build with several prayer beads and the like wrapped around his wrists. Silk, Furs, and leather belts draped across his form.

Name: Song-5
Known History: Song-5 used to have a name, family, and home. Everything changed on the day she was about to be sucked up by the realmstorm. Pushed away by a foreign entity, she was instead yoinked through a dark magical vortex, waking up in the Spirit's Grove. Now with a new body and powers, there was no way she could go back home. Eventually after crying herself to sleep, the crackling of familiar sounding lightning came back for round two. Now she's here!

Name: Soot
Known History: The youngest child in a family of blacksmiths, Soot chose to follow a different path, training as a wielder of arms rather than crafter in the hopes of one day leaving the nest on some grand adventure or other. His coarse methods of self-instruction have likely left him with some bad habits notable to those more experienced in martial training. Though a self-admitted daydreamer, he is even-tempered and bears a strong sense of responsibility, particularly to those he has promised to protect.
Physical Description: An ashen-haired Hiear youth of slight build at 5'/152 cm, Soot hardly cuts an imposing figure. Yet beneath the armor is a body toned and shaped through many long, dedicated hours of harsh training under layers of metal heavier than himself.

Name: Sophron
Known History:
A mysterious man who is seen across Arcadia wherever heroes are in the early stretches of their journeys. He never shows his face, and his origin is an unknown.

The particularly knowledgeable could draw connections between him and the followers of Scyllis, but the specifics aren't public.
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'11" and weighing 160lbs, Sophron's exact appearance is obscured as he is covered from head to toe, wearing a full cloak and mask.

He wields a dagger and a buckler primarily, as well as fighting with seemingly prehensile golden wire.

Name: Soryn Camelia
Known History: Not much is known about Soryn besides him being usually found in the Blue City, as well as missing his right arm. He's known for assisting in hunting the Kiir from time to time, as well as being particularly quiet about his own magical prowess.
Physical Description:
Soryn is a young man who stands at 6'1"/185cm tall. With long black hair, purple eyes, a muscular build, as well as having rabbit ears and a cotton tail that indicates traits as a hiear. Wearing green robes that he wears it in a half manner that shows much of his left arm and torso, as well as cotton pants and a pair of sandals.

One would be able to notice that he is missing much of his right arm, leaving a bandaged stump. Typically using the sleeve of the green robes to cover it.

Name: Stock Trinity
Identity: Merrane's Number One Stock Trader (From Another Realm).
Known History:
Stock’s whole life had been preplanned for her before she was even born. Her parents were lucky enough to work at the Trinity Inc and be allowed to carry a prestigious last name: Trinity; a last name many sought out to obtain. With it allowed to have only the best education and granted the purpose of working at the best company on Terra.  The organization that monopolized peace & saved Terra from itself. She loved the idea of being able to give back and earn money to help fund the prosperity that her future work environment already provided. 

"shit got fucked with a crazy storm and now i'm in this realm"

Stock struck a deal with a war factory owner in the Kingdom of Gold and with five years of work she still felt like she had only begun to scratch the surface of this land's different cultures, magics, and markets. After obtaining the owner of the war factory’s blessings and a parting heirloom to show their faith in her, Stock left the Kingdom of Gold to make her way to the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: She has a slim muscular build with a 5'6" frame that is often covered by magitech gear. Short black hair, with dyed ends, are usually managed by being tied up or hidden with a hat. She always has her heirloom in her hands and a backpack stocked with goods to sell. When her blue eyes aren't looking down at her heirloom she's looking confident towards her next investment.

Name: Storm
Known History: A 'pirate' working for the KPLA, Storm's always had a knack for exploiting others' weaknesses and knowing exactly where to twist the knife, and used this mostly to take from those she thought could afford to lose (mostly the Empire of Merrane) and give to those who needed it more (keeping plenty for herself of course). After Merrane began their conquest, she decided to lend her services to the KPLA, more than happy to be as much a thorn in the Empire's side as she could.
Physical Description: Nearly six feet tall (6'10" if you include the ears), Storm has dark skin that contrasts her silvery-white hair and ice blue eyes. She typically wears a sky blue coat fringed with white and her entire right arm, up to the shoulder, has been replaced with a metal prosthetic. (She always gives a different story when asked how it happened.)

Name: Stormbringer
Known History:
- Lucius was born in Haven to parents who made enough to get by.
- They worked a lot, so he had a lot of time to himself. He made good use of his solitude studying.
- He was fortunate enough to be sent to university
- His classes were a breeze, but he felt deeply unsatisfied with life
- He figured it out after catching a news report on the Temps of Terra. That was the life he wanted.
- Work on his next first project started immediately; a weapon that would set him apart other mercs.
- His peers found his diagrams unrealistic and childish, while his parents discovering his aspirations sparked a huge fight.
- He ran from both, and spent the next few years with obsessive determination on his project.
- After many prototypes, his weapon was finally complete. A railgun titled “Thunder Reigns”, the shock and awe from his blasts earning him the moniker “Stormbringer”. He loved it so much, he discarded his old name.
- He took a job in the Old World, where he was swept up by a Realmstorm.
Physical Description: The young man comes in at 5'7” (to his dismay), 140 lbs, bright blue eyes and dyed snow white hair. Wears an all black outfit: Jacket, boots, pants with some rips in them, and a compression shirt with a face mask. It's always pulled up. Despite his apparent slim form, a large railgun always accompanies him-strapped to his back. He swings it around like it's weightless.

Name: Strabo Brightfeathers
Known History:
- Born as the smallest of his nestlings, fell from the nest as a fledgling and recovered slowly.
- Never had interest in trinkets unlike other Ravens as a child, instead did weird movements that caused ridicule.
- Supportive parents disappeared one day while hunting, leaving no one to defend him.
- Revealed his talent along with his first trinket, an instrument, during his Coming of Age ceremony, shocking the murder with his unconventional storytelling through dance.
- Still attempting to be accepted by the flock, wanders the lands in search of inspiration and experiences to commit to memory and song.
Physical Description:
Strabo stands at a bubbly three saplings tall, his feathers black as night and eyes as blue as the sky. Despite this, he's always considered a colorful individual, garbed in brightly colored fabrics that allow him to be picked out in a crowd, and his dancing talons always causing a scene.

Strapped to his person is always an instrument of some kind, never the same as the last and always perfect for the occasion. His favourite, however, is a metal disk shaped like a stone that reverberates when struck, forged by a friendly lizard within the group he travels with.

Name: Stratos of Neikos
Known History:
- Born in Neikos, the Colosseum of Conflict. Nothing is known of Stratos' parents, and he was raised directly by Arikos herself.
- He lived an exciting life of training, sparring, competition, and socializing. A boisterous and jockey young man.
- When Arikos left Arcadia, just over four years ago, he took on a vastly different way of life. His free time became training, his spars became lethal tests of his ability without relent. He became focused, brutal, and distant.
- Little is known about Stratos, beyond those of his inner circle. Godless, he now strives for more.
Physical Description: A tall man of nearly all muscle. He's lean, swift, and well kept. His hands are perfectly manicured, skin without blemish, eyes a striking gold with no bags. He is the pinnacle of what a man could be, to him. A constant effort is taken to maintain his appearance.

Name: Suitori Izu
Known History:
Suitori Izu is a girl born near Ishiyama, and raised by another Village after her home was raided, where she fled into the night and miraculously survived. 

Taught to dance by her mother, and learned to fight by watching and studying others until she found herself a mentor of the blade.

She picked up Cultivation, taking the paths of Water and Body; with a hand dipped into various bits before settling on two.

Now a Goldhearted, following the Dao of Water and seeking to Liberate Ishiyama, alongside pursuing Pursua in hopes of achieving her dream.
Other Names:
Suitori (Family name)
Izu (Given Name)
Jade Beauty of Ishiyama, Dancer of Flowing Rivers, Student of the Sword of Teisei, Lady of House Aiuchi
Physical Description:
Height: 160cm
Eyes: Deep sea Blue
Weight: None of your business.
Complexion: Pale
A rather beautiful young woman, with long dark silky hair, donning a dancers attire and carrying a varied selection of weapons (2 for now). Normally seen with a Ringblade roughly her size.

A sly smile, a curious gaze, a gentle touch. These are among many of the tools she has at her disposal.

Name: Sullivan 🛡
Known History:
- Was a bodyguard for a royal family in Merrane and was relegated to escort and security detail
- Since he was a  family friend, he got in with aspirations and admiration of the work rather than qualification like weapon mastery
- Had believed that the resistance threat was smaller and more insignificant due to propaganda 
- An assassin was able to take advantage of his naivete and passivity and worm their way past them
- Failed to protect the lives of royal family heir and was dismissed for societal and physical incompetency
- Pursuit of purpose, becoming more capable as a bodyguard, and atonement for his failure to protect
Physical Description: Average height, short dark brown hair, toned skin, and light weight build

Name: Sumati
Known History:
* Daughter of the Elder of the tiny village of Kata, nestled in the forests wests of the Ngari Riverlands

* Her Father began her on the path of Shadow Qi, teaching her how to defend her family by killing interlopers and Spirit Beasts Both in full shadow.

* When she was old enough, she inherited the Hearth Daggers, the weapons passed down from her family to protect Kata.

* She took over the village when her Father died. Not long after, she married her husband: Akar.

* Together, they had a child, Palkyi

* While she was heading home from hunting a particularly tricky spirit beast, she accidentally fell into a realm storm.
Physical Description:
At a lithe 5'1, Sumati is by no respects an intimidating woman. She is a simple girl in mostly practical clothing, though she does often like spots of jewelry, especially her well worn earrings.

She is often quiet, moving with a certain practical grace. Each step has purpose. And when she fights with her daggers, that purpose is made manifest.

Name: Summer Rain
Known History:
Summer Rain lived their life with their clan. They taught Summer to hunt, eat, cook and how to survive the harsh wilderness of the mountains of Rhew by learning to fight like the savage beasts of the land do. 

Their tribe taught Summer to hide their body to all for they considered themselves not mortal, but spirits of the land who do not consider race and gender a thing. 

When Summer one morning found a man from outside the tribe being attacked by a beast, Summer went to rescue the man. They succeeded but in the skirmish their identity was revealed to the man from the outside world.

Summer's tribe demanded that Summer kill the man to keep him quiet forever. Summer refused to take another's life in such a way. Summer's tribe took the mans life anyway. For this Summer was exiled, which devastated Summer. But they figure that if they can kill enough legendary beasts and prove themselves a true spirit of the realms. They will be accepted back.
Physical Description: They appear to be very tall. Standing around 6'6. As for other physical attributes they cover their body in heavy layers of cloth and robe.

Name: Sunya
Known History:
Once a young mortal girl, then was indoctrinated into the Empty Monk order that prevailed over the lands of Leytik. Going on the path of becoming a cultivator by sacrificing their individuality, bit by bit.

Removing their name, their ambitions, their sense of self comfort, their bonds, their empathy... However, there was one thing that they never fully remove: their love for music. And that alone was the driving reason for abandoning her current path.
Physical Description: White hair, usually tied in an elaborate manner and wearing white robes. Standing at 5'4, usually moving in a graceful manner. Expressionless yellow eyes gazing at the world around them. Sometimes carrying an ornate guzheng that they seem to guard jealously.

Name: Svetlana Nenadović
Known History:
Svetlana Nenadović, firstborn son of Jovan Nenadović, is an heir to one of the wealthiest families in all of Myist. Those in the Agency would know the Nenadović family to be an old, important name in the SIA's history, having long ago helped found it and to this day serving as an important source of funding.

Svetlana is a practitioner of Vlach magic, a bending of the Black's corrupting influence to the will of the user. Those knowledgeable about such things might notice the toll it has taken on his mind and body...
Physical Description:
Svetlana is a sickly young man, standing at 5'2" with a boney frame. He body is tainted by exposure to the Black, his veins are a foul black and he struggles to walk without the aid of a cane.

He covers his ailments up with fine clothing, rather out of fashion by most standards but a sign of old wealth to others of high pedigree.

Name: Swarm
Age: N/A - [Body it uses is one of a 20 year old human]
Identity: A flower now free from the hive-mind
Known History:
Before inhabiting the vessel they find themselves in. Swarm was a mere flower amongst many within the Gwaed Forest.
A Sarracenia Colchicum, otherwise known as the Pitcher Crocus was once a normal flower before the shattering of the moon. After contact with one of many fallen shards, the flower changed to a carnivorous plant which now attacked wild life and at times humans. The shard has also granted it thought, with the inflorescences of these flower forming a hive-mind. Working single handedly to survive. Nothing more. That was what the hive was to do.
Decades would pass as the flowers stayed put. Never spreading, staying in one region of the forest. In recent times, bodies were dropped off. Dropped off where the pitchers hid and they were disposed. Though one did not make into the pitchers, only tossed away to the side. Safe from the horde a flower bloomed from the empty eye socket of the body. Time passed and Swarm was born. Able think on its own. Maybe able to form its own tale.
Physical Description: The Swarm appears as a female humanoid with a pair of small wings upon their back, pale lavender skin, short pale lavender hair, one red eye, and a Crocus flower blooming where the other eye should be. The Swarm wears a black and purple dress which seem to be well tailored for the body the Swarm lives in.

Name: Sybil
Known History: A member of the newly formed group of the Brave Asphodels, Sybil is the direct apprentice of the Gravetender Lysethea. Prior to her absconding to the Worldhelm, she practiced in hearing the voice of the Firwood through its spirits, creatures and plants, and spoke for peace and reconciliation with the rest of the Tribes…though her voice went unheard. As such, she took matters into her own hands…and instead of merely defying the will of the Black Pack, she chose to sever ties entirely: she rescued a Moth named Cassius, who foretold of the abject failure of Gawain’s plot, and in doing so shattered her bonds with the wolves. Marked with the Traitor’s Brand, she is an outcast among outcasts.
Physical Description: Of the Wolves of the Firwood, Sybil is a shorter and thinner member of their tribe. She stands only at about 5’2”, and her build is that of one who did little physical labor. The mark of the Hare rests on her breast, so it is rare to see…and even rarer is the arrowhead shaped mark that crisscrosses it, the Traitor’s Brand that denotes her status as a true enemy to her tribe.

Name: Syl'thra
Known History: Syl hails from the distant Farwood, supposedly, but not even Syl knows where she’s really from. Nor does she know who - or what - she really is. All she knows is that she crawled out of a pale silk cocoon in a dark forest one day, and before her wings could properly dry, a terrible storm swept through the foliage… and in the chaos, she saw a beautiful light which beckoned her closer. Now, somehow, she’s here - and Syl intends to learn as much as she can about the various realms and their peoples. So much to see! So much to do! So many things for a little moth girl to experience!
Physical Description: Syl is about the size of a human child and looks similar, with pale skin and a humanoid body structure. However, what sets her apart from a human are her gossamer wings, which hang like a cloak from her back, as well as dainty antennae which twitch inquisitively atop her head. She is clad in robes that are seemingly made from the remnants of a silk cocoon, and clutches a curiously-shaped tree branch close to her at all times.

Name: Sylvaine Corinth
Known History:
Sylvaine's past is unlikely to be known by anyone on the Worldhelm. Those from Kaiway on the other hand would either know her as one of the top students from her class, and class representative of her class in Gnosis Academy. Having come from a Upper Class family of Graduates this is almost expected of her in some regard. She is the wielder of the Regalia known as The Hegemony.

After the Anarchy Tournament was put on hold she had taken up the role as Acting Headmistress. Many don't agree with Vene's choice, but none the less she has taken up the role in the best of her abilities.
Physical Description: Sylvaine stands roughly at 5'10 without her heels on but stands closer to 6' with them. She holds herself to a level of prestige that many would make fun of. Her uniform is always well kept and the emblem of the House of Paladins always shown proudly on her shoulder. Over her shoulder is the Regalia known as The Hegemony, and above her head is a shimmering, purple halo of chaotic magic.

Name: Sylvaine Corinth.
Known History:
To those who don't know her history, Sylvaine Corinth is just a noble girl who attends Gnosis Academy as a Paladin to Lilith in her third year. There isn't very much that is strange about her, and seems like a normal girl.

To those who knew Sylvaine Corinth, she is the mortal reflection of the Third Angel of Rebellion.  Due to fragmentation, she has forgotten her time on the Worldhelm and the time in the Remedial class.
Physical Description: Sylvaine stands roughly at 5'10 without her heels on but stands closer to 6' with them. She holds herself to a level of prestige that many would make fun of. At school, she is usually in her custom uniform, and is seen wielding a machine gun known as ᵀʰᵉ Hegemony. She has many different trinkets that she carries with her from memories she can't fully recall.

Name: T.R.E.E
Known History:
*Upon asking T.R.E.E about their past, they always give the same general sounding response.*

"Hello there, I'm T.R.E.E, otherwise known as the Terrestrial Robotic Environmentalist Entity! Though the majority of my data repositories have become too damaged and corrupted over time to read, I am aware that my former duties consisted of documenting information regarding Lhodosian wildlife, and working towards the conservation of species that are affected by Merrani industrial efforts. I am to continue this mission here on the Worldhelm, and all the other realms, unless a future operating function forbids me otherwise! As for how I arrived here... I'm not very sure. Days and nights blur when you're sitting at the bottom of a pond for... I'm not sure how long, it seems my calendar module has been lost... Well, the water is murky, and storms are loud. One day those everyday ripples became surging waves, and in a flash, here I was. I hope this information can be of assistance to you!"
Physical Description: T.R.E.E stands at about 5'6", and is unnaturally dense and heavy due to their construction. Each footfall leaves a dissonant clang as they walk. Where cogs and scrap metal fail them, however, overgrown, seemingly magical flora keeps their form together, and assists in their movements, as vines lace in-between each joint. They carry around a simple binder of magitech cards, and are able to capture photos of whatever they are looking at, as upon closer inspection, the magitech lenses in their eye sockets appear to extend and retract, and change aperture.

Name: Taavi
Identity: Wandering Peddler of the Tundra Clans
Known History:
- Human from  the aldish Clan in Gravernmarq, left some years ago to learn more about cooking in other dwellings.

- Since he seldom returned to his birthplace, he often had a longing to belong to the places he studied at.

- So when a group of Wandering Merchants came along, all from different parts of the Realm he joined them. The call themselves "Catalysts of Commerce"

- While on a trip to Blood Pools to gather some bloody thistles for a dish, he was swept up in a Realmstorm and woke up in the Worldhelm
Physical Description:
Taavi is a light-skinned man with shortish brown hair. He wears a rather wide-brimmed green hat, sometimes decorated with multicoloured flowers.
The coat he wears is rather old and shabby looking, yet it has pleasant look about it.
He carries a bag on his back that contains all the things he needs in life.

Name: Tachibana Saki
Known History:
* Saki was born outside Taira castle. Growing up, she studied ikebana (flower arranging), shūji (calligraphy), and wasai (tailoring).
* Met an aspiring pharmacist, the two were married at 19, and had their first kid at 21.
* Opened a medicine and flower shop near the castle and hired an assistant. At 26, her husband was charged with tax crimes and arrested. He has not been seen since.
* Saki, her daughter Ami, and her assistant Erika moved to Moshibaru shortly after. Tachibana no Kusuri to Hana has since flourished.
* Recently, a mysterious samurai escorted Ami back to the shop one day. Saki was greatly thankful for rescuing her daughter, and the samurai has continued visiting. While Saki lacks the station to ask the samurai to go elsewhere, her presence is rather welcome at the shop, and so she has allowed her to come and go as she pleases.
Physical Description:
Saki stands at 157 cm (5'2") with brown eyes and long black hair that falls to her mid back. It's usually put up in a bun using several kanzashi (hair decorations). She wears mostly casual kimono and is sharply dressed, though the designs are rather flashy and noticeable.

Picrew credit <https://picrew.me/en/image_maker/29910>

Name: Taiki Ibuki
Known History:
- 2nd generation half-oni man from Sakai
- Showed some promise as a cultivator with a dual affinity to both demonic and heavenly qi, family was able to afford training with the plan being for him to join the Shogun's forces as a magus
- Spiritual progression stagnated after a few years, he ended up learning various card games to pass the boredom, infused his cards with qi for fun
- He tried incorporating his cards into his fighting style, having a 'game' to play gives him motivation to 'win' without having regards for the actual situation
- He received some training in talismans from his teachers as sort of the closest thing to what he's doing now, and he made a deck out of them
- Is able to make progress again, but the ennui of earlier lingers
- After getting the Goldhearted Treatment, went to Terra to go learn how 'Soul Hacking' worked. Instead ended up ordered by some weird guy to work on growing a heart. This too is cultivation?
Physical Description: 5'11'' horned man with long dark hair and dressed in a simple robe. Figure well-cut when seen. Usually wears a mask. Usually seems a little inattentive.

Name: Takano Akiyama
Identity: Last Scion of a Once-Great Merchant Clan
Known History: The last daughter of the Akiyama clan of Soga, she's been charged to bring fortune and wealth back to her family through travel across Nishibi...and in turn, apparently through other realms as well...?
Physical Description: 5'3", lightweight. She's a small girl who often folds herself smaller, and is often seen with a hinoki box that never leaves far from her grasp. She's also almost never seen without her glasses, which are so thick they obscure her eyes most of the time. In the brief periods they can be seen, her irises are a lustrous gold, almost unnaturally so.

Name: Takaoka Kiyo
Known History:
