Kiyo was born and raised among a small group of tengu. A community of several families, all moving between the smaller mountains abutting the Kald Forest as needed. They brought her up as a devout follower of Kuzunoha, and Kiyo still keeps to that faith today.

Spending many years as a warrior, defending her community and fighting in the War of Fox and Hound. Nearing forty, however, the hatred has guttered. She is tired of conflict and bloodshed, and wants nothing more than for everyone to know peace; to live, and to let live. Nothing could be worth all the pain, the death, all the days and nights spent in terror of enemies finding you, the heartbreak of finding bloody corpses in family homes, of cradling a dying brother in your arms. Nothing. Not even spreading Kuzunoha's beautiful natural order.

After chancing upon the Worldhelm, Kiyo found herself driven to do what she could to help others. Without children or wife, she could leave her community behind for a while, to do her part.
Physical Description:
Height: 6'4" / 194 cm
Wingspan: 10'9" / 328 cm
Eye color: Golden yellow
Hair color: Dark brown / Black
Plumage: Mottled browns
Weight: Much less than you'd think.
Shoe size: Not in stock.

Kiyo strikes an impressive silhouette, even when her prodigious wings are folded in. Her clothing is loose and flowing, ornate but generously layered. Beyond the practical needs of any clothing made on Aldistir, it was made to catch the eye and accentuate movement. Her hair hangs straight and falls halfway down her back. It's usually kept either loose or in a high ponytail.

In contrast to her sheer size, when the shape isn't lost in her dress, her figure is quite slight and willowy. Lanky, really, by all rights *gangling.* Yet in motion she is fluidity and grace, nothing out of place and not a single wasted movement. She always carries herself with elegant poise, as it if is all effortless to her. It's anything but. Still, a tengu has her pride, you know.

Name: Tanamachi Kaoru
Known History: A Swordswoman hailing from Teisei, known for carrying around a large greatsword that is as tall as her, is usually found and seen enjoying some sliced peaches by the wayside - out of sight. She doesn't say much about her life, as if not wanting to remember the past or wanting to make newer memories in the present and future... Strange, is it not? Either way, she isn't one for long dialogue but she won't turn away a potential snack partner.
Physical Description: A 5'3 tall girl with pale white skin, snow white hair, and ruby red eyes. Adorn on the top of her head is two black horns, she has a firm and maintained build that still illustrates a natural figure. Despite her strange physical appearance, Kaoru usually dresses up in traditional Teisei garb - just to feel close to the place she calls home.

Name: Tatsuya Sakanagi
Identity: Idealist Office Worker who Reaches Beyond his Laurels
Known History:
Tatsuya was a very dutiful man. Through long days, hard nights and extended required overtime, he gave long-standing years of hard work to NTTech. Always simply following what was needed to get the work done even if seemingly dubious though never illegal.

As a desk worker by nature he never cared for Temp work. The license he received from the company and the training was purely for the dangerous work.

The steadily growing feelings of discontent within him gave rise to a hidden desire new formed within his heart. He never considered himself to be a good person, and even less so someone who could stick their neck out for others in this city. However, now after the events of Termina City, Infernis' family, Involvement with Ms. Dawnlight and her goals and his previous familial relationships beginning to burn again with his Exwife Ayano and his Son Tetsuo.. His heart is pointed towards doing all he can for all he cares about and he cares about his family, all of his families and Terra.
Physical Description: A 5'10ft man, cleanly shaven and cleanly cut hair. Edged proper to standards of a professional working man. A Serious expression with sullen cheeks as a standard look, making it hard to tell whether or not they are upset about something, sad or otherwise from years of wearing the same look. Beautiful amber eyes dulled by a look of dispassion. While up there in age, maybe due to keeping fit or taking great care of his appearance, he does look maybe a few years younger than he actually is.

Name: Tavian Cole
Known History:
- Grew up in the industrial outskirts of Karlsgard, running with salvage crews.  
- Joined the KPLA as a saboteur and field medic. 
- Spared a young Merrani conscript who now leads an elite strike unit.
- Fiancée Aila, a clever and precise field operative, disappeared during a failed mission.
- Escaped Karlsgard via Realmstorm after Aila triggered a decoy to save him.
- Now among the Goldhearted, motivated by duty and unresolved loss.
- Keeps their old transceiver—silent since Aila vanished.
Physical Description:
- Lean, athletic build with an agile frame
- Tousled brown hair, blue eyes, faint stubble
- Worn brown trench coat over practical field clothes
- Utility belt with reinforced tools, vials, and pouches
- A bow slung across his back
- Expression often distant
- Regularly uses nicotine patches and drinks.

Name: Telerion
Identity: the former fae scout seeking a home.
Known History: He is definitely from the Realm of Fae, but what he was doing on the Woldheim was anyone's guess.
Physical Description:
The figure was humanoid, familiar, but thin like a tree sapling. His finely detailed face seemed sculpted from wood. Telerion's smile was small, soft, and warmed the room. He was not a captivating beauty, yet nothing was plain about him. Even when the slender figure stood still, the ends of the elf's dark hair softly waved like black birch branches in a wind. His sharp ears peeked out from his inky dark hair or held the hair back, which fell to below his shoulders when not gathered up. Something about his gentle voice reminded you of the wind rustling through trees. His laughter was a lilting, merry sound.

When Telerion looked at you, you knew you had his complete attention. The longer people spent with Teleri, as some call him, the more apparent it became he was not from around here.

It is also hard to ignore the rhyming. Telerion didn't speak in verse when surprised, stirred to wrath, or in depths of sadness, but when it happened it marked him as distinctly fae. He hated that.

Name: Tenzin Enkh
Identity: The Clenched Fist Seeking Outstreched Hands
Known History: He used to be a follower of the Empty Monks, who initially took him in and trained him in both cultivation and the ideology of Self-Annihilation at a young age. However over time he deviated in thought and belief due to his own scars and the things he believed he shouldn't let go. Tenzen ran away to escape from the Empty Monks' grasp. Running away into the wilds where he would presumably die over long by their assumption, were he not saved by the Holy Harmony.
Physical Description: He is a tall and weathered looking man, broad shouldered and big stature like someone who was made to crash against rocks. All from his time in the Temple of Fortitude that built up his body to be a walking wall with calloused hands that can crush stone between them. He is 6'4ft and weighing at currently 258.

Name: Tenzin el-Shayekh
Known History:
Tenzin spent his whole life forcibly worked and used as a test subject when it came to more magically dangerous areas. One day, when he was guided into an area of eldritch magic, it reacted to his own capabilities to channel ambient magic seeped into him, vastly changing his internal magical balances and making it difficult to keep himself grounded in the current time, space, and elements. 

This part is fixed now, and he's awkwardly getting used to being in the present; being more connected to people is more difficult than he thinks it would be.
Physical Description: Tenzin is 5'7 (170cm) with a slight build. He has dark skin and now bright white eyes and hair. On the left side of his face is the bright blue scales that showcase a magic user.

Name: Tessa
Known History:
- has been fighting against the Merrane Empire in Lhodos
- her father died in the same war she is now fighting in
- she is a Drake ranked officer in the KPLA
- when she isn't fighting, can often be found smoking or drinking
- has had no relationships, to her mother's chagrin
- loves pancakes, especially chocolate chip
- doesn't really know how to chill
Physical Description:
Tessa has short brown hair, with red highlights in and under her hair. Her amber eyes are usually cold, but soften around kids and the wounded. She normally dresses in a crop jacket, a dark shirt, and jeans, with combat boots. It may not be the most fashionable, but Tessa is most often concerned with practicality.

Tessa is not a tall woman, but her aura speaks for itself. She is commanding, and will do what is needed to accomplish the task at hand. She has spent most of her life in service to the protection of Karlsgard, and would have continued to do so, to protect those who she believes deserve to have a better life. She will unflinchingly protect those who cannot protect themselves.

Reasonable, logical, and relentlessly loyal to the causes she dedicates herself to, Tessa is a force to be reckoned with - both on and off the battlefield.

Name: Teyac
Known History:
Someone an Adventurer dragged into the Guild after chasing rumors of a strange Folkin in some ruins. It turned out to be a very weird Zen with a Folkin mask. Some say they were brought to the Guild to get the mask off their face. But it's clearly still there.

The mouth of the mask seems to open sometimes, and they've been seen "feeding" things to it. They also leave small red beads around. A few of them have magic, so it's best not to touch them.
Physical Description: A young effeminate Zen with a very long mane of white hair, half-wearing a mask that shares their red skin, fangs, tribal markings, and strange eyes. They wear very colorful, attention grabbing clothes with what looks like a juzu bead collar.

Name: Thalia Cornerstone
Known History:
Those who have been around Tradefair 10 years ago have seen a variety of bounties or warnings of a child who was a full-fledged part of a bandit troupe. Now, that same child is now one of their protectors of the city under the Golden Claw mercenaries' supervision. Regardless, to say that the Golden Claw's reputation had taken a plummet when that child was taken in would be taking it lightly. That is Thalia, seeking redemption for her actions, bracing herself for any ridicule, humiliations, or distain that comes across her path as her protects her land and her people.

And she has. Though it did take her family down below and her friends above to finally convince her of that fact. She has protected Kor'tarion time and time again. She's a bandit no longer. Not the ex-villain she made herself to be. A squire under the Marshall himself. A Knight of the Goldhearted Court. A blazing bonfire of Hope. That's who Thalia is. And she wouldn't have it any other way.
Physical Description: A short female human standing at 5'2 with short brown hair and green eyes. She is found consistently in her armor. Though more recently, she has started to come out of her metal shell.

Name: Thamalaine & Thamalina
Other Names:
Thamalain the Broad
Thamalina the Swift
Physical Description: Standing at six and a half feet tall in either form, Tham is a bulky/lithe satyr whose fur ranges from soft golds to fiery reds in a mane-like beard upon his/her chin. They dress in airy, loose clothing, and wrap themselves in ribbons and trinkets meant to catch the eyes of those they dance before.

Name: Thaumasios
Identity: He Who Seeks Beauty In Earth
Known History: Most know of Thaumasios due to his adventures around the archipelago, luring in seemingly random sailors with a song and the temptation see their loved ones in the underwater city Kalios.
Physical Description: Red flowing hair, always carrying a giant lyre as well as having a constant scent of sea breeze.

Name: The Assistant
Age: N/A - They do not seem to age
Known History:
Hailing from the Suntouched Isles of Nezmira, The Assistant awoke with one purpose: to aid, protect, and embetter those around them.
The folks of their home realm seem to disagree with that notion.

With their innate, primordial, magical talent, they can cast a wide variety of rituals and assistive spells, which is surely a boon to those venturing from the Worldhelm. They don't desire fame, fortune, glory, or anything of the sort... what *do* they want, anyway?
Physical Description:
Assistant is 7'8", weighing 319 lbs. They seem to be always cloaked in rocks; though it's unclear where the rocks end and the body begins, this outer coating of rocks seems to differ from day to day.

Though they have no mouth, their "speech" seems to emanate from the crystal embedded in their "face", coming out alongside a low hum.

Art from [Nico Schmieder on Artstation](https://www.artstation.com/ultimakrecia)

Name: TheresioldaGaratsumiYumikoDraugr
Known History: Born to a nomadic clan, this kitsune is used to the frozen hellscape that is known as Aldistir. Having studied the Elemental fusion style with the caravans chieftain, he now seeks to find the meanings for his masters words: If you want to be the strongest, you need to find a purpose for that strength
Physical Description: A small and seemingly fragile looking person, Due to his past he looks extremly effeminate and it would not be wrong to assume he be a woman. A fact he likes, simply because he likes womans fashion more than mens

Name: Theta-13, resident creature #3
Known History: Theta's a government experiment made for military reconnaissance and scouting [aren't those synonyms?],they were created in a lab, a mix of...... so many kinds of DNA. mostly human though, she used to be fully organic but failure after failure led them just replacing more and more of him with robotics, at this point xe's 64.85% mechanical by the time she finds her way onto the worldhelm, they only recently escaped while on a scouting operation, as such she's incredibly paranoid about being re-contained by her creators, which, seeing as they've only been out for a week, is a fairly reasonable fear. it's goal at the current moment is simply "to live" to experience whatever life it has left, seeing as, to her knowledge she'll be dead by 20 years old. in actuality, she will not die at 20 tears old, she somehow broke her bio chip [ever watched the clone wars animated series? remember fives? good, you get the concept] and since that's broken. good news! she is not dying at 20!
Physical Description: 6'2, pale skin, white hair, a thin tail, horns, one green eye one blue eye, pointy ears, it's outfit consists of a sleeveless shirt with basic armour plating over where his guts would be [y'know.... IF IT HAD ANY], as well as heavy duty black pants and combat boots.
Pronouns: anything you can come up with. he's just happy you're treating xem like a living thing.
Species: I mean............. legally speaking it's human? granted it's mixed with so many other species that her dna looks like a mixtape.

Name: Thyra Greco
Identity: Freak who dreams of creating smiles.
Known History:
Grew up on the dystopoian streets of Terra's old mining city Cadre. Orphaned for as long as she could remember. Survived thanks to the community of similar destitutes, orhpans and criminals. Learned to dance for coin and to be a decent street thug.
Kidnapped and experimented on in the Cadre labs for thirteen months.
Caught in a ruinstorm the moment she escaped from said lab and arrived at Worldhelm.
Physical Description:
5'5, dark hair with several red highlights. Green eyes. Usually wears baggy clothing. Left side of her body is twisted amalgom of flesh and metal including a bit of her neck and face on the left side. Dark haired cat tail. Cat ears on her head. modest figure.
(Art is mostly a placeholder. Image to possibly change in time when I can eventually get a commision for it.)

Name: Thyreos
Known History:
- The final Soul Vessel crafted by Hephael, Forge of Mankind.
- A blank vessel of metal, fire and magic given unique form, identity and sentience by the soul that has come to inhabit it.
- Having no memory of its previous life, this fusion of metal and soul was granted the name Thyreos and set upon Arcadia on a journey of growth and definition.
- A mild-mannered creature driven by a protective instinct it does not fully understand. Thyreos has a deep respect for life and endeavors to preserve it at every chance.
Physical Description: Thyreos' body is shrouded in voluminous robes and stands at 7' even in the form of an ivory-furred Minotaur. While lifelike in appearance, the Soul Vessel’s form is notably artificial to the touch and carries a heft that belies its size and shape, weighing around 300 lbs. The warmth of the Forge of Mankind burns eternally within its inner mechanisms.

Name: Théodore Pascal
Known History:
To those in the know, they would hear tales of Eternity's heir being a Leirsin witch who is very skilled in the Thauma and Anima disciplines. During his time before walking the Runewall, they would see Théodore accompanied with the Followers of Eternity, or working with House Lionheart; fighting against monsters or bandits.

Now his reputation varies depending who asks. From very mixed ones in Mastrazs, to generally positive ones in various places like Rocade or western Silverdale. He is a mystery to many in Eurys.
Physical Description:
Théodore is a Leirsin man standing at 6'0" with long white hair, a large spotted leopard tail and rounded feline ears. Golden-yellow eyes that gives off a soft shimmer, with freckles on his face and golden crystals that grow on the side of his face and neck. Wears a set of white long tunic with a golden cape in one arm, with bronze gauntlets.

His vocal pitch is rather soft, much like that of a gentleman. His mannerisms generally polite, moving with certainty and grace. Sometimes prone to emotional outbursts, or engage in banter. He gives a smile when interacting with people, and at times, tries to give an air of confidence.

Name: Tika & Bow
Known History: Tika was an engineering prodigy in Merrane. She's one of the youngest ever to attend the Caldera Engineering Academy, where work for the crown is designed and constructed. When the conquest of Karlgard began, bright minds from Caldera were put to work to win the war, Tika among them. She didn't approve, but she kept quiet and put herself to work on infrastructural studies that could prompt a more peaceful joining of nations. When she presented her findings to the regent, she was dismissed for her dissent.
Physical Description:
This duo consists of a, like, 4'9" pink engineer girl and a cat-size robot that's always either following her around, perched on her shoulders, or folded up into a briefcase somewhere on her person.

Tika's bag has downsized over time, but lots of technology is strewn about her person: a big capacitor on her hip, the butt of a bespoke rifle poking out of her pack, and all the tools somebody might need for impromptu invention.

Name: Tilly Howard
Known History: A third-year Gnosis Academy student and Paladin hopeful, Tilly is an unregistered Steelbin native from the Uncivilized Zone who escaped her fate in order to chase her dreams.
Physical Description:
Standing at 5'6", Tilly's strength is bizarre considering her thin frame and little apparent muscle.

She has light teal dyed hair, green eyes, and is notably missing one of her teeth. Her equipment is ramshackle to say the least, with her preference in weapons often being whatever is the heaviest object she can swing.

Name: Timotee
Known History:
"Growing up in Constance, Timotee never knew war, not firsthand, at least. They had heard of it, sure, but it was nothing more than news and a distant thought. However, Timotee was not someone to stay back and watch, so when they came of age, they decided to take matters into their own hands: they took whatever they could from their lab, their last experiment, their instruments, their notes, anything light enough to be carried, and moved to the front, where they started helping the less fortunate recover when they came back injured from the trenches.
After the ceasefire was signed, they kept working in Vale, until a multicolored storm spirited them away to the Worldhelm...  (powered by 2NA)"
Physical Description: A human with a gentle appearance, almost invisible unless illuminated by sunlight. A very frail body, and the slight curvature of their back makes them even shorter than their already modest height. Luckily, their hat adds a few centimeters, and sometimes even R4 lends a hand

Name: Timothy Maclain
Identity: Near-Legendary Soulrunner Fighting For a Better Tomorrow
Known History:
- Natural proficiency with computers and his own interest lead him to seeking job at SWORD where when working on some project or another he learned how to interact with the Soul Network, began using these skills for backend server work and freelance soulrunning 
- Freelance soulrunner gig went horribly wrong, is not quite sure who gave him the faulty intel but luckily a realmstorm picked him up in the nick of time 
- Since becoming a goldhearted, Timothy has played an instrumental role in the defense of Terra's soul network, most notably as far as the news would be concerned is the Death of Hong Lian (and related activities like the time 4 people jumped out of Baylore Tower and the related heist)
- Since then Timothy has been grappling the weight of effectively inheriting the ideals old man Baylore left behind, there are many ways that could potentially go down but all that's left to do when the man and the one who killed him are both dead is to push forward and trust in our decision
Other Names: Heimdallr (Soulrunner alias that he really sucks at using)
Physical Description: Timothy stands a relatively small and scrawny 5'5ft wearing what can affectionately be described as the cyberpunk equivalent of clothes you would throw on in a hurry to get to to work, glasses and in a sort of retro touch carries a wrist mounted computer despite having access to more efficient cybernetics

Name: Tomiko Umikiri
Identity: A Shelter for the Lost, Locked, and Lonely
Known History:
Tomiko grew up in Ogawa, as an Orphan. Her mother a Kitsune, and her Father dying shortly after her birth. Growing up in a smaller village as a symbol of things people would rather forget, she spent most of her early years alone, scrounging for scraps and living off of the pity of the few people who wouldn't shun her. 

One day, she discovered an old set of cooking utensils, and a bag with an attached cutting board. The spices inside the bag let the young Half-Fox truly experience vibrant flavor for the first time, and she knew then and there she wanted to be a cook, and to share the joy of good food. It took her a good few years to learn to cook, but she eventually became rather good at it.

She truly believes that her good fortune is thanks only to Yebisu, the Kami of Fishing, Alcohol, and Prosperity, and is one of the only few from Ogawa, and most of Teisei, who still show the minor god his due respect and reverence.
Physical Description: Tomiko is a cheery young Half-Yokai, with her prominent blue-tipped ears and tail, which match her eyes. She tends to dress in Oranges and Blues, and coupled with her Medium stature and 5'8" height, makes her stand out in whatever small crowd would arise in Ogawa. She's never seen without her trusty cooking utensils, her precious Chef's Cleaver and Spice Rack.

Name: Tonis
Known History:
Tonis was born a mute in Dryholde, growing up in the orphanage in The White Feather House he struggle at an early age to communicate
with others. However during his teenage years he fell in love with the strings seeing them play at the plaza. Once he started playing the cello himself he became more in tune with the souls of others making it easier to socialize have others understand him...however Tonis realize he was being too much in tune with others that he realize he was showing signs of being a mage. Luckily it was easy for him to hide his magic by just not playing as often as he would have like to however that changed when he was 19 years old. Tonis ended up using spiritist magic to heal a wounded construction worker after an accident, revealing himself as a mage to the public of Dryholde. Acting in haste Tonis had to quickly exile himself leaving his home behind with only his clothes and his cello.  However despite these events he is still very excited to explore the realms!
Physical Description: Blond Pompadour hairstyle with blue eyes. Wears a small goatee and white tattoos on his face.  He also wears a sword earring. His clothing is a simple blue over coat with a feather to its side.

Name: Topal
Known History:
- From a family of transcribers practicing in secret cataloging the atrocities committed under the Maharaja's rule
- Ultimate wish of wanting to serve the Great House of Kalyani
- Purusa (calligraphy) passed and taught as a family practice, but heavily suppressed by the war
- Family Keeping and relaying written records and transcribing copies of poems, scrolls, and cultivation manuals. Some had to be disguised as coded messages through anagrams and cyphers
- Family works discovered by the forces of the Maharaja
- Father killed for practicing Cultivation and Topal was imprisoned 
- Escaped as a refugee and lived in Tulasee Village until the Maharaja was defeated
Physical Description: Slightly above average height, lean build, simple garbs

Name: Torva
Known History: Torva lost his young kits to an Ald warband and he and his mate, Skadi, swore revenge. They took it, but soon they heard the cries of orphaned fox kits - orphans whose parents the same warband took. Torva decided that enough blood had been shed and convinced Skadi to help raise them... just as the warband returned for revenge of their own. Skadi was killed, but as Torva was ready to give his life for the kits, Kuzunoha granted him her blessing. He killed the warband and became the kits' self-appointed father until they grew up and dispersed. He set out looking for more children to look out for when the Realmstorm took him.
Physical Description: A large (about 100cm tall, 150cm long) wolf. He has grey pelt with a lighter grey chest and almost white belly. Near the nape of his neck is a red patch of fur. His eyes are bright red and scrutinizing.

Name: Trif
Known History:
Trif was born in The City of Nest and worked with her father at a young age to maintain the fields or the machines that do so. 
She was raised on company values and often found herself attached to her plants that she had once she was young.
She had made a name for herself, amongst others in various plant bioenginnering projects in Nest though never as the head researcher. Occasionally, she helped fix up any accidents within the workplace, if someone got injured handling a machine and so on and so forth.
And now she finds herself here!
Physical Description: A short 4'10 gal, often found in baggy clothing that hides most of their physique, often stained with dirt given her prior and current occupation.

Name: Trina Fellwar
Known History:
- Born in Wulforh

- Forced to go to Karsbren to work an apprenticeship with a blacksmith from there that worked for The Silver Castrum. Often pressured and overworked.

- Near the end of her apprenticeship, she was given her heirloom which was crafted by her great grandfather. A special garment imbued with intense flames.

- Once her apprenticeship was over, she went back to Wulforh. Learning business from her mother, and eventually finding most her work with The Silver Castrum.

- Father signed her up to go to an expedition through the runewall without her knowing, and thus she went in fear of what would happen if she declined.
Physical Description: A 5'9" tall pale skinned woman, she wears a well crafted and expensive looking set of black and red clothes. Her chest, legs and shoulders covered in various metals for better protection. One of her eyes blue, the other red and with short red hair she's often found with a neutral expression on her face.

Name: Trinity Heartwell
Known History: Known to be a student at hudal academy. New to being goldhearted and was shown the ropes by Dul.
Physical Description: 6 foot tall human male in blue and purple outfit

Name: Tristania - ᵀʰᵉ Measure
Identity: A Tool Chasing A Fairy Tale
Known History: Not much is known about her other than her station as a gilded. Those from the Pavilion or who have frequented Polis after the gilded have arrived could've seen her mending rips or tears in others fabrics. Often traveling with a few others in a small group alongside her brother.
Origin: The Fifth Floor, the Worthworks - The Pavilion - The Heaven's Sea
Physical Description:
Tristania is easily noted as a Gilded from her golden hair. Standing around 5'8 without any accessories to make her seem taller. Usually she is wearing different jewelry or accessories such as detachable horns, make up to add color to her cheeks, or rings/earrings. Besides that, she is usually wearing a necklace depicting scales to show some kind of faith to the Evaluator.

On the other hand, ᵀʰᵉ Measure is a giant pair of shearing scissors that stands roughly at seven feet in length. Around it is golden plants that keep it closed until its needed as a tool for someone else.

Name: Tson Gongn
Known History: He grew up in the mountains of Tanngula, in a secret palace monastery, nestled between two great mountains. Once a seat of power to a great demon king, Niu Gongn, who ruled this valley with an iron fist. He and his wife, Tieshan Gongn, a human sorceress. The Gongn's, hides here. Away from the eyes of heaven, where the traitor sits. The family was once allied to the throne taker, Xiang Shinan, but he betrayed them and took the powers of the demon king for himself. Now this family survives on its ability to kill monsters and offerings from the local village as repayment. For many years, they stayed in the valley, away from the chaos of the world. The demon king and sorceress would eventually have a son, and they decided to train him in the ways of Qi and hand to hand fighting. Tson, their new born child, became a master of fire and martial arts, and a skilled monster killer. He trains to achieve immortality like his parents and then challenge Xiang Shinan. . .
Physical Description: Tson is 5'10. He wears a long read robe with blue pants, and black slippers. He has a pair of black, armless sunglasses. His hair is a blazing red hair an his ponytail moves like flames, pointing up and flickering and moving. On his for head is a Bindi and has pointed ears, signifying his half-yokai heritage.

Name: Tsuihō Hira
Known History:
Tsuihō Hira is a half-kitsune who grew up in the outskirts of Hanae, never been able to truly go into village proper though is not hunted down with a mixture of fear and cautious respect for his natural use of wood qi and healing the injured that comes by, With the Kitsune rejected him for being too young and the Humans out of fear, Hira decides to make a oath to pacifism out of spite to both of them while he tries to understand and learn from both races.

After a few missions with the Goldhearted he has grown a more distaste for violence while still searching where he truly belongs. Inari's Will, Humans. Yokai, or none at all?

Even more missions past as Tsuiho ideals been pushed and challenged from coversating with the Yato no Kami and feeling true care from Inari even when Kitsune despises him. He now meditates on these new revalations to discover his place in this world.
Physical Description: White hair fox ears. Wearing a blue overcoat with a set of flowers on them. (White Anemone)

Name: Tsumugi
Known History: Hailing from Teisei a realm within Tian Yin usually found in the company of a red half-Oni warrior named Kurayamai. Little is known of her past she shares only stories of her time spent with her half-Oni companion gushing over the warrior's prowess.
Physical Description: A pale woman of athletic build, a limber dancer who always paints on a smile. White horns tipped in crimson curl out of a white cropped bob that ombres from pink to red. Red eyes pointed ears She wears a white silk robe covered in a cherry blossom pattern that is trimmed in red.

Name: Tsuru Inoue [井上鶴]
Identity: Dignified Crane of Sincerity and Fluttering Steel
Known History: Tsuru was born to a Samurai and a former Bandit who clashed in battle many times before something changed and they somehow settled down not only together but also she became a part of Clan Ito's military. There are stories about the both of them and their time as well as the lovely little crane they brought into world. The death of her father and injury of her mother was a shock and upset to many but gave rise to Tsuru rising to fill his place and inheriting his honor. She now stands as a Samurai Commander under the Ito Clan's Daimyo, having been elevated to such a point through merit and loyalty.
Physical Description: She stands at 5'7ft tall, very unthreatening looking yet stands with a quiet fire and resolve within her eyes. Not to be taken lightly as she uses her thin and unassuming form to great use as she equally acrobatic to make up for her lack of strength and quick reacting. Her greyish-blue eyes hold nothing close to coldness within them, only honesty and drive.

Name: Tsutsuji
Identity: The Spring Herald of the Feywyrd
Known History: Tsutsuji is the warming breeze, the new life that grows from the fading of winter. Her appearance was first noted three years ago as she appeared in the Feywyrd on what would be the first day of spring, racing a path through the forest with lilies and azaleas blooming in her wake. She creates wild gardens with her natural magic and care, and any who end up within find respite from the bite of the Blood Grotto- lest they seek to trouble the Spring Herald or her wards.
Physical Description: Tsutsuji is a large fox standing 4'2" at her shoulder with pale blue eyes and a pure white coat. However, when flowers begin to bloom across her body, the fur beneath turns an earthy black. She has three ribbon-like tails that float around her and branches that sprout from her head like antlers, flowers often growing upon them. All manner of flora may take root where she once stepped.

Name: Tucker Kawasaki
Known History:
Mr. Kawasaki is a reckless man who is used to facing the consequences of their actions. It's just that its his family who has paid the cost of his mistakes up until now. 
Having gambled most of his savings away, Tucker Kawasaki now works for/around 777LC in Fortune Valley as a Security Detail on temporary contract. He always catches his mark, but the company often hesitates to actually make him work. This bastard costs the company more in damages than what they save by catching someone who thought they could cheat the Company. 

In addition to this main cashflow, he works Odd Jobs across the several territories of Haven, scrounging up what he to pay off his family's debts can before they end up being turned into Insolvents by ET Acquisitions.
Physical Description:
Tucker Kawasaki is an unkempt man who would seem to be homeless if not for the fact that he has a vehicle and the seemingly sufficient cash flow to maintain its performance. A weather-worn trench-coat is layered atop a plain beige button-up and patchy jeans that have been repaired on countless previous occasions.
He has a "gun" on his hip, but it's actually a toy. When activated it unfolds into a portable electronic table for playing card games.

Name: Tylar Lin
Known History:
That one day, Tylar Lin’s life would change forever. It was like any other day, he was working on his family’s farm, trying to meet ends meet, despite all of the trouble Teisei was going through with no Sun… he was truly happy. He had a true love named Mari, and he was going to live an ordinary life.

That was, until a group of Oni attempted to take down Murata for good. Tylar saw Mari get struck down by a cruel and careless Oni, and in that moment… something snapped inside of him. A passion. A light. A want to bring hope and make things right. Picking up the Katana of a fallen town’s guard, Tylar, alongside the assistance of the town’s guard, pushed back the Oni menace.

He had earned the power of the Sun long thought lost in Teisei. After driving the last Oni from the town… he found himself on the Worldhelm, separated from his home.  But with his hope and the power of the sun now in him, Tylar hopes for a future where he can restore the light to Teisei… and eventually returning home.
Physical Description:
Tylar Lin is a 6' 1" man with a lighter medium skin and a thin, but surprisingly bulky stature. He has long, ponytailed brownish hair, a light stubble, and brown eyes.

He wears what mostly looks like standard peasant's garb, but slightly modified with more practical adventuring gear. A gauntlet with shining jewels for his sword arm, a practical waist wrap, and better boots ready him for his journey.

Name: Tyra All-Mother
Known History:
Apart from her parents, Tyra spent all her life in Aldistir being rejected and shunned for her half-blooded nature. Once they passed, she was left alone... just her and the snow. And so she wandered. She wandered until she found company in a fellow outcast, an old witch by the name of Olga, who taught her the blackened art of necromancy.

After some time, Tyra put theory to practice, and put life to the lifeless. With her talents, and some months of work, she created the being who would be her son. Though he seemed monstrous on the outside, she loved him with all her heart.

Recently, after an extended stay with the demon Sanctimony and their cult, Tyra has found a measure of confidence. Should the world shun her for her being, then let them do so. But never will she hide herself again.

Recently, her antlers were taken from her by the Aesir Kuzunoha, now she wears them as magical charms at her belt.
Other Names:
The Corpse Witch
Tyra Godbinder
Tyra Halfborn
Physical Description:
Tyra is an odd woman, standing at 6' with a build that ends up just on the chubbier side. Unlike before, she bares her arms and scars proudly, no longer will she be shamed for her past, not her present. She is covered in Aldistiri runes and tattoos, and scars from battle and blood sacrifice. Her cheek is marked with the brand of the archdemon Sanctimony, and her hair is tinged with gold and an otherworldly teal. Now missing her right eye from a deal, she has covered it with a simple patch.

Her 'son', Utsuki Halfborn, is a hulk of a man, some eight feet tall with dark hair and fair skin. His flesh is marked across with stitches, and even though he doesn't talk much, there is a doubtless innocence in his eyes.

Name: Tzera Crawford
Known History: She might have been heard of as one of the captains of the White Saber mercenary group. A group of swords for hire that tended to move towards more organized monster exterminations for large cities. However no one has heard from them in months after they took a mission in the far north.
Physical Description: A tall red haired woman with pointed wolf ears on the top of her head that seem to constantly be shifting towards the nearest sound. Her long mane of red hair is scruffy and full of split ends that seem to curl upwards. Her figure is on the more muscular side with thick arms and legs that are usually covered by the dark tunic and pants that she is wearing.

Name: Ursann, son of Ursoc
Identity: Outcast With A Heart Of Gold
Known History: Born of two worlds, he grew up knowing what it meant to be cast aside at an early age. Even as tragedy shadowed his youth, he remained open-hearted, offering help to any who needed it—from mercenary work to quiet acts of kindness. In time, he wove magic into his art, drawing the attention of higher powers. But as tensions deepened between the peoples of his blood, his family fractured, and his mother disappeared into the Sea of Blizzards. Determined to mend what was broken, he sought to heal the divide and joined a wandering company with the same dream. He nearly lost his life in the effort—only to be pulled back from the brink by the worldhelm, as a storm engulfed him.
Physical Description: Ursann is a massive man even for an ald, standing at roughly seven and three feet (222 centimeters), sporting a muscular build with pale skin and short, spiked platinum blonde almost white hair. He wears a fur-lined, open black jacket that reveals his heavily scarred torso, fastened with several diagonal leather straps housing his carving knives. His fur pants are dyed black and strapped at the thighs, tucked into fur-trimmed boots. His gauntlets are heavy and metallic, matching the massive weapons he usually utilizes. Despite all this and his overall aggressive visage Ursann is rather approachable.

Name: Uto Masahide Miyabi [宇土 将秀 雅]
Known History:
He was once a captain of the Imperial Guard, but when the Shogun took control of the Guard, he had been unable to stop it. The signs were all there, but he couldn't figure them out fast enough.

Instead of doing the honorable thing and sacrificing his life, he decided to flee. He escaped the clutches of the Shogun and the Empress by hiding out in Ishihara, where he learned to trade as a merchant. His skill with the blade lessened, but he gained several new skills. Hopefully those will be of use in the days to come.
Physical Description: Tall at 6'2", Masahide is well muscled, clearly working out beyond just stacking boxes in his store. A katana's hilt seems to constantly be at his side, and his build suggests he knows how to use it. He has black hair and always has a bit of stubble on his chin. His amber eyes have a hint of mischief within their intelligent gaze.

Name: Val "Maestri" Tamboia
Identity: Rockstar that'll help those in need
Known History:
- Underground guitarist, playing Heavy Metal and Rock songs, either his own creations or covers of existing musics. 
- Offered money and some services for him to play on stage, tends to stay at local underground bars, due to the regulations Spark-220 has on music. 
- Learned the techniques from his father, Mr. Spanò, and has been growing his music career and reputation, using part of his earnings to donate to charity.
- During one of his shows, he overheard 2 SWORD affiliated workers talking about something they've had taken from someone and contained: A guitar with the power to give hope to those that hear its songs. It was still incomplete, with missing key components that may make it malfunction
- He would then devise and execute a plan to take back the guitar. All was going right, until he jumped out of a window and was taken by a Realmstorm by sheer chance. Now he has enemies, people in need and fans waiting for his return. "Operation Mindcrime" was playing during this invasion.
Physical Description: Sits at 5'10" and 186 lbs, wears a heavy metal-themed attire with a vest, jeans, boots, earings and a choker

Name: Valen
Known History:
Born to the unforgiving lands of Aldistir, Valen was no different than the land itself. From an early age the lands taught him that the strong endure and this was drilled into him every day as he was being molded to be one worth remembering.

His father, Erik the Fierce, was the person that pushed him the hardest and Valen looked up to him as a role model. His tales of valor and combat told by anyone that trained him to be a warrior of his father's caliber. 

Reality reared it's head, in his 15th year of life his home was raided by Yokai seeking to eliminate them for their resources. Valen joined his father and the other warriors, and in this battle he saw why his father earned the title "The Fierce" as he stuck close to his side and did his best to imitate him. Valen fell in battle and the last sight was his father fighting alone against hordes of Yokai.

He awoke alone in the still simmering fires of his home, his father gone and the only thing he can do is be ensure the strong live.
Physical Description: Tall, pale skinned man and with scars, his brown eyes holding the burning signs of life in them. His no sign of facial hair along with little signs of aging in his face betrays his age allowing many to see his youth.

Name: Valen Bell
Known History: Valen Bell was born and raised in Ironholde living a laid back life living with his father and working as a guard and had plans on moving to Brightshield. Though sadly his planned trip was over before it even began when he got the news of his father's death when he was late to his post.  Valen was succumbing to grief until he took a chance in joining a church belonging to the rising Goddess Atee in which they welcomed him with open arms. After being converted and having a new view on life Valen sets out past Ironholde on a pilgrimage to protect the innocents while also spreading the word about the Goddess!
Physical Description: White hair novice looking male guard wearing outdated armor with a sword and shield.

Name: Valentin Bernstein
Known History: It is apparent at first glance that Valentin still carries his former profession as a butler with him. He is open about the fact that he used to serve as one from his home in Terra.
Physical Description: Valentin is a 6'4'' tall augmented human, likening the appearance of an anthropomorphic tiger. His fur has an orange/cream tone. Usually he is clad in a tidy and expensive-looking suit, as well as a few distinct adornment, such as his gold necklace that holds a beautiful amber gemstone in it. Valentin's posture is quite proper and polished, adding to a perhaps imposing impression at first sight.

Name: Valentine O'Loshio Torres
Known History:
Valentine grew up with a wonderful life in the city of Rachet. He loved the Merrane Empire and it's entirety, eventually going to school in Korala in hopes of helping the army as an engineer. That wasn't the only appeal though. Valentine felt a physical pull, a buzzing feeling since he was a kid that drew him to electronics.

After two years Valentine established themselves as a party animal. They worked in a bar for awhile and after justifying the Empire's actions received a quick punch to the face. It was that day they learned the truth and spiraled into depression. 

A year went by where Valentine relied on the genetic buzz to feel good. He gambled harder, felt better, and slowly crawled himself out of depression. He then took things into his own hands, writing papers to spread the word before getting shut down by authorities. Valentine agreed to stop, but if his papers were getting torn down he'd tell them in person. He opened the door to leave to Rachet and was suddenly here.
Physical Description: Valentine is adorned with a beautifully made suit matching accessories of all varieties. They're so invested in their appearance Valentine's yellow eyes are hidden by red contacts, and they even sport a makeup filled red heart to seem "memorable". When excited their slim body sometimes produces a slight hum, electric sparks flashing between their fingers hair and eyes.

Name: Valerie Knight
Known History:
- Born in North Rock with an absentee mother, an abusive father, and a little sister named Riley. Learned to be protective of her little sister. Father died when she was 18,

- Learned to pick up the slack financially for her little sister, hoping to scrounge up enough money to get by and get her sister a proper education with how talented she was.

- Got mixed in with the wrong crowd, soon she was doing any job she could get. Hoping that she could retire once Riley made a lot of money

- Found a stray by the name of Ozzy, saved him from being sent to juvenile prison and took him in.

- Only got more unhappy as she watched her sister and brother idolize her, but stayed on this path until it eventually killed her.

- She was brought back as an insolvent, swearing to herself that she could make an honest living now with her death wiping her slate clean. Takes any odd job she can get her hands on as long as it isn't too shady.

- Was taken by a Realmstorm along with her two siblings
Physical Description: Valerie is a large frame with a lax and aloof posture. Standing at 6'3 (190 CM), she dwarfs most other people around her. She is very visibly an insolvent, having pale skin and crimson eyes. In spite of her now lacking a need for sleep, the signs of her mistreatment of her body are still visible, under her eyes are large dark circles, and any skin that is normally covered with her business-wear usually have some sort of painful looking scar. Other distinctive features are a sharp metal tail, and a pair of pointy horns on the top of her head. She tends to wear a consistent wardrobe of professional attire, with the only changing up between her outfits tending to be the color of her tie.

Name: Valissa Eden
Known History:
Valissa joined in with 100G Security right out of high school in Haven, after her parents were tragically murdered by an unlicensed magic user just before her graduation. Wildly successful at her job, she became a top employee in no time, under the mentorship of another contractor by the name of Jade McCarthy. 

Good work means good pay, and she had all sorts of vices at her disposal to try and bury the pain of losing her parents over the following years, including getting her magitech wings installed. Over time, her and Jade became *very* close as the two fell in love. 

This ended when Jade was suddenly killed at the hands of whom authorities believe were Vignettes. While the investigation remains open, Valissa has grown cold and distant to those around her since then. She was relegated to a graveyard shift, where upon discovering an anomaly above the building, encountered a realmstorm.
Physical Description: Valissa Eden is a 5'9" /  175cm human with fair skin, red eyes, and wavy black hair that falls to her shoulders. She is fit with visible muscle tone. She has visible scars on her body, and a tattoo that runs across her chest and shoulders. Most notable are her prosthetic magitech wings protruding from her back. Two main thrust units provide flight, and several maneuvering thrusters give her agility. The wings emit a soft blue glow.

Name: Vanigad Ensed
Identity: Temporal Trickster of the Fallen God
Known History: A follower of the fallen god in Aldistir, Vanigad just kind of showed up. He said he was a warrior, but he uses no axe. He said he was a hunter, too, but his archery skills are odd. No one recognized him, and no one could tell exactly where he was from. But whenever someone thought they had him figured out, he would be gone before they knew it.
Origin: Forgotten Shrine to the Fallen God, Aldistir
Physical Description: A little shorter than average at 5'8", Vani carries himself tall and proud. He has short blonde hair and tends to wear comfortable and well-worn gear suitable for his frozen homeland, though he likes to keep a set of nicer clothing for walking about, and he wears an eyepatch over one eye. His irises seem to shift in the light, so the color is difficult to pin down, but he always has a smile on his face, as if he knows a secret no one else could ever guess.

Name: Vanille Kuylenberg
Known History:
Although Vanille was an adventurer in her younger years, she retired at 19 due to a severe injury. She settled down in Dryholde, where she would eventually marry her husband Arthur and have a son, Donovan. Arthur made his living as a monster hunter, and Vanille found fulfillment in turning the spoils of his hunts into incredible home cooking. Life had its struggles, but the family found their way together.

That all changed a year ago, when a monster attack beset the village of Dryholde. In the chaos, Vanille was separated from Arthur and the then 13-year-old Donovan, and she was knocked unconscious. When she came to the following morning, she found no trace of her family. Since then, she's trained her body and her techniques to once again take up adventuring.

Now, Vanille has found her son - under the name Marcelo Brightshield, the young king, a pawn for the Merchant with no memory of his mother. She will do whatever it takes to see him safe, and get revenge on those who hurt him.
Physical Description: Vanille is a somewhat petite woman, who would only be about 5'2" if she could stand. She has no use of her legs and so is always found in a wheelchair, either a ruggedized one for adventuring or a more basic one for more domestic affairs. Despite her disability, however, she maintains a strong physique, displaying lean muscles in her arms and upper body, though these are usually covered by her modest clothing.

Name: Vant Russel
Known History:
- Once a devout warrior of the Sündisznó, Vant survived countless cycles and wars, earning a fearsome reputation among the Ironbrood... before leaving it all behind.
- Decades of ritual slaughter hollowed his devotion. What was once glorified as "divine struggle" revealed itself as bloodshed without purpose.
- By 37, Vant abandoned the Thorn Dominion amidst a territorial conflict to flee to Veyrhold.
- At first he meant to disappear. But among humans, he found new purpose: to be useful without violence, and to live without proving his worth through blood.
- Seeking to control his lycanthropy, Vant became entangled with supernatural incidents across the city.
- Reports spread of a man clad in silver jewelry and ritual markings protecting civilians and resolving threats. The SIA took notice. Soon apprehended, Vant chose to join them.
- Now a DSE field investigator, he tracks and contains supernatural threats before they escalate. During a mission, he ended up pulled into a Realmstorm.
Physical Description:
Vant is a tall, broad-shouldered man with a heavy, weathered build, his posture subtly coiled as if keeping his frame held in check. He has dark, slightly silvered hair that falls in rough, loosely kempt layers, and tired hazel eyes flecked with dull gold. A jagged, claw-marked scar cuts across the right side of his face, joined by several smaller marks scattered over the rest of his body. 

He dresses in a long, worn coat over a button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, suspenders, slacks, sturdy boots and a loosened tie. His hands and shoulders are often wrapped in bandages, and over his neck and wrists sit solid silver shackles etched with runic script, joined in turn by smaller silver piercings lining his ears and nose.

Name: Ven & Vid
Known History:
Cogitav was once a powerful demon. With its particular mastery over void qi, separating its victims' souls from their bodies, it terrorized the populace.
It never anticipated the advent of the Empty Monks - particularly one by the name of Ergo Nonsum.

After long duel, Cogitav finally landed the killing blow - but only as its opponent landed their own.
With Ergo able to turn Cogivatv's soul-rending against it, both of their souls got separated from both their bodies.
The maelstrom of shattered souls and bodies eventually settled down into a humanoid figure with an amalgam of souls combined into this gestalt of something entirely new, containing fragmented memories and traits of their components.

This gestalt soul wanders the land, trying to understand other creatures, their Qi, and how they all intertwine.
True to their origins, they excel at draining life energy and turning others' strengths against them - though they can infuse others with excess energy if necessary as well.
Physical Description:
Ven is 6'0", weighing 136 lbs. They seem to be frequently tired, though they frequently look around to gauge their surroundings.

Vid is a small, dark sphere with a single yellow light in the center. It seldom leaves Ven's side, floating around them and acting as their form of speech.

Name: Venus Nightingale
Known History: While Venus herself wasn't very well known, her family on the other hand was known to be a supplier of many artifacts found around Lhodos. Though during operation mute she was taken in by Merrani scientists. Transferred to Korala for some experiments with her lineage and blood. Being grafted with a tail from a Dhaka Colossi. Many years later she is then transferred to the Heaven's Gate for safe keeping due to an incident resulting in some scientists deaths.
Physical Description: Venus stands at an average five foot and five inches tall. Though her skin is paler than the normal person. Being stuck in an research base for most of her life caused her growth to be stunted though luckily some took pity on the small girl. Giving her the luxuries of being able to pick out her own outfits or dye her hair. Most of this cause her to have an attitude of little to no care about what happens around her. Additionally a large tail like hook now follows behind her. "Fang" comes out of her body like a tail. Though it quickly turns more into a scythe as you reach the end of it. Four deep blue eyes often dart around to find the nearest thing of value.

Name: Vera Thorne
Known History: Vera used to be apart of the army of Mastrazs. He conscripted when he was 17 years old, he had lied about his age. At first, everything was well. However, calamity hit and much of Vera's comrades were slain. He felt powerless, after years of war and tragedy. Vera deserted the army, having doubt in the stability of the kingdom and himself. The kingdom had spent so much time arguing with other kingdoms that they could not mount a proper defense against the threats. Such pointless lives lost for seemingly no reason. Vera began to detest the higher class, the nobles who sit and play, eat, drink, and are never in danger. He left for the runewall after deserting.
Physical Description: Vera is a brown skinned man with dark hair, shaved on the sides. He is a human who stands around 6'1. Weighing roughly 180lbs. He doesn't smile often but he'l quip from time to time. He means well.

Name: Verdugo
Identity: Duelist of instinct and the wind
Known History: A known Duelist from Lhodos with an unusual connection with the elements that he seems to keep hidden seemingly out of habit. mostly relying on instinct and melee weaponry paired with his passive observation and spacey expression he is often underestimated by his challengers. He prefers to be on the side of justice and often refrains from engaging enemies unless they are caught red handed breaking the law or if said enemy attempts the first attack and he must stand his ground
Physical Description: 5' 10" with a split aesthetic the white and gold representing the "good" side of justice such as returning stolen good or zennit to their original owner or breaking up a bar fight, but the red and black side to represent the "dark" side of justice such as carrying out a death sentence for a known killer, or fighting back against assassins sent after him. with more loose or comfortable clothing his movements remain unrestricted and allow "flowy" or "smooth" movements to be done easier a rapier to accompany his swift and adaptable fighting style

Name: Verge Forrester
Identity: Merciful Protector of the Natural World
Known History:
Verge was created as part of an experiment by Dr. Howard Forrester of Parabellum in order to assist in subduing and capturing dangerous monsters.  She developed a close relationship with her creator, however, for unknown reasons she was sold to Tubal and Cain, where she was abused and used for weapons testing.  After a full year she escaped, slaughtering her way through the corporate lab until she was chosen by the Worldhelm.  Verge seeks to find Dr. Forrester for answers on why she was betrayed, and if she so decides, revenge.

After a mission from the Worldhelm, Verge confronted Forrester and made peace with him before his death.  She returned with two sisters:  the Doctor's birth daughter and another living weapon created off his research.  She also gained an understanding that she had friends among the Goldhearted and didn't have to be so alone.

She currently works under AGES.
Physical Description: Verge is a tall, dark-haired humanoid with pale skin and red eyes.  Her limbs and a portion of her face and torso are covered in dark purple scales.  Her hands and feet end in sharp black claws.  Her most obvious feature is a massive second set of limbs that grow from her back which she can morph into different appendages.  She wears form fitting tactical armor and black half-rim glasses.  Verge has a calm and unintentionally menacing demeanor.  She is poorly socialized and can come across as cold.

Name: Vespa
Identity: Scholar of the Past on a Mission of Altruistic Discovery
Known History: An orphan she grew up on the streets of Windhaven her quick wit and keen eyes kept her out of trouble and once she found Brody he kept her safe. Once she was old enough she found work on expeditions until she could fund her own spending her time exploring ruins. When it came time to fight in the rebellion she did not hesitate, and seeks to discover new ways of helping anyone she can to this day.
Physical Description:
Hair: Curly Brown
Eyes: Blue
Skin: Freckled & Sunkissed
Height: 5'7"

A woman of average build usually sporting a collared shirt and bracers attached to well worn pants tucked into boots. 

She is never without her loyal hound Brody ever at her side.

Name: Victor Cassidy
Identity: Self-Righteous Outlaw Taking Things Into His Own Hands
Known History:
- Helped run a General Store in Eckard's Rise with his family, Business collapsed
- Traveled to New Jamestown looking for work, ran afoul of some cheating gamblers and decided to challenge them head on, claims to have encountered Stinger
- Since that day Victor has been trying to take justice into his own hands, much to the chagrin of the Sheriffs
- Got taken by a realmstorm mid confrontation with another known outlaw that was scamming people
Physical Description: 5'11 ft (180.34 cm) man of fairly average build wearing fairly typical cowboy attire, is very rarely seen without his trusty revolver or a deck of cards

Name: Victoria Kaur
Known History:
To the people of Western Silverdale, the name Kaur is generally associated with Nefius Kaur, the acting governor of Wimcomb. It is known she has a young daughter. It is also known that this young daughter was exiled for a failure that saw good men killed.

What is not known is why, and certainly neither Nefius or her exiled daughter are about to speak on that...
Physical Description:
Victoria stands at a rather short 5'4. She has a lithe, athletic build, meant more for running and endurance than raw strength or power. This useful for her most practiced ability - running away.

Victoria has a significant aura of melancholy about her. She very rarely smiles, she almost never laughs. And her existence on the Worldhelm has only exacerbated these feelings.

Name: Vigo Mortenkaisen
Known History:
Vigo grew up in Brightshield, as a member of a small aristocratic house focused on the way of the blade. From a young age, she was trained with all manner of weapons and tactics, from swords to blunt weapons, and all sorts of combat strategies. Upon reaching her 21st birthday, as was custom for her house, she set out to make a name for herself, and would only return to claim the family name after doing so. She took the name Mortenkaisen, and now seeks to improve her skills out within the world.

A lot has happened for Vigo since she's left home, but most of the time she's been quietly supporting in the background. After all, even when others have been called forth on quests and trials, someone has to look out for those who don't receive the help they need.
Physical Description: Vigo is 5'10", with blond hair and brown eyes. She has a slim frame, but that misleads from the years of built muscle. Though she often is seen wearing armor and carrying her weapons, she has been occasionally seen wearing casual clothing.

Name: Vik (Vicorious) Aracar
Known History:
Vik devoted his life to being a helper. He worked as a tattoo artist, community worker, and occasionally even a hunter against Draugr in Aldistir. He fell behind in his hunting career as his merchant life developed, so to aid him in his adventures Vik was gifted a magical crossbow from his father. This crossbow was stolen from a mage, and one day Vik came back to see his father brutally murdered. It was a spontaneous discovery that shocked Vik so much that he packed what little of his things he had and left camp to clear his head. He ultimately couldn't find his way home and starved in the cold.

Vik awoke on a ship he didn't think he belonged in. People were kind where he was harsh, accepting while he was judgmental, and so skillful where he only had a few items. Since his adventures on the Worldhelm Vik has learned that his disliking to non-Alds was misplaced, and tries to build others up like they have helped him.
Physical Description: Vik has a medium build but broader frame at 6'2 (short for an Ald) and has slightly messy long white hair. They generally travel light with a flowy outfit to show off their multitude of tattoos spanning his body. His smile is usually noticeably small but his eyes are approving, offering his support with a stern face. This merchant sports a heavy crossbow across their back with faint orange runes carved into it and always walks with the sound of clinking potions in their bag.

Name: Viliana Atent
Known History:
- 3rd eldest child of one of the current Prime Chroniclers.
- Seen as both one who has potential to become a Chronicler and someone to has no drive to learn something practical at the same time.
- Thanks to this potential she underwent the trials and succeeded in being able to access the power in her bloodline.
- She will follow the strangest threads in pursuit knowledge for her own goal of trying to make the "perfect" world, following-up on the strangest threads of knowledge.
- The strange energy coming from the chamber of The Black Tear though? That seems to be the first serious thing she wanted to help look into.
- It would be during this a spark of energy would engulf and bring her to the Worldhelm.
Physical Description: Viliana is a woman with mid-length hair, with bit of red. Wears gothic style dresses typically in black and red of color. Finds herself easily cold while at rest, so its not uncommon to also see her with a large jacket.

Name: Viola Molie
Identity: Dead Girl Shackled to Her Name
Known History:
Viola is a younger vampire but has taken her role as Steward seriously as she made her second life in Veryhold. She worked simple jobs that integrated her into the infrastructure and took on any task given to her.  In playing her part, she even played a part in a romantic endeavor that ended abruptly.

Now, though, she is tasked to work with the man from her past again to find a forsaken vampire that has caused issues for the tribes as well.
Physical Description: A 5'2 woman with light hair, she often is dressed in finer clothing but rarely anything with much note. She is rarely one to do anything to bring attentions to herself, but she seems to hold herself with something one can consider discipline.

Name: Viola Zabala
Known History:
Born into the lesser nobility family Zabala within Nezmira's rigid hierarchy, Viola led a charmed and privileged life. She was a bright, cheerful, and obedient child, embodying the ideal daughter, never giving her parents reason for disappointment or tears. If she ever made a misstep, she’d quickly confess, seeking absolution with an innocence that only won her more favor. 

This honesty, combined with her privileged upbringing, afforded her a quality of life beyond the reach of most outside Nezzim. Her parents, known for their generosity, even showed kindness to their slaves. A rare quality that led to their reputation as the "belles of the ball" as it were. Their halls had no room for talk of rebellion or animosity; all was safe, serene, and far removed from danger. 

That was, until the fires of rebellion began to rage across Nezmira. Viola may be unprepared for the cost of what lies ahead, but she’s determined to help restore the harmony she once knew.
Physical Description: Standing at 5'10" with a slender, serpentine frame, she has a body adorned with smooth white and peach-colored scales, accented by aquamarine markings along her ribs and tail. Her eyes are a striking rose-red, and she typically wears light armor in shades of white and gold, leaving her midriff exposed for a balanced blend of elegance and agility.

Name: Violet
Known History:
- Carmelita Aneta, codenamed Violet, was adopted by elite assassins after her parents' death and raised by a brutal mentor named Yori.

- Trained to suppress her emotions and become a ruthless killer, Violet harbored resentment toward her mentor.

- She seized the opportunity to betray Yori when a - group of Vignettes was tasked with eliminating her, killing Yori with a single shot.

- Violet was taken in by another Vignette member, who taught her hacking skills in addition to her combat training.

- After connecting with 100G officers, she became a Vignette assassin, eventually rising to become the right-hand woman of a 100G higher-up.

- As per recent events she's fully gone through a Full Makeover! Changing herself via Body Modifications. She now looks more distinguished. Now sporting a more beautiful outfit with a white coat representing her position in 100G. However remnants of her previous style still stand as her purple tips on her hair have now become the color under her hair!
Physical Description:
Violet/Carmelita stands at 5'7", with striking white hair colored with purple on the inside. She wears a sleek white coat over her whitish blue top sporting a more fanciful outfit and somewhat buisness like outfit. Fit for a chieftain of 100G.

Always ready for action, Violet carries two pistols holstered at her sides. Her stylish appearance blends cold professionalism with deadly efficiency.

Name: Viridian „Song“ Leafsong
Known History:
Viridian always possessed a gift for transformation—turning one thing into another and crafting beauty as he saw it. So when his corner of the Faerie realm found a connection to a location near Tradefair, it felt natural to establish „The Verdant Thread & Vial“. The shop became a haven where travelers could rest, drink, and smoke while browsing his alchemical creations and finely tailored garments. It was also an effortless way to collect names, thanks, and apologies.

Perhaps it was too easy. Over time, Viridian grew careless. One fateful day, his recklessness cost him dearly: a powerful fey stole his true name. Ensnared by an enchantment, he was left unaware of who had taken it, and even worse, he was rendered incapable of speaking his full name. Now, he goes by the fragments "Song" or "Green" and devotes himself to the quest of reclaiming what was stolen.
Physical Description: On first glance the 6 feet tall Viridian could easily be mistaken for your average layed back human rocking a hippy vibe but the closer you look at him the clearer you can see hints of his fae nature. His long green hair that is braided in some parts turns into plant fibers on some parts, his iconic clothing has slightly moving patterns and his hookah often by his sides changes the color of the smoke coming out.

Name: Vista Wynn
Known History:
Vista took up the role of croupier in one of Tradefair's more seedy gambling dens, in the hopes of fleecing some hotshot, big-name, more-money-than-sense merchants out of their zenit. It's not like they were using it, after all!

After some time, though, she realized that the more frequent customers were those who were already down on their luck, those in deep debt, who had already exhausted most means of recovery and were resorting to the riskier options - shady jobs, gambling, crime.

Vista was already able to bend her own luck when the time called for it. She couldn't change others', not like that. Not the way they needed it.

And when opportunity knocks, she flung the door open. Aboard the Worldhelm, all she wants is to make a decent living. Not necessarily an *honest* one, mind you - old habits die hard - but an above-board one.
Physical Description:
Vista is 5'3", weighing 159 lbs. She is always dressed smartly, though her outfit is loose enough to move about comfortably, and so she can have cards up her sleeves - both literal and figurative.
When the chips are down, she has her lucky dealer's visor, which might be a bit more special than just some purple-tinted eye cover...

Art from [very_ito on Twitter](https://twitter.com/very_ito/status/1404052790582792199), edited by Sawzie

Name: Vital Courtemanche
Known History:
A young man who was disowned by his merchant family due to his antics. The cutthroat trade didn't suit him, and he grew aloof as a result. After some chance encounters with a mysterious woman, his eyes were opened to the wonders of life. Leaving his old life behind, he struck out to bask in and protect the beauty of the world. During his travels, he thought he'd caught a glimpse of the woman once more. Chasing after her, he got lost in the forest; when he emerged, he found himself in a settlement he'd never seen before: the Worldhelm.

-# For the long version, click [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/16E8FNRhRRuiEzTH5sF8w6eKL7dKQdTc-mzFLBzS47l8/edit?tab=t.0)
Physical Description:
Bearing pale skin and porcelain hair, Vital's appearance—coupled with his lean build and agile fighting style—is what had initially earned him the ring name of "The Bantam Phantom". Standing a little below average the height of the average male in Kor'Tarion, his smaller frame gives him more boyish than princely vibes. This is partially offset by the great care he takes in his appearance; the greatest expense in his budget is in his wardrobe, spending a large amount of his funds to keep his attire fresh and dapper.

Despite his attempts to seem like the suave and sophisticated hero like the ones out of the stories, he always comes off as the more fresh-faced and earnest sort. It does nothing to diminish the obvious confidence in his gait, but it denies him the aura of maturity he desires.

Name: Vivian Ashblanc
Known History: Born to the Ashblancs in Dryholde, Vivian lived her life happily betrothed to Ronan Ashwynd. Hunters of the night, trained, tempered, ready to fight alongside the Ashwynds against the monsters that would bring ruin to the pockets of humanity across Kor'tarion. All that was changed when Ronan was cast out, and Vivian was nearly killed by a Moonshard monster as she pursued him, left infused with ice magic as she was taken home. She was sent to Hudal academy for years to deal with this new curse, only for her life to be upended once again at the blood moon. Surviving and fighting off demons, she returned home- only to find Dryholde shattered, house empty, and her family missing.
Physical Description: Vivian stands at an average height of 5'6", a lean figure draped in lightweight hunting gear of mixed leather and cloth with a black mantle edged with black feathers over her shoulders. A feather pendant rests perpetually over her chest, tied with old leather. Pigment seems to be lost in a patch on the right side of her face and on other parts of her body,  interspersing her dark brown hair with locks of white with patches of skin bleached of color. Her right eye has a layer of ice over it, leaving the iris only faintly visible, but her unaffected eye is an inky black.

Name: Void
Known History: Found in a lab within the depths of Termina City, only released recently with the advent of a realmstorm picking him and his fellow experiment up. A moonfallen-human hybrid made by the hands of Baylore and a twisted 'mother' in Zenith.
Physical Description: A chitinous carapace covers much of Void's form including over where their mouth should be, carved or broken in places until it seems somewhat like clothes, it does seem to require constant maintenance  for it not to grow too far or grind against the ground. Between cracks in the carapace or even on the exterior is the same purple eye that rests across his form, always staring in the surrounding area or focusing on whoever Void may be interacting with at a time. A tail along with four or so tendrils each begin to form a sharp claw, grasping at nothing as if the tendrils themselves are exploring the surrounding area.

Name: Void Thunderstar
Known History:
-An orphan born in the Southern Colonies, learned to work, steal and survive by any means available, learning early in his life how to control and charge electricity into different objects.
-For that reason he ended up working for Nova Wardrobes at a special space suits, accessories and gear workshop in Silver rock until he decides to try to make the Southern colonies a better place for the creatures.
-While living and surviving on the colonies, understanding each biome and necessity for the creatures, he suddenly discovers that NTTech also sells creatures no matter what purpose they're being bought for.
-Void decides to try to sabotage or maybe even stop any attempt of selling creatures.
-5 years later, he's sucked into strange storm in one of his expeditions, and expands his motivations to protect any creature and lifeform from the Realmstorms.
Physical Description: A white-haired young human male with average size and weight, brown skin, grey eyes and usually uses a lose ponytail. Was born with a natural affinity to electricity and can sense storms. Usually wears black clothes that favor stealth, the suit and weapons can be charged with its own electric power (neon-blue light). The main weapon he uses it's his Neo-Wakizashi, the color of the blade and the hilt can change depending on the elemental power it carries, if it's "turned off" it emits no colorful light and is completely black instead.

Name: Vuk Yekno
Known History: Born in The Scalefire Empire never knowing his mother or father, Vuk has lived his life seeking friends and family. Only thing he knows about his parents is one of them most have been an elemental. His dark red hue scales that always seem to be admitting heat from his body that burns red hot when near any fire source or when overexcited. With people seeing his,  he was seen as an asset for harsh environments that other's may not be able to deal with. With the harsh life that comes with  living/going outside the Empire walls Vuk has had to train and be as tough as possible. At a young age Vuk joined up  with guards, soldiers and mercenaries to gain experience in combat and working as a unit to protect the people he calls family.  With his training he has vowed to protect and see to it that young kids have a bright and happy future. Vuk wants to see kids  have a better childhood than he had going to great lengths seeing to it. Vuk travels the world helping who he can.
Physical Description: Vuk comes in at an immense 7ft 4in, weighing 457 pounds with a dark red hue coming off  his dark green scales and white underbelly. His bright red eyes that that seem to have a fire  burning in them have people avoiding eye contact. People take one look at Vuk and see a massive,  scary and intimidating fellow. Anytime he opens his mouth to talk or eat you can see a small white cloud of smoke leave his mouth. His temper sometimes gets the better of him as he is  impatient and makes snappy judgments. You will never see Vuk without a cigar, even well sleeping.

Name: Wanderer
Identity: Wandering Paladin who believes in Good
